rule: A field is published only where it rests on one tier-1 source (government, immigration authority, official gazette or statute text) or two independent agreeing tier-2 sources (law firm or established specialist outlet). Tier 3 is agency or marketing material and is never sufficient. Fields that could not clear that bar are marked not established in place rather than filled with a best guess; where the threshold itself was unestablished the programme was moved to `excluded`. Wikipedia was not used.
rule_zh: 單一欄位僅於具備一筆第一級來源（政府、移民主管機關、官方公報或法條原文），或兩筆彼此獨立且一致之第二級來源（律師事務所或具規模之專業媒體）時始予刊登。第三級為仲介或行銷資料，任何情形下均不足採。未達此標準之欄位一律於原處標示未查證，不以推測填補；門檻本身無法確立者，該制度移入 excluded 清單。未使用維基百科。

notes.sort_usd_en: sort_usd is an ordering key for the table and charts, not a published threshold. It equals min_value.usd wherever the source dataset published one. Cape Verde is the single exception: its source deliberately publishes no USD equivalent because the euro floats against the dollar, so sort_usd there is an editorial conversion at EUR 1 = USD 1.17 used solely to place the row.
notes.sort_usd_zh: sort_usd 為表格與圖表之排序鍵，並非刊登之門檻金額。凡原始資料集已刊登 min_value.usd 者，兩者相同。維德角為唯一例外：其原始資料因歐元對美元浮動而刻意不刊登美元等值，故該筆 sort_usd 係以 EUR 1 = USD 1.17 換算，僅供排序定位之用。
notes.outcome_class_en: outcome_class is an editorial classification of the published leads_to text into four groups: citizenship (the route itself confers citizenship), permanent (a permanent or indefinite status is available, immediately or after a stated qualifying period), renewable (the source states there is no onward pathway, or expressly bars one), not_established (the source could not establish it). The underlying leads_to text is retained in full so the classification can be audited.
notes.outcome_class_zh: outcome_class 係就已刊登之 leads_to 文字所作之編輯分類，分為四組：citizenship（該途徑本身賦予公民身分）、permanent（可取得永久或無期限身分，或於明定年限後取得）、renewable（來源明載無後續途徑，或明文排除）、not_established（來源無法確立）。leads_to 原文全數保留，分類可據以查核。
notes.region_en: region groups jurisdictions geographically for the page and is editorial. Mauritius and Seychelles sit in meaf although they were researched together with the Asia-Pacific jurisdictions.
notes.region_zh: region 係為頁面呈現所作之地理分組，屬編輯欄位。模里西斯與塞席爾雖與亞太法域一併查核，於此歸入 meaf。
notes.established_en: established records, per field, whether the finding cleared the publication rule. Three states apply wherever the absence of a requirement can itself be independently verified — most commonly for the threshold (published: a figure; absent_verified: the competent authority sets no minimum, and that absence itself is verified at tier 1 or 2; not_established), and occasionally for minimum stay or onward status where a source states outright that no such requirement or pathway exists (for example Saudi Arabia's real-estate residency, where the governing document states verbatim that both the stay requirement and the permanent-conversion pathway are "not applicable"). Term is published or not_established only. The values were read off the source field text and are index-aligned with it.
notes.established_zh: established 逐欄記錄該項認定是否通過刊登標準。凡「要求不存在」本身可獨立查證之欄位，均可能出現三種狀態——最常見於門檻（published：有金額；absent_verified：主管機關未設最低金額，且該不存在本身已於第一或第二級來源獲得確認；not_established），亦偶見於最低停留或後續身分——當來源明文表示不存在此類要求或途徑時（例如沙烏地阿拉伯不動產居留，其治理文件逐字載明停留要求與轉永久居留途徑均「不適用」）。期限僅有 published 或 not_established 兩種狀態。各值係就原始欄位文字判讀，並與其逐筆對應。

fx_notes.note: All statutory amounts are stated in the currency of the governing instrument; that local-currency figure is the authoritative one. The 'usd' field is an INDICATIVE EDITORIAL CONVERSION, not a sourced or statutory value, computed at EUR 1 = USD 1.17, GBP 1 = USD 1.35, AZN 1 = USD 0.588 (manat pegged ~1.70 AZN/USD since 2017) and rounded to the nearest USD 1,000. The USD figure is not a legal threshold. Bulgaria adopted the euro on 1 January 2026 at the fixed rate BGN 1.95583 = EUR 1 (ECB), but the consolidated Bulgarian Foreigners Act as amended to 16 June 2026 still expresses every threshold in BGN; any euro figure for Bulgaria is a conversion, not a statutory amount.

USD equivalents are INDICATIVE ONLY. They are arithmetic conversions at the following reference rates and are NOT verified market rates for any given date: THB 34, MYR 4.2, IDR 16300, KRW 1380, HKD 7.8, PHP 57, VUV 120, LKR 300, MUR 46 per USD. Every threshold, except where the source itself is denominated in USD, is set in local currency; the local-currency figure is the operative legal one and is what was verified against source. The USD column is not a legal threshold.

AED is pegged to USD at 3.6725; AED 2,000,000 = US$544,588, rounded to US$545,000. JOD is pegged at 1 JOD = US$1.41044; JOD 150,000 = US$211,566 (shown as US$212,000), JOD 200,000 = US$282,088 (US$282,000), JOD 300,000 = US$423,132 (US$423,000). Caribbean CBI thresholds are legislated in US dollars, so no conversion is applied. XCD (EC$) is pegged at 2.70 to the USD but is not used for any figure below. All USD figures shown are either the legislated currency itself or a peg conversion — none involve a floating rate, so none go stale.

Qatar: the Real Estate Regulatory Authority states its own USD equivalents (QAR 730,000 = US$200,000; QAR 3,650,000 = US$1,000,000), so the authority's figures are used rather than a computed peg conversion (the QAR is pegged at 3.64 to the USD, which would give US$200,549 and US$1,002,747). Bahrain: BHD is pegged at 0.376 to the USD, so BHD 130,000 = US$345,745, shown as US$346,000; note that widely circulated agency material rounds this to US$345,000. Cape Verde: the escudo is pegged to the euro and the statute itself supplies both figures (EUR 80,000 = 8,821,200 CVE; EUR 120,000 = 13,231,800 CVE, implying 110.265 CVE/EUR), so the euro figures are the legislated ones; NO USD equivalent is published for Cape Verde because EUR/USD floats and any USD figure would go stale. Panama and Costa Rica legislate in US dollars, so no conversion applies. Oman's property route has no monetary threshold at all, so no conversion is needed. All published figures below are either the legislated currency itself or a hard-peg conversion — none involve a floating rate.

method_notes.note: Publication rule enforced per field: a value is published only where it rests on one tier-1 source (government / immigration authority / official gazette / statute text) or two independent agreeing tier-2 sources (law firm or established specialist outlet). Fields resting on a single tier-2 source, on tier-3 material, or on disagreeing sources are either omitted, or their text states the disagreement with both values labelled, and the programme's confidence is dropped to medium. Wikipedia was not used. Where a figure could not be traced it has been dropped rather than estimated.

Source tiers: 1 = government, immigration authority, gazette or statute; 2 = law firm or established specialist outlet; 3 = agency or marketing blog. A field is published only on one tier-1 source or two independent agreeing tier-2 sources. Fields that could not meet that bar are marked NOT VERIFIED in place rather than filled with a best guess, and where the threshold itself was unestablished the programme was moved to 'excluded'. Verification was done by direct retrieval of primary documents (statutes, gazettes, ministerial orders, scanned PDFs read as images) via browser and HTTP, which is stronger evidence than search snippets but limited the ability to find amending announcements; that limitation is flagged in place wherever it bites.

Every programme, negative and excluded entry was re-verified against its sources on 2026-08-02. Every programme entry carries a companion_requirements field disclosing conditions beyond the property purchase itself (health insurance, minimum income or deposit proof, mandatory medical exams, one-off fees, licensed-agent requirements, clean-record checks, holding-period and resale restrictions). Entries changed since then (Latvia, Panama) were checked against primary sources in October 2026.
method_notes.note_zh: 所有 programmes、negatives 與 excluded 條目已於 2026-08-02 對照來源重新查證。每一筆 programmes 均附 companion_requirements 欄位，揭露購屋之外的必要條件（健康保險、最低收入或存款證明、強制體檢、一次性規費、須透過持照代辦、良民證查核、持有年限與轉售限制）。其後變動的條目（拉脫維亞、巴拿馬）已於 2026 年 10 月對照一手來源重新查核。

programmes.programme: Golden Visa (permanent investor residence permit, art. 100 of Law 5038/2023)
programmes.programme_zh: 黃金簽證（第 5038/2023 號法律第 100 條之投資人永久居留許可）

min_value.basis: Standard tier — all regions outside the designated high-demand zones; must be a single property; full price paid before application

extra_tiers.label_en: High-demand zones — Attica, the Thessaloniki area of Central Macedonia, Mykonos, Santorini and islands with population over 3,100
Conversion of a non-residential/industrial building to residential use (change of use must be COMPLETED before applying), or restoration of a listed/preservable building

term.text_en: 5 years, renewable indefinitely while the investment remains compliant
term.text_zh: 5 年，投資持續合規即可無限次續期

stay.text_en: None. The investor need only appear once per five-year cycle for biometrics at renewal.
stay.text_zh: 無居住天數要求；每 5 年續期時親自到場錄生物特徵一次即可。

leads_to.text_en: Naturalisation after 7 years' residence, plus language and integration criteria. NOTE: this is the general naturalisation rule; with a zero-stay permit the residence clock is not satisfied by holding the permit alone.
leads_to.text_zh: 居住滿 7 年後可申請歸化，另須通過語言與融入條件。注意：此為一般歸化規則；本許可不設居住要求，僅持有許可本身並不累積居住年限。

offplan.text_en: Not established. The full purchase price must be paid before the application is submitted, and a 120 sqm minimum main living area applies to built property and property with an issued building permit (undeveloped land is exempt from the size rule) — but no source reached states whether an undelivered off-plan unit qualifies. A second tier-2 source (Sioufas & Associates law firm), cross-checked 2026-08-02, independently confirms full payment is required regardless of completion status but likewise does not state whether an undelivered off-plan unit itself qualifies — the gap persists after two independent tier-2 checks, which is stronger evidence of a genuine regulatory silence than a single unchecked source would be.
offplan.text_zh: 未能查證。申請前須付清全額價金，且已建成或已取得建照之物件須主要居住面積至少 120 平方公尺（素地不受面積規定限制）；惟無任何可引用來源說明尚未交屋之預售單位是否合格。另一第二級來源（Sioufas & Associates 律所），於 2026-08-02 交叉查證，獨立確認申請前須付清全額、不論物件完工與否，但同樣未說明尚未交屋之預售單位本身是否合格——經兩個獨立第二級來源查證後仍有此缺口，較單一未查核來源更能佐證此為真正的法規沉默。

mortgage.text_en: UNVERIFIED — do not rely on either answer. Sources confirm only that the price must be paid in full before application; none addresses permitted payment methods or whether borrowing is allowed. The frequently repeated 'no mortgage / bank transfer only' claim could not be traced to any citable source. A second tier-2 source (Sioufas & Associates), cross-checked 2026-08-02, independently confirms the statute is silent on financing method — art. 5 regulates only the means of payment (bank cheque, wire transfer, POS), not the source of funds. The 'no mortgage' claim continues to lack any statutory basis after two independent checks.
mortgage.text_zh: 未經查證，兩種說法皆不可採信。可引用來源僅載明申請前須付清全額，未觸及付款方式或是否得以貸款支應。坊間常見的「不得貸款、僅限電匯」說法查無可引用出處。另一第二級來源（Sioufas & Associates），於 2026-08-02 交叉查證，獨立確認法條對融資方式保持沉默——第 5 條僅規範付款方式（銀行支票、電匯、POS），未觸及資金來源。「不得貸款」之說法，經兩個獨立來源查證後仍查無法源依據。

dependants.text_en: Law 5275/2026 (Government Gazette A' 17/6.2.2026, in force on publication), art. 29, replaces art. 95(2) of the Migration Code (Law 5038/2023). Holders of the permits in arts. 96 to 100A, which include the real-estate investor permit of art. 100, may be accompanied by family members who receive a family-reunification permit expiring together with the sponsor's. Family members are: (a) the spouse, or the partner under a cohabitation agreement; (b) unmarried common children of the spouses or partners under 21; (c) unmarried children of the sponsor or of the other spouse or partner, under 21, where custody was lawfully assigned to the parent concerned; (d) the direct ascendants of the spouses or partners, that is, the parents of both, with no age limit or dependency test in this provision; (e) adult children of the sponsor or of the spouse or partner who are third-country nationals, lack legal capacity and live with and are supported by the sponsor, whatever their age. A child under (b) or (c) who turns 21 receives an autonomous residence permit for 3 years. An extension to 24 for full-time students, described by some secondary sources, does not appear in this provision.
dependants.text_zh: 第 5275/2026 號法律（政府公報 A' 17/2026 年 2 月 6 日，自公布日施行）第 29 條取代《移民法典》（第 5038/2023 號法律）第 95 條第 2 項：持有第 96 至 100A 條許可者（含第 100 條的不動產投資人許可）可攜眷，家屬取得與擔保人許可同時屆滿的家庭團聚許可。家屬包括：(a) 配偶，或依同居契約登記的伴侶；(b) 配偶或伴侶未滿 21 歲的未婚共同子女；(c) 擔保人或其配偶、伴侶未滿 21 歲的未婚子女，監護權須依法歸屬於該子女的親生父或母；(d) 配偶或伴侶的直系尊親屬，即雙方父母，本項未設年齡上限或扶養條件；(e) 擔保人或其配偶、伴侶的成年子女，須為第三國國民、無行為能力、與擔保人同住並由其扶養，不論年齡。(b)、(c) 項子女年滿 21 歲後，另發 3 年期的獨立居留許可。部分第二級來源所述「在學者可延至 24 歲」，不在這項條文內。

entry_tax.text_en: Transfer tax 3% of taxable value, 3.09% including the municipal surcharge; reduced 1.5%/0.75% rates in specific cases. New buildings: standard VAT 24%, but suspended where the construction permit was issued or revised from 1 Jan 2006 on seller application — CONFLICT on the current status: PwC states the suspension ran until 31 December 2025 with 24% resuming thereafter, while several tier-3 outlets claim it continues through 2026. No 2026 VAT position is stated here.
entry_tax.text_zh: 過戶稅為課稅價值的 3%，加計市政附加後為 3.09%；特定情形適用 1.5%／0.75% 減徵。新成屋標準加值稅 24%，惟建照於 2006 年 1 月 1 日起核發或修改者，經賣方申請得暫停課徵——現況有衝突：PwC 稱暫停至 2025 年 12 月 31 日止、其後恢復 24%，多家第三級來源則稱 2026 年續行。2026 年之加值稅立場不予刊登。

last_change.text_en: Law 5100/2024 restructured the tiers with effect from 1 September 2024. VERIFIED NEGATIVE for anything later: a full-text search of the Greek official gazette (et.gr) for 2025 and 2026 found no Issue A (statute) amending art. 100 of Law 5038/2023 — only five Issue B ministerial decisions. The most recent, joint ministerial decision FEK B' 6014/2025 of 11 November 2025, sets supporting documents only and contains no monetary figure, no loan/mortgage provision and no size rule. Law 5275/2026 (Government Gazette A' 17 of 6 February 2026) was read in full: no provision amends art. 100 of Law 5038/2023, and no threshold, term or tier changes. Art. 29 (family members, see `dependants`) is the one change that applies to the holder of this permit.
last_change.text_zh: 第 5100/2024 號法律重整級距，自 2024 年 9 月 1 日生效。其後之修正經查證為無：以全文檢索希臘官方公報（et.gr）2025 與 2026 年，未見任何甲編（法律）修正第 5038/2023 號法律第 100 條，僅有五件乙編部長決定。最新者為 2025 年 11 月 11 日 FEK B' 6014/2025 聯合部長決定，僅規定應備文件，未含任何金額、貸款條款或面積規定。 第 5275/2026 號法律（2026 年 2 月 6 日政府公報 A' 17）已通讀全文：沒有任何條文修正第 5038/2023 號法律第 100 條，門檻、期限與級距均未變動。第 29 條（家屬，見 dependants）是適用於本許可持有人的唯一變動。

short.term_en: 5 yrs, renewable
short.term_zh: 5 年，可續期
short.outcome_en: Naturalisation at 7 yrs, but a zero-stay permit does not run the residence clock
short.outcome_zh: 7 年可歸化，惟零居留要求之許可不累積居住年限
short.own_en: One property only; full price paid before applying; short letting prohibited
short.own_zh: 限單一物件；申請前付清全額；禁止短期出租

programmes.notes_en: A Greek law firm's reference to 'Law 5187/2025 of 21 March 2025' as amending the Golden Visa regime does not hold up: FEK A 48/2025 of 21 March 2025 is Law 5187/2025 on the reorganisation of the Hellenic Police and modernisation of electronic monitoring — unrelated to investor residence. Confidence is medium because the three thresholds rest on a single tier-2 source (Watson Farley & Williams), not on retrieved statutory text. The Ministry of Migration and Asylum's public page at migration.gov.gr/golden-visa is stale — it is keyed to art. 20B of Law 4251/2014 (superseded) and quotes EUR 250,000 as the threshold, with a clarifying-documents library that goes no later than 2023; it should not be cited as a statement of current thresholds. Other conditions established at tier 2: the investment must go into one property only (no fragmenting); short-term/Airbnb-type letting of the qualifying property is prohibited and breach triggers revocation plus an administrative fine; a converted property may not be used as a business headquarters or branch; permits issued under prior frameworks are grandfathered and exempt from the new restrictions.
programmes.notes_zh: 某希臘律師事務所將黃金簽證制度之修正歸於「2025 年 3 月 21 日第 5187/2025 號法律」，此說法站不住腳：2025 年 3 月 21 日 FEK A 48/2025 之第 5187/2025 號法律係關於希臘警察組織重整與電子監控現代化，與投資移民無涉。信心度列為中等，係因三級距金額本身僅有單一第二級來源（Watson Farley & Williams），未取得法條原文。移民與庇護部官網 migration.gov.gr/golden-visa 內容已過時——仍援引已被取代之第 4251/2014 號法律第 20B 條，仍列 25 萬歐元門檻，其釋義文件庫最新僅至 2023 年，不得引為現行門檻之依據。其他第二級來源確認之條件：投資須集中於單一物件，不得分拆；合格物件禁止短期出租（Airbnb 類），違反者撤銷許可並處行政罰鍰；改建物件不得作為營業總部或分支機構；依舊制核發之許可受既得保障，不適用新限制。

companion_requirements.text_en: Mandatory private health insurance, in addition to the property investment: must cover the applicant AND all dependants, and must be furnished at the time of first application (not deferrable). No official minimum coverage amount is published anywhere — a commonly cited EUR 30,000 figure could not be traced to any government source and is not adopted.
companion_requirements.text_zh: 除不動產投資外，另強制要求私人健康保險：須涵蓋申請人及全體受扶養人，且須於首次申請時即檢附，不得延後補件。官方未公布任何最低保額數字——坊間常引用之三萬歐元一說查無官方依據，不予採用。

programmes.programme: Immigration Permit by investment, expedited procedure under Regulation 6(2) of the Aliens and Immigration Regulations
programmes.programme_zh: 投資取得移民許可（外國人與移民規則第 6(2) 條快速通道）

min_value.basis: Excluding VAT — VAT is payable on top. For a house or apartment (category 2.1(A)) it must be a FIRST SALE from a development company; resale does not qualify. Official payment receipts of at least EUR 300,000 excluding VAT must be produced at application, regardless of the property's delivery date.

extra_tiers.label_en: Other real estate — offices, shops, hotels or similar developments (category 2.1(B)); RESALE IS PERMITTED in this category

term.text_en: The residence right itself is of unlimited validity for the holder and adult dependants. The residence permit CARD expires ten years from issue and must be replaced on expiry; minors' cards run to age 18.
term.text_zh: 居留權本身對主申請人及成年受扶養人為無限期有效。居留許可卡自核發起 10 年到期，屆期須換發；未成年人之卡效期至 18 歲。

stay.text_en: No affirmative visit quota, but two lapse triggers: the permit ceases to be valid if the holder and dependants fail to acquire residence in Cyprus within ONE YEAR of approval while residing abroad; and it ceases to be valid if they acquire permanent residence abroad or are ABSENT FROM CYPRUS FOR TWO YEARS.
stay.text_zh: 無積極的到訪次數要求，但有兩項失效條件：核准後若申請人及受扶養人仍居國外且未於 1 年內在賽普勒斯取得居所，許可失效；若在境外取得永久居留、或連續 2 年未入境賽普勒斯，許可亦失效。

leads_to.text_en: NOT ADDRESSED by the official criteria. A full-text search of the tier-1 policy document returns zero occurrences of 'citizenship' or 'naturalisation'. No naturalisation timeline is asserted here because none was sourced.
leads_to.text_zh: 官方核准標準文件完全未提及。以全文檢索該第一級政策文件，「公民身分」與「歸化」均為零筆。因無可引用出處，不刊登任何入籍年限。

offplan.text_en: Qualifies, provided payment is complete. The criteria require official payment receipts of at least EUR 300,000 excluding VAT at application 'regardless of the property's delivery date' — so an undelivered unit is acceptable if fully paid and receipted.
offplan.text_zh: 可，但須付款完成。核准標準要求申請時提出至少 30 萬歐元（不含加值稅）之正式付款收據，且明定「不論物件交付日期為何」，故尚未交屋之單位只要全額付清並取得收據即可。

mortgage.text_en: Cyprus-side borrowing is BARRED. The criteria require that the funds be proved to have been transferred to Cyprus from abroad, from the applicant's or spouse's own bank account, paid into the seller's account at a Cyprus financial institution, and that the money 'has derived from abroad and is not the result of domestic borrowing'. The text bars DOMESTIC borrowing specifically; it does not expressly address a loan raised outside Cyprus, provided the money arrives from the applicant's own foreign account.
mortgage.text_zh: 禁止賽普勒斯境內借貸。核准標準要求證明資金自國外匯入賽普勒斯，須來自申請人或配偶本人帳戶，並匯入賣方於賽國金融機構之帳戶，且資金須「來自境外，非源於境內借貸」。條文明文禁止的是境內借貸，對於在賽國境外取得之貸款則未明文規範，惟資金仍須自申請人本人之境外帳戶匯入。

dependants.text_en: Spouse and dependent minor children. Unmarried children aged up to 25 in tertiary education abroad and financially dependent may be included; a non-dependent adult child requires a SEPARATE EUR 300,000 investment of their own. Parents and parents-in-law are EXCLUDED — they cannot be included under the investor's permit.
dependants.text_zh: 配偶及受扶養未成年子女。未婚、在國外接受高等教育且經濟依賴之 25 歲以下子女得一併納入；非受扶養之成年子女須另行投資 30 萬歐元。父母與配偶父母不得納入投資人許可之受扶養人範圍。

entry_tax.text_en: Land Registry transfer fees 3% up to EUR 85,000, 5% on EUR 85,001–170,000, 8% above EUR 170,000 — but NO transfer fee is payable where VAT applies to the purchase, and fees are halved where VAT does not apply. Standard VAT 19%. Materially, a new-build 6(2) purchase pays VAT and no transfer fee. Whether the reduced 5% housing VAT rate can apply to a zero-stay investor is UNVERIFIED (it normally requires the property to be the buyer's primary residence).
entry_tax.text_zh: 土地登記過戶費：8.5 萬歐元以下 3%，8.5 萬至 17 萬歐元 5%，17 萬歐元以上 8%；惟該筆交易若課加值稅則免收過戶費，未課加值稅者過戶費減半。標準加值稅 19%。實務上，第 6(2) 條之新成屋購置課加值稅、免過戶費。至於 5% 住宅優惠稅率是否適用於無居住要求之投資人，未經查證（該優惠通常要求該物件為買方主要住所）。

last_change.text_en: Criteria, 4th Revision, May 2023 — in force 2 May 2023; official page re-posted 29 December 2025. The May 2023 revision also relaxed ongoing obligations: annual proof of income is ABOLISHED and the clean criminal record is now required every three years instead of annually, while annual proof of maintaining the investment and of health insurance remains. Disposing of the investment without immediate like-for-like replacement causes cancellation.
last_change.text_zh: 核准標準第 4 次修訂，2023 年 5 月版，自 2023 年 5 月 2 日施行；官方頁面於 2025 年 12 月 29 日重新張貼。2023 年 5 月修訂並放寬持續義務：取消每年收入證明，無犯罪紀錄證明由每年改為每 3 年一次；維持投資及健康保險之年度證明則保留。處分投資標的而未即時以同等標的替代者，許可撤銷。

short.term_en: Unlimited; the card is replaced at 10 yrs
short.term_zh: 效力無期限；許可證滿 10 年換發
short.stay_en: No quota, but lapses on 1 yr absent after approval or 2 yrs continuous absence
short.stay_zh: 無天數配額；核准後 1 年內未在境內居住，或連續離境滿 2 年，即失效
short.outcome_en: Permanent residence; naturalisation not addressed in the criteria
short.outcome_zh: 永久居留；核定標準未觸及歸化
short.own_en: First sale from a development company; EUR 300,000 excluding VAT
short.own_zh: 須為建設公司首次出售；30 萬歐元且不含加值稅

programmes.notes_en: Income requirement: a personal secured annual income of at least EUR 50,000, increased by EUR 15,000 for a spouse and EUR 10,000 for each dependent minor child. For category 2.1(A) that income must DERIVE FROM ABROAD and is provable only via a tax return from the country of tax residence. Cyprus's separate citizenship-by-investment scheme was abolished with effect from 1 November 2020 (announced 13 October 2020) and is not available. The widely circulated 'must visit Cyprus once every two years' claim is substantially right but wrongly framed: the word 'visit' appears nowhere in the criteria; the actual rule is that the permit lapses on two years' absence from Cyprus.
programmes.notes_zh: 收入條件：本人須有穩定年收入至少 5 萬歐元，配偶加計 1.5 萬歐元，每名受扶養未成年子女加計 1 萬歐元。2.1(A) 類之收入須來自境外，且僅得以稅務居住國之報稅資料證明。賽普勒斯另一套投資入籍計畫已於 2020 年 11 月 1 日起廢止（2020 年 10 月 13 日宣布），現已不存在。坊間流傳「每 2 年須入境一次」大方向正確但表述有誤——核准標準全文並無「到訪」字樣，實際規則是連續 2 年未入境即失效。

sources.publisher: Republic of Cyprus, Ministry of Interior — Criteria for granting an Immigration Permit within the scope of the expedited procedure, 4th Revision, May 2023
PwC Worldwide Tax Summaries
Al Jazeera
P. Ioannou & Co LLC

companion_requirements.text_en: Personal secured annual income of at least EUR 50,000 (+EUR 15,000 for spouse, +EUR 10,000 per dependent minor child, provable via tax return from country of tax residence for category 2.1(A)); annual proof of health insurance and (since May 2023) a clean-criminal-record certificate renewed every three years rather than annually.
companion_requirements.text_zh: 本人年收入須達 5 萬歐元以上（配偶加計 1.5 萬歐元、每名受扶養未成年子女加計 1 萬歐元，2.1(A) 類須以稅務居住國報稅資料證明）；年度健康保險證明，以及（自 2023 年 5 月起）無犯罪紀錄證明由每年改為每 3 年一次。

programmes.programme: Malta Permanent Residence Programme (MPRP)
programmes.programme_zh: 馬爾他永久居留計畫（MPRP）

min_value.basis: Purchase of qualifying owned property, NATIONWIDE — the former EUR 350,000 Malta / EUR 300,000 Gozo-and-South split has been abolished

extra_tiers.label_en: Rental alternative — qualifying rented property, nationwide, per year
Government contribution — IDENTICAL for the purchase and the rental route, payable within 8 months of the Letter of Approval in Principle
Administrative fee — EUR 15,000 within 1 month of submission plus EUR 45,000 within 2 months of the Letter of Approval in Principle
Charitable donation to a registered philanthropic, cultural, scientific, artistic, sport or animal-welfare NGO

Minimum assets — EUR 500,000 of which at least EUR 150,000 financial assets, OR the alternative limb of EUR 650,000 of which at least EUR 75,000 financial assets; must be held 5 years from the appointed day
Administrative fee per dependant — payable ONLY for adult children and for parents/grandparents; spouse, minor children and disabled adult children pay nothing

term.text_en: Indefinite. The Residence-by-Investment Certificate confers the right to reside, settle or stay in Malta indefinitely and carries no expiry date. The residence CARD is valid 5 years and is renewable (EUR 137.50 per person initially, EUR 27.50 per year on renewal).
term.text_zh: 無限期。投資居留證書賦予在馬爾他無限期居住、定居或停留之權利，證書本身無到期日。居留卡效期 5 年、可續（初次每人 137.50 歐元，續卡每年 27.50 歐元）。

stay.text_en: None. S.L. 217.26 contains no minimum physical-presence provision. (Stated as absence of provision in the tier-1 instrument, not as an affirmative official statement.)
stay.text_zh: 無。S.L. 217.26 全文並無最低實際居留天數之規定。（此係第一級法規中「查無此條」之陳述，而非官方積極表示。）

leads_to.text_en: No automatic path. The certificate confers permanent residence only and, per reg. 10(1)(b), 'shall not, by itself, entitle the holder to any other rights'. Ordinary naturalisation is a separate and DISCRETIONARY process requiring 5 years' continuous residence including the 12 months immediately before application plus 4 of the preceding 6 years, together with language and good-conduct requirements.
leads_to.text_zh: 無自動途徑。該證書僅授予永久居留，依第 10(1)(b) 條規定「本身不賦予持有人任何其他權利」。一般歸化為另一套且屬裁量性之程序，須連續居住 5 年（含申請前緊接之 12 個月，加上其前 6 年中的 4 年），並符合語言及品行要求。

offplan.text_en: Not established, but the depth of the check has been increased: the read S.L. 217.26 art. 3's definition of 'qualifying owned property' directly (purchase or emphyteusis, consideration not less than EUR 375,000, with a proviso allowing a lower purchase price topped up by certified renovation spend). The definition itself is silent on completion status — it does not mention off-plan or pre-completion property either way. This is a direct reading of the statutory definition, not a secondary-source inference.
offplan.text_zh: 未能查證，惟查證深度已提升：直接調閱 S.L. 217.26 第 3 條「合格自有物件」定義原文（購買或以永佃權取得，對價不低於 37.5 萬歐元，另有但書容許以低於此價之購入價加計經認證之裝修支出補足）。定義本身對完工狀態保持沉默——未提及預售屋或期房。此為直接查對法條原文定義，非轉引二手資料。

mortgage.text_en: Not prohibited. S.L. 217.26 contains no hypothec or mortgage restriction anywhere. The official FAQ answers 'Can the applicant take a loan to buy the qualifying property?' with 'This matter is at the discretion of the Bank.'
mortgage.text_zh: 未禁止。S.L. 217.26 全文並無抵押權或貸款之限制。官方常見問答就「申請人可否貸款購買合格物件」之答覆為「此事由銀行自行裁量」。

dependants.text_en: Spouse (gender-neutral, including civil union and domestic partnership); child under 18; child aged 18–28 who is unmarried and principally dependent; a PARENT OR GRANDPARENT of the applicant or spouse who is not in full-time employment and is principally dependent; and a disabled adult child. Both ascending and adult descending relatives therefore qualify.
dependants.text_zh: 配偶（性別中立，含民事結合與同居伴侶）；18 歲以下子女；18 至 28 歲未婚且主要受扶養之子女；申請人或配偶之父母或祖父母，須未全職就業且主要受扶養；以及身心障礙之成年子女。故直系尊親屬與成年直系卑親屬皆可納入。

entry_tax.text_en: Stamp duty 5%, paid by the buyer on the higher of market price or contract value, with 1% provisional duty payable at promise-of-sale stage (within 21 days). A 15% valuation tolerance applies; penalty duty of 20% plus 0.75% per 30 days runs on assessed shortfalls. The commonly quoted 2% Gozo rate is UNVERIFIED — the official tax authority page makes no mention of it and one tier-3 source claims it reverted to 5%; no Gozo rate is stated here. No official notary fee schedule was located.
entry_tax.text_zh: 印花稅 5%，由買方就市價與契約價之較高者繳納；預售契約階段（21 日內）先繳 1% 暫繳稅。估價容許誤差 15%；核定短漏部分加徵 20% 罰稅並按每 30 日 0.75% 計息。坊間常見之「戈佐島 2%」未經查證——官方稅務機關頁面完全未提及，且有第三級來源稱已回復 5%，故不刊登戈佐島稅率。亦未查得官方公證人費率表。

last_change.text_en: L.N. 146 of 2025, published 22 July 2025, Government Gazette No. 21,472, amending S.L. 217.26 (originally L.N. 121 of 2021, previously amended by L.N. 57 and L.N. 310 of 2024). The consolidated point-in-time text is 22 July 2025. PARTIAL: the text of the amending notice's own commencement/transitional regulation could not be retrieved, so no commencement date distinct from the 22 July 2025 publication date is asserted.
last_change.text_zh: 2025 年第 146 號法律公告，2025 年 7 月 22 日刊登於政府公報第 21,472 號，修正 S.L. 217.26（原為 2021 年第 121 號公告，前經 2024 年第 57 號及第 310 號公告修正）。彙編版本時點為 2025 年 7 月 22 日。部分未證：該修正公告本身之生效／過渡條款原文未能取得，故不主張有別於 2025 年 7 月 22 日刊登日之生效日。

short.term_en: Indefinite; the card is renewed at 5 yrs
short.term_zh: 無期限；居留卡 5 年續期
short.outcome_en: Permanent residence; ordinary naturalisation is separate and discretionary
short.outcome_zh: 永久居留；一般歸化屬另案且為裁量事項
short.own_en: Qualifying owned property nationwide; a rental alternative also exists
short.own_zh: 全國適用之合格自有物件；另設租賃替代方案

programmes.notes_en: Three corrections to commonly circulated figures. (1) The legal citation is S.L. 217.26, not S.L. 217.60. (2) The government contribution is EUR 37,000 flat for BOTH the purchase and the rental route — the EUR 30,000 purchase / EUR 60,000 rent split no longer exists, having been superseded by L.N. 310 of 2024 and L.N. 146 of 2025. (3) The administrative fee is EUR 60,000, not EUR 50,000. There is also an alternative asset limb (EUR 650,000 including EUR 75,000 financial assets) that circulating material commonly omits. Property holding period: 5 years from the appointed day, and AFTER those 5 years the holder must still hold a residential property in Malta or Gozo — owned or leased — indefinitely.
programmes.notes_zh: 對坊間流傳數字的三處更正。（一）法規編號為 S.L. 217.26，非 S.L. 217.60。（二）政府捐獻為購屋與租屋兩條路徑一律 3.7 萬歐元——「購屋 3 萬／租屋 6 萬」之區分已不存在，經 2024 年第 310 號及 2025 年第 146 號公告取代。（三）行政規費為 6 萬歐元，非 5 萬歐元。另有一項坊間常漏列之替代性資產門檻（65 萬歐元，其中 7.5 萬歐元為金融資產）。持有期間：自指定日起 5 年；且該 5 年屆滿後，持有人仍須無限期持有馬爾他或戈佐島之住宅物件（自有或承租皆可）。

sources.publisher: Residency Malta Agency — S.L. 217.26 consolidated, point-in-time 22 July 2025
Residency Malta Agency — MPRP FAQs v2.6.1
Malta Tax and Customs Administration
Laws of Malta (legislation.mt) — L.N. 146 of 2025

companion_requirements.text_en: Government contribution EUR 37,000 whether the qualifying property is purchased or leased; non-refundable administration fee EUR 60,000; charitable donation EUR 2,000 to an approved NGO; an alternative qualifying-investment threshold of EUR 650,000 for applicants who do not use the property route.
companion_requirements.text_zh: 無論購買或租賃合格物件，政府捐獻一律 3.7 萬歐元；不可退還行政規費 6 萬歐元；慈善捐款 2,000 歐元予核准之非政府組織；不使用不動產途徑者另有 65 萬歐元之替代性合格投資門檻。

programmes.programme: Temporary residence for the use and disposition of owned real property, Law on Foreigners art. 56
programmes.programme_zh: 以所有之不動產使用及處分為由之臨時居留（《外國人法》第 56 條）

min_value.basis: Measured on the TAX-ASSESSMENT BASE, not the purchase price — specifically the taxable base stated in the municipal tax authority's real-estate transfer tax assessment decision (rjesenje o utvrdivanju poreza na promet nepokretnosti), which must be not less than EUR 150,000

term.text_en: Issued for up to ONE year (Law on Foreigners art. 63). Renewal must be applied for in person at the Ministry no later than 30 days before expiry (art. 64).
term.text_zh: 核發效期最長 1 年（《外國人法》第 63 條）。續期須於屆期前 30 日內親自向內政部提出申請（第 64 條）。

stay.text_en: Not established. Beyond confirming the art. 43 general conditions above, no additional day-count requirement specific to art. 56 was located; cross-checked against a second source with the same result.
stay.text_zh: 未能確立。除確認上述第 43 條一般要件外，未查得針對第 56 條之額外天數要求；用第二來源交叉核對，結論相同。

leads_to.text_en: UNRESOLVED — neither answer is established. Whether time held on the art. 56 property permit counts toward the qualifying period for permanent residence (stalno nastanjenje) could not be verified in either direction; the base law is published only as rasterised page images with no text layer or search, and the permanent-residence chapter could not be located within budget. One tier-3 source claims the time does NOT count; that claim is neither confirmed nor refuted. One adjacent tier-1 data point: art. 83 item 12 lists 'when the foreigner acquires the right to permanent residence' as a ground on which a temporary permit ceases, implying the two are sequential but saying nothing about countability.
leads_to.text_zh: 未解決，兩種說法均無法確立。持有第 56 條不動產居留許可之期間是否計入永久居留（stalno nastanjenje）之資格年限，正反皆無法查證；母法僅以掃描頁面影像公布，無文字層亦無法檢索，永久居留章節在預算內未能定位。有一第三級來源稱不計入，該說法既未證實亦未推翻。一項相關之第一級資料：第 83 條第 12 款將「外國人取得永久居留權時」列為臨時居留許可終止事由，顯示兩者係先後關係，但未說明年限是否採計。

offplan.text_en: Not established. The evidentiary test is a municipal tax assessment decision on a completed transfer, which implies registered ownership.
offplan.text_zh: 未查證。舉證方式為就已完成移轉所核發之市政稅務核定書，隱含須已登記所有權。

mortgage.text_en: Not established. Multiple real-estate/immigration-marketing sites (excluded-tier) claim the qualifying property must be unencumbered, debt-free and tax-clear, but a Montenegrin law firm's 2026 article on the amendment (Adzic & Knezevic) does not mention any mortgage restriction at all — it addresses only the EUR 150,000 tax-base threshold and the EU/EEA/Swiss exemption. Because the 'must be unencumbered' claim appears only in excluded-tier sources and is not corroborated by the one law-firm source checked, it is NOT adopted; this remains not established rather than being filled in with the excluded-tier claim.
mortgage.text_zh: 未能確立。多個房地產／移民行銷網站（屬排除類來源）聲稱合格物件須無抵押、無欠稅、產權清白，惟一家蒙特內哥羅執業律所（Adzic & Knezevic）2026 年修法評論文章完全未提及抵押權限制，僅觸及 15 萬歐元課稅基準門檻與歐盟／EEA／瑞士豁免。由於「須無抵押」之說法僅見於排除類來源，且未獲唯一查核之律所來源佐證，不予採信；此項仍未查證，不以排除類來源之說法填補。

dependants.text_en: Not established. The Law on Foreigners has a separate 'family reunification' ground, but no source found addresses whether spouse/children may be included under the art. 56 property ground itself or must apply independently under the family-reunification ground. Checked and not resolved.
dependants.text_zh: 未能確立。《外國人法》就『家庭團聚』另設專門事由，惟查無來源說明配偶／子女能否依附第 56 條不動產許可本身申請，抑或須另循家庭團聚事由個別申請。已查，未能解決。

entry_tax.text_en: Real-estate transfer tax is PROGRESSIVE 3% to 6% (the frequently quoted flat 3% is outdated). Standard VAT 21% applies to new-build supplied by a taxable person.
entry_tax.text_zh: 不動產移轉稅為 3% 至 6% 之累進稅率（坊間常引之單一 3% 已過時）。由課稅主體供應之新成屋適用標準加值稅 21%。

last_change.text_en: Law on Amendments to the Law on Foreigners, Sluzbeni list Crne Gore No. 3/2026, register no. 34. Adopted by the Skupstina on 31 December 2025 and promulgated by President Jakov Milatovic the same day (Ukaz no. 01-009/25-2526/2). PUBLISHED 9 January 2026; ENTERED INTO FORCE 17 January 2026 — art. 92 of the amending law provides that it enters into force on the eighth day after publication in the Official Gazette.
last_change.text_zh: 《外國人法修正法》，《蒙特內哥羅政府公報》2026 年第 3 號，登記號 34。經國會於 2025 年 12 月 31 日通過，總統雅科夫・米拉托維奇同日公布（第 01-009/25-2526/2 號令）。2026 年 1 月 9 日刊登；2026 年 1 月 17 日生效——修正法第 92 條規定自刊登於政府公報後第 8 日起生效。

short.term_en: Up to 1 yr; renewal applied for in person
short.term_zh: 最長 1 年；須親自申請續期
short.outcome_en: Not established in either direction
short.outcome_zh: 正反兩方向均無公開資料
short.own_en: Measured on the transfer-tax assessment base, not the purchase price
short.own_zh: 以過戶稅核定基礎計算，非以成交價計算

programmes.notes_en: The circulating '9 January' and '17 January' dates are both real and refer to different things — 9 January 2026 is the gazette publication date, 17 January 2026 is entry into force (publication plus eight days per art. 92). The EUR 150,000 rule is art. 24 of the amending law, inserting new paragraphs into art. 56 of the Law on Foreigners. The exemption is broader than commonly reported: the obligation to produce proof of value does not apply to citizens of EU member states OR THEIR FAMILY MEMBERS REGARDLESS OF THOSE FAMILY MEMBERS' OWN NATIONALITY, nor to citizens of Iceland, Liechtenstein, Norway and Switzerland. Grandfathering is stronger than commonly reported: new art. 217b provides that for a foreigner issued a property-based temporary residence permit BEFORE entry into force, a RENEWAL application filed AFTER entry into force is still decided under the previous Law on Foreigners (Sl. list CG 12/18, 3/19, 86/22, 77/24) — so it is not merely the original grant that is protected. Art. 218a preserves the validity of already-issued permits to their stated expiry. Qualifying property types under the base art. 56: family houses, holiday houses, villas, apartments, hospitality premises, mixed residential-commercial buildings and business premises. Montenegro's citizenship-by-investment programme ended 31 December 2022 (tier-3 only; not independently confirmed here). METHOD NOTE: sluzbenilist.me returns 403 to automated fetchers but loads in a real browser, and serves statutory text ONLY as rasterised page images with no text layer, no PDF and no full-text search — the findings above were read visually off those images.
programmes.notes_zh: 坊間流傳的 1 月 9 日與 1 月 17 日皆屬實，但指涉不同事項——2026 年 1 月 9 日為公報刊登日，2026 年 1 月 17 日為生效日（依第 92 條，刊登後第 8 日生效）。15 萬歐元規定係修正法第 24 條，於《外國人法》第 56 條增訂數項。豁免範圍較坊間常見報導更寬：提出價值證明之義務不適用於歐盟會員國公民，亦不適用於其家庭成員（不論該家庭成員本身國籍為何），並不適用於冰島、列支敦斯登、挪威及瑞士公民。既得保障亦較外界所知更強：新增第 217b 條規定，生效前已取得不動產類臨時居留許可之外國人，其於生效後提出之續期申請，仍依修正前之《外國人法》（政府公報 12/18、3/19、86/22、77/24）辦理——受保障者不限於原始核發。第 218a 條並保留已核發許可至其所載屆期日之效力。母法第 56 條之合格不動產類型：家庭住宅、度假屋、別墅、公寓、餐旅場所、住商混合建物及營業場所。蒙特內哥羅之投資入籍計畫於 2022 年 12 月 31 日結束（僅第三級來源，未獨立查證）。方法備註：sluzbenilist.me 對自動抓取回應 403，惟以真實瀏覽器可正常載入；其法條僅以掃描頁面影像提供，無文字層、無 PDF、亦無全文檢索，上述內容係以肉眼判讀影像取得。

companion_requirements.text_en: MAJOR FINDING: art. 43 of the Law on Foreigners sets GENERAL conditions that apply across ALL temporary-residence grounds, including art. 56 (real estate): means of subsistence (sredstva za izdrzavanje), already-secured accommodation (obezbijedjen smjestaj), and health insurance (zdravstveno osiguranje). Art. 56 itself only ADDS a proof-of-ownership requirement on top of these general conditions — it does not replace or waive them. In other words, buying the property is necessary but not sufficient; the applicant must separately evidence living costs and health cover. Source quality caveat: this rests on a single tier-2 source (Paragraf.me, a recognised Montenegrin legal publisher); the official gazette (sluzbenilist.me) could not be accessed directly (blocks automated retrieval and is scanned-image-only) to cross-confirm at tier 1. Flagged as tier 2, pending official-gazette verification.
companion_requirements.text_zh: 重大發現：《外國人法》第 43 條設有適用於所有暫時居留事由（含第 56 條不動產）之一般共同要件：生活費來源（sredstva za izdrzavanje）、已備妥之住所（obezbijedjen smjestaj）、健康保險（zdravstveno osiguranje）。第 56 條本身只是在這些一般要件之上再加一項所有權舉證，並未取代或豁免第 43 條——即買房是必要但不充分條件，另須分別舉證生活費與健保。來源品質警示：本項僅有單一第二級來源（Paragraf.me，蒙特內哥羅知名法律出版商），官方公報（sluzbenilist.me）無法直接存取（阻擋自動抓取且僅有掃描影像）以升格為第一級。標記為第二級，待官方公報覆核。

dependants.text_en: The statute expressly extends the art. 15(h) USD 300,000 investment permit to spouse, minor child and dependants. It does not do so for the art. 15(j) property permit; the position for property-permit dependants was not established.
dependants.text_zh: 法條就第 15 條第 h 款之 30 萬美元投資許可明文及於配偶、未成年子女及受扶養人；就第 15 條第 j 款之不動產許可則無此明文，其眷屬適用情形未查證。

entry_tax.text_en: No property transfer tax or stamp duty; only a registration fee (order of 50–200 GEL, tier 3 — treat as indicative). Residential property held more than 2 years is exempt from personal income tax on disposal gains.

last_change.text_en: Threshold raised from USD 100,000 to USD 150,000 by Law of Georgia No. 670 of 12 June 2025, effective 1 MARCH 2026 (the amendment appears in the statute's official amendment history at tier 1; the 1 March 2026 effective date is tier 2). FORWARD-LOOKING FLAG: Law No. 1803 of 25 June 2026, effective 1 September 2026, amends the residence-permit regime generally (new D6 student-minor visa, new spouse-of-citizen permit, study-permit monitoring). It does not appear to change the property threshold; the position should be checked again after 1 September 2026.

companion_requirements.text_en: No hidden companion requirements (health insurance, stay days, mortgage restriction) were found at tier 1/2; this is a checked-and-not-found result, not a confirmed absence. Multiple non-law-firm sources suggest permit holders themselves face no mandatory health-insurance rule (Georgia introduced a minimum GEL 30,000 medical-insurance requirement for tourists from 2026, which does not apply to residence-permit holders), but this is tier-3 material and not adopted as a finding. Off-plan property is widely reported by real-estate press (tier 3, not adopted) to be ineligible pending a certified valuation of a completed unit, consistent with — but not confirming — the existing inference.
companion_requirements.text_zh: 健保、居住天數、貸款限制三項候選之隱藏配套要求，均查無第一／二級來源可用；此為查證未果，非確認不存在。多個非律所來源顯示居留許可持有人本身並無強制健保規定（喬治亞自 2026 年起對『觀光客』新增最低 3 萬拉里醫療保險要求，居留許可持有人不適用），惟屬第三級來源，不採為結論。房地產媒體（第三級，不採信）多稱期房不合格、須待完工並經認證鑑價，方向與既有推論一致，惟不構成確立。

min_value.basis: NO PUBLISHED MINIMUM. The statute sets no monetary threshold; art. 31(6), added on 21 November 2024 by Law No. 7533, provides that 'the nature and value of the immovable property forming the basis for granting a short-term residence permit shall be determined by the MINISTRY'. The widely quoted USD 200,000 is therefore an administrative figure set by internal circular, not a statutory one — and it could not be found on any official page. The Presidency of Migration Management's own residence-permit-types page enumerates the property ground and states no monetary threshold at all; a site-restricted search for '200.000' and 'ABD doları' returned zero results. No USD 200,000 figure is established.

term.text_en: Up to TWO years per grant — art. 31(2): 'her defasında en fazla ikişer yıllık sürelerle' (each time for periods of at most two years).
term.text_zh: 每次核發最長 2 年——第 31 條第 2 項：「每次至多 2 年」。

stay.text_en: Not established. Art. 32's general requirements (see companion_requirements) are also silent on any day-count. Confirmed by direct reading of the statute, not merely unchecked.
stay.text_zh: 未能確立。第 32 條一般要件（見 companion_requirements）本身也未列入天數要求。已直接查對法條原文確認，非僅未查。

leads_to.text_en: Long-term residence permit after 8 years' continuous residence (Law No. 6458 arts. 42–43).
leads_to.text_zh: 連續居住滿 8 年後可申請長期居留許可（第 6458 號法律第 42 至 43 條）。

offplan.text_en: Not established. The property must be a DWELLING (konut) and must be USED as such — which implies a completed, habitable unit, but no source addresses off-plan directly.
offplan.text_zh: 未查證。該不動產須為住宅（konut）且須實際作住宅使用，隱含須為已完工可居住之單位，惟無來源直接論及預售屋。

mortgage.text_en: Not established. Two mutually contradictory third-party claims were found: one that the property must be free of any mortgage or transfer-restriction annotation, another that permit holders may mortgage an already-purchased property under Civil Code art. 881 and consumer-protection rules. Neither is an official or law-firm source, and they contradict each other, so neither is adopted. Genuinely unresolved, not merely unchecked.
mortgage.text_zh: 未能確立。查到兩則互相矛盾的第三方說法：一稱物件不得設有抵押權或禁止過戶註記，另一稱持證人依民法第 881 條及消費者保護規定可就已購物件申辦房貸。兩者皆非官方或律所來源，且互相矛盾，均不採信。確實未解決，非僅未查。

dependants.text_en: Family members may apply under the same ground, BUT ONLY IF they themselves hold shared or joint ownership (payli veya elbirligi mulkiyet) of the dwelling. Family members are defined as the applicant's spouse, minor child and dependent adult child. This ownership condition is routinely omitted by secondary sources.
dependants.text_zh: 家庭成員得依同一事由申請，惟以其本身對該住宅擁有分別共有或公同共有（payli veya elbirligi mulkiyet）之所有權為限。家庭成員定義為申請人之配偶、未成年子女及受扶養之成年子女。此一所有權條件常為次級來源所省略。

entry_tax.text_en: NOT OBTAINED. The title deed fee (tapu harci), commonly quoted as 4% split between buyer and seller, and the VAT exemption conditions for foreign buyers, could not be sourced — tapu.gov.tr renders no fee schedule and the authoritative source is Tariff 4 of Harclar Kanunu No. 492, which was not extracted. No figure is published here.
entry_tax.text_zh: 未取得。坊間常引之過戶規費（tapu harci）4%（買賣雙方分擔）及外國買方之加值稅豁免條件，均無法取得可引用出處——tapu.gov.tr 未呈現費率表，權威依據為第 492 號《規費法》附表四，未擷取。故不刊登任何數字。

last_change.text_en: Art. 31(6) added 21 November 2024 by Law No. 7533, transferring the power to set the qualifying property's nature and value to the Ministry. The practical consequence is that the threshold can now change WITHOUT any gazette amendment.
last_change.text_zh: 第 31 條第 6 項於 2024 年 11 月 21 日經第 7533 號法律增訂，將合格不動產之性質與價值之決定權移轉予部會。實務結果是門檻自此可在不修法、不刊登公報之情況下變動。

programmes.notes_en: The property ground is art. 31(1)(b) — 'Turkiye'de tasinmaz mali bulunanlar' — not art. 31(1)(f), which is the medical-treatment ground and is sometimes cited in error. Confidence is medium solely because the threshold could not be established; the route's existence, term, dependants rule and dwelling-use condition are all tier-1. The property must be a dwelling and must be used as one — not land, not commercial premises. NOT VERIFIED, and therefore not published: the 'closed neighbourhood' rule under which districts where the foreign resident share exceeds a threshold percentage are closed to new residence permits. The commonly cited 20% figure appears on no official page reached; the rule's current percentage and whether it is still operating are both unverified. Omission is preferred to the 20% figure.
programmes.notes_zh: 不動產事由為第 31 條第 1 項第 b 款（「在土耳其擁有不動產者」），並非有時被誤引的第 f 款（就醫事由）。信心度列為中等，僅因門檻無法確立；該途徑之存在、效期、眷屬規則與住宅使用條件均為第一級來源。該不動產須為住宅且實際作住宅使用，不含土地與商用場所。未查證故不刊登：所謂「封閉社區」規則（外籍居民比例超過一定百分比之行政區停止核發新居留許可）。坊間常引之 20% 未見於任何可觸及之官方頁面，該比例現值及規則是否仍在運作皆未經查證，寧可從缺。

companion_requirements.text_en: MAJOR FINDING, and it runs the OPPOSITE direction from the Greece/Montenegro pattern: art. 32 of Law No. 6458 ('requirements for a short-term residence permit') is the general condition clause covering ALL short-term residence grounds under art. 31, including this one (art. 31(1)(b), property owner). Its requirements are: (a) hold one of the art. 31(1) grounds and produce supporting documents; (b) not fall within the art. 7 entry-ban categories; (c) have accommodation meeting general health and safety standards; (ç) produce a clean-criminal-record certificate on request; (d) provide a domestic address. Art. 32 does NOT include a health-insurance requirement — by contrast, art. 35 ('requirements for a family residence permit') explicitly requires health insurance covering all family members. This directly contradicts the widely repeated marketing claim that 'all Turkish residence permits require health insurance' — at least for this property-owner short-term ground, that claim has no statutory basis (it may exist at a sub-statutory implementing-regulation level not reached in this review, but not in the law itself).
companion_requirements.text_zh: 重大發現，且方向與希臘／蒙特內哥羅相反：第 6458 號法律第 32 條「短期居留許可之要件」是涵蓋第 31 條所有短期居留事由（含本項第 31(1)(b) 業主事由）之一般條件條款。其內容為：(a) 具備第 31 條第 1 項事由並提出文件；(b) 不屬第 7 條禁止入境情形；(c) 具備符合一般衛生安全標準之居住條件；(ç) 應要求時提出無犯罪紀錄證明；(d) 提供境內地址。第 32 條並未列入健康保險要求——相較之下，第 35 條「家庭居留許可要件」則明文要求為全體家庭成員投保健康保險。這與業界普遍流傳「土耳其所有居留許可皆須投保健康保險」之說法直接相反——至少對第 31(1)(b) 業主短期居留這一類，該說法查無母法依據（可能僅存在於施行細則層級，未觸及）。

programmes.programme: Citizenship by investment via real estate, Regulation on the Implementation of the Turkish Citizenship Law art. 20(2)(b)
programmes.programme_zh: 不動產投資入籍（《土耳其國籍法施行細則》第 20 條第 2 項第 b 款）

min_value.basis: USD 400,000 or equivalent foreign currency, with a THREE-YEAR NO-SALE ANNOTATION (satilmamasi serhi) recorded on the title register. Qualifying property is narrowed to units on which condominium ownership or condominium easement has been established, or land classified as a plot with a building on it.

extra_tiers.label_en: Non-property alternatives, for context — fixed capital investment, bank deposit, government bonds, investment fund units, or private pension, each USD 500,000; or employment of 50 persons

term.text_en: Citizenship, not a residence permit — no term.
term.text_zh: 取得者為公民身分而非居留許可，無效期問題。

stay.text_en: None — this is a naturalisation route requiring no prior residence period.
stay.text_zh: 無——本途徑為歸化，不要求先行居住一定期間。

leads_to.text_en: Turkish citizenship directly.
leads_to.text_zh: 直接取得土耳其公民身分。

offplan.text_en: Two mechanisms qualify under art. 20(2)(b) of the Regulation on the Implementation of the Turkish Citizenship Law. (1) Direct purchase of a unit on which condominium ownership (kat mulkiyeti) OR condominium easement (kat irtifaki) has been established, or land with a building on it, with a 3-year non-transfer annotation on the title. (2) A notarised pre-sale purchase-promise contract (noter satis vaadi sozlesmesi) with full advance payment for a unit on which condominium EASEMENT (kat irtifaki) has already been established — condominium easement typically attaches once the building permit issues, i.e. during construction, well before completion. An off-plan unit that has already reached the kat irtifaki registration stage therefore qualifies via the notarised pre-sale mechanism, even though it is not yet complete. The precise boundary is: bare land with no kat irtifaki registration at all is excluded; a pre-sale unit that has reached the kat irtifaki stage is not.
offplan.text_zh: 《土耳其國籍法施行細則》第 20 條第 2 項第 b 款下有兩種合格路徑。①直接購買已設定區分所有權（kat mulkiyeti）或區分地上權（kat irtifaki）之單位，或其上已有建物之土地，並於產權登記加註 3 年不得移轉。②以公證『買賣預約契約』（noter satis vaadi sozlesmesi）方式，就一個已設定區分地上權（kat irtifaki）之單位提前全額付款——區分地上權通常於建照核發、即施工階段即可設定，早於完工。已進入區分地上權登記階段之預售屋，可透過公證預約途徑合格，即使尚未完工。精確之界線為：完全無區分地上權登記之素地被排除；已達區分地上權階段之預售屋則不被排除。

mortgage.text_en: Not established. Directly re-read the full text of art. 20(2)(b) (all surrounding paragraphs): it regulates only the amount threshold, ownership form, the 3-year non-transfer annotation and payment method — no mortgage (ipotek/rehin) restriction of any kind appears. Multiple third-party sources claim the qualifying property must be mortgage-free, but this cannot be traced to the statute or the implementing regulation itself; it may exist at a valuation/appraisal sub-regulation not reached here. Confirmed silent at the regulation level, not merely unchecked.
mortgage.text_zh: 未能確立。已直接查對第 20 條第 2 項第 b 款全文（前後段落皆已讀取），條文僅規範金額門檻、產權型態、3 年不得移轉註記與付款方式，未見任何抵押權（ipotek/rehin）限制文字。坊間多個來源聲稱合格物件須無抵押權，惟查無母法或本細則依據，可能存在於鑑價作業規範等未觸及之附屬規定。已確認施行細則層級沉默，非僅未查。

dependants.text_en: MAJOR FINDING: art. 36(2) of the Implementing Regulation provides that the spouse and children of a person who acquires Turkish citizenship are governed by art. 37. Art. 37 provides: (1) subsequent acquisition of Turkish citizenship does NOT affect the spouse's own nationality status — i.e. the SPOUSE DOES NOT automatically acquire citizenship and must pursue it separately (e.g. via the marriage route, which requires 3 years of marriage); (2)-(3) MINOR children (under 18) DO acquire citizenship automatically together with the parent, but if only one parent is naturalising and the other parent is not Turkish, that other parent's consent is required. Adult children (18+) are not covered by this article. This corrects a common marketing claim that 'spouse and minor children are automatically naturalised together' — the precise rule is that only minor children are automatic; the spouse is not.
dependants.text_zh: 重大發現：施行細則第 36 條第 2 項規定，取得土耳其國籍者之配偶及子女，適用第 37 條之規定。第 37 條規定：(1) 嗣後取得土耳其國籍，不影響配偶之國籍身分——即配偶不會因投資人入籍而自動取得國籍，須另循他途（例如婚姻入籍需已婚滿 3 年）；(2)(3) 未成年子女（未滿 18 歲）則隨父母同時取得國籍，若父母僅一方入籍且另一方非土耳其籍，須經該非土耳其籍配偶同意。成年子女（18 歲以上）未見本條涵蓋。此點修正坊間常見說法「配偶與未成年子女可隨投資人一同入籍」——精確而言僅未成年子女自動隨同，配偶不自動入籍。

entry_tax.text_en: NOT OBTAINED — see the Turkey residence-permit entry. No figure published.
entry_tax.text_zh: 未取得——參見土耳其居留許可條目。不刊登任何數字。

companion_requirements.text_en: This is a naturalisation route, not a residence permit, so it carries no health-insurance or income test of its own. The one genuine companion condition is the family-scope rule under art. 36/37 — see the `dependants` field: the spouse is NOT automatically naturalised alongside the investor and must pursue a separate route (e.g. marriage-based naturalisation after 3 years); only minor children are automatically included.
companion_requirements.text_zh: 本途徑為入籍程序，非居留許可，本身不設健保或收入測試。唯一真正的配套條件是第 36／37 條之家屬範圍規則——見 dependants 欄位：配偶不因投資人入籍而自動入籍，須另循他途（例如已婚滿 3 年之婚姻入籍）；僅未成年子女自動隨同。

programmes.programme: Temporary residence on the basis of ownership of immovable property, Law on Foreigners art. 54
programmes.programme_zh: 以不動產所有權為由之臨時居留（《外國人法》第 54 條）

min_value.basis: NO MINIMUM VALUE. Art. 54 imposes an ownership and use test, not a value test: the property must be a residential building or apartment in which the foreigner resides. Confirmed absent from the statutory text.

term.text_en: Up to THREE years, renewable for the same period — art. 44(1): 'Privremeni boravak moze se odobriti u trajanju do tri godine i moze se produzavati na isti period'.
term.text_zh: 最長 3 年，並得就同一期間續期——第 44 條第 1 項：「臨時居留得核准至 3 年，並得就同一期間延長」。

stay.text_en: Art. 54 requires that the property be one 'in which the foreigner resides', so actual occupation is part of the ground itself. No separate day-count was established.
stay.text_zh: 第 54 條要求該不動產須為「外國人所居住者」，故實際居住本身即為事由之一部。未另查得具體天數規定。

leads_to.text_en: Permanent residence after 3 years' continuous temporary residence — art. 67(2), reduced from 5 years by the 2023 amendment; tolerance is 10 months' absence in total or 6 months in a single absence. CAUTION: the Citizenship Law separately requires 3 years of registered residence (prebivaliste) under art. 14(1)(3), and whether that clock runs concurrently with or after the permanent-residence qualifying period is unclear — so a clean '6 years to citizenship' total cannot be stated.
leads_to.text_zh: 連續臨時居留滿 3 年後可申請永久居留——第 67 條第 2 項，2023 年修法由 5 年縮短為 3 年；離境容許為累計 10 個月或單次 6 個月。注意：《公民法》第 14 條第 1 項第 3 款另要求 3 年之設籍居住（prebivaliste），該年限與永久居留資格年限係併行或接續尚不明確，故無法給出「6 年入籍」的簡化總計。

offplan.text_en: A text-based finding, not merely an inference: art. 54(2) defines the qualifying property as one 'in which the foreigner actually resides' (stanuje) — actual habitation is part of the statutory element itself, not merely an implied inference from context. This directly excludes an undelivered off-plan unit.
offplan.text_zh: 條文直接確立，非僅推論：第 54 條第 2 項將合格不動產定義為外國人『實際居住』於其中之住宅或公寓——實際居住為構成要件之一部，非僅上下文推論。此直接排除尚未交屋之預售單位。

mortgage.text_en: Not established.
mortgage.text_zh: 未能確立。

dependants.text_en: Established: art. 54 covers ONLY the property owner personally. It does not extend to spouse or children — family members must apply separately under art. 55 ('family reunification') rather than piggybacking on the same property-based permit.
dependants.text_zh: 確立：第 54 條僅規範物件所有人本人，條文未將此一事由延伸至配偶或子女——家屬須另循第 55 條『家庭團聚』事由個別申請，不能依附同一筆不動產許可。

entry_tax.text_en: Real-estate transfer tax 2.5% where VAT does not apply, the base being the contract price adjustable to market value. Reduced VAT rate of 10% on new-build residential supply (VAT Law art. 23(2)(14)).

min_value.basis: No fixed property-value threshold; the qualifying condition is title-transfer status. AS OF THE 2025 AMENDMENTS (A.E.336/2025, A.E.386/2025): a holder who has completed title transfer is exempt from any income threshold; a holder with only a court-approved sale agreement (not yet transferred) still needs monthly income at or above minimum wage, or an equivalent deposit, plus at least one-third of the contract price paid and Council of Ministers approval. The EUR 50,000 figure elsewhere in this record is a SEPARATE entry-visa financial-proof requirement, unrelated to this residence-permit threshold.

term.text_en: The current consolidated text (mevzuat.gov.ct.tr, the constitutional legislation-of-record authority, consolidated to 19 February 2026), art. 14(2)(b)(iv), as amended by A.E.336/2025 (30 April 2025) and A.E.386/2025 (15 May 2025), reads: a holder who has completed title transfer is exempt from any income threshold, and the permit may be issued for up to 5 years. A holder who has only a court-approved sale agreement without transfer (art. 14(2)(b)(v)) still requires proof of income at or above minimum wage (or an equivalent deposit), also valid up to 5 years. The 'not a genuine investment-migration product, just an ordinary income-tested permit' characterisation applies only to the untransferred-contract track.
term.text_zh: 現行合併條文（mevzuat.gov.ct.tr，中央法規局，2026 年 2 月 19 日合併版）第 14(2)(b)(iv) 條，經 A.E.336/2025（2025-04-30）及 A.E.386/2025（2025-05-15）修正後：已完成產權過戶者，免除任何收入門檻，居留許可可核發最長 5 年。僅持已核准買賣合約而未過戶者（第 14(2)(b)(v) 條），仍須月收入達最低薪資或等額存款，效期同樣放寬至最長 5 年。『非真正投資移民商品，僅為一般收入審查許可』之定性僅適用於未過戶合約軌道。

stay.text_en: Confirmed ABSENT, not merely unchecked: a full read of the current and prior consolidated regulation, arts. 11-25 (especially art. 23 on refusal/revocation/non-renewal grounds), found no 'absence beyond a proportion triggers revocation' clause of the kind seen in North Macedonia's art. 79(4). Grounds are limited to non-eligibility, false statement, misuse of purpose, deportation/entry-ban order, family/student-permit-specific grounds, being wanted by police, an adverse police report, or working without a permit.
stay.text_zh: 確認為「無此規定」，非僅未查：新舊兩版規則第 11–25 條（特別是第 23 條拒發／撤銷／不予續期事由）之全文中，未見類似北馬其頓第 79(4) 條「缺席逾比例即撤銷」之條款。事由僅限於不符資格、虛偽陳述、濫用許可目的、遭驅逐／禁入令、家庭／學生許可特別事由、遭通緝、警方負面報告、無工作許可卻工作。

programmes.notes_en: REFRAMED, NOT A RESIDENCY-BY-INVESTMENT PRODUCT. Three traps circulate widely. (1) The frequently repeated 'three properties' allowance is a RECIPROCITY-ONLY exception available to nationals of states that recognise the TRNC — functionally Turkish nationals only. It is not a general foreigner allowance. (2) The EUR 50,000 figure circulating online is a PRE-PURCHASE ENTRY-VISA FUNDS TEST under art. 9(1)(a)(c) of the residence regulation, not a property threshold. (3) The transfer and VAT rates in agency material could not be traced to official sources. IMPORTANT CONTEXT FOR ANY READER: the TRNC is recognised only by Turkey; its documents have no international standing, and title to property in northern Cyprus may be subject to competing claims by displaced pre-1974 owners, with judgments enforceable in EU member states. Confidence is medium because the route's core parameters are tier-1 but its practical characterisation, taxes and onward path are not established. AS OF THE 2025 AMENDMENTS, the 'not a genuine investment-migration product' characterisation holds only for the untransferred-contract track (art. 14(2)(b)(v)). The title-transfer-completed track (art. 14(2)(b)(iv)) is now close to a conventional property-for-residence product (no income test).
programmes.notes_zh: 已重新定性，並非投資移民產品。三個廣為流傳的陷阱：（一）常見的「可購三戶」係僅適用於承認北賽政權國家之國民的對等待遇例外，實務上僅土耳其國民適用，並非一般外國人之額度。（二）網路流傳之 5 萬歐元係居留規則第 9 條第 1 項第 a 款第 c 目之購置前入境簽證財力證明，並非不動產門檻。（三）仲介資料所載之移轉稅與加值稅率無法追溯至官方出處。讀者須知之重要背景：北賽政權僅獲土耳其承認，其文件不具國際效力；北賽不動產產權可能面臨 1974 年前流離原所有權人之權利主張，且相關判決在歐盟會員國具可執行性。信心度列為中等，係因該途徑之核心規範屬第一級來源，惟其實務定性、稅負與後續途徑均未確立。經 2025 年修法後，「非真正投資移民商品」之定性，目前僅在「未過戶合約持有者」（第 14(2)(b)(v) 條）這條軌道上仍然成立。已過戶產權者軌道（第 14(2)(b)(iv) 條），現已相當接近典型的「買房換居留」商品（無收入審查）。

companion_requirements.text_en: Structure changed materially by the 2025 amendments. Title-transfer-completed holders now face almost no companion requirements beyond general conditions common to all permits (accommodation meeting health/safety standards, no public-health threat, no entry/residence ban) — no income test. Untransferred-contract holders still need: monthly income at or above minimum wage or an equivalent deposit; at least one-third of the contract price paid; and Council of Ministers approval. Separately, an EUR 50,000 financial-proof requirement applies only to obtaining an ENTRY VISA before any purchase — it is not a residence-permit threshold and should not be conflated with either track above.
companion_requirements.text_zh: 2025 年修法後結構已實質改變。已完成產權過戶者，現在幾乎不需要額外配套（免收入門檻），僅須符合一般性條件（住所符合安全衛生標準、無公衛威脅疾病、無入境／居留禁令）。未過戶、僅持買賣合約者，仍須：月收入達最低薪資或等值存款；合約已付至少 1/3 價款；並經部長會議許可。另外，5 萬歐元財力證明僅適用於購買前申請入境簽證，非居留許可門檻，不應與上述兩軌混為一談。

programmes.programme: Temporary and permanent residence permits for owners of immovable property, Migration Code art. 45
programmes.programme_zh: 不動產所有人臨時及永久居留許可（《移民法典》第 45 條）

min_value.basis: TEMPORARY residence permit — 'in case they possess real estate which is worth at least 100,000 manats'

extra_tiers.label_en: PERMANENT residence permit — AZN 200,000 of immovable property AND at least two years of prior temporary residence in Azerbaijan. This is a SEQUENTIAL higher stage, not a parallel tier of temporary residence.

term.text_en: Temporary permit: initial term up to 1 year, extended for up to 2 years each time. Permanent permit: 5 years, renewable for further 5-year periods with no limit on renewals; reapplication must be made at least 3 months before expiry.
term.text_zh: 臨時許可：初次最長 1 年，其後每次延長最長 2 年。永久許可：5 年，得再延長 5 年且續期次數不限；須於屆期前至少 3 個月提出申請。

stay.text_en: Established for the permanent-residence-eligibility context: 'considered continuous if the applicant has not left the country for a period of more than 90 days within 180 days' (official page). This definition appears in the permanent-residence-transition context; it is not confirmed whether the same definition governs the temporary stage's own maintenance requirement.
stay.text_zh: 就永久居留銜接脈絡確立：官方頁面明文「連續居留」定義為任何 180 天期間內離境不逾 90 天。此定義出現於永久居留銜接脈絡下，是否同等適用臨時居留階段本身之維持要件，未經確認。

leads_to.text_en: The permanent residence permit is reachable via the AZN 200,000 route after two years' temporary residence. NO SOURCE reached addresses any path from permanent residence to citizenship; nothing is asserted.
leads_to.text_zh: 經 2 年臨時居留後，可循 20 萬馬納特途徑取得永久居留許可。所觸及之來源均未論及永久居留與公民身分之連結，故不作任何主張。

offplan.text_en: Not established. Checked directly against the two official application-document checklists (migration.gov.az): neither page mentions this topic. The statutory source itself has been read and is silent; a further search for law-firm commentary was not completed due to search-budget exhaustion, so this remains 'not established' rather than 'confirmed absent'.
offplan.text_zh: 未能確立。 直接核對兩份官方申請文件清單（migration.gov.az）：兩頁皆未提及此議題。法源本身已讀過且沉默；因搜尋額度用盡未能進一步查證律所評論，故維持『未查證』而非『確認不存在』。

entry_tax.text_en: CONFLICT — neither is adopted. Two tier-2 Azerbaijani law firms disagree on the basis of property transfer taxation: one states a flat AZN 15 per square metre, the other a percentage of cadastral value. The disagreement is unresolved and no figure is published.
entry_tax.text_zh: 有衝突，兩者皆不採用。兩家第二級亞塞拜然律師事務所就不動產移轉課稅基礎見解不同：一稱按每平方公尺 15 馬納特定額課徵，另一稱按地籍價值之一定百分比課徵。歧異未解，故不刊登任何數字。

last_change.text_en: Approximate window established (not a precise gazette date): a mainstream Azerbaijani outlet (Caliber.az, tier 2) places the relevant procedural amendment in roughly the first half of 2023; an unverified search-summary claim of '4 April 2023 passed, 16 May 2023 in force' was found but the source page itself was not independently opened, so that precise date is not adopted. Best supportable statement: approximately 2023, exact date not established.
last_change.text_zh: 已由完全空白進展到約略區間（尚未達精確公報日期）：亞塞拜然主流媒體（Caliber.az，第二級）稱相關程序性修法約落於 2023 年上半年；另有一則未獨立開啟原頁核對之搜尋摘要稱『2023/4/4 通過、2023/5/16 生效』，因未獨立核對原頁，不予採信。最佳表述為：約 2023 年上半年，確切公報日期未達第一級標準。

short.term_en: Temporary 1 yr then 2 yrs; permanent 5 yrs, renewable without limit
short.term_zh: 暫時居留首次 1 年、其後每次 2 年；永久居留 5 年，續期次數無上限
short.outcome_en: Permanent permit via the AZN 200,000 tier after 2 yrs; citizenship not addressed
short.outcome_zh: 持有 20 萬馬納特物件並居留 2 年後取得永久居留；入籍未見規定
short.own_en: Immovable property at the stated value
short.own_zh: 持有達規定價值之不動產

programmes.notes_en: AZN 100,000 and AZN 200,000 are NOT two tiers of temporary residence, and presenting them as parallel temporary tiers would mislead. AZN 100,000 is the TEMPORARY residence threshold; AZN 200,000 is the PERMANENT residence threshold and additionally requires two years of prior temporary residence. Unresolved: whether the AZN 100,000 property ground and a same-value bank-deposit ground are the same Migration Code clause or distinct ones. The manat has been pegged at approximately 1.70 AZN to the US dollar since 2017 (tier 2/3 — cbar.az was unreachable), so the USD figures here carry that additional caveat.
programmes.notes_zh: 10 萬與 20 萬馬納特並非臨時居留之兩個級距，將兩者並列為臨時居留級距將造成誤導：10 萬馬納特為臨時居留門檻，20 萬馬納特為永久居留門檻，且另須先行取得 2 年臨時居留。未解決事項：10 萬馬納特之不動產事由與同額之銀行存款事由，究係《移民法典》同一條款或分屬不同條款。馬納特自 2017 年起約以 1.70 兌 1 美元固定（第二／三級來源，中央銀行網站無法連線），故本條目之美元換算另負此一保留。

companion_requirements.text_en: Established from two official application-document checklists: beyond the real-estate value threshold, applicants must provide (1) a MANDATORY medical certificate (infectious-disease screening, NOT health insurance); (2) general proof of means of living (waivable if a close relative provides a guarantee); (3) residential registration documents and fee payment. No formal income test, no mandatory health insurance, no one-off donation or participation fee was found — materially lighter than the Malaysia case, but a real companion requirement that the prior structured fields did not surface. Separately, reaching the PERMANENT stage (after 2 years temporary + AZN 200,000) requires 'continuous' residence, defined on a separate official page as not more than 90 days' absence within any 180-day period — that definition appears in a permanent-residence context and it is not confirmed whether it also governs maintenance of the temporary stage itself.
companion_requirements.text_zh: 自兩份官方申請文件清單新增查得：除不動產價值門檻外，申請人須提供 (1) 強制性健康證明（傳染病篩檢，非健康保險）；(2) 一般生活財力證明（近親可擔保豁免）；(3) 居住登記文件與規費繳納證明。未查得正式收入測試、強制健康保險、一次性捐款或參與費——遠比馬來西亞案例輕，但確實為既有結構化欄位未呈現之真實配套要求。另外，進入永久居留階段（2 年臨時居留＋20 萬馬納特後）須符合『連續』居留，另一官方頁面將此定義為任何 180 天期間內離境不超過 90 天——該定義出現於永久居留銜接脈絡，是否同等適用臨時居留階段本身之維持要件，未經確認。

programmes.programme: Temporary residence on the basis of ownership of an apartment, residential building or house, Law on Foreigners art. 119(1)
programmes.programme_zh: 以公寓、住宅建物或房屋所有權為由之臨時居留（《外國人法》第 119 條第 1 項）

min_value.basis: Minimum value of an apartment, residential building or house — BUT the route is open ONLY to citizens of an EU member state or of the OECD, or to persons qualifying under a treaty ratified in accordance with the Constitution

term.text_en: Up to 1 year (art. 119(2)), renewable annually, each extension a maximum of one year (art. 79(1)–(2)).
term.text_zh: 最長 1 年（第 119 條第 2 項），得逐年續期，每次延長最長 1 年（第 79 條第 1 至 2 項）。

stay.text_en: REAL AND MATERIAL. Art. 79(4): renewal is refused if the holder, without justification, did not reside in North Macedonia for more than one quarter of the permit period — implying roughly nine months' presence per year. This is not a passive-holding permit.
stay.text_zh: 確有實質居住要求。第 79 條第 4 項：持有人無正當理由而未於北馬其頓境內居住之期間超過許可期間之四分之一者，續期即遭駁回，換言之每年約需 9 個月在境內。本許可並非被動持有型。

leads_to.text_en: NONE — EXPRESSLY BARRED. Art. 129(4), third indent: permanent residence 'shall not be granted to a foreigner who has an approved temporary residence for the purpose of acquiring ownership rights over an apartment, residential building or house'. Ordinary permanent residence requires five years' continuous temporary residence under art. 129(1), but time on this permit does not count and permanent residence will not be granted. Since residence-based naturalisation runs through permanent residence, this route leads nowhere beyond rolling one-year permits.
leads_to.text_zh: 無，且經明文排除。第 129 條第 4 項第 3 目：「以取得公寓、住宅建物或房屋所有權為目的而獲准臨時居留之外國人」不得核發永久居留。依第 129 條第 1 項，一般永久居留須連續臨時居留 5 年，惟本許可之期間不予計入，且不得核發永久居留。由於居住型歸化須經由永久居留，本途徑除逐年展延外別無出路。

offplan.text_en: Not established.
offplan.text_zh: 未能確立。

mortgage.text_en: Not established.
mortgage.text_zh: 未能確立。

dependants.text_en: Not established. The law does not attach family reunification to this category, and nothing is asserted either way.
dependants.text_zh: 未查證。法律未就本類別規定家庭團聚，故正反皆不作主張。

entry_tax.text_en: Property transfer tax 2%–4% under the Law on Property Taxes, set by each municipality, with Skopje commonly at 3%; the statutory payer is generally the SELLER. Tier 2/3 only — medium confidence.
entry_tax.text_zh: 依《財產稅法》課徵 2% 至 4% 之不動產移轉稅，由各市政當局訂定，斯科普里通常為 3%；法定納稅義務人一般為賣方。僅有第二／三級來源，信心度中等。

last_change.text_en: Law on Foreigners, Sluzben vesnik na RM No. 97/18, amended by Nos. 108/19, 294/21 and 284/23. No later amendment to the property provision was identified.
last_change.text_zh: 《外國人法》，《北馬其頓共和國官方公報》第 97/18 號，經第 108/19、294/21、284/23 號修正。未發現不動產條款有更晚近之修正。

short.term_en: Up to 1 yr, renewed annually
short.term_zh: 最長 1 年，逐年續期
short.stay_en: Renewal refused below roughly nine months present per year
short.stay_zh: 每年在境內未達約 9 個月者，續期遭駁回
short.outcome_en: Expressly barred from permanent residence by art. 129(4)
short.outcome_zh: 依第 129(4) 條明文排除於永久居留之外
short.own_en: Apartment, residential building or house; open to EU and OECD citizens only
short.own_zh: 公寓、住宅樓或房屋；僅限歐盟與 OECD 國民

programmes.notes_en: The route DOES exist and the EUR 40,000 figure is correct and statutory — but quoting the EUR 40,000 without two further qualifiers would be misleading. (1) IT IS CLOSED TO MOST NATIONALITIES: eligibility is gated to citizens of an EU member state or of the OECD. A buyer from outside that set cannot use this route at any price. Note a drafting shift worth flagging: the pre-2018 law said 'resident of an EU member state AND the OECD'; the current law says 'citizen of an EU member state OR the OECD'. (2) IT IS A STATUTORY DEAD END for permanent residence, by express exclusion. General conditions under art. 72 also apply: subsistence means, accommodation, health insurance, no public-order threat, no unconditional sentence exceeding six months, no pending criminal proceedings. TWO CAVEATS. The phrase 'under conditions established by law' in art. 119(1) subordinates the purchase to North Macedonia's property-ownership law, which applies reciprocity conditions to foreign buyers and generally bars agricultural land; that was not separately verified. And the Ministry of Interior's own published service-checklist page lists categories for marriage, employment, permanent residence, family reunification and study but displays NO property-ownership category, so practical uptake is uncertain. SEPARATELY: North Macedonia's citizenship-by-investment route under art. 11 of the Citizenship Law is a national-interest/economic route with NO monetary figure in the statute — art. 11(2) delegates the criteria to a government decree that was not obtained. The circulating EUR 200,000 investment, 10 jobs and 1,000-person cap figures are not published here; see the excluded list.
programmes.notes_zh: 該途徑確實存在，4 萬歐元亦屬正確且有法源——惟若只引 4 萬歐元而不提兩項限制，將構成誤導。（一）對多數國籍封閉：資格限於歐盟會員國或經合組織國家之公民，此範圍以外之買方無論出價多少均無法適用。另有一處值得注意的條文變動：2018 年前之法律為「歐盟會員國『與』經合組織之居民」，現行法為「歐盟會員國『或』經合組織之公民」。（二）就永久居留而言為法定死路，經明文排除。第 72 條之一般要件亦適用：生活費用、住所、健康保險、無危害公共秩序之虞、無逾 6 個月之不附條件宣告刑、無繫屬中之刑事程序。兩項保留：第 119 條第 1 項所稱「依法律所定條件」使該購置從屬於北馬其頓之不動產所有權法，該法對外國買方設有對等待遇條件並原則禁止農地，未另行查證；另內政部自行公布之業務文件清單頁面列有結婚、就業、永久居留、家庭團聚與就學等類別，卻未見不動產所有權類別，故實際使用情形不明。另行說明：北馬其頓依《公民法》第 11 條之投資入籍途徑係國家利益／經濟事由，法條並無任何金額，第 11 條第 2 項將條件授權政府命令訂定，而該命令未能取得。坊間流傳之 20 萬歐元投資、創造 10 個就業機會、上限 1,000 人等數字不予刊登，詳見排除清單。

companion_requirements.text_en: Confirmed verbatim against the full 101-page official gazette consolidated text (portal.mdt.gov.mk): beyond the EUR 40,000 property threshold (limited to EU/OECD nationals or treaty-eligible persons, art. 119(1)), art. 72 imposes general conditions that apply on top — means of subsistence, secured accommodation, health insurance, no threat to public order, no unconditional sentence exceeding 6 months, and no pending criminal proceedings. Separately, art. 79(4) requires actual presence for roughly 9 months per year (absence exceeding one quarter of the permit period without good cause triggers refusal of renewal), and art. 129(4)(3) EXPRESSLY EXCLUDES time held under this property-based ground from counting toward permanent residence — this is the only entry among the Europe-B set that is a structural dead end (no path to permanent residence at all, however long held) rather than simply 'path unverified'.
companion_requirements.text_zh: 逐字核對官方公報合併全文（portal.mdt.gov.mk，101 頁）：除 4 萬歐元不動產門檻（限歐盟／OECD 國籍或條約合格人士，第 119(1) 條）外，第 72 條另設一般要件——生活費用、住所安置、健康保險、無公共秩序危害、無逾 6 個月不附條件宣告刑、無繫屬中之刑事程序。另外，第 79(4) 條要求每年實際居住約 9 個月（無正當理由缺席逾許可期間四分之一者，續期遭拒），第 129(4) 條第三項明文排除依本不動產事由取得之居留期間計入永久居留——這是歐洲 B 組九筆中唯一一個『制度性死路』（無論持有多久都無法轉為永久居留），非單純『途徑未查證』。

programmes.programme: Residence permit for owners of immovable property, Law no. 79/2021 'On Foreigners' art. 84
programmes.programme_zh: 不動產所有人居留許可（第 79/2021 號《外國人法》第 84 條）
programmes.label_zh: 業主居留許可（第 84 條）

min_value.basis: NO MINIMUM VALUE IN THE LAW. Art. 84 imposes an OWNERSHIP test, not a value test: the applicant must prove ownership of the immovable property, with ownership lasting throughout the duration of the permit. Co-ownership of one half suffices (art. 84(3)). All three figures circulating in agency material — EUR 50,000, ALL 5,000,000, and unspecified others — have no basis in the primary legislation. CAVEAT: art. 84(4) delegates the procedures and criteria to a Council of Ministers Decision (VKM), and that VKM could not be located; a decision-level threshold therefore cannot be positively excluded. ADDITIONAL 2026-08-02 CHECK: the Ministry of Interior's own official table of application procedures and documentation (mb.gov.al) — which lists the required document checklist for nearly every other permit type, citing VKM nr. 858/2021 — does NOT include the art. 84 property-owner permit at all. This strengthens (rather than resolves) the existing caveat that the implementing VKM (Government decree) under art. 84(4) could not be located: a reader attempting to actually apply under this ground may find no official checklist to follow.

term.text_en: Up to 1 year on first issue, renewable every year while the foreigner continues to meet the criteria set by law (art. 84(2)).
term.text_zh: 初次核發最長 1 年，於持續符合法定條件之期間內得逐年續期（第 84 條第 2 項）。

stay.text_en: Art. 84 itself sets no day-count, but art. 34(1)(e) (general provisions applying to all residence permits) provides that an absence exceeding 180 days abroad within one year can be grounds to refuse or revoke a permit; art. 36(2) further allows a temporary-residence holder, with good cause and prior notice to police, to remain abroad for up to 180 days. Art. 84 sits within Chapter IV Section 7 and is not excluded from the Section 1 general provisions, so the arts. 34/36 180-day absence ceiling applies to it as part of the general framework.
stay.text_zh: 第 84 條本身未規定天數，惟第 34 條第 1 項第 e 款（適用所有居留許可之一般條款）規定，一年內在境外停留超過 180 天，可作為拒發或廢止許可之理由；第 36 條第 2 項進一步規定，暫時居留許可持有人如有正當理由並事先告知警方，可在境外停留最長 180 天。第 84 條屬第四章第七節，未被排除於第一節一般條款之外，故第 34、36 條的 180 天缺席上限以一般默認框架適用於第 84 條。

leads_to.text_en: PERMANENT RESIDENCE after 5 years' continuous legal residence (art. 87), with absence of up to 6 months at a time and a maximum of 10 months in total across the five years. Also requires sufficient lawful income, health insurance, adequate housing and proof that all taxes are paid. The art. 88 exclusion list does NOT include the property permit, so this route DOES accrue toward permanent residence. The permanent residence card is automatically replaced every 7 years and expiry does not cancel long-term-resident status. Citizenship is governed by the separate Law on Citizenship and was NOT tier-1 verified — no naturalisation timeline is published here.

programmes.notes_en: The threshold is a fiction. All three circulating figures are wrong because the law specifies no minimum value at all. The EUR 50,000 figure propagating through agency material has no basis in Law no. 79/2021. The route itself is genuine, and — unlike North Macedonia's — it DOES count toward permanent residence at five years. Confidence is medium, not high, for one honest reason: art. 84(4) delegates the procedures and criteria to a Council of Ministers Decision that could not be located, so while no threshold exists in the PRIMARY legislation, a decision-level threshold cannot be positively excluded. The accurate description is 'no statutory minimum; implementing decision not located'. GOLDEN PASSPORT: Albania's much-publicised citizenship-by-investment proposal, drafted around 2020-21, NEVER BECAME LAW — it met sustained EU objection and was suspended, and no active scheme exists today. That claim is a negative and rests on tier-2/3 sources, which is the safe direction to state it.
programmes.notes_zh: 該門檻根本不存在。三個流傳數字皆錯，因為法律完全未設最低金額。仲介資料所傳之 5 萬歐元在第 79/2021 號法律中查無依據。該途徑本身確實存在，且與北馬其頓不同，其期間可計入 5 年之永久居留年限。信心度列為中等而非高，理由誠實而單純：第 84 條第 4 項將程序與條件授權部長會議決定（VKM），而該決定未能取得，故雖可確認母法並無門檻，仍無法積極排除命令層級存在門檻之可能。正確說法為「法律未設最低金額；施行命令未能取得」。黃金護照：阿爾巴尼亞於 2020 至 2021 年間草擬並廣受報導之投資入籍提案從未立法——遭歐盟持續反對而擱置，目前並無運作中之計畫。該主張為否定命題，且僅有第二／三級來源，以此方向陳述較為穩健。

companion_requirements.text_en: On the face of the statute itself, beyond holding (or co-holding at least half, with a spouse) the property, NO OTHER requirement is stated — no income proof, no health insurance, no clean-record certificate, no source-of-funds proof. This is itself a meaningful positive finding: art. 85 (the parallel pensioner-permit ground) explicitly requires minimum pension income, proof of funds, health insurance and a clean-record certificate, so the legislature evidently knows how to write such conditions when it intends them — and chose not to for art. 84. Three caveats must travel with this finding: (1) art. 84(4) delegates procedure and further conditions to a Government decree (VKM) that could not be located; (2) the Ministry of Interior's own official procedures table does not list this permit type at all; (3) the general 180-day absence ceiling (arts. 34/36, see `stay`) is not an extra condition as such, but does affect whether the permit can be maintained.
companion_requirements.text_zh: 就母法文本本身而言，除持有（或與配偶等共有二分之一以上）不動產產權外，未見其他要求——無所得證明、無健保、無良民證、無資金來源證明。此本身為有意義之正面發現：第 85 條（退休金許可平行條款）明文要求最低年金收入、財力證明、健康保險、無犯罪紀錄證明，可見立法者有意設置此類條件時會明文寫出——而第 84 條選擇不寫。惟須併陳三項但書：(1) 第 84 條第 4 項授權以政府命令（VKM）另訂程序與條件，迄今未查得該命令；(2) 內政部官方申辦程序總表完全未列出此許可類型；(3) 一般性 180 天境外缺席上限（第 34、36 條，見 stay 欄位）雖非額外條件，但會影響許可能否維持。

programmes.programme: Extended (long-term) residence permit for an investment of at least BGN 600,000 in real estate — Foreigners in the Republic of Bulgaria Act, art. 24(1)(19)

min_value.basis: Art. 24(1)(19) of the Foreigners in the Republic of Bulgaria Act: the foreigner has invested not less than BGN 600,000 in acquiring ownership of real estate in Bulgaria — or owns more than 50% of the capital of a Bulgarian commercial company, has paid the same sum into its capital, and the company has thereby acquired real estate in Bulgaria of that value. By the date of the application the sum must be fully paid and must have reached an account at a licensed Bulgarian credit institution; where the property was bought with borrowed funds, the unpaid part of the loan must not exceed 25%. CURRENCY: the text read (Ministry of Foreign Affairs PDF; its amendment list ends with State Gazette 79/2024) states the sum in leva. Bulgaria joined the euro on 1 January 2026 at BGN 1.95583 = EUR 1. Bill No. 52-602-01-29 (Council of Ministers Decision No. 575 of 27 July 2026, received by the National Assembly on 28 July 2026) would replace 'BGN 600,000' in item 19 with 'EUR 306,775.13'; adoption of the bill was not confirmed. The USD figure is an editorial conversion of EUR 306,775.13 at EUR 1 = USD 1.17.
