stay.text_en: No annual day-count appears in the Act. Art. 40(1)(5) provides for withdrawal of the right of residence where, within one year of the permit, the foreigner has not settled and does not reside in Bulgaria; the exceptions it lists (the permanent-residence investor grounds in art. 25(1)(6), (7), (8), (13), (16) and art. 25g) do not include this ground. Art. 40(1)(6) provides for withdrawal where a holder of a long-term or permanent residence permit has been absent from the territory of the EU member states for 12 consecutive months.
stay.text_zh: 法條未設每年停留天數。第 40 條第 1 項第 5 款規定：許可核發後 1 年內，外國人未定居且未在保加利亞境內居住的，撤銷其居留權；該款列舉的例外（第 25 條第 1 項第 6、7、8、13、16 款及第 25g 條的永久居留投資事由）不含本事由。第 40 條第 1 項第 6 款規定：長期或永久居留許可持有人連續 12 個月不在歐盟會員國境內的，撤銷其居留權。

leads_to.text_en: PERMANENT RESIDENCE: art. 25(1)(17) allows a foreigner who has held an extended residence permit under art. 24(1)(19) or (20) and has maintained the investment for 5 years to obtain a permanent residence permit. The right of residence is withdrawn under art. 40(1)(1) when the art. 24 ground ceases. The Act contains no citizenship provision for this route; Bulgaria's citizenship-by-investment provisions are repealed (see notes).
leads_to.text_zh: 可申請永久居留：第 25 條第 1 項第 17 款規定，持有第 24 條第 1 項第 19 款或第 20 款延長居留許可、並維持投資滿 5 年的外國人，得取得永久居留許可。第 24 條所列事由消滅時，居留權依第 40 條第 1 項第 1 款撤銷。本事由法條未設入籍途徑；保加利亞的投資入籍制度已廢止，詳見備註。

ownership_form.text_en: Ownership of real estate in Bulgaria (недвижими имоти) acquired by the foreigner, or by a Bulgarian commercial company in which the foreigner holds more than 50% of the capital and has paid in the same sum (art. 24(1)(19)). Whether and how foreigners may own land was not examined.

The bill's own amendment list shows two later amendments to the Act (State Gazette 52/2025 and 55/2026), and its wording still refers to 'BGN 600,000' in item 19. The pending bill (No. 52-602-01-29, 28 July 2026) would restate the figure as EUR 306,775.13, which is BGN 600,000 at the fixed rate; its adoption was not confirmed.

programmes.notes_en: The route exists in the statute, in art. 24(1)(19), the extended-residence ground. Art. 25, the list of permanent-residence grounds, has no property ground, so a search of art. 25 alone finds no route. Other investor grounds in the same Act are not property routes and are not scored here: art. 24(1)(20) (BGN 250,000 into a company in an economically disadvantaged region, with 5 jobs), art. 25(1)(16) (BGN 500,000 and 10 jobs) and art. 25(1)(6) to (8) (BGN 1 to 6 million in securities, a priority project or company capital). Citizenship by investment was abolished in 2022: the Citizenship Act now refers to repealed arts. 12a and 14a, and the Foreigners Act carries amendments from State Gazette 22/2022 in force from 18.03.2022; the gazette issue of the repealing provision itself was not independently confirmed. Primary text read: the Ministry of Foreign Affairs PDF of the Act, whose amendment list ends with State Gazette 79/2024. The two later amendments (State Gazette 52/2025 and 55/2026) were not read in consolidated form because lex.bg and apis.bg block automated access. Practitioner sources (ILF Law, Lexology) describe the same ground consistently. Confidence is medium because the permit's validity period is not established and the later amendments were not read.
programmes.notes_zh: 法條中確有這條途徑，在第 24 條第 1 項第 19 款（延長居留事由）。第 25 條是永久居留事由清單，其中沒有不動產事由，只查第 25 條會得出無途徑的結論。同一部法律的其他投資事由不是不動產途徑，此處不計入：第 24 條第 1 項第 20 款（於經濟弱勢地區投入公司 25 萬列弗並創造 5 個職位）、第 25 條第 1 項第 16 款（50 萬列弗與 10 個職位）、第 25 條第 1 項第 6 至 8 款（100 萬至 600 萬列弗投入證券、優先投資計畫或公司資本）。投資入籍已於 2022 年廢止：《公民法》現行條文提及已廢止的第 12a、14a 條，《外國人法》亦載有自 2022 年 3 月 18 日施行的 2022 年《國家公報》第 22 期修正；廢止條款本身的公報期別未經獨立查證。所讀原文為保加利亞外交部公布的法律 PDF，修正沿革止於 2024 年《國家公報》第 79 期。其後兩次修正（2025 年第 52 期、2026 年第 55 期）因 lex.bg 與 apis.bg 阻擋自動化存取，未讀到彙編版。ILF Law 與 Lexology 兩家執業者來源對同一事由的描述一致。信心度列為中等，因為許可效期未能確立，且較晚的修正未讀。

entry_tax.text_en: CONFLICT — only the range is stated here, not a band table. The tax on foreign real-estate investment (impost sobre la inversio estrangera immobiliaria) exists under Llei 3/2024 plus Decret 76/2024, and the Government's own headline states it is 'un impost d'entre el 3 i el 10%' (a tax of between 3 and 10%). But the sources disagree on the scale: the tier-1 statute (Llei 3/2024 art. 8) reads as 6% for a single-family home or one residential unit with up to three parking spaces and 10% for everything else, whereas tier-2/3 commentary gives a progressive band table of 3% for a first property, 5% for two to five, 8% for six to nine, and 10% for ten or more or for development projects. Both agree on a 90% reduction for property committed to long-term rental, with a 10-year minimum hold and clawback with interest on early sale. FURTHER LIVE RISK: the Government has published a proposal to DOUBLE this tax, so any rate published now may be stale within months.
entry_tax.text_zh: 有衝突——僅列區間，不列級距表。外國人不動產投資稅（impost sobre la inversio estrangera immobiliaria）依第 3/2024 號法律及第 76/2024 號命令課徵，政府官方標題稱其為「3% 至 10% 之稅」。惟各來源就稅率結構不一致：第一級法條（第 3/2024 號法律第 8 條）文義為獨棟住宅或含三個以下停車位之一個住宅單位課 6%，其餘一律 10%；第二／三級評論則列出累進級距：第一戶 3%，第二至五戶 5%，第六至九戶 8%，第十戶以上或開發案 10%。兩者一致之處為：承諾長期出租者減徵 90%，最低持有 10 年，提前出售須連息追繳。另有現行風險：政府已提出將此稅加倍之方案，故現時刊登之任何稅率數月內即可能失效。

last_change.text_en: Llei 2/2026, del 22 de gener, de continuitat i consolidacio ('Omnibus II'), amending Llei 10/2012 on foreign investment and the immigration law; entered into force 13 February 2026 (the in-force date is tier 2). It also added a new eligible asset class — Andorran-issued debt and financial instruments, and Andorran collective investment funds, capped at 36 months.
last_change.text_zh: 2026 年 1 月 22 日第 2/2026 號《延續與整併法》（俗稱 Omnibus II），修正第 10/2012 號外資法及移民法；2026 年 2 月 13 日生效（生效日為第二級來源）。該法並新增合格資產類別——安道爾發行之債務與金融工具，以及安道爾集合投資基金，上限 36 個月。

programmes.notes_en: Llei 2/2026 changed nearly every number. The EUR 600,000 investment minimum is superseded by EUR 1,000,000; the per-dependant charge rose from EUR 10,000 to EUR 12,000; and — the single most consequential change — the EUR 50,000 AFA deposit is NO LONGER REFUNDABLE, converting what was a returnable deposit into a sunk cost. Real estate still qualifies as an asset class but is now gated by an EUR 800,000 minimum per property unit. Confidence is medium because the entry-tax field rests on disagreeing sources and the authorisation term could not be verified above tier 3.
programmes.notes_zh: 第 2/2026 號法律幾乎改動所有數字。投資門檻 60 萬歐元已由 100 萬歐元取代；每名受扶養人費用由 1 萬歐元調升至 1.2 萬歐元；影響最大的一項是 5 萬歐元之 AFA 保證金已不予退還，由可返還之押金變為沉沒成本。不動產仍屬合格資產類別，惟每一物件單位另設 80 萬歐元以上之門檻（總投資 100 萬歐元中）。依刊登規則，因入手稅欄位來源互相矛盾、且居留許可效期無法取得第三級以上來源，信心度降為中等。

companion_requirements.text_en: Mandatory illness/disability/old-age insurance, confirmed at tier 1 on the official e-Tramits page — applicants must hold insurance or medical cover for illness, disability and old age; minors and applicants over 60 need only prove medical cover (a slightly lighter standard). This is a genuinely independent, statutory condition, entirely separate from the property purchase — an applicant who has completed the EUR 1,000,000 investment and paid the EUR 50,000 AFA deposit still cannot be approved or renewed without this insurance. Also confirmed: income threshold at 300% of minimum wage +100%/dependant (tier 1); 90 days/year actual residence (tier 1); AFA deposit EUR 50,000 (non-refundable) + EUR 12,000 per dependant (non-refundable). A clean-criminal-record requirement was not found on the renewal page checked — this may be an initial-application-only requirement whose specific URL was not located.
companion_requirements.text_zh: 最重要的新發現：強制健康／失能／老年保險，經官方頁面確認達第一級——申請人須有疾病、失能、老年之保險或醫療保障；未成年人與 60 歲以上申請人僅需證明有醫療保障（要求略寬鬆）。此為真正獨立於不動產購買之外的法定條件——即使已完成 100 萬歐元投資並繳納 5 萬歐元 AFA 保證金，若無此保險仍無法核准或續期。另已確認：所得門檻為最低工資 300%＋每受扶養人加 100%（第一級）；每年至少 90 天實際居住（第一級）；AFA 保證金 5 萬歐元（不可退還）＋每受扶養人 1.2 萬歐元（不可退還）。無犯罪紀錄證明未見於查核之續期頁面——可能僅為初次申請頁面之要求，未查得確切網址。

min_value.basis: Art. 16-bis(1)(a) — 'acquisto a titolo oneroso per il prezzo non inferiore ad euro 500.000,00 di fabbricato o porzione di fabbricato da destinare ad abitazione propria o del proprio nucleo familiare'; the building must have been completed, or be in a to-be-renovated or shell state, BEFORE 31 May 2017; up to EUR 150,000 of completion, renovation or demolition-and-rebuild costs count toward the total, with energy class A required for demolition-and-rebuild

term.text_en: Established: San Marino does not use a conventional 'fixed term + renewal' structure for this ground. Direct reading of art. 16-quinquies of the coordinated statutory text confirms it names 'residenza elettiva' expressly: an applicant obtains a temporary residence certificate valid up to 6 months pending completion of civil-registry residence registration, after which the status is continuous (not term-limited) until revoked, renounced, or 'consolidated' after roughly ten years (see leads_to).
term.text_zh: 確立：聖馬利諾對本事由並非採用傳統『固定效期＋續期』結構。直讀彙編條文第 16-quinquies 條，明文點名『residenza elettiva』：申請人先取得最長 6 個月之臨時居留證，以待完成戶籍居留登記程序，其後成為連續性居留狀態（非效期限制），直至被撤銷、放棄，或約十年後『固化』（見 leads_to）。

stay.text_en: Structural inference, not a verbatim confirmation: art. 17(4)/(5) (residence-revocation grounds) provides that loss of actual habitual residence for more than six months allows the registrar to revoke residence status; this should in principle apply to all residence statuses including residenza elettiva, but the full text of art. 16-bis ITSELF (the article that actually defines residenza elettiva) could not be retrieved, so the cross-reference from art. 16-bis to art. 17 is not confirmed verbatim. Recorded at this lower confidence level rather than as a settled fact.
stay.text_zh: 結構性推論，非逐字確認：第 17 條第 4／5 項（居留撤銷事由）規定，實際慣常居住地喪失逾六個月，戶政官得撤銷居留身分，理論上應適用所有居留身分，包括 residenza elettiva；惟第 16-bis 條本身（真正定義 residenza elettiva 之條文）全文未能取得，故第 16-bis 條是否交叉引用第 17 條未經逐字確認。以較低信賴等級記錄，非視為已定案事實。

leads_to.text_en: Established: after roughly ten years, residenza elettiva status 'consolidates' into ordinary residenza anagrafica effettiva with the corresponding rights (esteri.sm official page, corroborated by two parallel provisions — 16-ter and 16-quater — that carry the identical ten-year consolidation clause for other residence categories, strengthening confidence this is a uniform statutory design). Separately, general naturalisation requires 20 years' continuous residence (15 for a spouse, 10 for certain categories); WHETHER YEARS HELD UNDER residenza elettiva COUNT TOWARD THAT naturalisation clock was NOT established.
leads_to.text_zh: 確立：約十年後，residenza elettiva 身分『固化』為一般戶籍居留（residenza anagrafica effettiva），取得相應權利（esteri.sm 官方頁面，另有兩條平行條文——第 16-ter、16-quater 條——就其他居留類別設有相同的十年固化條款佐證，增加此為該法統一設計之可信度）。另，一般歸化須連續居住 20 年（配偶 15 年、特定類別 10 年）；residenza elettiva 之居住年限是否計入該歸化年限，未能確立。

IMPORTANT DISTINCTION: Decreto Delegato of 20 February 2025 n.26, following DD 177/2024 and effective 1 December 2024, tightened the SEPARATE 'residenza atipica' regime — raising it to EUR 120,000 annual income or EUR 500,000 liquid assets and banning shared-housing applications — but DID NOT touch the EUR 500,000 / EUR 600,000 elective-residence figures.
last_change.text_zh: 整合條文於 2024 年 4 月 9 日更新。重要區辨：2025 年 2 月 20 日第 26 號授權命令（承接第 177/2024 號命令，2024 年 12 月 1 日生效）收緊的是另一套「非典型居留」（residenza atipica）制度——提高至年收入 12 萬歐元或流動資產 50 萬歐元，並禁止合住式申請——並未變動選擇性居留之 50 萬／60 萬歐元金額。

programmes.notes_en: The EUR 500,000 figure is CORRECT and, contrary to the general expectation that San Marino figures would be agency folklore, it is verifiable directly in the statute at tier 1. The main risk with this jurisdiction is conflation: 'residenza elettiva' (the EUR 500,000 property route, unchanged) and 'residenza atipica' (the retiree/economic regime, tightened in 2025) are routinely mixed up in secondary material. Term, stay requirement and any path to citizenship were not established and are omitted rather than guessed.

companion_requirements.text_en: Two findings at tier 1, both from the esteri.sm official page dedicated to residenza elettiva: (1) mandatory private health insurance — applicants must hold health insurance. (2) A prohibition on taking up expanded public-sector employment. Two further items are inferred from parallel provisions (16-ter/16-quater) rather than confirmed in art. 16-bis's own text, so carry lower confidence: a clean-criminal-record and means-of-funds requirement (likely, by analogy, but not verbatim-confirmed for elettiva specifically), and the six-month-absence revocation risk (see `stay`). Limitation: art. 16-bis itself (the article that actually defines residenza elettiva) could not be retrieved in full text. Confidence for this programme is treated as medium-high rather than high pending retrieval of art. 16-bis in full.
companion_requirements.text_zh: 兩項第一級發現，皆來自 esteri.sm 官方頁面（residenza elettiva 專屬）：(1) 強制私人健康保險——申請外國人須持有健康保險。(2) 不得從事擴大公部門受僱關係之限制。另兩項係由平行條文（16-ter／16-quater）推論而非於第 16-bis 條自身文字中逐字確認，信賴等級較低：良民證與財力證明要求（依平行條文推斷極可能相同，但未就 elettiva 逐字確認），以及缺席逾六個月之撤銷風險（見 stay 欄位）。限制：第 16-bis 條本身（真正定義 residenza elettiva 之條文）未能取得完整逐字文本。本筆信心度視為 medium-high 而非 high，待取得第 16-bis 條全文後再調整。

min_value.basis: NO MINIMUM PROPERTY VALUE AND NO PURCHASE REQUIREMENT. The condition is 'approved residential accommodation' in Gibraltar available exclusively to the applicant and family for the whole tax year — RENTING QUALIFIES. In practice the Finance Centre approves property at the upper end of the market and several estates are pre-approved, but that is administrative practice, not a published threshold. The binding financial test is a net wealth requirement, below.

leads_to.text_en: Reportedly the pathway to Gibraltarian Status was extended from 10 to 20 years for new residents, with existing Cat 2 holders grandfathered — SINGLE tier-2 source, published here as reported rather than as established. CONFIDENCE FURTHER DOWNGRADED: three additional independent articles covering the same 469/2026 press release (gbc.gi, ellulcruz.com, triay.com) were checked and NONE mentions any change to the 10-to-20-year citizenship-eligibility timeline — only the single original source (IMI Daily) mentions it, and it cites no official source of its own. Since three independent outlets reporting on the same underlying announcement would be expected to mention a genuine citizenship-timeline change if one existed, this strengthens (not weakens) the case that this claim may conflate the Category 2 tax reform with an unrelated UK nationality/immigration-law change. Treat as lower confidence than a typical single-tier-2-source claim, not merely 'unverified'.
leads_to.text_zh: 據報導，新住民取得直布羅陀身分之年限已由 10 年延長為 20 年，現有 Cat 2 持有人受既得保障——僅單一第二級來源，此處係轉述而非確立之事實。 可信度進一步下修：另讀了報導同一則 469/2026 新聞稿的三篇獨立文章（gbc.gi、ellulcruz.com、triay.com），三篇全部完全未提到公民身分年限有任何變動——僅唯一原始來源（IMI Daily）提及，且未引用任何官方出處。三家獨立媒體報導同一則新聞卻無一提及理應會提及的公民年限變革，反而強化（而非削弱）此說法可能把 Cat 2 稅務改革與另一項不相干的英國國籍／移民法變動混為一談的疑慮。可信度應低於一般單一第二級來源之主張，非僅『未查證』。

last_change.text_en: Press release 469/2026, read in full and searched verbatim for 'private medical insurance', 'health insurance' and 'medical insurance', contains none of those phrases. It states only that Category 2 status does not grant access to publicly funded education and medical services. Private medical insurance is widely required in Category 2 practice, but that is not sourced to this press release. See `companion_requirements` for the corrected framing. Press release 469/2026 (18 June 2026) states that the Government 'intends' to raise the minimum net wealth for new applicants from GBP 2 million to GBP 5 million and the application fee from GBP 1,233 to GBP 5,000, and to provide that a person who does not maintain Category 2 status has no right to remain resident. The amending rules were not located, and the Income Tax Office page checked states no net-wealth figure, so whether these changes are in force is unconfirmed.

programmes.notes_en: FRAMING MATTERS MORE THAN THE NUMBERS HERE: Cat 2 is not a residency-by-property-purchase programme and should not be presented as one. Applicants must also not have been resident in Gibraltar in the previous five years. Two figures commonly cited elsewhere are wrong: the application fee announced for new applicants is GBP 5,000, not GBP 1,100 — and the pre-change figure was GBP 1,233, so GBP 1,100 was never correct; and the maximum annual tax is GBP 42,380, not GBP 44,740, which no source found supports. Confidence is medium because the minimum annual tax rests on a single tier-2 source and whether the GBP 5 million threshold and the GBP 5,000 fee are in force is unverified (announced 18 June 2026).

companion_requirements.text_en: Category 2 is confirmed NOT a property-purchase scheme (qualifying accommodation may be rented or bought). The actual companion requirements are: net assets of at least GBP 5,000,000 (announced for new applicants on 18 June 2026, previously GBP 2,000,000; not confirmed in force); application fee GBP 5,000 (announced, previously GBP 1,233); NOT resident for Gibraltar tax purposes in the preceding five years (upgraded to tier 1 — Income Tax Office page confirms verbatim 'is not resident in Gibraltar and has not been in the previous five years'); minimum annual tax due of at least GBP 37,000 (upgraded to tier 1, same ITO page); no access to publicly funded education or healthcare (self-funded). Private medical insurance is commonly required in market practice, but — see `last_change` — this is NOT sourced to the press release that is sometimes cited for it; no tier-1 or tier-2 source discussing insurance specifically was found.

programmes.notes_en: TAX STRUCTURE: 20% on the first GBP 1.25 million of income, 1% above GBP 1.25 million, and 20% on Jersey land and property income (and on dividends from Jersey-property-income companies) with no 1% taper. If combined income falls below GBP 1.25 million, the applicant is deemed to receive sufficient additional income to ensure the GBP 250,000 minimum tax is paid. Two points require correction against commonly circulated figures: (1) GBP 145,000 is the SUPERSEDED minimum annual tax — the current figure for new approvals is GBP 250,000; (2) the 'GBP 1.25 million sustainable annual income' framing is a mischaracterisation — GBP 1.25 million is the income band boundary at which the rate drops from 20% to 1%, not an eligibility test. The actual eligibility test is the GBP 10 million asset wealth test. CAVEAT THAT DRIVES THE MEDIUM RATING: the Locate Jersey supplementary sheet carrying the GBP 3.5 million / GBP 1.75 million property thresholds is stamped 'Information accurate as at 1 July 2023' and states that all rates are subject to annual review. No 2026-dated official restatement was found, so the two property thresholds — the headline numbers for this entry — are verified as at mid-2023 only.
programmes.notes_zh: 稅制結構：所得前 125 萬英鎊課 20%，超過部分課 1%；澤西島土地與不動產所得（及澤西島不動產所得公司之股利）一律課 20%，不適用 1% 遞減。合計所得低於 125 萬英鎊者，視為另有足額所得，以確保繳足 25 萬英鎊之最低稅額。有兩點須對坊間流傳數字進行更正：（一）14.5 萬英鎊為已被取代之最低年稅額，新核准案之現行數字為 25 萬英鎊；（二）「125 萬英鎊可持續年所得」之表述係誤解——125 萬英鎊是稅率由 20% 降為 1% 之所得級距分界，並非資格門檻，真正的資格檢驗為 1,000 萬英鎊之資產門檻。列為中等信心度之關鍵保留：載有 350 萬／175 萬英鎊不動產門檻之 Locate Jersey 補充說明表標註「資訊截至 2023 年 7 月 1 日正確」，並載明所有費率每年檢討。查無 2026 年之官方更新版本，故本條目最核心的兩個不動產門檻僅查證至 2023 年年中。

companion_requirements.text_en: Buying the property is not sufficient on its own: (1) minimum annual tax contribution GBP 250,000; (2) global assets of at least GBP 10,000,000 (with a liquidity component); (3) sustainable global income exceeding GBP 1,250,000, which must be guaranteed for at least 10 years; (4) a DBS (Disclosure and Barring Service) clean-record background check, with any adverse or negative background factor assessed; (5) applicants must actually obtain UK immigration clearance and take up genuine residence in Jersey to live and work — this is not a passive tax-residence status; (6) renting an equivalent-value property is only a bridge, not a substitute: Locate Jersey's own page states applicants are expected to purchase within roughly 12 months of arrival.
companion_requirements.text_zh: 買房本身不是終點：①年度最低稅額貢獻 25 萬英鎊；②全球資產至少 1,000 萬英鎊（含一定流動性）；③可持續全球所得逾 125 萬英鎊，且須保證至少 10 年；④ DBS（Disclosure and Barring Service）良民證背景查核，並評估任何不良或負面背景因素；⑤申請人須實際取得英國移民許可並真正遷居澤西島工作生活——非被動之稅務居民身分；⑥先租等值物件僅為過渡安排，非替代方案：Locate Jersey 官網明文，預期申請人於抵達後約 12 個月內完成購買。

NO SPECIFIC MINIMUM NUMBER OF DAYS PER YEAR was found in any source; nothing is asserted. Via four different access routes, all unsuccessful: gov.gg root domain (connection refused, same as before), guernseylegalresources.gg (returned HTTP 403 — the site exists but actively blocks automated access, a different failure mode from 'cannot connect'), guernseylegislation.gov.gg (DNS could not resolve), and a re-read of the existing Ogier source (states only that occupants must 'occupy the property in accordance with the Population Management Law' with no further detail). entry_tax.text_en: Document duty, progressive, under the Document Duty (Rates) (Amendment) Ordinance 2024 effective 8 November 2024: 2.25% up to GBP 300,000; 3.50% on GBP 300,001–500,000; 4.00% on GBP 500,001–950,000; 4.25% on GBP 950,001–1,250,000; 4.50% on GBP 1,250,001–2,500,000; 5.50% on GBP 2,500,001–5,000,000; and 7.00% OVER GBP 5,000,000. The contents allowance is capped at 2.5% of price, so roughly 97.5% is dutiable, and downsizing relief has been available since November 2024. The 2% second-home / non-primary-residence surcharge was REMOVED by the 2026 Budget to ease pressure on the rental market — it is not live for 2026. A further point with a real evidentiary basis: the same P2025-121 proposition page shows TWO further 2025 ordinances proposed in the same package — 'The Document Duty (Rates) (Amendment) Ordinance, 2025' and 'The Document Duty (Anti-Avoidance) (Rates) (Amendment) Ordinance, 2025' — meaning the rate table currently cited (from the 2024 ordinance) may well have been partially amended or superseded, though the specific differences could not be confirmed (PDF text-extraction failed). The rate table should be read as pending verification rather than as still current.
entry_tax.text_zh: 文件稅採累進制，依 2024 年《文件稅（費率）（修正）條例》，2024 年 11 月 8 日生效：30 萬英鎊以下 2.25%；30 萬至 50 萬英鎊 3.50%；50 萬至 95 萬英鎊 4.00%；95 萬至 125 萬英鎊 4.25%；125 萬至 250 萬英鎊 4.50%；250 萬至 500 萬英鎊 5.50%；逾 500 萬英鎊 7.00%。傢俱設備扣除上限為價金之 2.5%，故約 97.5% 須課稅；2024 年 11 月起並有換小屋減免。2% 之第二住宅／非主要住所附加稅已由 2026 年度預算取消，以紓解租賃市場壓力，故不屬 2026 年現行制度。 新增有實據支撐之疑點：同一份 P2025-121 提案頁面顯示，同批還提出了另外兩項 2025 年條例——《文件稅稅率修正條例》2025 年版與《文件稅反避稅稅率修正條例》2025 年版——代表目前引用的 2024 年條例費率表，很可能已被這兩項 2025 年新條例部分修正或取代，惟未能打開 PDF 全文比對具體差異（PDF 文字擷取技術性失敗）。該稅率表宜視為待查，而非現行有效不變。

short.outcome_zh: 無公開資料；gov.gg 每次連線均遭拒絕
short.own_en: A property inscribed on Part A of the Open Market Housing Register
short.own_zh: 須為公開市場住房登記簿甲部所載之物件

programmes.notes_en: FRAMING: correct to say there is no minimum property value — this is a market segment, not a threshold programme. Guernsey land and building income remains taxable at 20% IN ADDITION TO any capped amount. Two figures commonly cited elsewhere are wrong: (1) the Open Market new-resident cap is GBP 60,000, not GBP 50,000 — GBP 50,000 was the superseded 2018-2023 figure, and GBP 50,000 is separately the document-duty condition, which is probably the source of the confusion; (2) document duty tops out at 7%, not 5.5% — 5.5% is the GBP 2.5-5 million band, not the top rate. Confidence is medium because most fields rest on single tier-2 or quasi-official sources rather than on gov.gg, which was unreachable throughout.
programmes.notes_zh: 定性：稱其無最低不動產金額正確——這是一個市場區隔，而非門檻型計畫。根西島之土地與建物所得仍須另按 20% 課稅，不受任何上限涵蓋。坊間常見兩處數字有誤：（一）公開市場新住民稅額上限為 6 萬英鎊而非 5 萬英鎊，5 萬英鎊係 2018 至 2023 年之舊制數字；且 5 萬英鎊另為文件稅之門檻條件，混淆很可能由此而來。（二）文件稅最高級距為 7% 而非 5.5%，5.5% 係 250 萬至 500 萬英鎊之級距而非最高稅率。信心度列為中等，係因多數欄位僅有單一第二級或準官方來源，而 gov.gg 全程無法連線。

sources.publisher: Locate Guernsey (States of Guernsey agency)
Ogier
Trinity Chambers LLP
LTS Tax
States of Guernsey — 2026 Budget proposition P2025-121

companion_requirements.text_en: Confirmed: buying a Part A property genuinely carries no minimum price threshold (a market-segmentation fact, not an investment threshold). But there are companion conditions: (1) the purchaser must actually 'occupy' the property under the Population Management Law to obtain residence rights — the specific day-count could not be established despite four independent access attempts (see `stay`); (2) document duty is progressive up to 7% on the portion above GBP 5,000,000, under a 2024 ordinance that may already be partially superseded by two 2025 ordinances proposed in the same package as the 2026 budget (see `entry_tax`); (3) to access the 'new-resident four-year GBP 60,000 tax cap', the purchase itself must trigger at least GBP 50,000 of document duty (implying a purchase price of roughly GBP 1.4 million or more); (4) family members must apply on the basis of residing WITH the property occupant. No other mandatory financial threshold or health/background-check requirement was found — but this 'not found' carries LOW confidence, because the primary law source (gov.gg) was unreachable throughout, and guernseylegalresources.gg, though it exists, actively blocks automated access, so a condition present in the primary legislation but not captured in the secondary sources checked here cannot be excluded.
companion_requirements.text_zh: 確認：Part A 物件本身確實不需要達到特定金額門檻（市場區隔事實，非投資門檻）。惟仍有配套：①購買人須依《人口管理法》實際『占用』該物件才能取得居留權，具體天數四次獨立嘗試後仍查無（見 stay 欄位）；②文件稅累進至最高 7%（逾 500 萬英鎊部分），依 2024 條例，惟很可能已被同批與 2026 預算一併提出之兩項 2025 年條例部分修正（見 entry_tax）；③若想適用『新住民前 4 年 6 萬英鎊稅額上限』，該次購屋須觸發至少 5 萬英鎊之文件稅（隱含成交價約 140 萬英鎊以上）；④家人須以『隨屋居住』為條件申請許可。查無其他強制性資金門檻或健康／背景查核要求——惟此『查無』信心度偏低，因一手法規來源（gov.gg）全程連不上，guernseylegalresources.gg 雖存在但主動擋下自動化存取，無法排除一手法規裡藏有未查到的條件。

programmes.programme: Extension of stay for the purpose of investment — THB 3m real-estate route (Immigration Bureau Orders 237/2568 and 238/2568)
programmes.programme_zh: 以投資為目的之居留延期——300 萬泰銖不動產途徑（入出境事務局第 237/2568、238/2568 號命令）
programmes.label_en: Investment extension of stay: the THB 3m limb
programmes.label_zh: 投資型延長居留：300 萬泰銖分項

min_value.basis: Purchase of a condominium unit at a registered purchase price of not less than THB 3,000,000, AND a certification-and-request letter from the Ministry of Tourism and Sports (or its delegate) certifying the applicant as a long-stay tourism supporter. The MOTS letter is a mandatory, non-severable element of this tier at BOTH the visa stage (Order 237/2568 item 3.2(2)) and the extension stage (Order 238/2568 item 2.5.C(3)). Without it this tier is unavailable. MOTS CERTIFICATE PROCEDURE/FEE, PREVIOUSLY AN OPEN ITEM, NOW CONFIRMED: three independent sources agree the certificate is obtained through an authorised agent, the Thailand Longstay Service (TLS), for a one-time membership fee of THB 4,000 plus an annual service fee of THB 27,000; processing takes roughly 7-10 business days; media reporting confirms this has been operational since October 2025.

extra_tiers.label_en: General investment tier requiring NO Ministry of Tourism and Sports certificate. Satisfied by purchase OR lease of not less than 3 years of a condominium unit at not less than THB 10,000,000, or by fixed deposit / government or state-enterprise bonds at the same figure, or a combination. Requires evidence of transfer of not less than THB 10,000,000 into Thailand. Order 237/2568 item 3.1; Order 238/2568 item 2.5.B.

CLOSED LEGACY TIER — not available to new applicants. Order 238/2568 item 2.5.A(2) restricts this THB 3,000,000 tier to aliens who 'entered the Kingdom before 1 October B.E. 2549 (2006) and have been continuously permitted to stay for investment of not less than 3 million baht'. Grandfathered holders only.

term.text_en: Extension of stay granted in periods of not more than one year at a time, renewable while conditions are maintained ('permit granted each time not exceeding 1 year').
term.text_zh: 每次核給不超過一年之居留延期，條件維持期間可續延。

stay.text_en: No minimum physical-presence requirement is stated in either Order. Standard Thai immigration obligations apply (90-day address reporting; re-entry permit needed to preserve the extension when leaving).
stay.text_zh: 兩項命令均未規定最低實際居住天數。仍適用泰國一般入出境義務（90 天居留通報；出境須辦再入境許可以保留延期效力）。

leads_to.text_en: No pathway to permanent residence or citizenship arises from this route as such. Thai permanent residence is a separate annual-quota system under the Immigration Act B.E. 2522 with its own criteria; nothing in Orders 237/2568 or 238/2568 confers or accelerates it.
leads_to.text_zh: 本途徑本身不通往永久居留或公民身分。泰國永久居留係《1979 年入出境法》下另設之年度配額制度，第 237/2568、238/2568 號命令均未賦予或加速該資格。

ownership_form.text_en: Condominium unit freehold only; no land. Foreigners in aggregate may hold not more than 49% of the space of the whole units in any one condominium (Condominium Act B.E. 2522 s.19 bis). Orders 237/2568 and 238/2568 both cross-refer to 'the law on condominiums and the holding of ownership of condominium units by aliens' in the documentary schedule.
ownership_form.text_zh: 僅限區分所有權（公寓大廈）之完全所有權，不含土地。同一棟公寓大廈之外國人持有面積合計不得超過全部專有部分之 49%（《佛曆 2522 年公寓大廈法》第 19 條之 1）。第 237/2568 與 238/2568 號命令之文件清單均援引「公寓大廈法及外國人區分所有權之持有」。

offplan.text_en: Effectively excluded. The documentary schedule requires a registered condominium ownership document in the applicant's own name — 'copy of the registration showing ownership of the condominium unit, or the title deed, or the condominium unit ownership certificate under the land law, the condominium law and the law on foreign ownership of condominium units' — plus a photograph of the unit. An off-plan unit has no registered title until handover and so cannot satisfy this. Note this is a consequence of the documentary requirement; neither Order contains an express words-of-exclusion for off-plan.
offplan.text_zh: 實質上排除。文件清單要求申請人本人名下之已登記區分所有權文件（區分所有權登記謄本、所有權狀或依土地法、公寓大廈法及外國人區分所有權法核發之權利證明），並須檢附房屋照片。預售屋於交屋前無登記所有權，故無法滿足。此為文件要件之結果，兩項命令均未明文排除預售屋。

mortgage.text_en: Not addressed in either Order. The Orders require evidence of transfer of the qualifying sum into Thailand from abroad and evidence of payment for the unit; a domestic mortgage would not evidence inward transfer. Treat as unresolved rather than permitted.
mortgage.text_zh: 兩項命令均未規範。命令要求檢附自海外匯入合格金額之證明及購屋付款證明；本地房貸無法證明資金匯入。應視為未定，不得逕認為許可。

dependants.text_en: Yes, under Order 238/2568 item 2.20, granted in periods of not more than one year at a time. Spouse (relationship must be genuine in both law and fact); children, adopted children or stepchildren who are unmarried, living as part of the household and not over 20 years of age (unless ill or disabled and unable to support themselves); and parents aged 50 or over. Where the principal holds the THB 3m real-estate tier, each family member ALSO needs a Ministry of Tourism and Sports certification letter confirming they are family of the long-stay tourism supporter.
dependants.text_zh: 可攜眷。依第 238/2568 號命令第 2.20 項，每次核給不超過一年。配偶（法律與事實上均須為真實關係）；未婚、同住且未滿 20 歲之子女、養子女或配偶之子女（因病或身心障礙而無法自立者不在此限）；以及年滿 50 歲之父母。主申請人若走 300 萬泰銖不動產途徑，各眷屬另須取得觀光暨體育部證明信，確認其為長期旅遊支持者之家屬。

entry_tax.text_en: NOT VERIFIED. Thai transfer taxes on a condominium conveyance (transfer fee, specific business tax or stamp duty, withholding tax) were not checked against a Revenue Department or Land Department source and are omitted rather than estimated.
entry_tax.text_zh: 未能確立。區分所有權移轉之泰國稅費（過戶費、特種營業稅或印花稅、預扣稅）未經稅務廳或土地廳來源查證，故從缺，不作推估。

last_change.text_en: Orders 237/2568 and 238/2568 both signed 1 October B.E. 2568 (2025) by Pol. Lt. Gen. Phanumas Boonyalak, Commissioner of the Immigration Bureau, and both expressed to take effect from 1 October 2025. They amend the tables annexed to Orders 14/2568 and 12/2568 respectively (both dated 23 January 2568).
last_change.text_zh: 第 237/2568 與 238/2568 號命令均由入出境事務局局長 Phanumas Boonyalak 警察中將於佛曆 2568 年（2025 年）10 月 1 日簽署，並自 2025 年 10 月 1 日生效，分別修正第 14/2568 號及第 12/2568 號命令（均為佛曆 2568 年 1 月 23 日）之附表。

short.term_en: Granted 1 yr at a time, renewable while conditions hold
short.term_zh: 每次核給 1 年，條件維持即可續期
short.stay_en: None stated; 90-day address reporting applies while in Thailand
short.stay_zh: 未設；在泰期間適用 90 天住所申報
short.outcome_en: No pathway to permanent residence or citizenship
short.outcome_zh: 不通往永久居留或公民身分
short.own_en: Condominium freehold only, no land; 49% foreign cap per building
short.own_zh: 僅限公寓完全所有權，不含土地；每棟外國人持有上限 49%

programmes.notes_en: The two-decree structure: for anyone entering Thailand after 1 October 2006, the THB 3,000,000 tier applies only where the applicant holds a Ministry of Tourism and Sports (MOTS) certificate; without it, the effective threshold is THB 10,000,000. This is not administrative practice — the certificate is a listed criterion in both decrees' review basis and a required supporting document. There is a third, closed tier: a legacy THB 3,000,000 band limited to those who entered before 1 October 2006 and have continuously held an investment-based residence extension. On the purchase route, there is no 'seller must be Thai or foreign ownership capped at 49%' condition — that condition applies only to the lease route's lessor (must be a Thai natural person, or a Thai-majority-owned legal entity) and the fixed-deposit route's bank. The visa category is not specifically 'Non-Immigrant B'; both decrees require only that the applicant already hold some category of non-immigrant visa, and describe the grant as an investment-purpose residence extension under s. 34 of the B.E. 2522 Immigration Act; no sub-code is stated and none is published here. Lease alternative (for completeness): the THB 3,000,000 real-estate tier can also be satisfied by leasing a condominium unit or residence for at least THB 85,000/month — a lease of at least 1 year with at least 3 months prepaid at the visa stage, at least 12 months prepaid at the residence-extension stage, or a registered lease exceeding 3 years with total prepaid rent of at least THB 3,000,000. Whether the Ministry of Tourism and Sports has published the certificate's issuance procedure, an authorised-agent list, or a fee schedule could not be established. Pending that, the THB 3,000,000 tier's practical workability remains unsettled even though its legal basis is settled.
programmes.notes_zh: 兩項命令之結構：凡 2006 年 10 月 1 日以後入境者，300 萬泰銖僅在取得觀光暨體育部（MOTS）證明暨請求函時方可適用；無該函者，實際門檻為 1,000 萬泰銖。此非行政慣例，該函在兩項命令之審查基準欄均為列名要件，並同時列為應備文件。另有第三、已封閉之級距：僅限 2006 年 10 月 1 日前入境且持續持有投資居留延期者適用之舊制 300 萬泰銖級距。購買途徑並無「賣方須為泰國人或外資不超過 49%」之條件——該條件僅出現於租賃途徑之「出租人」（須為泰國自然人或泰國人持股逾 50% 之法人）及定存途徑之「銀行」。簽證類別並非特定為「Non-Immigrant B」；兩項命令僅要求申請人已持有某類非移民簽證，並將核給描述為《佛曆 2522 年入出境法》第 34 條下以投資為目的之居留延期；條文未載子代碼，不予刊載。租賃替代方案（供完整參考）：300 萬泰銖不動產級距亦可以每月不低於 85,000 泰銖租賃區分所有權房屋或住宅滿足——簽證階段為期不低於 1 年之租約並預付至少 3 個月，居留延期階段須預付至少 12 個月，或登記逾 3 年之租約且預付租金合計不低於 300 萬泰銖。觀光暨體育部是否已公布該證明函之核發程序、受委任機構名單或規費，未能確立。在此確認前，300 萬泰銖級距之法律依據雖已確定，實務可行性仍屬未定。

companion_requirements.text_en: The MOTS (Ministry of Tourism and Sports) certificate itself is a genuine companion requirement, not a formality: BOTH the principal applicant AND each dependant must obtain it before applying, and it carries its own fee (THB 4,000 one-time + THB 27,000/year via the TLS authorised agent, see `min_value`). Without the certificate, the effective property threshold rises to THB 10,000,000. Dependants may only apply after the principal has secured the full 12-month extension — an ordering rule not otherwise visible from the two decrees' headline terms.
companion_requirements.text_zh: MOTS（觀光暨體育部）證明函本身是真正的配套要求，非形式文件：主申請人與每位依親人皆須先取得該函才能申請，且該函本身另有規費（透過 TLS 代理，一次性 4,000 泰銖＋年度 27,000 泰銖，見 min_value）。無此函者，實際門檻升為 1,000 萬泰銖。依親人須待主申請人取得完整 12 個月延期後才能申請——此排序規則不見於兩項命令之標題條件本身。

programmes.programme: Long-Term Resident (LTR) visa — Wealthy Global Citizen category
programmes.programme_zh: 長期居留（LTR）簽證——高資產全球公民類別
programmes.label_zh: 長期居留 LTR：高資產全球公民

min_value.basis: Investment in Thailand of at least USD 500,000 in the applicant's own name, which may be in one or a combination of: Thai government bonds with at least 5 years' remaining maturity; direct investment in companies registered in Thailand; or investment in Thai property. Property is a qualifying asset class within this figure and carries no separate property-specific minimum. The investment must already have been made before applying.

term.text_en: 10 years: 'Permission will be granted to stay in Thailand the first time for five years which can be extended for 5 more years if qualifications are met.'
term.text_zh: 10 年：首次核給 5 年，符合資格者可再延長 5 年。

stay.text_en: No minimum physical-presence requirement stated. LTR holders are exempt from the standard 90-day reporting in favour of annual reporting (not re-verified, so not relied on).
stay.text_zh: 未規定最低居住天數。LTR 持有人免除一般 90 天通報而改為年度通報（此點未獨立查證，不予刊載）。

leads_to.text_en: No pathway to permanent residence or citizenship. The LTR is a renewable long-stay visa only.
leads_to.text_zh: 不通往永久居留或公民身分。LTR 僅為可續延之長期居留簽證。

ownership_form.text_en: Condominium unit freehold only; no land. Foreigners in aggregate may hold not more than 49% of the space of the whole units in any one condominium (Condominium Act B.E. 2522 s.19 bis).
ownership_form.text_zh: 僅限區分所有權之完全所有權，不含土地。同一棟公寓大廈之外國人持有面積合計不得超過全部專有部分之 49%（《佛曆 2522 年公寓大廈法》第 19 條之 1）。

offplan.text_en: NOT VERIFIED. The BOI page states only 'investment in Thai property' without defining completion status. Omitted rather than inferred.
offplan.text_zh: 未查證。BOI 頁面僅載「投資泰國不動產」，未界定完工狀態。從缺，不作推論。

mortgage.text_en: NOT VERIFIED.
mortgage.text_zh: 未查證。

dependants.text_en: Yes — spouse and dependants are eligible. Visa fee THB 50,000 per person for the 10-year multiple-entry visa when collected in Thailand.
dependants.text_zh: 可攜眷——配偶及受扶養人符合資格。10 年多次入境簽證於泰國境內領取者，每人簽證費 50,000 泰銖。

entry_tax.text_en: NOT VERIFIED for the property purchase itself. IMPORTANT CORRECTION: the widely-quoted 17% flat personal income tax applies to the HIGHLY-SKILLED PROFESSIONALS category only ('17% Personal income tax for Highly-skilled professionals'), NOT to Wealthy Global Citizen. It does not apply to this route.
entry_tax.text_zh: 購置本身之稅負未查證。重要更正：常被引用之 17% 個人所得稅單一稅率僅適用「高技術專業人才」類別，不適用高資產全球公民類別，不適用於本途徑。

last_change.text_en: The current BOI page shows no personal-income requirement for this category, unlike the Highly-Skilled panel which retains a USD 80,000/yr test — consistent with a revision that removed the INCOME test. The USD 1 million assets requirement was NOT removed and remains the category's defining heading. The date and scope of the amending announcement could not be located and are NOT verified; the current requirements are stated, the amendment is not narrated.
last_change.text_zh: 現行 BOI 頁面就本類別未列個人所得要件，與仍保留每年 8 萬美元門檻之高技術專業人才類別不同，與「移除所得要件」之修訂一致。100 萬美元資產要件並未移除，仍為本類別之標題要件。修訂公告之日期與範圍無法查得，未經查證；本欄僅陳述現行要件，不敘述修訂經過。

short.term_en: 10 yrs, issued as 5 plus 5
short.term_zh: 10 年，先核 5 年再延 5 年
short.outcome_en: No pathway to permanent residence or citizenship
short.outcome_zh: 不通往永久居留或公民身分
short.own_en: Condominium freehold only, no land; 49% foreign cap per building
short.own_zh: 僅限公寓完全所有權，不含土地；每棟外國人持有上限 49%

programmes.notes_en: Property is one qualifying asset inside a USD 500,000 investment test — there is no property-only LTR route and no property-specific threshold. TWO ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS that are easy to miss and both are hard gates: (a) 'Owning at least USD 1 million in global assets or Thai assets in the applicant's name' — this remains live and is the category's defining condition, contrary to reports that it was dropped; and (b) health insurance of at least USD 50,000 coverage, OR Thai social security, OR a bank balance of at least USD 100,000 held for at least 12 months. Helpfully, the USD 1m assets test 'can include or combine with the investment in Thailand of at least USD 500,000 mentioned above', so the total commitment is USD 1m, not USD 1.5m. Every condition must be maintained throughout the life of the visa, including the investment amounts.
programmes.notes_zh: 不動產僅為 50 萬美元投資測試下之一種合格資產——LTR 並無純不動產途徑，亦無不動產專屬門檻。另有兩項易被忽略且均為硬性門檻之要件：(a)「申請人名下持有至少 100 萬美元之全球或泰國資產」——此要件仍然有效，且為本類別之核心條件，與「已取消」之傳聞相反；(b) 保額至少 5 萬美元之健康保險，或泰國社會保險，或持有至少 12 個月、餘額至少 10 萬美元之銀行存款。惟 100 萬美元資產測試「得包含或合併上述至少 50 萬美元之泰國投資」，故總承諾為 100 萬美元而非 150 萬美元。簽證存續期間所有條件（含投資金額）均須持續維持。

sources.publisher: Thailand Board of Investment (BOI) — Long-Term Resident Visa official portal
Siam Legal International — Thailand Law Library, Condominium Act B.E. 2522 translation

companion_requirements.text_en: Beyond the USD 500,000 investment (of which property is only one eligible asset class), the programme separately requires (a) global or Thai assets totalling at least USD 1,000,000 — this MAY overlap with the investment amount, so the total commitment is USD 1,000,000, not USD 1,500,000; and (b) health insurance of at least USD 50,000 coverage, OR Thai social security, OR a bank deposit held for at least 12 months with a balance of at least USD 100,000. Both (a) and (b) are confirmed against the BOI official page and remain in force.
companion_requirements.text_zh: 除 50 萬美元投資（房產僅為其中一種合格資產）外，另須（a）全球或泰國資產總額達 100 萬美元——可與投資額重疊，故總承諾為 100 萬非 150 萬美元；（b）保額 5 萬美元以上之健康保險，或泰國社會保險，或持有滿 12 個月、餘額 10 萬美元以上之銀行存款。（a）（b）對照 BOI 官方頁面確認，維持有效。

programmes.programme: Malaysia My Second Home (MM2H) — Silver / Gold / Platinum
programmes.programme_zh: 馬來西亞我的第二家園（MM2H）——銀/ 金/ 白金級

min_value.basis: Silver category. 'Compulsory to purchase and own a residence after obtaining the approval as MM2H participant.' 'Value of the purchased residence should be RM600,000 or above.' Property purchase is a COMPULSORY CONDITION but is NOT sufficient on its own — it sits on top of a fixed deposit of USD 150,000 in a Malaysian institution licensed under the Financial Services Act 2013 or Islamic Financial Services Act 2013, plus a one-off participation fee of RM1,000.

extra_tiers.label_en: Gold category: residence of RM1 million or above, plus fixed deposit of USD 500,000 and a one-off participation fee of RM3,000. Pass of 15 years.
Platinum category: residence of RM2 million or above, plus fixed deposit of USD 1 million and a one-off participation fee of RM200,000. Pass of 20 years.

Special Economic Zone / Special Financial Zone category (MOTAC's MM2H website): the residence must be bought in Forest City, Johor, after approval, at a floor price set by Johor state property-acquisition policy. MOTAC publishes no residence-value figure for it, so none is stated here. The amount shown is the fixed deposit for ages 21 to 49 (USD 32,000 from age 50). Participation fee RM1,000; resale barred for 10 years; pass of 10 years; 90 days' stay a year.
extra_tiers.label_zh: 經濟特區／金融特區類別（旅遊藝術文化部 MM2H 官網）：核准後須在柔佛州森林城購置住宅，底價依柔佛州不動產取得政策。官方未公布住宅價值金額，此處不列。所列金額為 21 至 49 歲適用的定存（50 歲以上為 3.2 萬美元）；參加費 RM1,000；10 年內不得出售；准證 10 年；每年停留 90 天。

term.text_en: Silver: MM2H pass for 5 years. Gold: 15 years. Platinum: 20 years. In every category 'the pass can be renewed for every 5 years'. The hologram security sticker is issued for the length of the pass but is bounded by the participant's passport validity.
term.text_zh: 銀級：5 年 MM2H 准證。金級：15 年。白金級：20 年。各級別均為「每 5 年可續」。全息安全貼紙依准證期限核發，但以申請人護照效期為限。

stay.text_en: Minimum 90 days (cumulative) in Malaysia per year — a real obligation, not a formality. For participants aged 25 to 49 the 90 days may be fulfilled by the principal OR his/her dependants.
stay.text_zh: 每年須在馬來西亞停留累計至少 90 天——此為實質義務而非形式。25 至 49 歲之申請人，該 90 天得由主申請人或其眷屬履行。

leads_to.text_en: Nothing. MM2H is a Social Visit Pass. It does not lead to permanent residence or citizenship, and time held does not count toward either.
leads_to.text_zh: 無。MM2H 屬社交訪問准證，不通往永久居留或公民身分，持有期間亦不計入任一資格。

ownership_form.text_en: Freehold or leasehold title, including landed property — Malaysia is unusual in Asia in permitting foreign freehold of land. BUT every acquisition by a non-citizen requires the written consent of the State Authority under the National Land Code, and each state sets its own minimum purchase price, which operates INDEPENDENTLY of the MM2H thresholds. Low-cost, low-medium-cost and medium-cost housing is barred to foreigners and permanent residents.
ownership_form.text_zh: 可持有永久業權或租賃業權，含有地房產——馬來西亞在亞洲罕見地允許外國人持有土地永久業權。惟非公民之每一宗取得均須依《國家土地法典》取得州政府書面同意，且各州自訂最低購價，該門檻獨立於 MM2H 門檻運作。低成本、中低成本及中等成本房屋禁止外國人及永久居民購買。

offplan.text_en: NOT VERIFIED, but re-confirmed by an active re-read rather than a carried-over label: the same full-text re-read found the document silent on completion status, as before.
offplan.text_zh: 未查證，惟已由主動重讀而非延續舊標籤所確認：同一次全文重讀確認文件對完工狀態同樣保持沉默。

mortgage.text_en: NOT VERIFIED, but re-confirmed by an active re-read rather than a carried-over label: read the full Terms and Regulations document again in full and it does not address mortgage/financing at all — this is confirmed statutory silence, not an unchecked field.
mortgage.text_zh: 未查證，惟已由主動重讀而非延續舊標籤所確認：通讀《新參與者條款與規則》全文，文件對房貸／融資議題完全未提及——屬確認之條文沉默，非未查欄位。

dependants.text_en: Spouse; biological, step- or adopted children below 21; children aged 21 to 34 may be included but must be unemployed and single while in Malaysia. Medically certified children with disabilities (no age limit) and parents or parents-in-law may also be included. No participation fee is charged for dependants in any category. A foreign domestic helper may be applied for separately. RE-CONFIRMED, not merely carried over: directly read the full Terms and Regulations PDF again and the figures match exactly, including that dependants are exempt from the participation fee and that a foreign domestic helper may be applied for separately.
dependants.text_zh: 配偶；未滿 21 歲之親生、繼親或收養子女；21 至 34 歲之子女得納入，惟在馬來西亞期間須未就業且未婚。有醫療證明的身心障礙子女（無年齡限制），以及父母與配偶的父母，亦可納入。各級別眷屬均免收參與費。外籍家庭幫傭可另行申請。 已重新確認，非延續舊結論：直接通讀《新參與者條款與規則》全文，數字逐字相符，包含依親人免收參與費、外傭可另行申請。

entry_tax.text_en: Five independent advisory sources agree that the transfer-memorandum stamp duty for non-citizen residential buyers rose from 4% to 8% effective 1 January 2026 (one of the five cites the 2025 Finance Bill / 2026 Budget) — consistent with this site's own /my/report.html content, which independently corroborates the same 8% figure. NOT confirmed against a hasil.gov.my (Inland Revenue Board) tier-1 page, so held at tier 2. Whether the commercial-property rate remains at 4% is reported by only a single source and is NOT adopted (fails the two-independent-tier-2-source bar). State consent-fee amounts (levied separately by each state's Land Office, or by the EPU for the Federal Territories) remain genuinely unconfirmed — actively checked, each state's rate/percentage could not be located.
entry_tax.text_zh: 部分確立：五個獨立顧問來源一致指出，外國人／非公民住宅買方之產權移轉備忘錄印花稅，自 2026 年 1 月 1 日起由 4% 調升至 8%（其中一份引用《2025 年財政法案／2026 年財政預算案》）——與本站 /my/report.html 既有內容之 8% 口徑互相印證。惟未對照 hasil.gov.my（內陸稅收局）第一級頁面確認，故列為第二級。商業地產是否維持 4% 僅見單一來源，不予採信（未達雙重獨立第二級來源標準）。各州同意費金額（由各州土地局分別徵收，聯邦直轄區則經 EPU）查證，仍確實無法確立各州具體費率／百分比。

last_change.text_en: The three-tier Silver/Gold/Platinum structure is stated in the MOTAC 'Terms and Regulations for New Participants' document, which is marked 'ACCURATE AS OF 22 JULY 2024' on every page. The MOTAC Application Guidelines Booklet published May 2026 is consistent with it and confirms renewal is a 5-year extension.
last_change.text_zh: 銀/金/白金三級結構載於旅遊藝術文化部《新參與者條款與規則》，該文件每頁標註「資料截至 2024 年 7 月 22 日」。旅遊藝術文化部 2026 年 5 月發布之《申請指南手冊》與之一致，並確認續期為 5 年延長。

short.term_en: Silver 5 yrs, Gold 15, Platinum 20; renewable every 5 yrs
short.term_zh: 銀級 5 年、金級 15 年、白金級 20 年；每 5 年續期
short.outcome_en: Nothing. A social visit pass; time held counts toward neither PR nor citizenship
short.outcome_zh: 無。屬社交訪問准證，持有年資不計入永久居留亦不計入入籍
short.own_en: Freehold or leasehold including land, but state consent and each state’s own minimum price apply
short.own_zh: 可持有永久或租賃業權，含土地；惟須州政府同意並符合各州自訂最低購價

programmes.notes_en: THE EFFECTIVE-FLOOR QUESTION: state minimums are not always the binding floor for an MM2H buyer. Penang's own Land and Mines Office guideline (updated 1 August 2024) shows that Penang grants MM2H participants an EXPRESS CONCESSION of RM500,000, on both the island and the mainland, for strata AND landed property — far below both the general foreign thresholds and below MM2H Silver's own RM600,000. The concession is limited: 'Malaysia My Second Home (MM2H) is for residence only and limited to 2 units only.' So in Penang the binding constraint on an MM2H Silver participant is the MM2H programme's own RM600,000, not RM3,000,000. Penang's general (non-MM2H) foreign thresholds are: strata, island — RM1 million (since 1 July 2012); landed/landed strata, island — RM3 million (since 1 April 2017); strata, mainland (Seberang Perai) — for INDIVIDUAL foreign buyers, RM500,000 from 1 July 2012 until 27 April 2017, THEN RM1,000,000 from 28 April 2017 (the RM1 million figure in the Penang Land and Mines Office guideline attached to the 2012 date is the threshold for CORPORATE buyers, not individuals; the individual-buyer floor before 2017 was RM500,000); landed, mainland — RM1 million (since 1 July 2012, unaffected by this correction). Permanent residents pay a RM250,000 floor. The RM3 million figure is real, but it binds foreigners who are NOT MM2H participants buying landed property on the island — not MM2H buyers. THE CORRECT GENERAL STATEMENT is therefore: the operative floor for any given purchase is the HIGHER of (a) the MM2H tier minimum and (b) whatever minimum the relevant state applies to that buyer and that property type — and some states, Penang demonstrably among them, apply a LOWER minimum to MM2H participants specifically. It cannot be resolved nationally; it must be checked state by state. KUALA LUMPUR IS NOT VERIFIED. A commonly cited KL figure of RM1,000,000 could not be confirmed: the Federal Territories Land and Mines Office (ptgwp.gov.my) was unreachable from this environment across repeated attempts by three different methods, and the Economic Planning Unit's Guideline on the Acquisition of Properties PDF on ekonomi.gov.my refused every connection. The RM1,000,000 figure appears only in tier-3 sources here and is therefore NOT published. Any KL figure should be verified against PTGWP or the EPU guideline before use. SEQUENCING (verified, and it settles the lock question's premise): the purchase is required AFTER approval, not before — 'Compulsory to purchase and own a residence after obtaining the approval as MM2H participant.' THE 10-YEAR LOCK: the instrument says only 'Selling of the residence is not allowed for 10 years. However, the house can be upgraded (buying of a new residence) to a residence of higher value from the current property.' It does NOT state whether the 10 years runs from the SPA or from visa issuance. Since the purchase must post-date approval, the two dates cannot be far apart, but the document does not resolve the start point and neither reading is published as fact. SPECIAL ECONOMIC ZONE / SPECIAL FINANCIAL ZONE CATEGORY: MOTAC's MM2H website lists a fourth category beside Silver, Gold and Platinum (mm2h.gov.my/category/sez). It requires buying and owning a property in Forest City, Johor after approval (floor price subject to Johor state policy; no figure published), a fixed deposit of USD 65,000 for ages 21 to 49 or USD 32,000 for ages 50 and above, a one-off fee of RM1,000, no sale for 10 years (upgrading to a higher-value residence is allowed), 90 days' presence a year (dependants may fulfil it for participants aged 25 to 49) and a pass of 10 years. It is shown under `extra_tiers` and is not this entry's headline threshold, because MOTAC publishes no residence-value floor for it and it is tied to one development. The general terms document (accurate as of 22 July 2024) sets 25 as the minimum age for all categories, while the zone page quotes deposit bands from age 21; the two are not reconciled.
programmes.notes_zh: 實際門檻問題：州最低價並非在所有情形下都是 MM2H 買方之拘束底線。檳城土地礦務局自身指引（2024 年 8 月 1 日更新）顯示：檳城對 MM2H 參與者明文給予 RM500,000 之優惠，島區與威省、分層與有地房產皆適用，遠低於一般外國人門檻，亦低於 MM2H 銀級自身之 RM600,000。該優惠有限制：「馬來西亞我的第二家園（MM2H）僅限自住，且以 2 個單位為限。」故在檳城，MM2H 銀級參與者之拘束條件為 MM2H 方案自身之 RM600,000，而非 RM3,000,000。檳城一般（非 MM2H）外國人門檻為：島區分層 RM100 萬（2012 年 7 月 1 日起）；島區有地/有地分層 RM300 萬（2017 年 4 月 1 日起）；威省（大陸段）分層——個人外籍買家門檻自 2012 年 7 月 1 日起為 RM500,000，直到 2017 年 4 月 28 日才調高至 RM100 萬（檳城土地礦務局指引中，與 2012 年日期連結之 RM100 萬實為「公司」買家門檻，非個人買家；2017 年前個人買家之實際門檻為 RM500,000）；威省有地 RM100 萬（2012 年 7 月 1 日起）。永久居民門檻為 RM250,000。RM300 萬確有其事，但拘束的是非 MM2H 之外國人購買島區有地房產，而非 MM2H 買方。正確之一般性陳述為：任一宗購置之實際底線，係(a) MM2H 級別門檻與(b) 該州就該買方及該房產類型所適用之最低價，兩者取其高——且部分州（檳城為明證）對 MM2H 參與者另訂較低門檻。此事無法在全國層次一概而論，必須逐州查核。吉隆坡未經查證。坊間常引之 RM1,000,000 數字無法確認：聯邦直轄區土地礦務局（ptgwp.gov.my）在本環境下以三種方法反覆嘗試均無法連通，經濟策劃單位之《房地產取得指引》PDF（ekonomi.gov.my）亦拒絕所有連線。RM1,000,000 僅見於三級來源，故不予刊載。吉隆坡的數字須先向 PTGWP 或經濟策劃單位指引查證後方可使用。順序（已查證，並釐清鎖定期問題之前提）：購置須於核准之後，而非之前——「經核准為 MM2H 參與者後，強制購買並持有住宅。」10 年鎖定期：條文僅載「住宅於 10 年內不得出售。惟該住宅得升級（購買新住宅）為價值更高之房產。」文件未載明 10 年係自買賣合約起算或自簽證核發起算。因購置必然晚於核准，兩個日期不致相距甚遠，惟文件未解決起算點，故兩種解讀均不作為事實刊載。經濟特區／金融特區類別：旅遊藝術文化部的 MM2H 官網在銀、金、白金三級之外另列第四類（mm2h.gov.my/category/sez）。該類別須在核准後於柔佛州森林城購置並持有住宅（底價依柔佛州政策，官方未公布金額）、定存 21 至 49 歲 6.5 萬美元（50 歲以上 3.2 萬美元）、一次性參加費 RM1,000、10 年內不得出售（可升級換購較高價值住宅）、每年在境 90 天（25 至 49 歲者可由眷屬履行）、准證 10 年。它列在 extra_tiers，不作本條目的標題門檻，因為官方沒有為它公布住宅價值底線，且僅限單一開發案。一般條款文件（資料截至 2024 年 7 月 22 日）規定所有類別最低年齡 25 歲，而特區頁面的定存級距從 21 歲起算，兩者未能對齊。
