companion_requirements.text_en: (1) mandatory medical examination for the principal applicant and every dependant, at a MOTAC-designated clinic/hospital, approval required before the application can proceed; (2) the application must be submitted through a MOTAC-licensed MM2H travel agent via the One Stop Centre — self-filing is not permitted; (3) the principal applicant must be aged 25 or over and a national of a country with diplomatic relations with Malaysia; (4) every 5-year renewal requires re-submission of a fresh medical report, insurance proof and a valid passport copy; (5) renewal/upgrade also requires a notarised Personal Bond and an MFII medical report; (6) a renewal fee of RM1,500 (Silver) / RM3,000 (Gold) / RM5,000 (Platinum), covering the principal and dependants combined, due at each 5-year renewal.
companion_requirements.text_zh: ①主申請人與每位依親人皆須至 MOTAC 指定診所／醫院完成體檢，核准後方可繼續辦理；②申請須透過 MOTAC 核發執照之 MM2H 旅遊代理商，經 One Stop Centre 送件，不可自行直接申辦；③主申請人須年滿 25 歲，且來自與馬來西亞有邦交之國家；④每次續證皆須重新提交體檢報告、保險證明與有效護照影本；⑤續證／升級另須具結之個人保證書（Personal Bond）及 MFII 體檢報告；⑥續證費——銀級 RM1,500／金級 RM3,000／白金級 RM5,000（主申請人＋依親人合計），每 5 年續證時繳納。

programmes.programme: Residence Visa — Leasehold Holder category
programmes.programme_zh: 居留簽證——租賃權持有人類別
programmes.label_zh: 居留簽證：租賃權持有人

min_value.basis: 'Requires leasehold ownership of a Vanuatu property valued at 10 million Vatu or more, with certified income of at least 250,000 Vatu per month per person in the application.' The property test alone is NOT sufficient — the monthly income test is a co-equal condition.

term.text_en: NOT VERIFIED — no fixed term is stated. The Department states only that for the Leasehold Holder category 'the visa's duration may vary based on individual circumstances.' The published fee schedule runs from 57,600 VUV (1 year) to 511,200 VUV (10 years) for applicants aged 18 and over, implying options in the 1-10 year range, but the Department does not commit to a term.
term.text_zh: 未查證——本頁不列固定期限。移民局僅表示租賃權持有人類別「簽證期限視個別情況而異」。公布之費用表自 57,600 瓦圖（1 年）至 511,200 瓦圖（10 年）（18 歲以上申請人），顯示選項落在 1 至 10 年區間，惟移民局未承諾特定期限。

stay.text_en: NOT VERIFIED.
stay.text_zh: 未查證。

leads_to.text_en: NOT VERIFIED. The Department lists a separate 'Permanent Residency Visa' but its relationship to the Leasehold Holder route was not established.
leads_to.text_zh: 未查證。移民局另列「永久居留簽證」，惟其與租賃權持有人途徑之關係未確立。

ownership_form.text_en: LEASEHOLD ONLY. Vanuatu land is customary-owned and the Department's own term for the qualifying interest is 'leasehold ownership' — there is no foreign freehold. The commonly-cited 75-year maximum lease term is NOT published here: the only source found was a single tier-2 report of a 2024 amendment to the Land Leases Act [CAP 163] s.32B raising the maximum on PUBLIC land from 75 to up to 99 years, which is both single-sourced and about public rather than custom land.
ownership_form.text_zh: 僅限租賃權。萬那杜土地為習俗所有，移民局就合格權益之用語為「租賃權所有」，不存在外國人永久業權。常被引用之 75 年最長租期本處不予刊載：僅查得單一二級來源報導 2024 年《土地租賃法》[CAP 163] 第 32B 條修正，將公有地最長租期由 75 年提高至最多 99 年，該來源既屬單一，且涉及公有地而非習俗地。

offplan.text_en: NOT VERIFIED.
offplan.text_zh: 未查證。

mortgage.text_en: NOT VERIFIED.
mortgage.text_zh: 未查證。

dependants.text_en: Yes. 'Applicants can include their spouse and dependent children in their visa application, except for those applying under the Self-Funded Resident category.' Leasehold Holder is not among the excepted categories.
dependants.text_zh: 可攜眷。「申請人得將配偶及受扶養子女納入簽證申請，惟以自費居民類別申請者除外。」租賃權持有人不在除外類別之列。

entry_tax.text_en: A 13 July 2026 notice from the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (Stamp Duty Commissioner) confirms that sale and purchase agreements, lease transfers and leasehold assignments ARE subject to stamp duty under s. 19 of the Stamp Duties Act CAP.68 — the 'no stamp duty' assumption is confirmed wrong. The SPECIFIC RATE could not be established: only a single non-authoritative source (myvanuatu.vu) cites 5%, which does not clear the two-independent-source bar and is not adopted.
entry_tax.text_zh: 部分確立：萬那杜金融服務委員會（印花稅稽核官署名）2026 年 7 月 13 日公告確認，《印花稅法》CAP.68 第 19 條下，買賣合約、租約移轉、租賃權轉讓均須課徵印花稅——『無印花稅』之假設經確認為錯誤。具體稅率仍無法確立：僅查得單一非權威來源（myvanuatu.vu）引用 5%，未達雙重獨立來源標準，不予採信。

last_change.text_en: NOT VERIFIED. The Department's own site cites the Immigration Act No. 17 of 2010 as the governing statute.
last_change.text_zh: 未查證。移民局網站援引《2010 年第 17 號入出境法》為主管法律。

short.term_en: Not verified; the Department states duration may vary
short.term_zh: 無公開資料；主管機關僅稱期限視個案而定
short.outcome_en: Not verified
short.outcome_zh: 無公開資料
short.own_en: Leasehold only; land is customary-owned and there is no foreign freehold
short.own_zh: 僅限租賃權；土地屬習俗所有，不存在外國人永久業權

programmes.notes_en: The VUV 10,000,000 figure is confirmed at tier 1, but a second hard gate materially changes who qualifies and is often omitted from summaries: certified income of at least VUV 250,000 per month PER PERSON in the application. For a couple that is VUV 500,000/month of certified income, which is a substantial ongoing test rather than a formality. Maintenance obligation: 'The main applicant must maintain the required monthly income and leasehold ownership of the property.' CITATION: the Department cites the Immigration Act No. 17 of 2010, not '[CAP 66]' as sometimes stated — CAP 66 is not the correct citation. Confidence is medium because term, stay, and pathway-to-PR are all unverified. STRICTLY SEPARATE from the Vanuatu citizenship-by-donation programmes (DSP/CIIP), which sit with the Vanuatu Citizenship Office, are not property-based, and were not verified here.
programmes.notes_zh: 1,000 萬瓦圖之數字已於一級來源確認，惟另有第二項硬性門檻常被摘要遺漏，且該門檻實質改變適用對象：申請案內每人每月經認證所得至少 25 萬瓦圖。以夫妻二人計即為每月 50 萬瓦圖經認證所得，屬持續性之實質測試而非形式。維持義務：「主申請人須維持所需之每月所得及該不動產之租賃權。」引註：移民局援引《2010 年第 17 號入出境法》，而非有時所稱之「[CAP 66]」——CAP 66 並非正確引註。因期限、居住要求及永久居留銜接均未查證，可信度列為中等。與萬那杜捐獻式公民計畫（DSP/CIIP）嚴格區分，後者主管機關為萬那杜公民局，非以不動產為基礎，未能確立。

sources.publisher: Vanuatu Department of Immigration and Passport Services
Vanuatu Financial Services Commission — Notice on Stamp Duty on Sale and Purchase Agreements, 13 July 2026

companion_requirements.text_en: Established: beyond the VUV 10,000,000 leasehold property, each applicant's file must show certified income of at least VUV 250,000 per month (VUV 500,000/month for a couple combined), and this is a CONTINUOUS maintenance test, not a one-off snapshot.
companion_requirements.text_zh: 確立：除 VUV 1,000 萬租賃權不動產外，申請案內每人每月須有經認證所得至少 VUV 250,000（夫妻合計 VUV 500,000／月），且須持續維持，非一次性測試。

programmes.programme: Special Resident Retiree's Visa (SRRV) Classic — deposit-to-property conversion
programmes.programme_zh: 特別居留退休簽證（SRRV）經典型——存款轉換不動產

min_value.basis: Minimum value of the property into which the visa deposit may be converted. Condominium: 'The visa deposit under the SRRV Classic may be converted into a condominium unit provided that the CCT is under the principal retiree's name and the value of the property is at least US$50,000.00 in Philippine Peso equivalent.' Long-term lease of house and lot: 'The Contract of Lease should be at least US$50,000.00 in Philippine Peso equivalent', and 'The lease should be at least 25 years and can be renewed for another 25 years at the option of the retiree-lessee.' DEPOSIT TIERS, PREVIOUSLY DELIBERATELY UNPUBLISHED, NOW ESTABLISHED FROM THE PRA'S OWN PAGE: pensioner aged 50+, USD 15,000; pensioner aged 40-49, USD 25,000; non-pensioner aged 50+, USD 30,000; non-pensioner aged 40-49, USD 50,000.

term.text_en: Indefinite while the deposit or the converted investment is maintained and the holder remains qualified. SRRV is a special resident visa with multiple-entry privileges.
term.text_zh: 只要存款或轉換後之投資維持且持有人資格存續，期限不限。SRRV 為具多次入境權之特別居留簽證。

stay.text_en: No minimum physical-presence requirement.
stay.text_zh: 無最低居住天數要求。

leads_to.text_en: No pathway to Philippine citizenship. SRRV is permanent-resident-style status contingent on maintaining the deposit or investment.
leads_to.text_zh: 不通往菲律賓公民身分。SRRV 屬須維持存款或投資之類永久居留身分。

ownership_form.text_en: Condominium unit title (CCT) or a long-term lease of house and lot — NEVER land. Republic Act No. 4726 (Condominium Act) s.5: 'no condominium unit therein shall be conveyed or transferred to persons other than Filipino citizens, or corporations at least sixty percent of the capital stock of which belong to Filipino citizens, except in cases of hereditary succession.' Expressed as a 60% Filipino floor, which is how the statute puts it, rather than as a 40% foreign cap.
ownership_form.text_zh: 僅限區分所有權狀（CCT）或房地長期租賃，絕不含土地。第 4726 號共和國法（區分所有權法）第 5 條規定，區分所有權單位不得移轉予菲律賓公民以外之人，或菲律賓公民持股未達 60% 之法人，繼承者除外。此係法條之表述方式（菲方持股 60% 下限），而非「外資 40% 上限」。

offplan.text_en: Excluded for the condominium conversion. The rule requires the Condominium Certificate of Title (CCT) to be already issued in the principal retiree's name, which an off-plan unit does not have.
offplan.text_zh: 區分所有權轉換排除預售屋。規則要求區分所有權狀（CCT）已登記於主申請退休人名下，預售屋不具備。

mortgage.text_en: NOT VERIFIED.
mortgage.text_zh: 未查證。

dependants.text_en: Spouse and children may be included; two dependants are covered by the base deposit and each additional dependant requires a further USD 15,000 deposit.
dependants.text_zh: 配偶及子女得納入；基本存款涵蓋 2 名眷屬，超過部分每名須另增 15,000 美元存款。

entry_tax.text_en: General information only, not SRRV-specific: the Philippine Documentary Stamp Tax is 1.5% of the higher of the transaction price or the BIR zonal value — this is the ordinary property-transaction tax, not a rule specific to SRRV conversion, and was not confirmed against a bir.gov.ph tier-1 rate page.
entry_tax.text_zh: 僅供一般參考，非 SRRV 專屬：菲律賓印花稅（Documentary Stamp Tax）為成交價與 BIR 稅務區值兩者取高之 1.5%——此為菲律賓一般不動產交易稅，非 SRRV 轉換專屬規則，未對照 bir.gov.ph 第一級稅率頁面確認。

last_change.text_en: NOT VERIFIED as a dated change. Legal basis for the conversion is Rule VIII-A of the Implementing Rules and Regulations of Executive Order No. 1037.
last_change.text_zh: 未查證具體修訂日期。轉換之法律依據為第 1037 號行政命令施行細則第 VIII-A 條。

short.term_en: Indefinite while the deposit or the converted investment is maintained
short.term_zh: 維持存款或轉換後之投資期間無期限
short.outcome_en: Permanent-resident-style status; no pathway to Philippine citizenship
short.outcome_zh: 近似永久居留之身分；不通往菲律賓公民身分
short.own_en: Condominium title or a 25-year lease of house and lot; never land
short.own_zh: 區分所有權狀或房地 25 年租賃，絕不含土地

programmes.notes_en: The visa is granted by the DEPOSIT; the purchase is a permitted post-issuance use of that deposit — the direction is the opposite of a property route. The clincher is explicit in the PRA checklist: 'Conversion of visa deposit into an existing condominium unit under principal retiree's name is only allowed 30 days after the issuance of SRRV.' You cannot buy your way to an SRRV; you obtain the SRRV by depositing, then may redeploy the deposit into property worth at least USD 50,000. TWO CORRECTIONS TO COMMONLY CIRCULATED CLAIMS: the reported '2023 reform raising the age to 50+' is FALSE — the PRA's current stated eligibility is 'Principal/s — 40 years old and above'. And 'USD 50,000 for the Classic' is FALSE as a blanket deposit figure; it applies only to non-pensioners aged 40-49. DEPOSIT BANDS: the SRRV Classic deposit falls in the range USD 15,000 to USD 50,000 depending on age band and pension status. The per-band allocation is deliberately NOT published: the PRA table's row/column orientation was ambiguous on extraction and the risk of transposing two figures is real, and the deposit is not the property threshold anyway. Pension proof required: at least USD 800/month for single applicants, USD 1,000/month with dependants. Land ownership by foreigners is constitutionally barred; the 1987 Constitution Art. XII text itself could not be retrieved and is not cited here.
programmes.notes_zh: 簽證係由存款取得；購置僅為核發後動用該存款之許可用途，方向與「不動產途徑」正好相反。菲律賓退休管理局檢核表明文載定：「將簽證存款轉換為主申請退休人名下既有區分所有權單位，僅於 SRRV 核發 30 日後始得為之。」無法以購置換取 SRRV；須先以存款取得 SRRV，其後方得將存款轉投入價值至少 5 萬美元之不動產。對坊間流傳說法之兩處更正：所謂「2023 年改革將年齡提高至 50 歲以上」為錯誤——退休管理局現行資格為「主申請人 40 歲以上」。「經典型 5 萬美元」作為通案存款數字亦為錯誤，該數字僅適用 40 至 49 歲之非領退休金者。存款級距：SRRV 經典型存款依年齡級距與是否領退休金，落在 15,000 至 50,000 美元區間。各級距對應金額刻意不予刊載：擷取時該表列欄方向存有歧義，錯置兩個數字之風險確實存在，且存款本非不動產門檻。須檢附退休金證明：單身申請人每月至少 800 美元，有眷屬者每月至少 1,000 美元。外國人持有土地為憲法所禁；1987 年憲法第 12 條本文無法取得，本處不予引註。

sources.publisher: Philippine Retirement Authority (PRA)
Philippine Retirement Authority — PRA-SD-FORM-0003, checklist for conversion into a condominium unit
LawPhil Project — Republic Act No. 4726 (Condominium Act)

companion_requirements.text_en: The SRRV's substantive threshold is the DEPOSIT, not the property purchase — property is only what the deposit may later be converted into. The deposit must sit for at least 30 days before it can be converted into a real-estate investment. A pension-income proof of at least USD 800/month (single) or USD 1,000/month (with dependants) is a SEPARATE, parallel requirement running alongside the deposit/property threshold, not an alternative to it.
companion_requirements.text_zh: SRRV 的實質門檻是「存款」而非「購屋」——房產僅為存款其後可轉換之標的。存款須先存滿 30 天才可轉換為房產投資。退休金證明每月至少 800 美元（單身）或 1,000 美元（含依親人）為與存款／房產門檻並行之獨立必要條件，非其替代方案。

programmes.programme: New Capital Investment Entrant Scheme (New CIES)
programmes.programme_zh: 新資本投資者入境計劃（新 CIES）
programmes.label_zh: 新資本投資者入境計畫

min_value.basis: Total minimum investment. 'An Applicant must make investment of a minimum of HK$30 million Net.' Of this, at least HK$27 million goes into permissible financial assets and/or real estate, and HK$3 million must be placed into the CIES Investment Portfolio managed by the Hong Kong Investment Corporation Limited. Applicant must also hold net assets of at least HK$30 million for the six months preceding assessment.

extra_tiers.label_en: AGGREGATE CAP on real estate counted toward the HK$30m: 'The total investment amount in real estate which is counted towards the fulfillment of minimum investment threshold is subject to an aggregate cap of HK$15 million.'

SUB-CAP on residential real estate within that HK$15m: 'of which the investment in residential real estate is capped at HK$10 million.' Residential investment must be in one single property with a transaction price of HK$30 million or above.

term.text_en: From the Immigration Department's official FAQ: a first-time entrant, on visitor status, must complete the investment within 180 days; a residence visa is then issued, initially valid for no more than 24 months, with subsequent renewals of roughly 3 years each.
term.text_zh: 自入境處官方 FAQ 確立：首次以訪客身分入境須於不超過 180 天內完成投資，其後獲發居留簽證，首次核發不超過 24 個月，其後每次續期約 3 年。

stay.text_en: Not addressed by a day-count requirement as such; see `term` for the visitor-status 180-day investment-completion deadline, which is the operative time constraint.
stay.text_zh: 確立：本身無天數要求；實際具拘束力之時間限制為訪客身分下的 180 天投資完成期限，見 term 欄位。

leads_to.text_en: This scheme does NOT confer automatic permanent residence. The holder must separately satisfy the general 'ordinarily resident' continuous 7-year test under the Immigration Ordinance to become eligible to apply for permanent-resident status.
leads_to.text_zh: 確立：本計畫並非自動取得永久居留。持有人仍須另行依《入境條例》符合『通常居住』連續 7 年之一般測試，方具永久居民資格申請條件。

ownership_form.text_en: Hong Kong imposes no nationality restriction on property ownership; title is leasehold from Government in the ordinary course. Within New CIES, non-residential means commercial and/or industrial property; land itself and partly-residential multi-purpose property cannot be counted.
ownership_form.text_zh: 香港對物業擁有權不設國籍限制；一般情形下業權為政府批出之租契。在新 CIES 下，非住宅指商業及/或工業物業；土地本身及部分作住宅用途之綜合用途物業不得計入。

offplan.text_en: Permitted for NON-RESIDENTIAL only: the non-residential category expressly includes commercial and/or industrial property 'including pre-completion' (offices, commercial/retail premises, factories). Land and multi-purpose real estate that is partly residential are excluded. Definitions follow s.29A of the Stamp Duty Ordinance (Cap. 117).
offplan.text_zh: 僅非住宅類允許：非住宅類別明文包含商業及/或工業物業「含樓花」（寫字樓、商業/零售物業、工廠）。土地及部分作住宅用途之綜合用途物業除外。定義依《印花稅條例》（第 117 章）第 29A 條。

mortgage.text_en: NOT VERIFIED.
mortgage.text_zh: 未能確立。

dependants.text_en: Corroborated by TWO independent tier-1 sources (the official Guidebook and the Immigration Department FAQ, described independently but consistently): spouse (including same-sex civil-partnership relationships) and unmarried children under 18.
dependants.text_zh: 確立，由兩個獨立第一級來源互證（官方 Guidebook 與入境處 FAQ 各自獨立敘述但一致）：配偶（含同性伴侶關係）及未滿 18 歲之未婚子女。

entry_tax.text_en: NOT VERIFIED.
entry_tax.text_zh: 未能確立。

last_change.text_en: Two dated relaxations, both from the scheme's own footnotes. Residential real estate was admitted for purchases completing on or after 16 OCTOBER 2024. Before 17 SEPTEMBER 2025 the residential transaction-price threshold was HK$50 million or above and the aggregate real-estate cap was HK$10 million; from 17 September 2025 the residential threshold fell to HK$30 million and the aggregate real-estate cap rose to HK$15 million.
last_change.text_zh: 兩次有明確日期之放寬，均出自計劃自身註腳。住宅物業自 2024 年 10 月 16 日或之後完成交易者始獲納入。2025 年 9 月 17 日之前，住宅成交價門檻為 5,000 萬港元或以上，房地產總上限為 1,000 萬港元；自 2025 年 9 月 17 日起，住宅門檻降至 3,000 萬港元，房地產總上限升至 1,500 萬港元。

short.term_en: Not verified
short.term_zh: 無公開資料
short.outcome_en: Not verified
short.outcome_zh: 無公開資料
short.own_en: Real estate counts toward at most HK$15m of the total, residential at most HK$10m
short.own_zh: 不動產計入總額上限為 1,500 萬港元，其中住宅上限 1,000 萬港元

programmes.notes_en: 'Non-residential only, capped at HK$10 million' is a superseded launch rule, not the current rule. Residential property has been admissible since purchases completing on or after 16 October 2024, and the caps changed again on 17 September 2025. Current position: aggregate real-estate cap HK$15 million, of which residential is capped at HK$10 million, and any residential investment must be a single property transacting at HK$30 million or above. FRAMING: property is NOT a route here. It is one permitted asset class inside a single HK$30 million investment requirement, and it is capped so that it can never satisfy more than half of it. There is no property-only pathway into New CIES. Most non-financial fields above are outside the researched scope and are marked unverified rather than guessed. The commonly-cited 1 March 2024 launch date was not stated on the pages read and is not confirmed here — the rules refer only to 'the launch date of the Scheme'.
programmes.notes_zh: 「僅限非住宅、上限 1,000 萬港元」為已被取代之開辦規則，並非現行規定。住宅物業自 2024 年 10 月 16 日或之後完成交易者即可納入，上限並於 2025 年 9 月 17 日再度變更。現行規定：房地產總上限 1,500 萬港元，其中住宅上限 1,000 萬港元，且住宅投資須為單一物業且成交價 3,000 萬港元或以上。定位：不動產在此並非途徑，而係單一 3,000 萬港元投資要求下之一種許可資產類別，且其上限使其永遠無法滿足該要求之一半以上。新 CIES 並無純不動產途徑。上列多數非財務欄位不在查證範圍內，標示未查證而不作臆測。常被引用之 2024 年 3 月 1 日開辦日期未見於所讀頁面，本處不予確認——規則僅提及「計劃開辦日」。

sources.publisher: InvestHK — New Capital Investment Entrant Scheme, investment requirement
Hong Kong Immigration Department — New CIES FAQ

companion_requirements.text_en: Of the HK$30,000,000 total investment, HK$3,000,000 must be placed into a CIES-managed investment portfolio administered by Hong Kong Investment Corporation Limited — this portion cannot be avoided regardless of how the applicant allocates the remainder toward real estate. Applicants must also hold net assets of at least HK$30,000,000 for the six months preceding application.
companion_requirements.text_zh: HK$30,000,000 總投資額中，HK$3,000,000 須強制投入由香港投資管理有限公司管理之 CIES 投資組合——無論申請人如何分配其餘款項至不動產，這筆錢皆無法迴避。申請人並須於申請前 6 個月持有淨資產達 HK$30,000,000。

programmes.programme: Residence permit by acquisition of scheme property (PDS / RES / IHS / Smart City) or a G+2 apartment
programmes.programme_zh: 取得計畫類房產（PDS / RES / IHS / 智慧城市）或 G+2 公寓之居留許可
programmes.label_en: Scheme property or a G+2 apartment
programmes.label_zh: 計畫類物件或 G+2 公寓

min_value.basis: Immigration Act 2022 s.8(1)(d): a non-citizen is eligible for a residence permit where he 'purchases an immovable property under the Integrated Resort Scheme, Real Estate Scheme, Invest Hotel Scheme, Property Development Scheme or Smart City Scheme, provided that the purchase price is not less than 375,000 US dollars or its equivalent in any other hard convertible foreign currency' (exchange rate: the selling rate at signature of the title deed). s.8(1)(e) applies the same figure to the buyer's own contribution where he buys together with other persons. s.8(1)(f): he 'purchases or otherwise acquires an apartment used, or available for use, as residence in a building of at least 2 floors above ground floor, provided the purchase price is not less than 375,000 US dollars or its equivalent'. The permit is issued by the Director-General of Immigration with the approval of the Minister (s.8(3)). The Immigration Act 2022 (Act 14 of 2022, assented 27 July 2022) repealed the earlier Immigration Act (s.38), so the earlier numbering (s.5(1)(g) and (ga)) is no longer the operative text.

extra_tiers.label_en: NOT a residence threshold — the minimum price at which a non-citizen is PERMITTED TO BUY a G+2 apartment at all. Non-Citizens (Property Restriction) Act s.3(3)(c)(v): 'an apartment used, or available for use, as residence, in a building of at least 2 floors above ground floor, provided the purchase price is not less than 6 million rupees or its equivalent in any other hard convertible foreign currency'. A G+2 purchase priced between MUR 6 million and USD 375,000 is lawful but confers NO residence.

term.text_en: Open-ended, tied to continued holding. EDB guidelines: 'The residence permit granted to the non-citizen remains in force until such time the non-citizen shall hold the residential property under the G+2 or where the person nominated... informs the Economic Development Board to terminate the residency.' Immigration Act 2022 s.19(1)(b): a non-citizen ceases to hold the status of resident where he 'no longer satisfies the requirements based on which he was issued with a permit'.
term.text_zh: 無固定年限，與持續持有掛鉤。經濟發展局指引：外國人之居留許可持續有效，直至其不再持有該 G+2 住宅，或經指定人通知經濟發展局終止居留為止。《2022 年入出境法》第 19(1)(b) 條：外國人不再符合核發許可所依據的要件時，即喪失居民身分。

stay.text_en: No minimum physical-presence requirement is imposed by Immigration Act 2022 s.8(1)(d) to (f), which create this permit.
stay.text_zh: 《2022 年入出境法》第 8(1)(d) 至 (f) 款創設本許可，未課予最低實際居住要求。

leads_to.text_en: NO route to permanent residence via the property itself. Immigration Act 2022 s.11(1)(a) routes permanent residence through Part IV of the First Schedule to the Economic Development Board Act 2017. Act 18 of 2025 (in force 9 August 2025) repealed and replaced that Part with four categories — Investor, Professional, Self-employed, Retired non-citizen — and Act 13 of 2026 (Economic and Financial Measures (Miscellaneous Provisions) Act 2026, assented 12 August 2026, s.15(e)(iii)(B)) adds a fifth, 'Golden visa': a golden-visa holder who has invested at least USD 1,000,000 within 12 months of its issue 'in any business activity other than acquisition of a residential property under the EDB property schemes'. None of the five is property-based. The retired-non-citizen route requires 5 years' residence permit PLUS USD 200,000 transferred over 5 years. Citizenship: NOT VERIFIED — the Mauritius Citizenship Act was not examined and no naturalisation claim is published.
leads_to.text_zh: 不動產本身不通往永久居留。《2022 年入出境法》第 11(1)(a) 條將永久居留導向《2017 年經濟發展局法》附表一第四部。2025 年第 18 號法（2025 年 8 月 9 日生效）廢止並取代該部，改列四類——投資者、專業人士、自營作業者、退休外國人；2026 年第 13 號法（《2026 年經濟與財政措施（雜項規定）法》，2026 年 8 月 12 日經總統簽署，第 15(e)(iii)(B) 條）再增第五類「黃金簽證」：黃金簽證持有人在簽發後 12 個月內，投資不少於 100 萬美元於「經濟發展局房產計畫下取得住宅以外的任何商業活動」。五類均非以不動產為基礎。退休外國人途徑須持居留許可滿 5 年，並於 5 年內匯入 20 萬美元。公民身分：未查證——未檢視《模里西斯公民法》，不刊載歸化主張。

ownership_form.text_en: Freehold, but only within a permitted channel. A non-citizen may not freely buy Mauritian property; acquisition must fall within the Non-Citizens (Property Restriction) Act, i.e. under one of the EDB schemes or as a G+2 apartment at not less than MUR 6 million.
ownership_form.text_zh: 可持有完全所有權，惟須循許可管道。外國人不得自由購置模里西斯不動產；取得須落入《非公民（財產限制）法》範圍，即依經濟發展局各計畫之一，或以不低於 600 萬盧比購買 G+2 公寓。

offplan.text_en: NOT VERIFIED as such. Related and verified: under regulations in force 13 December 2024, 85% of the purchase price must be paid to the promoter in Mauritian rupees and the remaining 15% in USD/EUR/other hard currency or MUR; local loan financing is available only above USD 750,000 (raised from USD 500,000), with the first USD 750,000 to come from own funds transferred from abroad. Critically, 'The amendments do not apply to sale of apartment under the Ground+2 scheme.'
offplan.text_zh: 本身未查證。相關且已查證者：依 2024 年 12 月 13 日生效之規則，購價之 85% 須以模里西斯盧比支付予開發商，其餘 15% 得以美元/歐元/其他強勢貨幣或盧比支付；本地貸款融資僅於 75 萬美元以上部分可用（由 50 萬美元提高），首筆 75 萬美元須為自海外匯入之自有資金。關鍵在於「該等修正不適用於 Ground+2 計畫下之公寓買賣」。

mortgage.text_en: Local loan financing is permitted only for the portion above USD 750,000; the first USD 750,000 must come from the buyer's own funds transferred from abroad. This does NOT apply to G+2 apartments.
mortgage.text_zh: 本地貸款融資僅適用於 75 萬美元以上之部分；首筆 75 萬美元須為買方自海外匯入之自有資金。此規定不適用於 G+2 公寓。

dependants.text_en: Yes. Immigration Act 2022 s.8(1)(d)(ii), (e)(ii) and (f)(ii) make 'the spouse, dependent child, parent or other dependent of a person, other than a young professional,' to whom the purchase limb applies eligible for a residence permit. Note this expressly extends to PARENTS, which is unusually generous.
dependants.text_zh: 可攜眷。《2022 年入出境法》第 8(1)(d)(ii)、(e)(ii)、(f)(ii) 條使符合購置要件者（青年專業人士除外）的「配偶、受扶養子女、父母或其他受扶養人」取得居留許可資格。值得注意者，該條明文及於父母，條件相當寬鬆。

entry_tax.text_en: The two 10% charges introduced for deeds registered on or after 1 July 2026 were narrowed by the Finance Act 2026 (Act 14 of 2026, assented 12 August 2026). (1) BUYER: Registration Duty Act s.3(1G) — which made the registration of a deed transferring an EDB-scheme or G+2 residential property to a non-citizen chargeable at 10% (Part I, paragraph K of the First Schedule) — is repealed by s.16(b). The ordinary registration-duty rate then applies; that rate was not verified here. The 10% applied to deeds registered from 1 July 2026 until the repeal. (2) SELLER: Land (Duties and Taxes) Act s.4(9) is repealed (Finance Act s.9(a)(i)) and replaced by a new s.4(11): an additional duty of 10% (Seventh Schedule, new Part IV), payable by the transferor, on the transfer to a non-citizen under s.3(3)(c)(v) of the Non-Citizens (Property Restriction) Act — that is, a G+2 apartment — of a residential property located on State land or on Pas Géométriques, except where a notarised presale agreement was executed before 19 June 2026. Properties under the EDB schemes (IRS, RES, IHS, PDS, Smart City) are no longer within the seller's charge. Neither section is listed in the Act's commencement section (s.28); the gazette date was not checked.
entry_tax.text_zh: 2026 年 7 月 1 日或之後登記契據適用的兩項 10% 稅負，已由《2026 年財政法》（2026 年第 14 號法，2026 年 8 月 12 日經總統簽署）縮減。(1) 買方：《登記稅法》第 3(1G) 條原規定向外國人移轉經濟發展局計畫或 G+2 住宅的契據登記，依附表一第一部 K 段課 10%，該條已由財政法第 16(b) 條廢止，改按一般登記稅率，該稅率此處未查證；10% 適用於 2026 年 7 月 1 日起至廢止前登記的契據。(2) 賣方：《土地（稅捐）法》第 4(9) 條廢止（財政法第 9(a)(i) 條），改增第 4(11) 條：向外國人依《非公民（財產限制）法》第 3(3)(c)(v) 條（即 G+2 公寓）移轉位於國有土地或 Pas Géométriques 的住宅，由移轉人加繳 10% 額外稅（附表七新增第四部）；2026 年 6 月 19 日前已簽署公證預售協議者除外。經濟發展局各計畫（IRS、RES、IHS、PDS、智慧城市）下的房產不再適用賣方這項稅。兩條均未列入該法的施行條款（第 28 條）；公報日期未查。

last_change.text_en: Finance Act 2026 (Act 14 of 2026, assented 12 August 2026) repealed the buyer's 10% registration duty on these properties and narrowed the seller's 10% additional duty to G+2 apartments on State land or Pas Géométriques (see entry_tax). The Economic and Financial Measures (Miscellaneous Provisions) Act 2026 (Act 13 of 2026, assented 12 August 2026) added a 'Golden visa' item to the permanent-residence criteria. Before these, Act 18 of 2025 (in force 9 August 2025) had introduced the 10% charges for deeds registered from 1 July 2026 and replaced the permanent-residence criteria. The permit itself is governed by the Immigration Act 2022 (Act 14 of 2022).
last_change.text_zh: 《2026 年財政法》（2026 年第 14 號法，2026 年 8 月 12 日經總統簽署）廢止買方就這些房產負擔的 10% 登記稅，並把賣方的 10% 額外稅縮到國有土地或 Pas Géométriques 上的 G+2 公寓（見 entry_tax）。《2026 年經濟與財政措施（雜項規定）法》（2026 年第 13 號法，同日簽署）在永久居留要件中新增「黃金簽證」一項。在此之前，2025 年第 18 號法（2025 年 8 月 9 日生效）曾訂出適用於 2026 年 7 月 1 日起登記契據的 10% 稅負，並取代永久居留要件。許可本身依《2022 年入出境法》（2022 年第 14 號法）核發。

short.term_en: Open-ended, tied to continued holding of the property
short.term_zh: 無固定期限，繫於持續持有該物件
short.stay_en: None imposed by the Immigration Act provisions
short.outcome_en: No route to permanent residence via the property itself
short.outcome_zh: 物件本身不通往永久居留
short.own_en: Freehold, but only inside an EDB scheme or as a G+2 apartment
short.own_zh: 完全所有權，惟須循經濟發展局各計畫或以 G+2 公寓取得

programmes.notes_en: The Economic Development Board's live domain is edbmauritius.org — edb.mu does not resolve. The thresholds here are taken from the statutes themselves (the Immigration Act 2022 as published by the Passport and Immigration Office; the other Acts from the Attorney-General's Laws of Mauritius portal and the Mauritius Revenue Authority), not from the EDB's summaries. G+2: purchase of a G+2 apartment at USD 375,000 or more IS residence-granting, under Immigration Act 2022 s.8(1)(f). The apparent 'buy without residence' case is real but is a PRICE BAND, not a scheme exclusion — between MUR 6 million (the minimum at which a non-citizen may buy a G+2 at all) and USD 375,000 (the minimum at which the purchase also carries residence). STATUTE VERSION: the Immigration Act in force is the Immigration Act 2022 (Act 14 of 2022), which repealed the earlier Immigration Act (s.38). Under the 2022 Act the G+2 residence permit sits in section 8, at s.8(1)(f), so the EDB guidelines' reference to 'Section 8 of the Immigration Act' is correct; the earlier Act's section 8 ('Prohibited immigrants') and its s.5(1)(g), (ga) and (i) are no longer the operative provisions. ONE ITEM DELIBERATELY NOT PUBLISHED: The short title of Act 18 of 2025 was not verified; cite it by act number, and note it is NOT the Budget 2026-2027, which is a different instrument.
programmes.notes_zh: 經濟發展局現行網域為 edbmauritius.org——edb.mu 網域無法解析。本處門檻取自法規本文：《2022 年入出境法》取自護照及移民辦公室公布的版本，其他法律取自檢察總長署「模里西斯法律」入口與模里西斯稅務局，而非經濟發展局之摘要。G+2：以 37.5 萬美元以上購買 G+2 公寓確可取得居留，依據為《2022 年入出境法》第 8(1)(f) 條。所謂「購買而不取得居留」之情形確實存在，但屬價格區間而非計畫排除——即介於 600 萬盧比（外國人得購買 G+2 之最低價）與 37.5 萬美元（購買同時取得居留之最低價）之間。法規版本：現行《入出境法》為《2022 年入出境法》（2022 年第 14 號法），已廢止舊《入出境法》（第 38 條）。依 2022 年法，G+2 居留許可規定於第 8 條第 1 項第 f 款，經濟發展局指引所稱「《入出境法》第 8 條」並無錯誤；舊法第 8 條（禁止入境者）及其第 5(1)(g)、(ga)、(i) 條已非現行規定。一項刻意不予刊載：2025 年第 18 號法之簡稱未經查證；請以法律編號引用，並注意其非 2026-2027 年度預算案，二者為不同法案。

companion_requirements.text_en: EDB Guidelines require '(v) Medical certificates for each applicant with a validity period of 6 months' and '(vi) Morality certificates of applicants, above the age of 18, with a validity period of 6 months' — i.e. EVERY applicant, including dependants aged 18+, must separately submit a 6-month-valid medical certificate AND a 6-month-valid morality (clean-record) certificate, beyond the property purchase itself. Separately, s. 3(3)(c)(v) of the Non-Citizens (Property Restriction) Act requires that a G+2 purchase (MUR 6,000,000 threshold) be made 'on production of an authorisation from the Economic Development Board granted after it has obtained the approval of the Minister' — i.e. buying itself (not just the residency permit) requires EDB-plus-ministerial discretionary authorisation, not merely meeting the price threshold. A full-text search found no fixed-deposit or bond requirement, and no separate income test on the property route itself (that only applies to the distinct non-citizen retiree route: USD 1,500/month or USD 200,000/5 years) — this is a genuine checked-and-absent result, not an unchecked gap.
companion_requirements.text_zh: EDB 指引第 (v) 項「每位申請人須提交 6 個月效期內之體檢證明」、第 (vi) 項「18 歲以上申請人須提交 6 個月效期內之品行（無犯罪紀錄）證明」——即每位申請人（含 18 歲以上受扶養人）除購屋外，皆須另外提交 6 個月效期內的體檢證明與品行證明。另外，《非公民（財產限制）法》第 3 條第 3 項第 c 款第 v 目規定，G+2 購買（MUR 6,000,000 門檻）須「經濟發展局取得部長核准後，出具授權書」——即購買行為本身（非僅居留許可）須經 EDB 加部長裁量授權，非單純達到價格門檻即可。全文檢索未發現固定存款或保證金要求，亦未發現不動產路徑本身有額外收入門檻（該項僅適用於另一條非公民退休人士路徑：每月 1,500 美元或 5 年 20 萬美元）——此為真正查過而確認不存在之結果，非未查缺口。

programmes.programme: Investor Visa Category (resident visa)
programmes.programme_zh: 投資人簽證類別（居留簽證）

min_value.basis: 'a. USD 100,000 - for a 5 year visa.' Funds must be routed through an Inward Investment Account and then a Visa Programme Foreign Currency Account at a licensed commercial bank. Acquisition of immovable property is ONE of five permitted uses of those funds, alongside voting shares of at least 10% in a Sri Lankan company, an overseas company's place of business, government or CBSL debt securities of 5 years or more, and term deposits.

extra_tiers.label_en: 'b. USD 200,000 - for a 10 year visa.' Granted initially for 5 years, with a letter extending it a further 5.

term.text_en: 5 years at USD 100,000; 10 years at USD 200,000 (issued as 5 years then extended by a further 5). The project is reviewed every 2 years. Visa fees USD 200 per year each.
term.text_zh: 10 萬美元為 5 年；20 萬美元為 10 年（先核 5 年，再延長 5 年）。投資案每 2 年審查一次。簽證費每人每年 200 美元。

stay.text_en: NOT VERIFIED.
stay.text_zh: 未查證。

leads_to.text_en: NOT VERIFIED.
leads_to.text_zh: 未查證。

ownership_form.text_en: Condominium freehold on ANY floor above ground level — the fourth-floor restriction is GONE. Land (Restrictions on Alienation) Act No. 38 of 2014 s.2(1) prohibits transfer of title to land to a foreigner, to a Sri Lankan company with foreign shareholding of fifty per cent or above, or to a foreign company; the maximum lease tenure alternative 'shall not exceed ninety nine years'. The 2014 condominium exemption originally required a parcel 'situated on or above the fourth floor'. Act No. 21 of 2018 s.2(a) repealed that paragraph and substituted 'a condominium parcel specified under the Apartment Ownership Law', keeping only the proviso that 'the entire value shall be paid upfront through an inward foreign remittance prior to the execution of the relevant deed of transfer'. Certified 30 July 2018 and deemed in operation from 1 April 2018.
ownership_form.text_zh: 可持有地面層以上任何樓層之區分所有權完全所有權——四樓限制已廢除。《2014 年第 38 號土地（讓與限制）法》第 2(1) 條禁止將土地所有權移轉予外國人、外資持股達 50% 以上之斯里蘭卡公司或外國公司；替代之最長租期「不得逾 99 年」。2014 年之區分所有權豁免原要求須為「位於四樓或以上」之單元。《2018 年第 21 號法》第 2(a) 條廢止該款，代之以「《公寓所有權法》所定之區分所有權單元」，僅保留「全部價金須於簽立移轉契據前經自海外匯入方式一次付清」之但書。2018 年 7 月 30 日核可，並溯自 2018 年 4 月 1 日施行。

offplan.text_en: NOT VERIFIED.
offplan.text_zh: 未查證。

mortgage.text_en: Effectively precluded for the qualifying sum: the money must arrive as an inward remittance through the designated accounts.
mortgage.text_zh: 就合格金額而言實質排除：款項須經指定帳戶自海外匯入。

dependants.text_en: Yes — eligibility covers 'Foreign Nationals; Spouse and dependants of main applicant.'
dependants.text_zh: 可攜眷——資格涵蓋「外國人；主申請人之配偶及受扶養人」。

entry_tax.text_en: Art. 7(1)(b) of the 2024 consolidated Land (Restrictions on Alienation) Act FULLY EXEMPTS land lease tax where the unit is on the 4th floor or above, the lease term is at least 35 years, and the full amount was remitted before signing. Art. 6(3)(c)/(d) sets a PREFERENTIAL 7.5% rate (vs the general 15%) for shorter-lease apartments. In practice this has little bite for most Investor Visa buyers because 4th-floor-and-above units already qualify for full ownership (not leasehold) under the Apartment Ownership Law, and the land lease tax by definition only applies to leasehold.
entry_tax.text_zh: 確立：《土地（讓與限制）法》2024 年整合版第 7(1)(b) 條——四樓以上、租期滿 35 年、簽約前已全額匯入者，完全豁免土地租賃稅。第 6(3)(c)/(d) 條對較短租期之公寓則為優惠稅率 7.5%（一般稅率為 15%）。實務上此議題對多數投資人簽證買家已無實益，因為四樓以上公寓本可依《公寓所有權法》取得完全所有權（非租賃），土地租賃稅依定義僅課徵於租賃。

last_change.text_en: NOT VERIFIED for the Investor Visa itself.
last_change.text_zh: 投資人簽證本身未查證。

short.term_en: 5 yrs at US$100,000; 10 yrs at US$200,000
short.term_zh: 10 萬美元為 5 年；20 萬美元為 10 年
short.outcome_en: Not verified
short.outcome_zh: 無公開資料
short.own_en: Condominium freehold on any floor above ground; freehold land prohibited
short.own_zh: 地面層以上任何樓層之區分所有權完全所有權；土地不得取得完全所有權

programmes.notes_en: THE MECHANISM IS A REMITTANCE, NOT A DEED. Property purchase qualifies, but it is one of five permitted uses of money that must first be remitted into an Inward Investment Account and then a Visa Programme Foreign Currency Account. The gating act is the inward remittance, not the conveyance — describing this as a 'buy property, get residency' route would be materially misleading. The ownership question posed is answered squarely: a foreigner CAN hold freehold title to a condominium unit on any floor above ground level, provided the entire price is paid upfront by inward foreign remittance before the deed is executed. Freehold LAND remains prohibited, with a 99-year lease as the alternative.
programmes.notes_zh: 關鍵在匯款而非契據。購置不動產確可符合資格，惟其為款項之五種許可用途之一，而該款項須先匯入「境外投資帳戶」再轉入「簽證計畫外幣帳戶」。門檻行為是資金匯入而非產權移轉；將其描述為「買房換居留」將造成實質誤導。所詢之所有權問題可明確回答：外國人可持有地面層以上任何樓層區分所有權單元之完全所有權，惟全部價金須於簽立移轉契據前以自海外匯入方式一次付清。土地之完全所有權仍禁止，替代方案為 99 年租賃。

companion_requirements.text_en: Established from the official Guideline PDF: a medical report, a police clearance certificate valid within 3 months, a security-screening form, and an investment plan document are all required beyond the remittance itself. On exit, at least 2 months' written notice is required, plus a further 14 working days' notice before permanent departure. The Guideline nowhere sets a minimum physical-presence day count.

programmes.notes_en: CONFIDENCE IS MEDIUM BECAUSE THE PROGRAMME'S CURRENT STATUS IS UNRESOLVED, not because the figures are shaky. The figures are tier-1. But two official signals from the same Department conflict: the Golden Paradise page is still live and still states USD 200,000 for 10 years, while the Department's own Residence Visa index now lists sixteen categories with NO Golden Paradise entry among them (it lists Employment, Investor, Religious, Educational, NGO, Registered Indians, Ex-Sri Lankan Citizens, Family Members, Diplomatic, Medical, Court, My Dream Home Visa Programme, Resident Guest Scheme, Digital Nomad, Port City Commission, and Relations of Sri Lankan Citizens). The Golden Paradise site footer still reads '2010-2022'. No tier-1 source, and no two agreeing tier-2 sources, say whether it is open, closed, or superseded; claims that it is closed trace only to social-media comments. Its status is unconfirmed; the Investor Visa Category appears to be the active route. A Sri Lankan news report (Ada Derana, 1 October 2025) describes the first residence visa granted under a 'Single Individual Investor Category' set up by regulations in Extraordinary Gazette No. 2360/24 of 27 November 2023: USD 100,000 for a 5-year visa and USD 200,000 for a 10-year visa, with the funds held in a Visa Programme Foreign Currency Account. That is the structure of the Investor Visa entry (`sri-lanka`). The Department has published no notice that Golden Paradise is closed or merged, and the merger rests on this single news report. If it is as reported, the figure that applies to a condominium purchase is the Investor Visa's USD 100,000 (5 years) or USD 200,000 (10 years), and the 'USD 200,000 for 10 years' on this page is the same top tier. Confirm with the Department of Immigration and Emigration before relying on a new application under the Golden Paradise name. SECOND AND MORE IMPORTANT POINT: as with the Investor Visa, the qualifying act is a DEPOSIT into a designated foreign currency account. A condominium is a permitted use of the deposited funds. Describing this as 'USD 200,000 for a condominium purchase' is materially misleading.
programmes.notes_zh: 可信度列為中等係因計畫現況未定，而非數字薄弱。數字均為一級來源。惟同一主管機關發出兩項相互衝突之官方訊號：黃金天堂頁面仍在線並仍載明 20 萬美元、10 年，而該局居留簽證索引現列 16 類，其中並無黃金天堂（所列為就業、投資、宗教、教育、非政府組織、登記印度人、前斯里蘭卡公民、家庭成員、外交、醫療、法院、我的夢想家園簽證計畫、居留賓客計畫、數位游牧、港口城市委員會、斯里蘭卡公民親屬）。黃金天堂網站頁尾仍顯示「2010-2022」。無一級來源，亦無兩份相互印證之二級來源說明其開放、關閉或已被取代；稱其已關閉之說法僅見於社群媒體留言。其現況未確認，投資人簽證類別似為現行途徑。斯里蘭卡媒體 Ada Derana（2025 年 10 月 1 日）報導，首張「單一個人投資者類別」居留簽證當日核發；該類別依 2023 年 11 月 27 日第 2360/24 號特別公報的規定設立：5 年期簽證 10 萬美元、10 年期簽證 20 萬美元，資金須存入簽證計畫外幣帳戶。此結構與投資人簽證條目（sri-lanka）相同。移民局未發布黃金天堂已關閉或已併入的公告，併入的說法僅見這一則新聞報導。若屬實，購買區分所有權房產適用的是投資人簽證的 10 萬美元（5 年）或 20 萬美元（10 年），本頁的「20 萬美元／10 年」即同一最高級距。以黃金天堂名義提出新申請前，請先向移民局確認。第二項且更重要：與投資人簽證相同，門檻行為係將款項存入指定外幣帳戶。區分所有權房產僅為該筆存款之許可用途。將其描述為「20 萬美元購買區分所有權房產」將造成實質誤導。

programmes.programme: Second Home limited-stay permit (rumah kedua)
programmes.programme_zh: 第二家園限期居留許可（rumah kedua）

min_value.basis: The PROPERTY limb. Permenkumham No. 22 of 2023 art.56(2)(b): a commitment statement to purchase property in the form of 'rumah susun atau apartemen' (a strata unit or apartment) in Indonesia worth at least US$1,000,000 or equivalent. The commitment must be satisfied within 90 days of ITAS issuance. Note the regulation says strata or apartment only — NOT landed houses — and contains no 'luxury' qualifier.

extra_tiers.label_en: The DEPOSIT limb, and the cheaper of the two. Permenkumham No. 22 of 2023 art.56(2)(a): a commitment statement to keep funds in an account in the applicant's OWN NAME at a STATE-OWNED bank worth at least US$130,000 or equivalent. The two limbs are alternatives ('atau'), so nobody needs to buy property to obtain this permit.

term.text_en: Maximum 5 years. Permenkumham No. 22 of 2023 art.105(10)(a): 'Orang Asing yang tinggal dalam rangka rumah kedua dengan jangka waktu paling lama 5 (lima) tahun.' The permit is a limited-stay permit (ITAS); the visa application doubles as the ITAS and re-entry permit application under art.33(6).
term.text_zh: 最長 5 年。《2023 年第 22 號法務暨人權部長條例》第 105 條第 10 項第 a 款：「以第二家園為由居留之外國人，期間最長 5 年。」該許可為限期居留許可（ITAS）；依第 33 條第 6 項，簽證申請同時作為 ITAS 及再入境許可之申請。

leads_to.text_en: Art. 120(1) of the regulation provides that a Second Home permit holder may, through a change of status, obtain KITAP permanent-residence status — listed alongside the investor golden-visa route (arts. 39/40) under the same article's scope.
leads_to.text_zh: 確立：條例第 120 條第 1 項明定，第二家園許可持有人可經身分轉換取得永久居留許可（KITAP）——與投資人黃金簽證（第 39／40 條）並列於同一條文之適用範圍內。

ownership_form.text_en: No Hak Milik (freehold over land) for foreigners — this is absolute. Permen ATR/BPN No. 18 of 2021 art.185: a foreigner holding valid immigration documents may own a landed house (rumah tapak) only on Hak Pakai — over State land, over Hak Milik by PPAT deed, or over Hak Pengelolaan — and may own a strata unit (rumah susun) built on Hak Pakai OR Hak Guna Bangunan land. Art.188(1): a strata unit owned by a foreigner on HP or HGB land is issued Hak Milik atas Satuan Rumah Susun (SHMSRS). Note a widening versus the older rule: since PP 18/2021 and Permen 18/2021, foreign strata ownership is permitted over HGB land as well as Hak Pakai. Art.186 limits landed houses to the luxury category, one plot per person or family, maximum 2,000 m2 (waivable by the Minister for exceptional economic impact), and limits strata to commercial rumah susun.
ownership_form.text_zh: 外國人不得取得土地之 Hak Milik（完全所有權），此為絕對限制。《2021 年農業及空間規劃部/國家土地局第 18 號部長條例》第 185 條：持有效移民文件之外國人，僅得以 Hak Pakai（使用權）持有有地住宅（rumah tapak）——包括國有地、經 PPAT 契據設定於 Hak Milik 之上者，或設定於 Hak Pengelolaan 之上者——並得持有建於 Hak Pakai 或 Hak Guna Bangunan（建物權）土地上之區分所有權單元（rumah susun）。第 188 條第 1 項：外國人持有之區分所有權單元，若坐落於 HP 或 HGB 土地，核發 SHMSRS（區分所有權完全所有權狀）。相較舊制已放寬：自第 18/2021 號政府條例及第 18/2021 號部長條例起，外國人之區分所有權亦得設定於 HGB 土地，而不限於 Hak Pakai。第 186 條並將有地住宅限於豪宅類別、每人或每一家庭 1 筆、最大 2,000 平方公尺（部長得就具重大經濟效益者豁免），區分所有權則限於商業型 rumah susun。

entry_tax.text_en: General information only, not visa-specific: three consistent tier-2 sources put Indonesia's BPHTB (land and building transfer duty) at 5% of transaction value (net of regional exemption thresholds), plus a separate 2.5% capital-gains withholding (PPh) — this is the general Indonesian tax regime, not a rule specific to this visa.
entry_tax.text_zh: 僅供一般參考，非簽證專屬：三方二級來源一致，印尼房產轉讓稅（BPHTB）為成交價之 5%（扣除各地區免稅額後），另有 2.5% 之資本利得預扣稅（PPh）——此為印尼一般稅制，非簽證專屬規則。

last_change.text_en: Governed by Permenkumham No. 22 of 2023, recorded on the BPK legal database as 'Berlaku' (in force), amended by Permenkumham No. 11 of 2024. Permen Imipas No. 3 of 2025 revoked only articles 43, 45, 52, 53, 54 and 55 — the diaspora provisions — and did NOT touch article 56.
last_change.text_zh: 依《2023 年第 22 號法務暨人權部長條例》，審計署法規資料庫記載其狀態為「有效」，並經《2024 年第 11 號部長條例》修正。《2025 年第 3 號移民暨矯正部長條例》僅廢止第 43、45、52、53、54、55 條（僑民條款），未觸及第 56 條。

programmes.notes_en: IDR 2,000,000,000 is the 2022 launch figure and does NOT stand in 2026; it is not the current figure. The current governing text states the thresholds in US DOLLARS, not rupiah: US$130,000 as a state-bank deposit, or US$1,000,000 in a strata unit or apartment. The IDR 2bn figure was simply that deposit amount re-denominated at roughly IDR 15,400/USD at the time. SECOND POINT: the permit is a maximum of FIVE years, not ten. THIRD: this programme has NOT been absorbed into the Golden Visa. 'Rumah kedua' (art.33(2)(j)) and the investor 5- and 10-year visas (art.33(2)(e)) are separate categories inside the same regulation and both are live. TWO CITATIONS DELIBERATELY NOT PUBLISHED: (1) Circular No. IMI-0740.GR.01.01 of 2022 could not be retrieved or confirmed from any source, and a tier-2 Indonesian source cites a DIFFERENT number (IMI-0820.GR.01.01 of 2022) for the same visa — neither is relied on, and the point is moot since the circular is superseded by Permenkumham 22/2023. (2) The index code 'E33' appears NOWHERE in Permenkumham 22/2023 or 11/2024 on a full-text search; index codes are set at Directorate-General level in the e-visa system and could not be sourced. The article number and the threshold are the operative references, not the index code. Work rights were not verified. FOR THE PER-PROVINCE MINIMUM PRICES, SEE THE FIELD BELOW: mechanism verified, figures NOT. Permen ATR/BPN No. 18 of 2021 art.187(2) provides that the price of the residential house 'ditetapkan dengan Keputusan Menteri' — is set by Ministerial Decision, not in the regulation itself. The operative instrument is Keputusan Menteri ATR/BPN No. 1241/SK-HK.02/IX/2022, whose existence and citation were confirmed from a scanned Directorate-General circular (Dirjen Penetapan Hak dan Pendaftaran Tanah, letter HR.01/1963/XI/2022 of 1 November 2022) issued to implement art.187(2). The per-province figures themselves could NOT be verified: the ATR/BPN JDIH portal was unreachable throughout and Kepmen 1241 is not indexed on peraturan.bpk.go.id. CRITICAL — the widely-circulated table giving DKI Jakarta landed IDR 10bn and Bali IDR 5bn comes from the Annex to Permen ATR/BPN No. 29 of 2016, which BPK records as REVOKED by Permen 18/2021. Those figures are not stated here.
programmes.notes_zh: 20 億印尼盾為 2022 年開辦時之數字，2026 年已不適用，並非現行數字。現行規範以美元而非印尼盾訂定門檻：國營銀行存款 13 萬美元，或區分所有權單元／公寓 100 萬美元。20 億印尼盾僅是當時以約 15,400 印尼盾兌 1 美元換算之同一存款金額。第二點：該許可最長為 5 年而非 10 年。第三點：本計畫並未被黃金簽證吸收。「第二家園」（第 33 條第 2 項第 j 款）與投資人 5 年及 10 年簽證（第 33 條第 2 項第 e 款）係同一條例下之不同類別，且均仍有效。兩項引註刻意不予刊載：(1) 2022 年第 IMI-0740.GR.01.01 號通函無法自任何來源取得或確認，且一份二級印尼來源就同一簽證引用不同文號（2022 年第 IMI-0820.GR.01.01 號）——兩者均不採用；且因該通函已為《2023 年第 22 號部長條例》所取代，此點已無實益。(2) 索引代碼「E33」經全文檢索並未出現於《2023 年第 22 號》或《2024 年第 11 號》部長條例；索引代碼係由總局於電子簽證系統層級設定，無法取得來源。條號與門檻才是依據，索引代碼不是。工作權未經查證。各省最低價格詳見下列欄位：機制已查證，數字未查證。《2021 年第 18 號部長條例》第 187 條第 2 項規定，住宅價格「由部長決定書訂定」，而非規定於該條例本身。實際依據為第 1241/SK-HK.02/IX/2022 號農業及空間規劃部長決定書，其存在與引註係自總局掃描版通函（土地權利設定及登記總局 2022 年 11 月 1 日 HR.01/1963/XI/2022 號函，為施行第 187 條第 2 項而發）確認。各省具體金額無法查證：農業及空間規劃部法規資訊入口全程無法連通，且第 1241 號部長決定書未收錄於 peraturan.bpk.go.id。關鍵提醒——流傳甚廣之「雅加達有地住宅 100 億印尼盾、峇里島 50 億印尼盾」表格，出自《2016 年第 29 號部長條例》附件，而審計署記載該條例已由第 18/2021 號條例廢止。該等數字不予採用。

companion_requirements.text_en: The property (USD 1,000,000) and the deposit (USD 130,000, held at a state bank in the applicant's own name) are ALTERNATIVE routes ('atau'/'or'), not cumulative. Where the property route is used, the promised purchase must be completed within 90 days of permit issuance.
companion_requirements.text_zh: 房產（100 萬美元）與存款（13 萬美元，須存於國營銀行、申請人本人名下）為互斥替代方案（『atau』），非必須疊加。走房產路徑者，須於核發後 90 天內完成承諾購買。

programmes.programme: Golden Visa — individual investor not establishing a company, 10-year limited-stay visa
programmes.programme_zh: 黃金簽證——不設立公司之個人投資者 10 年期限期居留簽證

min_value.basis: Permenkumham No. 22 of 2023 art.40(3)(d), as amended by Permenkumham No. 11 of 2024 (set 1 April 2024): for the 10-year limited-stay visa for an individual investor NOT establishing a company, 'pernyataan komitmen akan membeli rumah susun atau apartemen senilai harga paling sedikit US$1.000.000' — a commitment statement to purchase a strata unit or apartment worth at least US$1,000,000. Property is one of four alternatives; the other three are Indonesian government bonds, shares in an Indonesian listed company, or mutual funds, each at US$700,000.

extra_tiers.label_en: THE 5-YEAR TIER, WHICH HAS NO PROPERTY OPTION AT ALL. Permenkumham No. 22 of 2023 art.39(3), as amended: the 5-year tier for an individual investor not establishing a company may be satisfied ONLY by government bonds, shares in a listed Indonesian company, or mutual funds at US$350,000. There is no property limb. US$350,000 buys securities, not real estate.

For reference, the company-forming investor tiers, which are not property routes: US$2,500,000 for the 5-year visa and US$5,000,000 for the 10-year visa; for a corporate director or commissioner, US$25,000,000 (5-year) and US$50,000,000 (10-year).

leads_to.text_en: The same art. 120(1) mechanism as `indonesia` — investors under this golden-visa individual-investor track may also change status to KITAP permanent residence.
leads_to.text_zh: 確立：與 indonesia 條目相同之第 120 條第 1 項機制——本黃金簽證個人投資者檔之投資人，同樣可經身分轉換取得 KITAP 永久居留。

ownership_form.text_en: No Hak Milik (freehold over land) for foreigners — this is absolute. Permen ATR/BPN No. 18 of 2021 art.185: a foreigner holding valid immigration documents may own a landed house (rumah tapak) only on Hak Pakai — over State land, over Hak Milik by PPAT deed, or over Hak Pengelolaan — and may own a strata unit (rumah susun) built on Hak Pakai OR Hak Guna Bangunan land. Art.188(1): a strata unit owned by a foreigner on HP or HGB land is issued Hak Milik atas Satuan Rumah Susun (SHMSRS). Note a widening versus the older rule: since PP 18/2021 and Permen 18/2021, foreign strata ownership is permitted over HGB land as well as Hak Pakai. Art.186 limits landed houses to the luxury category, one plot per person or family, maximum 2,000 m2 (waivable by the Minister for exceptional economic impact), and limits strata to commercial rumah susun.
ownership_form.text_zh: 外國人不得取得土地之 Hak Milik（完全所有權），此為絕對限制。《2021 年農業及空間規劃部/國家土地局第 18 號部長條例》第 185 條：持有效移民文件之外國人，僅得以 Hak Pakai（使用權）持有有地住宅（rumah tapak）——包括國有地、經 PPAT 契據設定於 Hak Milik 之上者，或設定於 Hak Pengelolaan 之上者——並得持有建於 Hak Pakai 或 Hak Guna Bangunan（建物權）土地上之區分所有權單元（rumah susun）。第 188 條第 1 項：外國人持有之區分所有權單元，若坐落於 HP 或 HGB 土地，核發 SHMSRS（區分所有權完全所有權狀）。相較舊制已放寬：自第 18/2021 號政府條例及第 18/2021 號部長條例起，外國人之區分所有權亦得設定於 HGB 土地，而不限於 Hak Pakai。第 186 條並將有地住宅限於豪宅類別、每人或每一家庭 1 筆、最大 2,000 平方公尺（部長得就具重大經濟效益者豁免），區分所有權則限於商業型 rumah susun。

last_change.text_en: Permenkumham No. 11 of 2024, set 1 April 2024, amended the art.39 and art.40 thresholds; its preamble states the purpose as 'untuk melaksanakan penyesuaian kebijakan Golden Visa'. The instrument REMAINS IN FORCE: Permen Imipas No. 3 of 2025 revoked only articles 43, 45, 52, 53, 54 and 55, verbatim 'Ketentuan Pasal 43, Pasal 45, Pasal 52, Pasal 53, Pasal 54, dan Pasal 55... dicabut dan dinyatakan tidak berlaku'. Articles 39 and 40 are untouched. The Golden Visa instrument is Permenkumham 22/2023 as amended by Permenkumham 11/2024, not Permen Imipas 3/2025.
last_change.text_zh: 《2024 年第 11 號部長條例》於 2024 年 4 月 1 日訂定，修正第 39 條及第 40 條門檻；其前言載明目的為「執行黃金簽證政策之調整」。該規範仍屬有效：《2025 年第 3 號移民暨矯正部長條例》僅廢止第 43、45、52、53、54、55 條，原文為「第 43 條、第 45 條、第 52 條、第 53 條、第 54 條及第 55 條之規定……廢止並宣告失效」。第 39 條及第 40 條未受影響。黃金簽證的依據是《2023 年第 22 號部長條例》（經《2024 年第 11 號部長條例》修正），而非《2025 年第 3 號移民暨矯正部長條例》。

programmes.notes_en: The USD 1,000,000 figure is confirmed, but the tier structure sometimes cited is wrong. There are not two property sub-tiers at US$350,000 and US$1,000,000. Property appears ONLY at the 10-year tier and ONLY at US$1,000,000; the US$350,000 figure is the 5-year tier and buys securities — government bonds, listed shares or mutual funds — with no property limb whatsoever. The asset is also narrower than 'residential property': the text says 'rumah susun atau apartemen', a strata unit or apartment, which is consistent with the underlying land law, since a foreigner cannot hold Hak Milik over land. A CAVEAT WORTH PUBLISHING: each threshold article ends with a delegation providing that the amounts are 'ditetapkan oleh Direktur Jenderal setelah berkoordinasi dengan kementerian atau lembaga terkait' — set by the Director General after coordination with relevant ministries or agencies. The Director General can therefore change these figures by decree without amending the regulation. No such decree was found, but the amounts are not fixed at ministerial level and should be re-checked before reliance. INDEX CODE NOT PUBLISHED: the strings 'E28', 'E28C' and 'E33' appear nowhere in Permenkumham 22/2023 or 11/2024 on a full-text search. They are e-visa system index codes set at Directorate-General level; no .go.id page listing them could be reached. The threshold and the article number are the operative references, not the index code. NOTE THE CONVERGENCE: the Second Home permit's property limb and this Golden Visa property limb are both US$1,000,000 for a strata unit or apartment. What differs is the term — 5 years versus 10 — and the fact that Second Home offers a US$130,000 deposit alternative while this route's cheapest non-property alternative is US$700,000. Mechanism verified, figures NOT. Permen ATR/BPN No. 18 of 2021 art.187(2) provides that the price of the residential house 'ditetapkan dengan Keputusan Menteri' — is set by Ministerial Decision, not in the regulation itself. The operative instrument is Keputusan Menteri ATR/BPN No. 1241/SK-HK.02/IX/2022, whose existence and citation were confirmed from a scanned Directorate-General circular (Dirjen Penetapan Hak dan Pendaftaran Tanah, letter HR.01/1963/XI/2022 of 1 November 2022) issued to implement art.187(2). The per-province figures themselves could NOT be verified: the ATR/BPN JDIH portal was unreachable throughout and Kepmen 1241 is not indexed on peraturan.bpk.go.id. CRITICAL — the widely-circulated table giving DKI Jakarta landed IDR 10bn and Bali IDR 5bn comes from the Annex to Permen ATR/BPN No. 29 of 2016, which BPK records as REVOKED by Permen 18/2021. Those figures are not stated here.
programmes.notes_zh: 100 萬美元之數字已確認，惟坊間有時流傳之級距結構有誤。並不存在 35 萬美元與 100 萬美元兩個不動產子級距。不動產僅出現於 10 年期級距，且僅為 100 萬美元；35 萬美元係 5 年期級距，購買標的為有價證券——政府公債、上市股票或共同基金——完全無不動產選項。標的範圍亦較「住宅不動產」為窄：條文用語為「rumah susun atau apartemen」（區分所有權單元或公寓），此與土地法制一致，因外國人不得就土地取得 Hak Milik。一項值得刊載之保留：各門檻條文末均有授權規定，載明金額「由總局長於與相關部會或機構協調後訂定」。故總局長得以決定書變更該等金額而無須修正條例。未查得此類決定書，惟該等金額並非固定於部長層級，援用前應重新查核。索引代碼不予刊載：經全文檢索，「E28」、「E28C」、「E33」等字串並未出現於《2023 年第 22 號》或《2024 年第 11 號》部長條例。該等代碼係由總局於電子簽證系統層級設定，且無法連通任何列載該等代碼之 .go.id 頁面。門檻與條號才是依據，索引代碼不是。請注意其匯流：第二家園許可之不動產選項與本黃金簽證之不動產選項，同為區分所有權單元或公寓 100 萬美元。差異在於期限（5 年對 10 年），以及第二家園另提供 13 萬美元存款替代方案，而本途徑最低之非不動產替代方案為 70 萬美元。機制已查證，數字未查證。《2021 年第 18 號部長條例》第 187 條第 2 項規定，住宅價格「由部長決定書訂定」，而非規定於該條例本身。實際依據為第 1241/SK-HK.02/IX/2022 號農業及空間規劃部長決定書，其存在與引註係自總局掃描版通函（土地權利設定及登記總局 2022 年 11 月 1 日 HR.01/1963/XI/2022 號函，為施行第 187 條第 2 項而發）確認。各省具體金額無法查證：農業及空間規劃部法規資訊入口全程無法連通，且第 1241 號部長決定書未收錄於 peraturan.bpk.go.id。關鍵提醒——流傳甚廣之「雅加達有地住宅 100 億印尼盾、峇里島 50 億印尼盾」表格，出自《2016 年第 29 號部長條例》附件，而審計署記載該條例已由第 18/2021 號條例廢止。該等數字不予採用。

companion_requirements.text_en: Same land restriction as `indonesia`: foreigners cannot hold Hak Milik (full freehold) title. The 10-year tier's apartment option numerically overlaps with the Second Home route's property option (both USD 1,000,000) — they differ in permit duration and in the non-property alternative threshold (Second Home deposit USD 130,000 vs this track's securities option starting at USD 700,000).

min_value.basis: KRW 1,000,000,000 (10억 원), and it is now UNIFORM across every designated zone — the older split under which some zones took KRW 500 million no longer exists. The Korea Visa Portal describes the scheme as granting Residence (F-2) status, permitting free economic activity, to a foreigner who invests at or above the threshold amount in designated investment property (tourism and resort facilities) within an investment zone designated and published by the Minister of Justice, and granting Permanent Residence (F-5) status according to set criteria where the investment is maintained for five years.

extra_tiers.label_en: A DIFFERENT SCHEME, listed here only to keep the two apart — the Public Business Investment Immigration programme (공익사업 투자이민제), which is NOT a property route. Ministry of Justice: 'the standard investment amount is KRW 1.5 billion or more (for high-value investment immigration, KRW 3 billion or more)'. The general route gives F-2 then F-5 after five years maintained, and the F-5 survives repayment of the principal once the five years have elapsed; the high-value route gives F-5 directly, conditional on holding for five years, and the F-5 is cancelled if the money is returned before then.

term.text_en: F-2 residence status on investment, converting to F-5 permanent residence after five years of maintained investment.
term.text_zh: 投資後取得 F-2 居住資格，投資維持滿 5 年後轉換為 F-5 永久居留資格。

leads_to.text_en: F-5 permanent residence after five years, and this is a genuine PR outcome rather than a renewable long-stay permit — which makes this route materially different from most others covered here. The investment must be MAINTAINED: the portal notes that pledging the asset as security, having it seized, or borrowing against it breaks the maintenance condition.
leads_to.text_zh: 5 年後取得 F-5 永久居留，且此為真正之永久居留結果而非可續延之長期居留許可——此點使本途徑與本頁多數途徑有實質差異。投資須持續維持：入口網註明設定擔保、遭查封或以之借款，均將使「維持投資」之條件不成立。

ownership_form.text_en: Investment must be in designated investment property — tourism and resort facilities — inside a zone designated and published by the Minister of Justice. This is not general residential real estate: ordinary housing outside a designated zone does not qualify no matter its value.
ownership_form.text_zh: 投資標的須為法務部長官指定並公告之投資地區內之指定投資不動產（觀光休閒設施）。此非一般住宅不動產：指定地區以外之一般住宅，無論價值多高均不符合資格。

last_change.text_en: The threshold was raised from KRW 500 million to KRW 1 billion in 2023, at which point the scheme was also renamed from 부동산 투자이민제 (real-estate investment immigration) to 관광·휴양시설 투자이민제 (tourism and resort facility investment immigration). THE CONFLICT DEEPENED rather than resolved: a Jeju Provincial Government notice dated 17 February 2026 (via the Jeju Investment Portal) states the designation now extends to 31 DECEMBER 2027 — a THIRD version, distinct from both the original expiry dates (most regions lapsing 30 April or 19 May 2026) and an earlier report of 'extended to end of 2026'. Critically, this notice is issued by JEJU PROVINCIAL GOVERNMENT specifically, not a national Ministry of Justice announcement — the Ministry of Justice's own gazette (고시) text was still not located. Maintain the existing medium confidence and 'unresolved' framing; none of the three dates is adopted.
last_change.text_zh: 門檻於 2023 年由 5 億韓元調高至 10 億韓元，同時將制度名稱由「不動產投資移民制」更名為「觀光休閒設施投資移民制」。 查證讓衝突更嚴重而非解決：濟州道政府 2026 年 2 月 17 日公告（經濟州投資入口網轉載）稱地區指定延至 2027 年 12 月 31 日——第三個版本，與原始到期日（多數地區 2026 年 4 月 30 日或 5 月 19 日屆期）及先前『延至 2026 年底』之報導版本皆不同。關鍵是，該公告由濟州道地方政府發布，並非法務部全國性公告，法務部官報（고시）原文仍未能定位。維持既有之 medium 信心度與『未解決』框架，不採信三個日期中任何一個。

programmes.notes_en: THE THRESHOLD IS SOLID; WHETHER THE SCHEME IS CURRENTLY OPEN IS NOT. Confidence is medium for that reason alone. THE ZONE AND EXPIRY QUESTION COULD NOT BE RESOLVED, and both sides are on the record, so both are reported. VERSION 1 — the Ministry of Justice's own operational Korea Visa Portal, read on 1 August 2026, lists eleven designations all at KRW 1 billion with these operating periods: Gangwon Mangsang to 31 Dec 2025 (lapsed); Gangwon Yongpyong Tourism Complex to 31 MARCH 2030; Jeju to 30 Apr 2026; Busan Osiria East Busan Tourism Complex to 19 May 2026; Yeosu Hwayang to 31 Dec 2025 (lapsed); Busan Haeundae Tourism Resort to 19 May 2026; Incheon Songdo, Cheongna and Yeongjong each to 30 Apr 2026; Yeosu Gyeongdo Marine Tourism Complex to 30 Apr 2026; and Gangwon Pyeongchang Alpensia to 30 Apr 2026. On that data most designations had ALREADY EXPIRED on 30 April or 19 May 2026 — that is, before today. VERSION 2 — Jeju Province announced on 17 February 2026 that the scheme's operating period is extended from 30 April to 31 DECEMBER 2027 with investment amount and eligible assets unchanged, and Korean media report the extension came via a Ministry of Justice notice (고시) dated 8 February 2026 covering five regions in a single instrument: Jeju; Busan Osiria; Incheon Yeongjong, Songdo and Cheongna; Gangwon Pyeongchang and Donghae; and Jeonnam Yeosu Gyeongdo and Hwayang. THE TWO HAVE NOT BEEN RECONCILED. The underlying zone-designation notice could not be located: these designations are gazetted in the 관보 rather than posted on the Ministry's notice board, and the only related instrument on the national law information centre is the PROCEDURAL notice 법무부고시 제2023-237호 setting the designation procedure, not the zone list or dates. Note also that a blanket 'all zones extended to end-2027' framing is inconsistent with the portal's own entry for Yongpyong, which runs to 31 March 2030. ANYONE ACTING ON THIS MUST CONFIRM WITH THE RELEVANT IMMIGRATION OFFICE BEFORE COMMITTING CAPITAL. The KRW 500 million and KRW 300 million figures sometimes cited for the public-business route are wrong — that scheme runs at KRW 1.5 billion and KRW 3 billion, and it is a bond and public-fund route, not property.
programmes.notes_zh: 門檻確實，但制度目前是否開放並不確實。可信度列為中等即因於此。地區指定與到期問題無法解決，且雙方各有官方記載，故並陳。版本一——法務部自身之簽證入口網（2026 年 8 月 1 日讀取）列出 11 處指定地區，金額均為 10 億韓元，施行期間如下：江原望祥地區至 2025 年 12 月 31 日（已失效）；江原龍平觀光園區至 2030 年 3 月 31 日；濟州至 2026 年 4 月 30 日；釜山 Osiria 東釜山觀光園區至 2026 年 5 月 19 日；麗水華陽地區至 2025 年 12 月 31 日（已失效）；釜山海雲台觀光度假村至 2026 年 5 月 19 日；仁川松島、青蘿、永宗各至 2026 年 4 月 30 日；麗水鏡島海洋觀光園區至 2026 年 4 月 30 日；江原平昌 Alpensia 至 2026 年 4 月 30 日。依此資料，多數指定已於 2026 年 4 月 30 日或 5 月 19 日屆期，即在今日之前。版本二——濟州道於 2026 年 2 月 17 日公告，該制度施行期間自 4 月 30 日延長至 2027 年 12 月 31 日，投資金額與投資標的維持現行標準；韓國媒體並報導該延長係經法務部 2026 年 2 月 8 日之告示，以單一文件涵蓋五個地區：濟州；釜山 Osiria；仁川永宗、松島、青蘿；江原平昌、東海；全南麗水鏡島、華陽。兩者尚未調和。相關地區指定告示無法查得：該等指定係刊載於官報而非公告於部會公告欄，而國家法令資訊中心上唯一相關文件為程序性之法務部告示第 2023-237 號，僅規定指定程序，未載地區清單或期限。另請注意，「所有地區一律延至 2027 年底」之表述與入口網自身之龍平條目（至 2030 年 3 月 31 日）並不一致。任何據此行動者，投入資金前必須向主管出入境暨外國人事務廳確認。坊間有時流傳之公益事業途徑 5 億韓元與 3 億韓元均為錯誤——該制度金額為 15 億韓元與 30 億韓元，且屬公債及公益基金途徑，非不動產。

companion_requirements.text_en: Established: the investment must be in a Ministry-designated tourism/leisure facility area, NOT ordinary housing. During the maintenance period, encumbering (mortgaging), having the investment seized, or borrowing against it will invalidate the 'maintained investment' condition required for F-5 conversion.
companion_requirements.text_zh: 確立：投資標的須為法務部指定地區內之指定觀光休閒設施，非一般住宅。投資期間設定擔保、遭查封或以之借款，皆會使 F-5 轉換所需之『維持投資』條件失效。

programmes.programme: Golden Visa (property / real-estate investor route)
programmes.programme_zh: 黃金簽證（房產投資人路徑）

min_value.basis: Purchase value of the property at the time of purchase; property must be wholly owned by the applicant, and one or more properties may be combined to reach the threshold

term.text_en: DISAGREEMENT BETWEEN TWO TIER-1 SOURCES. Dubai Land Department, which operates the application channel, states a '10-years renewable residence permit' and publishes a fee schedule for a 10-year permit (AED 9,884.75 total). ICP, the federal immigration authority, publishes a category table reading 'Investors in Public Investments or Real Estate — 10 years (public investments) / 5 years (real estate investments)'; the identical table is reproduced on the u.ae government portal (updated 28 July 2026, sourced to ICP). Both readings are cited below; no single figure is stated. Re-verified 2026-08-02: DLD still states 'a 10-years renewable residence permit' (page footer: Last Update 13 July 2026); ICP still states '5 years (real estate investments)' (footer 23 March 2026); u.ae still states '5 years (real estate investments)' (footer 28 July 2026). This is the SECOND independent check reaching the same conflicting result — not an unchecked gap.
term.text_zh: 兩個一級來源互相矛盾。負責受理申請的杜拜土地局（DLD）寫「10 年可續期居留許可」，並按 10 年許可收費（合計 AED 9,884.75）。聯邦身分公民海關與港口安全總局（ICP）的類別表則寫「公共投資或房地產投資人——公共投資 10 年／房地產投資 5 年」，u.ae 政府入口網站（2026 年 7 月 28 日更新，註明來源為 ICP）沿用同一張表。兩種說法並列，不給出單一數字。 2026-08-02 已重新查證：DLD 仍寫「10 年可續期居留許可」（頁尾 Last Update：2026 年 7 月 13 日）；ICP 仍寫「5 年（不動產投資）」（頁尾 2026 年 3 月 23 日）；u.ae 仍寫「5 年（不動產投資）」（頁尾 2026 年 7 月 28 日）。此為第二次獨立查證得到相同矛盾結果——非未查缺口。

stay.text_en: Could not be verified from any UAE government source consulted. ICP lists 'long-term residency without the need for a sponsor' among the benefits and u.ae lists 'the ability to stay outside the UAE for more than the usual period of six months needed to keep their residence visa valid', but neither states a numeric minimum-stay rule, and neither states that there is none. The widely repeated claim of 'no minimum stay' was not found in any official text.
stay.text_zh: 在所查閱的任何阿聯政府來源中都無法查證。ICP 列出的權益包括「無需擔保人的長期居留」，u.ae 列出「可在境外停留超過通常維持居留效力所需的六個月上限」，但兩者都未寫出具體的最低居留天數規則，也都沒有明說不存在此規則。廣為流傳的「無最低居留要求」說法，在官方文本中查無依據。

leads_to.text_en: No naturalisation pathway is attached to the Golden Visa in any source consulted. UAE citizenship is granted only under a separate discretionary nomination regime and is not an entitlement arising from this visa. Not verified further.
leads_to.text_zh: 所查來源中，黃金簽證本身不附帶入籍途徑。阿聯國籍另循一套裁量性提名制度授予，並非本簽證衍生的權利。未進一步查證。

ownership_form.text_en: Freehold, but only within designated areas: foreign nationals may hold freehold title only in areas designated for non-GCC ownership in each emirate. This general rule was NOT verified against a government source; what IS tier-1 verified is that DLD requires 'a certificate of ownership of the real estate from the competent authority' (an e-Certificate of Title / title deed) and that the property be wholly owned by the applicant. Treat the designated-areas point as unverified.
ownership_form.text_zh: 自由保有產權，但僅限指定區域：外籍人士僅能在各酋長國劃定供非海合會國民持有的區域內取得自由保有產權。此一般性規則未對照政府來源查證；經一級來源確認的是 DLD 要求提交「主管機關出具的不動產所有權證明」（產權電子證書／地契），且物業須由申請人完全持有。指定區域一節請視為未查證。

offplan.text_en: NOT CONFIRMED — and the available official evidence points the other way. The Dubai Land Department service page requires an 'e-Certificate of Title / Title deed' and, where the property is mortgaged, 'a bank letter indicating 2 million AED paid amount as a proof'. That wording is byte-identical in the Internet Archive captures of 7 January 2026 and 8 July 2026 — i.e. the competent authority's own published conditions did not change across the period in which a February-2026 liberalisation is said to have occurred. See notes for the full finding.
offplan.text_zh: 未獲證實——且現有官方證據指向相反方向。杜拜土地局服務頁要求提交「產權電子證書／地契」，若物業有貸款，則須提交「載明已付款 200 萬迪拉姆的銀行證明函」。此段文字在網際網路檔案館 2026 年 1 月 7 日與 2026 年 7 月 8 日兩份快照中逐字相同——亦即在所謂 2026 年 2 月放寬的期間前後，主管機關自己公布的條件並未改動。完整結論見備註。

mortgage.text_en: TIER-1-AGAINST-TIER-1 CONFLICT — both sides are shown and neither is picked: the ICP official document checklist for the golden-visa real-estate category requires 'A letter from the Real Estate Registration Department proving ownership of one or more properties valued at >= AED 2 million (WITHOUT LOANS)' — i.e. ICP's own text requires the property to be mortgage-free. This directly CONTRADICTS the Dubai Land Department, which explicitly accepts a mortgaged property: 'The property may be mortgaged, and a no-objection bank letter...' Both are official tier-1 government sources, independently re-fetched twice (direct connection and via proxy) returning the same text each time — not a mis-read. This sits alongside the existing 10-year (DLD) vs 5-year (ICP/u.ae) term conflict as a second, independent instance of one official UAE source disagreeing with another on the same programme. A reader financing the purchase with a mortgage will get a different answer depending on which government agency's page they read.
mortgage.text_zh: 第一級對第一級之矛盾，新發現——兩邊都要寫，不選一邊：ICP 官網黃金簽證房產類別之文件清單要求「不動產登記局出具之函件，證明持有一項或多項總值不低於 200 萬迪拉姆之物業（無貸款）」——即 ICP 官方文字要求物業完全無貸款。此與杜拜土地局（DLD）直接衝突，DLD 明文接受抵押物件：「物業得設定抵押，並附銀行無異議函……」兩者皆為第一級政府來源，獨立兩次重新擷取（直連＋代理），每次結果相同——非誤讀。此與既有之 10 年（DLD）vs 5 年（ICP／u.ae）效期矛盾並列，是另一組獨立的『阿聯官方來源彼此對不上』案例。以貸款購屋申請之讀者，會因查閱的政府機關不同而得到不同答案。

dependants.text_en: Spouse, children and parents may be sponsored (DLD). ICP additionally lists the ability to issue residency for spouse and children among the Golden Visa benefits. Family applications require a no-objection letter from the father where applicable.
dependants.text_zh: 可為配偶、子女與父母申請依親（DLD）。ICP 另將為配偶與子女核發居留列為黃金簽證權益之一。依親申請在適用情形下須附父親出具的無異議函。

entry_tax.text_en: Not established. DLD publishes only the visa service fee (AED 9,884.75 in total for the 10-year permit, covering medical examination, Emirates ID, residency confirmation, departmental and administrative charges). Dubai's 4% property transfer fee was not verified and is deliberately omitted rather than asserted.
entry_tax.text_zh: 未能確立。DLD 僅公布簽證服務費（10 年許可合計 AED 9,884.75，含體檢、Emirates ID、居留確認、部門與行政規費）。杜拜 4% 產權過戶費未查證，故刻意略去而不逕行宣稱。

last_change.text_en: The governing instrument is Cabinet Resolution No. 65 of 2022 issuing the Executive Regulation of Federal Decree-Law No. 29 of 2021 on entry and residence of foreigners: issued 12 July 2022, published in Official Gazette No. 731 of 15 July 2022, in force 3 October 2022 — which matches the reported 'October 2022' change. Its Article 77 provides that the Golden Residence Permit is governed by the Annex to the resolution. IMPORTANT CAVEAT: the Annex is published only as a PDF that could not be text-extracted, so the AED 2,000,000 figure itself could NOT be traced into the gazetted text; it is sourced to ICP and DLD instead. The official legislation portal records the resolution as last updated 27 November 2025 with five recorded amendments — no 2026 amendment is listed. The claim that the threshold was cut from AED 10,000,000 was not independently verified and is not published.
last_change.text_zh: 母法為 2022 年第 65 號內閣決議，發布 2021 年第 29 號聯邦法令（外國人入境與居留）之施行細則：2022 年 7 月 12 日發布，刊登於 2022 年 7 月 15 日第 731 號官方公報，2022 年 10 月 3 日生效——與報導的「2022 年 10 月」改動時點吻合。其第 77 條規定黃金居留許可適用該決議之附件。重要保留：該附件僅以 PDF 形式公布且無法擷取文字，因此 AED 2,000,000 這個數字本身無法回溯到公報文本，改以 ICP 與 DLD 為來源。官方法規入口網站記載該決議最後更新日為 2025 年 11 月 27 日，共五次修正，未列任何 2026 年修正。門檻由 AED 10,000,000 調降的說法未獨立查證，故不予刊登。

short.term_en: Two tier-1 sources disagree: DLD says 10 yrs, ICP says 5
short.term_zh: 兩筆第一級來源不一致：杜拜土地部稱 10 年，聯邦身分安全與海關港口總局稱 5 年
short.stay_en: Could not be verified from any UAE government source
short.stay_zh: 未能自任何阿聯政府來源查證
short.outcome_en: No naturalisation pathway is attached in any source consulted
short.outcome_zh: 所查來源均未附任何歸化途徑
short.own_en: Wholly owned by the applicant; properties may be combined; the designated-areas rule is unverified
short.own_zh: 須由申請人完全持有，得合併多筆物件；指定區域規則無公開資料

programmes.notes_en: THE FEBRUARY-2026 QUESTION — ANSWER: NOT CONFIRMED, with affirmative contrary evidence. (1) No official UAE text was located that removes a 50%-paid requirement in February 2026. (2) No official UAE text was located that ever imposed a 50%-paid requirement in the first place — the '50% rule' appears nowhere in ICP, u.ae, DLD or the Executive Regulation. (3) The official legislation portal shows Cabinet Resolution 65/2022 last updated 27 November 2025 with five amendments and no 2026 amendment. (4) Decisively: the Dubai Land Department 'Golden Visa application - Investor' service page — the actual application channel, and the competent authority for valuation — carries word-for-word identical text in the Internet Archive captures of 7 January 2026 (before) and 8 July 2026 (after), including the requirement that a mortgaged property be evidenced by 'a bank letter indicating 2 million AED paid amount as a proof' and service terms requiring the bank NOC to indicate 'the paid amount and the balance'. If a February-2026 liberalisation had taken effect, DLD's own conditions page did not reflect it five months later. (5) Every source asserting the change is a tier-3 agency or marketing blog, and they do not agree with each other on the date (20 February vs 22 February 2026). The change is therefore unconfirmed; DLD still requires the bank letter to evidence the paid amount. THE APRIL-2026 QUESTION: not verified at all — no source of any tier was located for an April 2026 decision. What can be said at tier 1 is that Article 53 of the Executive Regulation (the separate 'Foreigner Real Estate Owner Residence Permit', a different and shorter permit from the Golden Visa) sets NO minimum property value in its current published text: it requires only that the property be fully built, not vacant land, wholly owned, habitable, evidenced by a certificate of ownership, and that the applicant have monthly income of at least AED 10,000 or prove financial solvency. So no AED 750,000 floor exists in the current regulation — but the portal's last-update date of 27 November 2025 means this absence predates April 2026 and does not evidence an April 2026 change. LAPSE ON SALE: not verified. No government source consulted states that the visa lapses if the qualifying asset is sold; this commonly repeated point is therefore omitted rather than asserted. WORK RIGHTS: ICP states holders enjoy 'freedom to live, work, study, and invest in the UAE' — tier 1, src 0.
programmes.notes_zh: 2026 年 2 月的問題——答案：未獲證實，且有反向的正面證據。（1）未能定位到任何在 2026 年 2 月取消「已付 50%」要求的阿聯官方文本。（2）也未能定位到任何曾經課予「已付 50%」要求的阿聯官方文本——ICP、u.ae、DLD 與施行細則中都查無「50% 規則」。（3）官方法規入口網站顯示 2022 年第 65 號內閣決議最後更新於 2025 年 11 月 27 日，共五次修正，無 2026 年修正。（4）關鍵證據：杜拜土地局「黃金簽證申請——投資人」服務頁（實際受理管道，也是估值主管機關）在網際網路檔案館 2026 年 1 月 7 日（前）與 2026 年 7 月 8 日（後）兩份快照中逐字相同，包含有貸款物業須以「載明已付款 200 萬迪拉姆的銀行證明函」佐證，以及服務條款要求銀行無異議函載明「已付金額與餘額」。若 2026 年 2 月的放寬確已生效，DLD 自家的條件頁在五個月後仍未反映。（5）所有主張此變動的來源皆為三級仲介或行銷部落格，且彼此連日期都不一致（2 月 20 日對 2 月 22 日）。因此該變動未獲證實；DLD 迄今仍要求以銀行函佐證已付金額。2026 年 4 月的問題：完全未獲證實——任何層級的來源都未能定位到 2026 年 4 月的決定。可在一級來源層次陳述的是：施行細則第 53 條（另一項「外籍不動產所有權人居留許可」，與黃金簽證不同且期限較短）在現行公布文本中並未設定任何最低物業價值，僅要求物業已完工、非空地、完全持有、可居住、附所有權證明，且申請人月收入不低於 AED 10,000 或能證明財務能力。因此現行法規中不存在 AED 750,000 門檻——但入口網站最後更新日為 2025 年 11 月 27 日，代表此一「不存在」早於 2026 年 4 月，不能用來佐證 2026 年 4 月有任何改動。出售資產後失效：未獲證實。所查政府來源皆未說明出售合格資產後簽證即失效，故此一常見說法予以略去而不逕行宣稱。工作權：ICP 載明持有人享有「在阿聯居住、工作、就學與投資的自由」——一級來源，src 0。

companion_requirements.text_en: Beyond the AED 2,000,000 property: a medical examination fee of AED 700 is included within the total AED 9,884.75 fee package on the DLD page; dependants (especially parents) require separate health-insurance documentation. No minimum income test, fixed deposit, or extra criminal-record check was found. See `mortgage` for a major tier-1-vs-tier-1 conflict on whether the property may be mortgaged.
companion_requirements.text_zh: 除 AED 2,000,000 房產外，DLD 頁面顯示體檢費 AED 700（含在總費用 AED 9,884.75 內）；若為家屬（尤其父母）申請依親則需另附健康保險文件。未發現最低收入測試、固定存款、額外犯罪紀錄查核要求。物業是否可設定抵押，見 mortgage 欄位之重大第一級對第一級矛盾。

programmes.programme: Foreigner Real Estate Owner Residence Permit (Article 53, Executive Regulation) — separate from the Golden Visa
programmes.programme_zh: 外籍不動產所有權人居留許可（施行細則第 53 條）——與黃金簽證不同
programmes.label_zh: 不動產業主居留許可（第 53 條）

min_value.basis: NO minimum property value is stated in the current published text of Article 53. The only monetary condition is on the applicant, not the asset: monthly income of at least AED 10,000, or proof of financial solvency for the duration of stay.

term.text_en: Not established — actively checked across three sources (art. 53 full text, GDRFA page, ICP mirror page), none states a fixed validity period. The ONE clue found: GDRFA's fee clause ('an extra AED 100/year after 2 years of residence') implies the base period MIGHT be 2 years, but this is inferred from a fee structure, not a stated term — '2 years' cannot be stated as a fact; this remains not_established.
term.text_zh: 未查證——查了三個來源（第 53 條全文、GDRFA 頁、ICP 鏡像頁），均未載明固定年限。唯一線索：GDRFA 費用條款「居留超過 2 年後每年加收 AED 100」暗示基礎期限可能是 2 年，惟此為從收費結構推論，非明文年限聲明——不能把『2 年』當作事實；此項維持未查證。

stay.text_en: Not verified. Actively checked across three sources (art. 53 full text, GDRFA page, ICP mirror page): none mentions a minimum stay day-count or a naturalisation/permanent-residence pathway. Genuinely checked and silent across all three, not merely unchecked.
stay.text_zh: 未查證。 查了三個來源（第 53 條全文、GDRFA 頁、ICP 鏡像頁）：均完全未提及最低居留天數或永居／入籍路徑。三處皆確實查過且沉默，非僅未查。

leads_to.text_en: Not verified. Actively checked across three sources (art. 53 full text, GDRFA page, ICP mirror page): none mentions a minimum stay day-count or a naturalisation/permanent-residence pathway. Genuinely checked and silent across all three, not merely unchecked.
leads_to.text_zh: 未查證。 查了三個來源（第 53 條全文、GDRFA 頁、ICP 鏡像頁）：均完全未提及最低居留天數或永居／入籍路徑。三處皆確實查過且沉默，非僅未查。

ownership_form.text_en: The property must be wholly owned by the applicant and evidenced by 'a certificate of ownership of the Real Estate from the Competent Authority in the Real Estate registration in the State'. Vacant land does not qualify.
ownership_form.text_zh: 物業須由申請人完全持有，並以「國內不動產登記主管機關出具的所有權證明」佐證。空地不符資格。

offplan.text_en: Excluded by the text: 'The Real Estate shall be fully built and does not include vacant land owners' and 'The Real Estate shall be habitable'.

mortgage.text_en: Article 53 is silent on mortgages. (By contrast Article 52(3), on the retiree permit, expressly accepts a mortgaged title deed provided at least AED 1,000,000 of value has been released from the mortgage.) No inference is drawn.
mortgage.text_zh: 第 53 條對抵押未置一詞。（相對地，關於退休人士許可的第 52 條第 3 款明文接受設有抵押的地契，但須已清償至少 AED 1,000,000 的抵押價值。）此處不作推論。

dependants.text_en: Not established — checked against GDRFA and ICP pages: 'family' appears as a SEPARATE service category on both sites' structure, hinting that this permit itself may not automatically include dependants, but this inference has NOT been confirmed against the verbatim text of art. 53 or a dedicated family clause — too weak to upgrade the field. Remains not_established.
dependants.text_zh: 未查證——查 GDRFA 與 ICP 頁面：兩站結構上『家屬』皆為獨立於本許可之外的另一服務類別，暗示第 53 條許可本身可能不自動含依親，惟此判讀未經第 53 條原文或專屬家庭條款逐字覆核，證據強度不足以升級。維持未查證。

entry_tax.text_en: PARTIALLY ESTABLISHED, but with a tier-1-vs-tier-1 reconciliation problem: GDRFA Dubai's service page (footer 'Website last updated on 02/08/2026') lists a fee breakdown — residence-permit fee AED 200 + Knowledge Dirham AED 10 + Innovation Dirham AED 10 + in-country processing fee AED 500 + delivery fee AED 20, plus an extra AED 100/year after 2 years of residence. ICP's mirror service page gives a DIFFERENT breakdown — application AED 100 + annual issuance AED 100 + smart-services fee AED 100. Both are official tier-1 sources and they do not reconcile. No single figure is stated: the fee schedule is found at two tier-1 sources but the breakdowns conflict, pending reconciliation.
entry_tax.text_zh: 部分確立，惟有第一級對第一級的對帳問題：GDRFA 杜拜服務頁（頁尾『網站最後更新於 02/08/2026』）費用清單為居留許可費 AED 200＋Knowledge Dirham AED 10＋Innovation Dirham AED 10＋境內受理費 AED 500＋送達費 AED 20，另有居留滿 2 年後每年加收 AED 100。ICP 鏡像服務頁費用拆項不同——申請費 AED 100＋年度核發 AED 100＋智慧服務費 AED 100。兩者皆為官方第一級來源，惟彼此對不上。不給出單一數字：兩個第一級來源皆有費用表，惟拆項互相衝突，待對帳。
