programmes.notes_en: Included because it is the instrument the reported 'AED 750,000 two-year investor visa' would sit in, and because its full conditions are readable at tier 1 while the Golden Visa Annex is not. The full Article 53 text is: the permit issues without a guarantor/host party where (1) the real estate is fully built and does not include vacant land owners; (2) a certificate of ownership from the competent registration authority is submitted; (3) the real estate is wholly owned by the applicant; (4) the real estate is habitable; (5) the applicant has monthly income of not less than AED 10,000 or its foreign-currency equivalent, or proves financial solvency throughout his stay. Confidence is medium only because term and stay could not be established, not because the conditions are doubtful — those are verbatim from the gazetted regulation.
programmes.notes_zh: 納入的理由：報導中的「AED 750,000 兩年投資人簽證」若存在，法源即在此條；且此條的完整條件在一級來源可讀，而黃金簽證附件不可讀。第 53 條全文為：在無擔保人／接待方的情況下核發居留許可，須符合（1）不動產已完工且不包含空地所有權人；（2）提交登記主管機關出具的所有權證明；（3）不動產由申請人完全持有；（4）不動產適於居住；（5）申請人月收入不低於 AED 10,000 或等值外幣，或能證明在境內停留期間的財務能力。信心度僅列為 medium，是因為期限與居留要求無法確立，而非條件本身有疑——條件係逐字取自公報法規。

companion_requirements.text_en: Beyond a fully-owned, completed, habitable property, the only substantive condition is the applicant's own monthly income of at least AED 10,000 (or proof of financial capacity), plus modest administrative fees falling somewhere in the AED 200-500 range (the two tier-1 sources disagree on the exact breakdown — see `entry_tax`). No health insurance, medical exam, criminal-record check, or minimum holding period was found in art. 53's text, the GDRFA page, or the ICP mirror page — all three were checked directly.
companion_requirements.text_zh: 除完全持有、已完工、可居住的房產外，唯一實質條件是申請人本人月收入須達 AED 10,000 以上（或證明財務能力），加上落在 AED 200–500 區間之少量行政規費（兩個第一級來源對拆項意見不一，見 entry_tax）。第 53 條全文、GDRFA 頁、ICP 鏡像頁三處皆已直接查核，均未見健康保險、體檢、犯罪紀錄查核或最低持有期限要求。

entry_tax.text_en: Government fees, not property transfer tax: due diligence US$10,000 (main applicant); post-approval application fee US$25,000 (main applicant). The CIU also refers to 'purchase costs (mainly compulsory insurance fund contributions and conveyance fees)' without quantifying them.
entry_tax.text_zh: 此處為政府規費而非產權移轉稅：盡職調查費 US$10,000（主申請人）；核准後申請費 US$25,000（主申請人）。CIU 另提及「購置成本（主要為強制保險基金提撥與過戶費）」，但未列出金額。

last_change.text_en: The five-country Memorandum of Agreement on Citizenship by Investment Programmes is real — signed 20 March 2024 under the OECS framework, in force 1 July 2024, setting USD 200,000 as a FLOOR (not a mandatory uniform price; member states may still set a higher threshold but may not discount below it). St Kitts' current price already sits above this floor, so the memorandum has no binding effect on its figure. Separately, the current USD 325,000/600,000 pricing took effect on 25 October 2024 under S.R.O. No. 43 of 2024 (down from a prior USD 400,000/800,000 tier), as reported by IMI Daily on 30 October 2024.
last_change.text_zh: 確立：2024 年五國備忘錄真實存在，正式名稱《投資入籍計畫協議備忘錄》，2024/3/20 於 OECS 架構下簽署，2024/7/1 生效，設定 20 萬美元為地板值（非強制統一價，會員國仍可訂更高門檻，但不得打折至地板值以下）。聖克里斯多福現價已高於此地板值，備忘錄對其數字無拘束力。另，現行 32.5 萬／60 萬美元定價自 2024 年 10 月 25 日起生效（依 2024 年第 43 號法定規則與命令，此前為 40 萬／80 萬美元一檔），IMI Daily 於 2024 年 10 月 30 日報導。

companion_requirements.text_en: Within the CBI system: due diligence fees (main applicant US$10,000 + each dependant aged 16+ US$7,500) and post-approval application fees (main applicant US$25,000 + spouse US$15,000 + other dependants US$10,000-15,000/person by age); a clean criminal record; no bankruptcy in the past 10 years; nationals of Afghanistan, Belarus, Iran, Iraq, North Korea and Russia are excluded from applying. SEPARATELY, for a buyer using the ORDINARY (non-CBI) purchase route, St Kitts requires a distinct Alien Landholding License at 10% of the purchase price (floor USD 50,000, cap USD 200,000), roughly 3 months to process — CBI-approved-development purchasers are EXEMPT from this licence. A reader who assumes the threshold price alone suffices via the ordinary route, without going through CBI, would be caught by this fee.
companion_requirements.text_zh: CBI 體系內部：盡職調查費（主申請人 US$10,000＋每位 16 歲以上依親人 US$7,500）與核准後申請費（主申請人 US$25,000＋配偶 US$15,000＋其他依親人依年齡 US$10,000–15,000／人）；無犯罪紀錄；10 年內無破產紀錄；排除阿富汗、白俄羅斯、伊朗、伊拉克、北韓、俄羅斯國籍申請人。另外，若走一般（非 CBI）購房途徑，聖克里斯多福另需獨立之外國人土地持有執照，費率為購價 10%（下限 US$50,000、上限 US$200,000），約 3 個月處理期——經 CBI 核准建案購買者豁免此執照。若讀者誤以為不透過 CBI、僅達門檻價即可走一般購房程序，會被課到這筆費用。

stay.text_en: With a live legislative change in progress: the general CBI rule requires a cumulative minimum of 5 days' physical presence within 5 years of citizenship being granted. SIGNIFICANT TIMING CAVEAT: on 14 July 2026 Prime Minister Gaston Browne introduced amendment legislation to extend this to 30 days (paired with the new regional regulator ECCIRA), but as of this verification date (2 August 2026) there is no confirmation the bill has passed third reading or entered into force. Currently 5 days; an amendment bill to extend to 30 days has been introduced but is not confirmed in force — neither 5 nor 30 is settled.
stay.text_zh: 部分確立，且有進行中之立法變動：CBI 一般規則要求公民身分取得後 5 年內累計在境內停留至少 5 天。重大時效性提醒：2026/7/14 Gaston Browne 總理已向國會提出修法草案，擬將此天數延長為 30 天（配合新成立之區域監理機構 ECCIRA），惟截至查證日期（2026-08-02）尚未見官方確認三讀通過或生效。現行 5 天，延長至 30 天之修法草案已提出但尚未確認生效——5 天與 30 天均不視為定案。

entry_tax.text_en: Government processing fees: US$10,000 single applicant; US$20,000 family of up to four. Property transfer taxes are not established. For the general (non-scheme) property-transfer stamp duty: multiple attempts to reach the Antigua Inland Revenue Department (ird.gov.ag) failed with SSL certificate errors and 404s. Genuinely attempted and failed, not merely 'not covered'.
entry_tax.text_zh: 政府處理費：單一申請人 US$10,000；四人以下家庭 US$20,000。產權移轉稅未涵蓋。 重查一般（非本方案）不動產過戶印花稅：多次嘗試連接安地卡稅務局（ird.gov.ag）均遇 SSL 憑證錯誤與 404。確實已嘗試而失敗，非單純『未涵蓋』。

companion_requirements.text_en: Within the CBI system: processing fees (single applicant US$10,000; family of up to four US$20,000, plus US$10,000 per additional dependant for families of five or more); a police clearance certificate (required for any country of residence exceeding 6 months); a medical examination including an HIV test (valid within 90 days). companion_requirements.text_zh: CBI 體系內部：處理費（單身申請人 US$10,000；四人以下家庭 US$20,000，五人以上每多一人再加 US$10,000）；無犯罪紀錄證明（居住滿 6 個月以上之國家皆須開立）；醫療檢查含 HIV 檢測（90 天內有效）。另外，走一般（非 CBI）購房途徑者，需依《非公民土地持有（修正）法》2020 年版取得「非公民土地持有執照」，費率坊間普遍引用為購價 5%（少數來源稱 7%，未解決）——經 CBI 核准建案購買者豁免此執照。

dependants.text_en: Government fees run from US$75,000 for the main applicant alone to US$100,000 for the main applicant plus up to three dependants, plus US$25,000-US$40,000 per additional dependant depending on age. These figures are not a mix-up with the donation option: confirmed correct via two independent official pages, which keep the two fee structures clearly separate.
dependants.text_zh: 政府規費自主申請人單獨申請的 US$75,000，至主申請人加最多三名依親人的 US$100,000，另每名額外依親人依年齡加收 US$25,000～US$40,000。 針對先前『是否與捐贈選項混淆』之疑慮重點覆核：經兩個獨立官方頁面確認正確，兩者將不動產費表與經濟多元化基金（捐贈）費表完全分開列示——非誤植，非混用。

entry_tax.text_en: Government fees as above. Property transfer taxes are not established.
entry_tax.text_zh: 政府規費如上。產權移轉稅未涵蓋。

last_change.text_en: Same five-country Memorandum of Agreement (signed 20 March 2024, in force 1 July 2024) — Dominica's USD 200,000 threshold sits EXACTLY at the memorandum's floor value, i.e. fully consistent with it.
last_change.text_zh: 確立：同一份五國備忘錄（2024/3/20 簽署，2024/7/1 生效）——多米尼克現價 20 萬美元恰好落在備忘錄之地板值上，與備忘錄完全吻合。

short.term_en: Citizenship; no term
short.term_zh: 公民身分，無期限
short.stay_en: Not stated on the page consulted
short.outcome_en: Citizenship directly
short.outcome_zh: 直接取得公民身分
short.own_en: Title in a pre-approved project; 3-yr hold, 5 if the buyer is also an applicant
short.own_zh: 預核准建案內之產權；持有 3 年，若後手同為申請人則為 5 年

programmes.notes_en: Processing time is not published on the page consulted and is deliberately omitted.
programmes.notes_zh: 所查頁面未公布處理時程，故刻意略去。

sources.publisher: Dominica Citizenship by Investment Unit
Dominica Citizenship by Investment Unit — FAQs
OECS Press Room — Memorandum of Agreement on Citizenship by Investment Programmes
ArabMLS (Dominica real-estate reference, older material)

companion_requirements.text_en: Government fees (main applicant alone US$75,000; main applicant plus up to 3 dependants US$100,000; plus US$25,000-40,000 per additional dependant by age); clean criminal record; good character; a health certificate (excluding HIV/AIDS, tuberculosis and similar conditions); proof of source of funds. SEPARATELY, a buyer using the ORDINARY (non-CBI) purchase route needs an Alien Landholding License at 10% of the land value or purchase price, whichever is higher, for parcels exceeding 1 acre (residential) or 3 acres (commercial) — CBI applicants are EXEMPT. The rate for this licence is sourced to older material (some dating to 2008) and is flagged as 'a long-standing rule that would benefit from an updated official confirmation.'
companion_requirements.text_zh: 政府規費（主申請人單獨 US$75,000；主申請人＋最多 3 名依親人 US$100,000；每多一名依親人依年齡另加 US$25,000–40,000）；無犯罪紀錄；良好品行；健康證明（排除 HIV/AIDS、肺結核等傳染病）；資金來源證明。另外，走一般（非 CBI）購房途徑者，需取得外國人土地持有執照，費率為地價或購價（取較高者）之 10%，適用於購買超過 1 英畝（自用）或 3 英畝（商用）之土地——CBI 申請人豁免此要求。此執照費率之來源年代較舊（部分可回溯至 2008 年），標記為『規則歷史悠久，宜有更新之官方確認』。

programmes.programme: Citizenship by Investment Programme — Real Estate Project Option
programmes.programme_zh: 投資入籍計畫——不動產建案選項
programmes.label_zh: 投資入籍：不動產建案選項

min_value.basis: Minimum investment in an approved real estate project, plus administrative fees; approved categories are high-end branded hotels and resorts, and high-end boutique properties

term.text_en: Citizenship, not residency — no term.
term.text_zh: 取得的是公民身分而非居留權，無期限。

stay.text_en: Not stated on the page consulted. Deliberately omitted. Confirmed via two independent official pages (main page and FAQ): both are genuinely silent on any day-count — a confirmed absence from the pages checked, not merely an unchecked field.
stay.text_zh: 所查頁面未載明。刻意略去。經官方主頁與 FAQ 兩處確認：兩者皆確實未提及任何居留天數要求——此為已查核確認之頁面沉默，非未查欄位。

leads_to.text_en: Citizenship directly.
leads_to.text_zh: 直接取得公民身分。

ownership_form.text_en: The investor receives title deed to the property. The CIP lists the currently open real estate projects by name, so the property must be in a project on the approved list.
ownership_form.text_zh: 投資人取得該物業的地契。CIP 逐一列名目前開放的不動產建案，故物業須位於核准清單內的建案。

offplan.text_en: Not addressed on the page consulted. Deliberately omitted.
offplan.text_zh: 所查頁面未處理。刻意略去。

mortgage.text_en: Not addressed on the page consulted. Deliberately omitted.
mortgage.text_zh: 所查頁面未處理。刻意略去。

dependants.text_en: Processing fee US$1,000 and due diligence US$5,000 per dependant (main applicant: US$2,000 processing and US$8,000 due diligence).
dependants.text_zh: 每名依親人處理費 US$1,000、盡職調查費 US$5,000（主申請人為處理費 US$2,000、盡職調查費 US$8,000）。

entry_tax.text_en: There is a non-refundable, post-approval administrative fee, confirmed on two independent official pages (main page and FAQ): main applicant alone US$30,000; main applicant plus spouse US$45,000; dependants under 18, US$5,000 each; dependants 18 and over, US$10,000 each; families with 4 or more dependants pay an additional US$10,000 per extra dependant. This is distinct from the National Action Bond option's separate US$50,000 administrative fee — the two must not be interchanged. For a family of principal + spouse + 2 children under 16, total real cost is approximately property US$300,000 + processing US$2,000+2x1,000=US$4,000 + due diligence US$8,000 (children under 16 exempt) + administrative fee US$45,000 (incl. spouse) + 2xUS$5,000=US$55,000, i.e. approximately US$367,000.
entry_tax.text_zh: 核准後有一筆不可退還之行政費，經兩個獨立官方頁面（主頁與 FAQ）交叉一致：主申請人單獨 US$30,000；主申請人＋配偶 US$45,000；依親人 18 歲以下 US$5,000／人、18 歲以上 US$10,000／人；4 名以上依親人家庭每多一名再加 US$10,000。此與 National Action Bond 選項另一筆 US$50,000 行政費不同，兩者不可混用。以主申請人＋配偶＋2 名未滿 16 歲子女計算，實際總成本約為房產 US$300,000＋處理費 US$2,000+2×1,000=US$4,000＋盡職調查費 US$8,000（子女未滿16歲免收）＋行政費 US$45,000（含配偶）+2×US$5,000=US$55,000＝約 US$367,000。

last_change.text_en: Same five-country Memorandum of Agreement — Saint Lucia's USD 300,000 threshold sits above the USD 200,000 floor and is unaffected by it.
last_change.text_zh: 確立：同一份五國備忘錄——聖露西亞 30 萬美元門檻已高於 20 萬美元地板值，不受其拘束。

short.term_zh: 公民身分，無期限

short.outcome_zh: 直接取得公民身分

short.own_zh: 公告核准清單內建案之地契

programmes.notes_en: Downgraded from high on one field only: the holding period before resale is NOT stated on the official investment-options page and could not be established. Everything else here is verbatim from the CIP unit. For reference, the same page gives the non-property options as National Economic Fund US$240,000 (applicant plus up to three dependants) and National Action Bond US$300,000 — useful context for whether the real-estate route is competitive.
programmes.notes_zh: 僅因一個欄位下調信心度：轉售前的持有期間在官方投資選項頁未載明，無法確立。其餘內容皆逐字取自 CIP 主管單位。供對照：同一頁列出非不動產選項為國家經濟基金 US$240,000（申請人加最多三名依親人）與國家行動債券 US$300,000，可用於判斷不動產路徑是否具競爭力。

sources.publisher: Saint Lucia Citizenship by Investment Unit
CIP Saint Lucia — FAQs
OECS Press Room — Memorandum of Agreement on Citizenship by Investment Programmes

companion_requirements.text_en: Processing fee and due diligence fee, plus the post-approval administrative fee (US$30,000/US$45,000 + dependant fees, see `entry_tax`). Separately, Saint Lucia also has a non-citizen land holding licence regime (under the Department of Lands and Surveys), but its rate could not be established, and the claim that CBI investors are exempt comes only from a real-estate marketing site (tier 2, commercial in nature) — flagged as 'regime confirmed to exist, details below the credible threshold' rather than adopted as fact.
companion_requirements.text_zh: 處理費與盡職調查費，加上核准後行政費（US$30,000／US$45,000＋依親人費用，見 entry_tax）。另外，聖露西亞亦有非公民持有土地執照制度（隸屬 Department of Lands and Surveys），惟費率未能查得，且『CBI 投資人豁免』一節僅來自房產中介網站（第二級，商業推廣性質）——標記為『制度存在，細節未達可信門檻』，非採為既定事實。

programmes.programme: Five-year residency permit by property purchase (revised Cabinet criteria, 2026)
programmes.programme_zh: 購置不動產取得五年居留許可（2026 年內閣修訂標準）

min_value.basis: Property located OUTSIDE the Capital Governorate (Amman), with no requirement that it be purchased from a developer. Value is determined by the valuation of the Department of Lands and Survey, not by the contract price.

extra_tiers.label_en: Property purchased from a real estate developer or housing company (anywhere, including Amman)
extra_tiers.label_zh: 向不動產開發商或住宅公司購買（不限地區，含安曼）

extra_tiers.label_en: Property purchased from a party OTHER than a real estate developer or housing company (i.e. resale, in Amman)
extra_tiers.label_zh: 向開發商或住宅公司以外的對象購買（即安曼的中古屋交易）

term.text_en: Five years, renewable. The criteria provide for 'granting or renewing five-year residency permits to both investors and non-investors, regardless of their previous period of residence in Jordan'.
term.text_zh: 五年，可續期。修訂標準規定「不論其先前在約旦居留期間長短，得對投資人與非投資人核發或續發五年期居留許可」。

stay.text_en: No minimum stay is stated in the criteria as published. Not asserted either way.
stay.text_zh: 已公布的標準未載明最低居留天數。此處不作任何方向的斷言。

leads_to.text_en: This property route grants RESIDENCY only. Jordan does separately operate a Citizenship by Investment Programme, introduced in 2018, under which 681 investors had been granted citizenship as at the date of this announcement — but the routes to citizenship in the revised criteria are other instruments (notably the Amman Stock Exchange route, whose threshold was raised in the same decision), not the property purchase described here. Property does not buy Jordanian citizenship.
leads_to.text_zh: 本不動產路徑僅授予居留權。約旦另設有 2018 年推出的投資入籍計畫，截至本公告日已有 681 名投資人循此取得公民身分——但修訂標準中通往公民身分的是其他工具（尤以安曼證券交易所路徑為主，其門檻在同一決議中調高），並非此處所述的購置不動產。購置不動產並不取得約旦國籍。

ownership_form.text_en: Freehold purchase, valued by the Department of Lands and Survey. The property must be retained for no less than five years and neither sold nor mortgaged during that period. Failure to comply with any prescribed condition results in cancellation of the residency (or revocation of citizenship, for the citizenship route).
ownership_form.text_zh: 自由保有產權之購置，由土地測量局估價。物業須持有不少於五年，期間不得出售亦不得設定抵押。未遵守任一規定條件者，居留權將遭撤銷（入籍路徑則為撤銷公民身分）。

offplan.text_en: Not addressed in the published criteria. Note that value is set by Department of Lands and Survey valuation, which implies a registered, valued property. Deliberately not asserted.
offplan.text_zh: 已公布標準未處理此點。惟價值係由土地測量局估價認定，隱含須為已登記且經估價的物業。刻意不作斷言。

mortgage.text_en: PROHIBITED during the holding period. The property must be 'retained for no less than five years and is neither sold nor mortgaged during that period'. A mortgaged property therefore cannot support this residency.
mortgage.text_zh: 持有期間內禁止設定抵押。物業須「持有不少於五年，且在該期間內不得出售亦不得設定抵押」。因此已設抵押的物業無法支撐此居留權。

dependants.text_en: Not specified for the residency route in the published criteria. (The criteria do detail dependants for the separate citizenship route — spouse, dependent daughters, unmarried sons under 24, dependent parents, and where investment exceeds JOD 2 million also male children under 30 with their spouses and children — but that is the citizenship route, not this one. Do not transfer those terms across.)
dependants.text_zh: 已公布標準未就居留路徑載明依親規定。（標準確有詳列另一條入籍路徑的依親範圍——配偶、受扶養女兒、24 歲以下未婚兒子、受扶養父母，投資逾 JOD 200 萬時另及 30 歲以下男性子女與其配偶子女——但那屬入籍路徑，非本路徑。不得將該等條件移用。）

entry_tax.text_en: Not stated in this announcement. A 6% transaction fee (reduced to 3% where the seller is a housing company) circulates in market material but does NOT appear in the Invest Jordan text read here, and is not published. Two conflicting general (non-scheme-specific) transfer-tax figures were found — PwC states a uniform 6%, while a separate real-estate portal states a size-graduated 3%/6%. Neither supports the 'discount for housing-company seller' claim, and both concern general transfer tax rather than a scheme-specific rule. Neither figure is adopted.
entry_tax.text_zh: 本公告未載明。坊間另有資料稱有 6% 交易規費（賣方為住宅公司時降為 3%），但此數字並未出現在所讀取的 Invest Jordan 文本中，故不予刊登。 查：查得兩則互相矛盾的一般（非本方案專屬）過戶稅說法——PwC 稱統一 6%；另一房產入口網站稱依坪數分級 3%/6%。兩者皆不支持坊間所稱『賣方為住宅公司則降稅』之說法，且均屬一般過戶稅而非本方案專屬規則。兩個數字均不予採信。

last_change.text_en: A Jordanian Cabinet decision approving amendments to the criteria for granting residency and citizenship to investors, announced by the Ministry of Investment (Invest Jordan). The decision number and exact date were NOT stated on the page read; market material cites 'Council of Ministers Decision No. 9238 of 15 July 2026', which could neither be confirmed nor refuted here. The Invest Jordan announcement, not the decision number, is the source relied on until the number is independently sourced. The date is corroborated: the official Jordanian news agency Petra filed a story on 15 July 2026 describing the decision as made at a 'Wednesday session' — 15 July 2026 was indeed a Wednesday, which is tier-1 corroboration. The decision number 9238 itself, checked against three further reports (Jordan Times, ZAWYA, Jordan News), appears in none of them.
last_change.text_zh: 約旦內閣通過修訂投資人居留與入籍標準的決議，由投資部（Invest Jordan）公告。所讀頁面未載明決議編號與確切日期；坊間另有資料引用「2026 年 7 月 15 日部長會議第 9238 號決議」，此點無法確認亦無法否證。在決議編號獲獨立佐證前，此處依據 Invest Jordan 公告，而非決議編號。 日期部分已獲佐證：約旦官方通訊社 Petra 於 2026 年 7 月 15 日發稿，描述決議係於『週三會議』作成——2026 年 7 月 15 日確實是週三，此點已獲第一級來源佐證。決議編號 9238 本身，經追加查核三篇報導（Jordan Times、ZAWYA、Jordan News）後仍完全查無，任一報導皆未列出決議編號。

short.term_en: 5 yrs, renewable
short.term_zh: 5 年，可續期
short.stay_en: Not stated in the criteria as published
short.stay_zh: 所公布之核定標準未載
short.outcome_en: Residency only; the citizenship routes sit in other instruments
short.outcome_zh: 僅取得居留權；入籍途徑規定於其他法令
short.own_en: Freehold valued by the Department of Lands and Survey; 5-yr hold, no sale or mortgage
short.own_zh: 完全所有權，由土地測量局估價；須持有 5 年，期間不得出售或抵押

programmes.notes_en: This entry corrects three claims that circulate elsewhere. (1) HOLDING PERIOD: circulating material sometimes states '4 years inside the zoning area / 6 outside'. The Invest Jordan text states a single, uniform period: 'retained for no less than five years'. The period is five years. (2) CITIZENSHIP: circulating material sometimes states 'never citizenship'. That is right about this route but wrong as a statement about Jordan, which has run a Citizenship by Investment Programme since 2018 with 681 grants to date; the same Cabinet decision raised the Amman Stock Exchange citizenship threshold. The accurate statement is 'this route gives residency; Jordan's citizenship route is a different instrument'. (3) FEES and the Minister of Interior approval step: not present in the Invest Jordan text and not published. The three thresholds themselves (JOD 150,000 / 200,000 / 300,000) and their triggers are confirmed verbatim at tier 1.
programmes.notes_zh: 本條修正三項坊間流傳之說法。（一）持有期間：坊間有時稱「分區內 4 年／區外 6 年」。Invest Jordan 文本載明單一且一致的期間：「持有不少於五年」。期間為五年。（二）公民身分：坊間有時稱「絕不授予公民身分」。就本路徑而言正確，但作為對約旦整體的陳述則有誤——約旦自 2018 年起即設有投資入籍計畫，迄今已核發 681 例；同一份內閣決議並調高了安曼證交所的入籍門檻。準確的說法是「本路徑給居留權；約旦的入籍路徑是另一套工具」。（三）規費與內政部長核准程序：未見於 Invest Jordan 文本，不予刊登。三檔門檻本身（JOD 150,000／200,000／300,000）及其適用條件，已在一級來源逐字確認。

sources.publisher: Invest Jordan / Ministry of Investment — 'Cabinet Approves Amendments to the Criteria for Granting Residency and Jordanian Citizenship to Investors'
Petra — Jordan News Agency (official state news agency)

companion_requirements.text_en: No tier-1 or dual-tier-2 evidence was found for any companion requirement beyond the purchase itself (no deposit, no income proof, no insurance, no language test). One possible lead was found but NOT adopted due to a timing mismatch: a July-2025 (pre-reform) article describes an overall investor residency/citizenship framework with a 500-person annual cap, security review and financial vetting, but none of the three articles covering the 15 July 2026 post-reform announcement repeats this, so it is not confirmed to carry over to the current version — left as an open item, not adopted as fact.
companion_requirements.text_zh: 未找到任何一級或雙重二級來源證實『買房之外』的必要條件（無存款、無收入證明、無保險、無語言測試）。查到一項疑似線索但不予採用，因時間點對不上：2025 年 7 月（修法前）一篇報導提及整體投資人居留／入籍框架設有 500 人年度上限、安全審查與財力核實，惟描述 2026 年 7 月 15 日修法後之三篇報導皆未再提及，無法確認是否延續至現行版本——列為待觀察項，不作為既定事實。

programmes.programme: Property-linked residency (two tiers, under the non-Qatari real estate ownership regime)
programmes.programme_zh: 不動產連結居留（兩檔門檻，隸屬非卡達人不動產所有權制度）

min_value.basis: Real Estate Regulatory Authority, verbatim: 'Residency tied to property is granted for properties valued at 730,000 Qatari Riyals (equivalent to 200,000 US Dollars).' The USD equivalent is the authority's own.

extra_tiers.label_en: Higher tier — PERMANENT RESIDENCY BENEFITS ONLY, not a permanent residency card. Authority verbatim: 'Permanent residency benefits are available for properties valued at no less than 3,650,000 Qatari Riyals (equivalent to 1 million US Dollars), which include benefits related to health, education, and investment.'
extra_tiers.label_zh: 高檔門檻——僅取得永久居留「權益」，並非永久居留卡。主管機關原文：「不動產價值不低於 3,650,000 卡達里亞爾（相當於 100 萬美元）者，可享永久居留權益，包括醫療、教育與投資方面的權益。」

term.text_en: NOT ESTABLISHED. The Real Estate Regulatory Authority publishes no term or renewal cycle for either tier, and no other tier-1 Qatari source was opened. Deliberately omitted rather than estimated. Two candidate leads were checked and explicitly excluded: (1) Qatar's 2018 Law No. 10 permanent-residency system — a different mechanism (requires 20 years' lawful residence if born abroad, 10 if born in Qatar), unrelated to this property-based route; (2) the Ministry of Interior's general residence-permit renewal rules (standard 1-3 years) — no property-route-specific term found there either. Both leads checked and ruled out, genuinely not found rather than not looked for.
term.text_zh: 未能確立。不動產監理總署未就任一檔門檻公布期限或續期週期，亦未能開啟其他卡達一級來源。故刻意略去而不作估算。 查並明確排除兩條候選線索：(1) 卡達 2018 年第 10 號永久居留法——另一套機制（境外出生須合法居留 20 年、境內出生 10 年），與本購房居留無關；(2) 內政部一般居留延期規定（標準 1-3 年）——未查到針對本購房居留專屬之期限規定。兩條線皆已查並排除，確實查無而非未查。

stay.text_en: REPORTED at 90 days per year, published here only because two independent tier-2 sources agree: the US Department of State's 2025 Investment Climate Statement for Qatar ('provided they reside in Qatar for a minimum of 90 days a year', in the context of the 730,000-riyal usufruct threshold) and Fragomen, the immigration law firm ('They must reside in Qatar for at least 90 days annually'). The requirement does NOT appear in the Qatari Real Estate Regulatory Authority's own text. The two sources also differ in emphasis on which tier the rule attaches to — State ties it to the lower threshold, Fragomen to the permanent-residency tier. Treat 90 days as the working figure, not as a verified statutory rule. CONFIDENCE IS LOWERED, not raised, by a third data point: a third source (a Turkey-based immigration law firm) attributes the 90-day rule specifically to art. 7 of Resolution 28/2020, but a full-text check of the actual art. 7 (via the Qatar Tourism instruction manual) shows its real content is 'permanent residency benefits: medical/education/investment' — no day-count language at all ('90', 'day', 'annually', 'per year' all return zero hits). This is negative evidence on the article-number attribution, not supporting evidence; that attribution is very likely wrong.
stay.text_zh: 報導值為每年 90 天，此處刊登僅因兩個彼此獨立的二級來源說法一致：美國國務院《2025 年卡達投資環境報告》（在 73 萬里亞爾用益權門檻的脈絡下稱「須每年在卡達居住至少 90 天」）與移民律師事務所 Fragomen（「須每年在卡達居住至少 90 天」）。此要求並未出現在卡達不動產監理總署自身的文本中。兩來源對此規則附著於哪一檔門檻的側重也不同——國務院繫於較低門檻，Fragomen 繫於永久居留檔。請將 90 天視為工作假設值，而非已查證的法定規則。信心度因第三筆資料而下修而非上升：第三個來源（一家土耳其移民律師事務所）將 90 天規則具體歸於 2020 年第 28 號決議第 7 條，惟全文核對第 7 條實際內容（透過卡達旅遊局說明手冊）顯示其真正內容為『永久居留權益：醫療／教育／投資』，完全無天數相關文字（『90』『day』『annually』『per year』檢索皆掛零）。此為該條號歸屬之負面證據，非支持證據；該條號歸屬極可能有誤。

leads_to.text_en: Residency only. Critically, the higher QAR 3,650,000 tier does NOT confer a permanent residency card: the authority's wording is 'permanent residency BENEFITS... which include benefits related to health, education, and investment'. The Qatari permanent residency card is governed by a separate statute — Law No. (10) of 2018 on Permanent Residency — which appears as its own entry in the authority's legislation index, distinct from Law No. (16) of 2018 on non-Qatari real estate ownership. The claim that buying property for QAR 3.65m gives Qatari permanent residency is not supported.
leads_to.text_zh: 僅取得居留權。關鍵在於：QAR 3,650,000 這一檔並不授予永久居留卡；主管機關的用語是「永久居留『權益』……包括醫療、教育與投資方面的權益」。卡達的永久居留卡另有法源——2018 年第 10 號永久居留法，在主管機關的法規索引中自成一條，與規範非卡達人不動產所有權的 2018 年第 16 號法律有別。「花 365 萬里亞爾買房即可取得卡達永久居留」之說法查無依據。

ownership_form.text_en: Freehold within designated areas, plus a separate usufruct regime. The authority's project page states 'Non-Qataris are allowed to own real estate in (9) specific areas' and separately that 'Non-Qataris have the right to use real estate in (16) areas, and the use of the real estate shall be for a period not exceeding (99) years, renewable'. NOTE THE INTERNAL INCONSISTENCY, which is the actual answer to the 9-versus-10 question: the same page's prose still says nine, while the accompanying list already includes the Simaisma Resort & Beach Project (zone 70) as a tenth entry. The list has been updated for Cabinet Decision 21/2026; the sentence counting the areas has not. The accurate description is 'nine in the authority's prose, ten in its own list following the 2026 amendment', not a single number. REINFORCED (not resolved): a Qatar Tourism-authored '2020 Resolution 28 instruction manual' was located and describes ONLY the original 9 zones, with no mention of Simaisma or the 2026 Resolution 21 — indirect corroboration that '9' is the original statutory text and '10' (including Simaisma) was only added to the published list after the 2026 amendment.
ownership_form.text_zh: 指定區域內的自由保有產權，另有一套獨立的用益權制度。主管機關的建案頁載明「非卡達人得在（9）個特定區域持有不動產」，並另載「非卡達人得在（16）個區域享有不動產使用權，使用期限不超過（99）年，可續期」。請注意其內部矛盾——這正是「9 個還是 10 個」問題的真正答案：同一頁的敘述文字仍寫九個，但隨附清單已納入西邁斯馬度假村與海灘專案（第 70 號分區）作為第十筆。清單已依 2026 年第 21 號內閣決議更新，計數的那句話則尚未更新。準確的描述是「主管機關敘述文字寫九個，其自身清單在 2026 年修正後為十個」，而非逕自擇一數字。 強化（非解決）此矛盾：查得卡達旅遊局主辦之《2020 年第 28 號決議說明手冊》，全文只描述原始 9 區，完全未提 Simaisma 或 2026 年第 21 號決議——間接佐證『9』是舊制原文、『10』（含 Simaisma）是 2026 修正後才加進清單。

offplan.text_en: Not addressed by any Qatari government source consulted. Deliberately omitted.
offplan.text_zh: 所查卡達政府來源皆未處理此點。刻意略去。

mortgage.text_en: Not addressed by any Qatari government source consulted. Deliberately omitted.
mortgage.text_zh: 所查卡達政府來源皆未處理此點。刻意略去。

dependants.text_en: Not stated on the pages consulted. Deliberately omitted.
dependants.text_zh: 所查頁面未載明。刻意略去。

entry_tax.text_en: No public information could be confirmed on this specific point.
entry_tax.text_zh: 無公開資料可確立。

last_change.text_en: CONFIRMED THAT THE INSTRUMENT EXISTS. The Real Estate Regulatory Authority's own legislation index lists, as its most recent entry, 'Cabinet Decision No. (21) of 2026 Amending certain provisions of Decision No. (28) of 2020 on determining the areas in which non-Qataris are permitted to own real estate'. So Cabinet Decision 21/2026 is real and does amend the areas schedule of Decision 28/2020 — that much is tier-1. The reported date of 14 May 2026 for the addition of Simaisma is NOT confirmed: every source carrying that date is tier-3 social media, and the wave of such posts dates to late June / July 2026, which sits awkwardly with a mid-May decision. The same index also records two other 2025-26 changes: Law No. (1) of 2025 amending Law No. (16) of 2018, and Cabinet Decision No. (1) of 2025 on GCC citizens' ownership.
last_change.text_zh: 已確認該法令存在。不動產監理總署自身的法規索引以「2026 年第 21 號內閣決議——修正 2020 年第 28 號決議關於劃定非卡達人得持有不動產區域之部分條文」為最新一筆。因此 2026 年第 21 號內閣決議確實存在，且確實修正了第 28 號決議的區域表——此點屬一級來源。至於將西邁斯馬（Simaisma）納入的日期為 2026 年 5 月 14 日之說，未獲證實：載有該日期的來源全為三級社群貼文，而這波貼文集中在 2026 年 6 月底至 7 月，與 5 月中旬的決議日期在時序上並不相稱。同一索引另記載兩項 2025–26 年變動：修正 2018 年第 16 號法律的 2025 年第 1 號法律，以及關於海合會公民持有的 2025 年第 1 號內閣決議。

short.term_en: Not established; the authority publishes no term or renewal cycle
short.term_zh: 無公開資料；主管機關未公布期限或續期週期
short.stay_en: Reported at 90 days per year on two agreeing tier-2 sources
short.stay_zh: 據兩筆一致之第二級來源，每年 90 天
short.outcome_en: Residency only; the higher tier confers benefits, not a permanent residency card
short.outcome_zh: 僅取得居留權；較高級距給予相關待遇，非永久居留證
short.own_en: Freehold in designated areas; the authority’s own prose and list disagree on how many
short.own_zh: 指定區域內之完全所有權；主管機關敘述文字與其清單所載區域數不一致

programmes.notes_en: CONFIRMED AT TIER 1, from the Real Estate Regulatory Authority (aqarat.gov.qa), the Qatari body competent for the non-Qatari ownership regime: (1) both thresholds, QAR 730,000 and QAR 3,650,000, verbatim, with the authority's own USD equivalents; (2) THE KEY NUANCE — the QAR 3.65m tier gives 'permanent residency benefits... health, education, and investment', not a permanent residency card, and the PR card sits under a separate statute (Law No. 10 of 2018) that appears as its own line in the authority's legislation index; (3) Cabinet Decision No. 21 of 2026 exists and amends Decision No. 28 of 2020 on the areas schedule. NOT ESTABLISHED: (a) the article attribution 'Decision 28/2020 Art. 7' — the authority's page carries the substance but not the article number, so cite the authority, not the article; (b) the 14 May 2026 date for Simaisma; (c) the term of either residency; (d) the 90-day presence rule at tier 1 — it rests on two agreeing tier-2 sources and is flagged as such. The freehold count is best reported as the authority's own inconsistency rather than as nine or ten.
programmes.notes_zh: 已確認的事項，全部來自卡達不動產監理總署（aqarat.gov.qa）——非卡達人所有權制度的主管機關——屬一級來源：（1）QAR 730,000 與 QAR 3,650,000 兩檔門檻的逐字內容，含主管機關自訂的美元對價；（2）關鍵細節——365 萬里亞爾這一檔給的是「永久居留權益……醫療、教育與投資」，而非永久居留卡，且永久居留卡另有法源（2018 年第 10 號法律），在主管機關法規索引中自成一條；（3）2026 年第 21 號內閣決議確實存在，且修正 2020 年第 28 號決議的區域表。未能確立：（a）「第 28 號決議第 7 條」的條號歸屬——主管機關頁面有實質內容但無條號，故引用時應引主管機關而非條號；（b）西邁斯馬的 2026 年 5 月 14 日日期；（c）兩檔居留權的期限；（d）90 天居留規則在一級來源的依據——該規則立基於兩個說法一致的二級來源，已據此標註。自由保有區域數量以「主管機關自身前後不一致」的形式報導，優於逕自寫九或十。

companion_requirements.text_en: The Qatar Tourism-hosted official instruction manual states that non-Qatari residents applying online for real-estate residency must submit, besides title deed and ID documents, a CERTIFICATE OF GOOD CONDUCT (police clearance). This is a government-hosted document (Qatar Tourism, the ministry co-administering the ownership zones), but it was NOT independently cross-checked against moj.gov.qa or aqarat.gov.qa directly (moj.gov.qa did not connect) — flagged as 'government-hosted document, not fully cross-checked against the primary property/justice-ministry domains' rather than a complete tier-1 confirmation. The 90-day residency rule remains supported only by tier-2 sources. A third source attributes the rule to art. 7 of the underlying 2020 Resolution 28, but a full-text check of the ACTUAL art. 7 covers 'permanent residency benefits: medical/education/investment', not a day-count at all — this citation is very likely wrong, which should LOWER confidence in the 90-day figure, not raise it, despite it superficially looking more precise. No deposit, income proof, or language-test requirement was found.
companion_requirements.text_zh: 卡達旅遊局主辦之官方說明手冊明載，非卡達居民線上申請不動產居留時，除產權狀與身分證件外，須檢附良民證（無犯罪紀錄證明）。此為政府機構主辦文件（卡達旅遊局，共同主管持有區之部會），惟未能與 moj.gov.qa 或 aqarat.gov.qa 直接交叉核對（moj.gov.qa 連線失敗）——標記為『政府機構主辦文件，未與主管地政／司法部網域直接交叉核對』，非完整達第一級標準。90 天居留規則仍僅有第二級來源支持。第三個來源將此規則歸於 2020 年第 28 號決議第 7 條，惟逐字核對第 7 條實際內容為『永久居留權益：醫療／教育／投資』，並非天數規定——此條號歸屬極可能有誤，應據此調降（而非調升）對 90 天數字之信心，儘管其表面看似更精確。未查得存款、收入證明或語言測試要求。

programmes.programme: Golden Residency — Property Owner route
programmes.programme_zh: 黃金居留——不動產所有權人路徑

min_value.basis: Official programme site, verbatim: 'Real estate investors who own property with a total personal share value of BHD 130,000' or higher.

term.text_en: Permanent. Official programme site, verbatim: 'A permanent residency with no restrictions on length of stay', allowing the holder to 'stay as long as you wish'.
term.text_zh: 永久。官方計畫網站原文：「永久居留權，停留期間不設限制」，持有人可「想住多久就住多久」。

stay.text_en: No minimum stay is imposed. The benefits page states the residency carries 'no restrictions on length of stay'. Note this is a statement about the absence of a cap, phrased as a benefit; the site does not separately assert 'there is no minimum'. The natural reading of a permanent residency with unrestricted length of stay is that no minimum applies, and no minimum appears anywhere on the official site.
stay.text_zh: 不設最低居留天數。權益頁載明該居留權「停留期間不設限制」。請注意：這是以權益的語氣陳述「無上限」，官網並未另行明說「無下限」。永久居留且停留期間不受限制，其自然解讀即為不存在最低居留要求，且官網任何處均未出現最低天數。

leads_to.text_en: Not addressed on the official pages consulted. The programme grants residency and access to a National ID Card; citizenship is not mentioned. Deliberately not asserted either way.
leads_to.text_zh: 所查官方頁面未處理此點。該計畫授予居留權與國民身分證，未提及公民身分。此處刻意不作任何方向的斷言。

ownership_form.text_en: Aggregation across properties IS allowed — this confirms the reported claim. Official site, verbatim: applicants may qualify through 'a single property or multiple properties, provided the combined value of the applicant's shares meets or exceeds the threshold of BHD 130,000.' Note the threshold is measured on the applicant's SHARES, so a part-interest in a larger asset counts at its share value.
ownership_form.text_zh: 確實允許跨物業合併計算——此點證實了報導中的說法。官方網站原文：申請人可透過「單一物業或多個物業」符合資格，「惟申請人各該持分之合計價值須達到或超過 BHD 130,000 門檻」。請注意門檻是以申請人的「持分」衡量，因此持有較大資產的部分權益，按其持分價值計入。

offplan.text_en: Not addressed on the official pages consulted. Deliberately omitted.
offplan.text_zh: 所查官方頁面未處理。刻意略去。

mortgage.text_en: Not addressed on the official pages consulted. Note that the threshold is expressed as the applicant's 'total personal share value', which is an equity concept rather than a purchase-price concept, but no inference is drawn.
mortgage.text_zh: 所查官方頁面未處理。惟門檻的表述為申請人的「個人持分總價值」，屬權益概念而非買價概念，此處不作推論。

dependants.text_en: Benefits extend to 'your spouse, parents, and children', with access to healthcare and education.
dependants.text_zh: 權益及於「配偶、父母與子女」，並可使用醫療與教育資源。

entry_tax.text_en: Official FAQ confirms the application fee is BHD 5 (approx. USD 13) plus an issuance fee of BHD 300 (approx. USD 795), for a combined total of approximately USD 808.
entry_tax.text_zh: 確立：官方 FAQ 逐字確認申請費 BHD 5（約 13 美元）＋核發費 BHD 300（約 795 美元），合計約 808 美元。

last_change.text_en: THE BHD 200,000 FIGURE IS SUPERSEDED — CONFIRMED, and confirmed from the government's own site on both sides of the change. The official Golden Residency site's own news item of 10 April 2025 described the property-owner category as 'Investors who own real estate in Bahrain valued at BHD 200,000 (equivalent to USD 530,555) or more at the time of purchase'; the same site's current eligibility page states BHD 130,000. The reduction was reported by IMI Daily on 28 November 2025 as a 35% cut from BHD 200,000 to BHD 130,000. The current figure is BHD 130,000. Anything still quoting BHD 200,000 is quoting the 2022-2025 figure. A CANDIDATE governing instrument was located: Resolution No. 20 of 2022 ('on issuing the golden entry visa and residence permit for foreigners'), consistently named across legal databases and law-firm reporting — but the primary source (legalaffairs.gov.bh or the official gazette) was NOT independently reached, so this is held at tier 2, not yet upgraded to tier 1.
last_change.text_zh: BHD 200,000 一數已遭取代——已確認，且在變動前後皆由政府自家網站佐證。官方黃金居留網站 2025 年 4 月 10 日的新聞稿將不動產所有權人類別描述為「於購置時持有巴林境內價值 BHD 200,000（相當於 530,555 美元）以上不動產之投資人」；同一網站現行的資格頁則載明 BHD 130,000。IMI Daily 於 2025 年 11 月 28 日報導此次調降，幅度為由 BHD 200,000 降至 BHD 130,000，減幅 35%。現行數字為 BHD 130,000。任何仍引用 BHD 200,000 的資料，引的都是 2022–2025 年的舊值。 查得候選母法：2022 年第 20 號決議（『向外國人核發黃金入境簽證及居留許可』），在法律資料庫與律所報導中名稱一致——惟主管機關官方公報（legalaffairs.gov.bh）未能獨立取得，故僅達第二級，尚未升格第一級。

programmes.notes_en: Every substantive field here comes from the Bahraini government's own dedicated programme site, goldenresidency.gov.bh, which is reachable from this environment even though the National Portal for Residency Affairs (npra.gov.bh) refuses connections; goldenresidency.gov.bh is the programme's own site and is treated as the authoritative source here. All three of the commonly reported claims check out: BHD 130,000, permanence, and aggregation of properties. The BHD 200,000 figure is confirmed as the superseded launch-era figure, and the confirmation is unusually clean because the same government site carries both numbers at different dates. Two things are NOT published: a minimum-stay statement framed as 'there is explicitly no minimum' (the site says no restriction on length of stay, which is not quite the same sentence), and the governing legal instrument, which was not located. The non-property Golden Residency categories are Retired, Talented and long-term Residents; those were not researched here.
programmes.notes_zh: 本條所有實質欄位皆取自巴林政府自設的計畫官網 goldenresidency.gov.bh。該站在本環境可正常連線，儘管居留事務國家入口網站（npra.gov.bh）拒絕連線；goldenresidency.gov.bh 即為該計畫自身之網站，於此視為權威來源。三項常見報導說法全部成立：BHD 130,000、永久性、可跨物業合併計算。BHD 200,000 確認為已遭取代的上路初期數字，且此一確認格外乾淨，因為同一政府網站在不同時點分別載有兩個數字。有兩點不予刊登：一是把最低居留寫成「明文規定無最低要求」（官網寫的是停留期間不設限制，與該句並不完全等同）；二是母法法源，未能定位。黃金居留的非不動產類別為退休人士、專業人才與長期居民，未予研究。

Kingdom of Bahrain — official Golden Residency site, news item of 10 April 2025 stating the then-current property-owner criterion as 'real estate in Bahrain valued at BHD 200,000 (equivalent to USD 530,555) or more at the time of purchase' (the superseded figure, from the same government site)

companion_requirements.text_en: Beyond the property itself: an NPRA (National Passport, Residency and Foreign Nationals Affairs) application fee of BHD 5 plus an issuance fee of BHD 300 (combined ~USD 808). Both official pages checked (eligibility and benefits) show no asset-proof, health-insurance, criminal-record, or language-test requirement. A separate claim of 'renew every 10 years for BHD 300' appears only in a search-engine snippet, was not confirmed on the official page directly, and is NOT adopted.
companion_requirements.text_zh: 除不動產本身外：NPRA（國家護照、居留與外籍人士事務局）申請費 BHD 5＋核發費 BHD 300（合計約 808 美元）。已查核之兩個官方頁面（資格與權益）均未見資產證明、健康保險、無犯罪紀錄或語言測試要求。另有一則『每 10 年續繳 BHD 300』之說法，僅出現在搜尋引擎摘要中，未於官方頁面直接核實，不予採信。

programmes.programme: Residence Visa for Property Owner (Integrated Tourism Complexes) — Royal Oman Police
programmes.programme_zh: 不動產所有權人居留簽證（綜合旅遊綜合體）——阿曼皇家警察
programmes.label_en: Residence visa for ITC property owners
programmes.label_zh: 綜合旅遊綜合體業主居留簽證

min_value.basis: NO minimum property value is stated by the competent authority. The Royal Oman Police service description on the national government portal sets only a qualitative condition: the applicant must be an owner of a residential unit within one of the Integrated Tourism Complexes in the Sultanate. This confirms the reported 'no value threshold' claim at tier 1. Property purchase DOES also qualify via a separate, distinct instrument: the Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Investment Promotion's (MoCIIP) redesigned Golden Residency programme, launched 31 August/1 September 2025, EXPLICITLY lists direct property purchase (including ready ITC units) as ONE of several qualifying investment channels — Tier One (10 years) at approximately OMR 500,000, Tier Two (5 years) at approximately OMR 250,000, reachable via company investment, government bonds, OR direct real-estate purchase. This is a SEPARATE instrument from the Royal Oman Police's 2-year ITC-only visa documented as the main subject of this entry — see `notes` for how the two, plus a third (the golden-residency-holder's separate privilege to buy OUTSIDE ITCs), fit together. The precise OMR 250k/500k figures rest on a single tier-2 source (Oman Observer) and conflict with other outlets citing a uniform OMR 200,000 — NOT adopted as a settled figure pending official omanresidence.gov.om confirmation (two attempts did not retrieve the original table).

extra_tiers.label_en: MoCIIP Golden Residency (a DIFFERENT instrument from the Royal Oman Police ITC visa documented as this entry's main subject) — Tier One, approx. OMR 500,000, 10-year term, reachable via direct real-estate purchase among other channels. Amount UNCONFIRMED at tier 1: sourced to Oman Observer (tier 2) only, and conflicts with other outlets citing a uniform OMR 200,000. Not settled.
MoCIIP Golden Residency Tier Two, approx. OMR 250,000, 5-year term, same caveats as Tier One above — amount unconfirmed at tier 1.

term.text_en: TWO YEARS — this CONTRADICTS the reported claim of a 10-year Golden Residency. The Royal Oman Police service description reads, verbatim: 'This service allows residential unit owners within one of the integrated tourism complexes in the Sultanate of Oman to obtain a residence visa valid for two years.' See notes for what the 10-year programme actually is.
term.text_zh: 兩年——此點與「10 年黃金居留」的報導說法相牴觸。阿曼皇家警察的服務說明原文為：「本服務讓阿曼蘇丹國境內綜合旅遊綜合體之住宅單位所有權人，得取得為期兩年之居留簽證。」10 年計畫實際所指為何，見備註。

stay.text_en: Not stated in the service description. Note one condition that cuts the other way: 'The applicant must be outside the country when applying for the visa.' Deliberately not asserted.
stay.text_zh: 服務說明未載明。惟有一項條件方向相反，值得注意：「申請人於申請簽證時須人在境外。」此處刻意不作斷言。

leads_to.text_en: Not addressed. Two adjacent Royal Oman Police services exist for family — 'Get a Visa to Join a Residential Unit Owner' and 'Renew Residency for a Residential Unit Owner's Immediate Family' — so the status is renewable and sponsorable in practice, but no naturalisation pathway is stated. Deliberately not asserted.
leads_to.text_zh: 未處理此點。阿曼皇家警察另設兩項與家屬相關的鄰接服務——「取得依親住宅單位所有權人之簽證」與「住宅單位所有權人直系親屬居留續期」——顯示該身分在實務上可續期並可為家屬擔保，但未載明任何入籍途徑。此處刻意不作斷言。

ownership_form.text_en: Historically: ownership of a residential unit inside a licensed Integrated Tourism Complex. Non-GCC foreigners could hold title only within such complexes — a geographic restriction that is the real constraint on this route, since it confines purchases to a handful of master-planned resort developments rather than the open market. A new Real Estate Registry Law (Royal Decree No. 56/2026, in force 18 May 2026 according to Trowers) allows registration of property in the names of non-Omani individuals and companies 'subject to the laws regulating non-Omani ownership'; its implementing regulation had not been issued when Trowers wrote (July 2026). IMI Daily reports that foreign ownership now extends nationwide subject to forthcoming regulations; the law-firm source does not say so, so the nationwide claim is NOT adopted.
ownership_form.text_zh: 原有規定：持有領照綜合旅遊綜合體內住宅單位的所有權。非海合會外籍人士僅能在此類綜合體內取得產權——這項地理限制才是本路徑的真正約束，因為它把購置範圍限縮在少數幾個總體規劃的度假開發案，而非公開市場。新的《不動產登記法》（第 56/2026 號蘇丹令，據 Trowers 自 2026 年 5 月 18 日起施行）允許以非阿曼籍個人與公司的名義登記不動產，但「須符合規範非阿曼人持有的法律」；Trowers 撰文時（2026 年 7 月）施行細則尚未頒布。IMI Daily 稱外國人持有範圍已擴及全國、待施行細則；律所來源未如此表述，故全國說不採信。

offplan.text_en: Not directly addressed, but the required documents are 'Copy of the property ownership' and a 'Letter indicating the location of the property', which implies a registered, located unit. The reported claim that the property must be BUILT is neither confirmed nor refuted by the service page; it is not published.
offplan.text_zh: 未直接處理，惟所需文件為「不動產所有權影本」與「載明不動產位置之函件」，隱含須為已登記且有具體位置的單位。關於物業須「已完工」的報導說法，服務頁既未證實亦未否證，故不予刊登。

mortgage.text_en: Not addressed. Deliberately omitted.
mortgage.text_zh: 未處理。刻意略去。

dependants.text_en: Provided for through a separate service, 'Get a Visa to Join a Residential Unit Owner': 'An expatriate owner of a residential unit holding a property owner's residence permit... may obtain a [joining visa]'. Terms not read in detail.
dependants.text_zh: 另由「取得依親住宅單位所有權人之簽證」一項服務規範：「持有不動產所有權人居留許可之外籍住宅單位所有權人……得取得〔依親簽證〕。」細部條件未逐一查閱。

entry_tax.text_en: The service page shows a fixed cost but the fee schedule was behind a 'Show' control that was not expanded. Not published.
entry_tax.text_zh: 服務頁顯示為固定收費，惟費用明細藏在未展開的「顯示」控制項後方。不予刊登。

last_change.text_en: The Royal Oman Police service record carries 'Updated: August 05, 2025'. Royal Decree 12/2006 is the underlying instrument for Integrated Tourism Complex ownership by non-Omanis, but the decree text itself was NOT read and the reported attribution to its Article 8 is not confirmed. The Royal Oman Police service description, not the article number, is the source relied on. ROYAL OMAN POLICE DECISION No. 87/2026 (June 2026): amending the Executive Regulations of the Foreigners' Residence Law and published in Official Gazette issue No. 1653, it lets a foreigner who owns a registered residential unit, or a unit whose registration is not yet complete, obtain a 'Property Owner Residency' without a sponsor, on a certificate from the competent authority. The legal representatives of an entity that owns such a unit also qualify, and the accompanying spouse and first-degree relatives may be included. Residency, theirs included, ends when ownership is transferred by any legal act. Entry visas linked to an unregistered unit or a construction plot run for six months to one year, renewable. The reports (Oman Observer, Muscat Daily, Gulf News, IMI Daily) state no minimum property value (IMI Daily says expressly that there is none) and no residence term for the owner permit, and none mentions integrated tourism complexes. The decision text itself was not retrieved; the effective date is reported as the date of its publication in the Gazette (one outlet gives 22 June 2026).
last_change.text_zh: 阿曼皇家警察的服務紀錄載明「更新日期：2025 年 8 月 5 日」。2006 年第 12 號蘇丹令為非阿曼人於綜合旅遊綜合體持有不動產的母法，惟未讀取該令原文，報導中歸屬於其第 8 條之說法未獲證實。此處依據阿曼皇家警察的服務說明，而非條號。 阿曼皇家警察第 87/2026 號決定（2026 年 6 月）：修正《外國人居留法》施行細則，刊於第 1653 期官方公報。外國人擁有已登記的住宅單位，或登記尚未完成的單位，可憑主管機關證明免擔保人取得「不動產所有權人居留」；持有該單位之法人的法定代表人同樣適用，隨行配偶與一等親屬可一併納入。所有權因任何法律行為移轉時，居留（含家屬）隨之終止。與未登記單位或建築用地連結的入境簽證，效期 6 個月至 1 年，可續期。各報導（Oman Observer、Muscat Daily、Gulf News、IMI Daily）均未載最低不動產價值（IMI Daily 明言無最低門檻），也未載業主許可的居留年限，且均未提及綜合旅遊綜合體。決定全文未取得；生效日報導為公報刊登之日（一家媒體稱 2026 年 6 月 22 日）。

short.term_en: Two years, per the Royal Oman Police service description
short.term_zh: 2 年，依阿曼皇家警察服務說明
short.stay_en: Not stated; the applicant must be outside Oman when applying
short.stay_zh: 未載；申請時申請人須在境外
short.outcome_en: Not addressed; family join and renewal services exist but no naturalisation is stated
short.outcome_zh: 未見規定；設有眷屬依親與續期服務，惟未載歸化途徑
short.own_en: Unit in a licensed Integrated Tourism Complex; a 2026 registry law may widen this, rules pending
short.own_zh: 領照綜合旅遊綜合體內的住宅單位；2026 年登記法可能放寬，施行細則未出

programmes.notes_en: There are three distinct things in Oman's property/residency landscape and they must not be conflated. (a) The Royal Oman Police's 2-year, no-minimum-value ITC-owner visa, described above. (b) Separately, the Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Investment Promotion's (MoCIIP) redesigned Golden Residency programme (launched 31 Aug/1 Sep 2025) treats direct property purchase — including ready ITC units — as one of several qualifying investment channels (alongside company investment and government bonds), at roughly OMR 250,000 (5-year tier) or OMR 500,000 (10-year tier) — see `extra_tiers`. Property purchase is therefore a qualifying route for this instrument, not merely a benefit unlocked afterward. (c) The Investor Residency Programme privilege of buying property outside integrated tourism complexes, unlocked once a golden-residency holder qualifies via non-property capital, is a third and separate thing — property there genuinely is only a privilege, not a qualifying route. (b) and (c) must not be merged. One item is quoted rather than interpreted: the ROP visa's special conditions include 'the applicant must have a commercial register', which sits strangely with a purely residential purchase; this has been confirmed present on repeated checks, so it is not a page rendering artefact, but its purpose is not otherwise explained. (d) A fourth item has existed since June 2026: Royal Oman Police Decision No. 87/2026 created a sponsor-free 'Property Owner Residency' (see `last_change`). Its geographic scope, residence term and fee are not published here because the decision text was not read and the press reports do not state them. Whether it replaces the 2-year ITC visa documented above is not stated.
programmes.notes_zh: 阿曼的不動產／居留制度並存三件不同的事，不可混為一談。(a) 阿曼皇家警察之 2 年、無最低金額 ITC 業主簽證，如上所述。(b) 另外，商工投資推廣部（MoCIIP）改版之黃金居留計畫（2025 年 8 月 31 日／9 月 1 日上線），將直接購置不動產（含 ITC 現成單位）列為多條合格投資管道之一（與公司投資、政府債券並列），約 OMR 250,000（5 年檔）或 OMR 500,000（10 年檔）——見 extra_tiers。就此一制度而言，購屋是合格途徑，非僅事後解鎖的權益。(c) 投資人居留計畫中，持有黃金居留後可在綜合旅遊綜合體之外購置不動產之權益，是持有人透過非不動產資本管道取得黃金居留後才解鎖的第三件事——就此一特定權益而言，不動產確實僅是附帶權益，非合格途徑。(b) 與 (c) 不可混為一談。有一項僅予引述不作詮釋：ROP 簽證之特別條件包含『申請人須具備商業登記』，這與純住宅購置格格不入；反覆查核已確認此條件確實存在，非頁面渲染假象，惟其立法目的另無說明。（d）2026 年 6 月出現第四項：阿曼皇家警察第 87/2026 號決定創設免擔保人的「不動產所有權人居留」（見 last_change）。決定全文未讀，報導也未載其地理範圍、居留年限與規費，故此處不刊登。它是否取代上述 2 年期 ITC 簽證，報導未說明。

companion_requirements.text_en: ROP 2-year ITC-owner visa: must apply from OUTSIDE Oman, must not hold another valid visa, must have a commercial registration (reason unclear; repeated checks confirm it is a genuine requirement), fee approximately OMR 50 (not settled: this figure sits behind a collapsible control on the source page and attempts to expand it have returned different results). MoCIIP Golden Residency (property channel): application fee approximately OMR 551 (tier 1) or OMR 326 (tier 2, Oman Observer) — the two figures are not reconciled.
companion_requirements.text_zh: 阿曼皇家警察 2 年 ITC 業主簽證：申請時須人在境外、不得持有其他有效簽證、須具備商業登記（原因不明，反覆查核確認屬實），費用約 OMR 50（尚未定案：該數字藏於來源頁面之可展開控制項後方，不同嘗試展開所得結果並不一致）。MoCIIP 黃金居留（不動產路徑）：申請費約 OMR 551（第一級）或 OMR 326（第二級，Oman Observer）——兩數字未經對帳。

programmes.programme: Green Card — Autorização de Residência Permanente no País (second-residence status by property purchase)
programmes.programme_zh: 綠卡——國內永久居留許可（以購置不動產取得第二居所身分）

min_value.basis: Lei n.º 30/IX/2018, Article 3(a), verbatim: foreigners who, for residence, have bought built or under-construction real estate 'de valor igual ou superior a €80.000 (oitenta mil euros), correspondente a 8.821.200$00..., em município de produto interno bruto (PIB) per capita inferior à média nacional, desde que pago com recursos transferidos do estrangeiro'. Three conditions, all cumulative: the value, the municipality's GDP per capita being BELOW the national average, and payment from funds transferred from abroad.

extra_tiers.label_en: Municipality whose GDP per capita is EQUAL TO OR ABOVE the national average — Article 3(b): value of EUR 120,000 or more (13,231,800 CVE), likewise payable only with funds transferred from abroad. Article 3(c): where GDP per capita cannot be calculated per municipality, the criterion becomes GDP per capita by ISLAND.
extra_tiers.label_zh: 人均 GDP「等於或高於」全國平均之市鎮——第 3 條 b 款：價值 120,000 歐元以上（13,231,800 埃斯庫多），同樣須以自境外匯入之資金支付。第 3 條 c 款：無法按市鎮計算人均 GDP 時，改採「按島」計算的人均 GDP 為判準。

term.text_en: Indefinite in status, five-yearly in paperwork — both halves are statutory and apply together. Lei n.º 30/IX/2018 Article 4: 'O Green Card confere ao seu titular direito a autorização de residência permanente no país, nos limites e para os fins exclusivos nele previstos' — a permanent residence authorisation, but expressly within the limits and for the exclusive purposes provided in the Act. Article 5(2): 'O título de residência permanente deve, porém, ser renovado de cinco em cinco anos' — the permanent residence title must NONETHELESS be renewed every five years, or whenever the identifying particulars recorded on it change. Decreto-Regulamentar n.º 1/2020 Article 11(1) adds the cycle: 'O Green Card é renovável de 5 em 5 anos, e por 10 anos a partir da segunda renovação' — renewable every 5 years, and for 10 years from the second renewal onwards.
term.text_zh: 身分上是無限期，文件上是五年一輪——兩半都有法源，兩者併行。2018 年第 30/IX 號法律第 4 條：「綠卡賦予持有人於國內取得永久居留許可之權利，惟以本法所定之範圍與專屬目的為限。」第 5 條第 2 項：「惟永久居留證照須每五年續發一次」，或於其上登載之識別資料變動時續發。2020 年第 1 號規則命令第 11 條第 1 項補足週期：「綠卡每 5 年可續期一次，自第二次續期起改為每 10 年。」

stay.text_en: No minimum stay is imposed by either instrument — the reported claim holds. Neither the Act nor the Regulation states a number of days. One conditional presence test does exist and should be read alongside: Decreto-Regulamentar n.º 1/2020 Article 11(6) provides that where a renewal application is filed AFTER the card's validity has expired, the application 'deve ser sempre acompanhado de prova de permanência em território nacional ou comprovativo dos motivos de ausência' — it must always be accompanied by proof of presence in national territory or evidence of the reasons for absence. So absence is never counted while you renew on time, but becomes something you must justify if you renew late.
stay.text_zh: 兩份文件皆未課予最低居留天數——報導說法成立。法律與規則命令均未載明天數。惟確有一項附條件的在境檢驗，應一併說明：2020 年第 1 號規則命令第 11 條第 6 項規定，續期申請若於卡片效期「屆滿之後」提出，該申請「均須檢附在國境內停留之證明，或缺席事由之佐證文件」。因此按時續期者從不計算缺席天數，逾期續期者則須就缺席提出說明。

leads_to.text_en: Not addressed by either instrument. The Act's own statement of purpose (Article 1) is 'to promote the country's economy, in particular the real estate sector' via a differentiated status for the holder of a SECOND residence — framing that points away from, not towards, naturalisation. No citizenship claim is published.
leads_to.text_zh: 兩份文件均未處理此點。該法自述的立法目的（第 1 條）是透過為「第二居所」持有人設立差異化身分，「促進國家經濟，尤其是不動產部門」——此一定位指向的是與入籍相反的方向。不刊登任何公民身分主張。

ownership_form.text_en: Purchase of built or under-construction real estate, held continuously. The renewal file must include 'Comprovativo da manutenção da propriedade do património imobiliário que deu origem à sua aquisição' (Regulation Article 11(4)(a)) — proof that the applicant still owns the property that gave rise to the card. There is therefore no fixed holding period in the sense of 'five years then free': the property must be held for as long as the status is to be kept, which is a stronger and open-ended constraint. The instruments do not describe the tenure as freehold or otherwise, so the commonly repeated 'full freehold' claim is NOT published here.
ownership_form.text_zh: 購置已建成或興建中之不動產，並須持續持有。續期文件須包含「證明仍維持持有該取得之不動產」（規則命令第 11 條第 4 項 a 款）——即申請人仍持有當初據以取得綠卡之物業。因此並不存在「持滿五年即可自由處分」意義下的固定持有期：物業須持有至不再需要維持該身分為止，這是一項更強且無期限上限的約束。兩份文件均未將產權型態描述為自由保有或其他形式，故常見的「完全自由保有產權」說法，此處不予刊登。

offplan.text_en: OFF-PLAN QUALIFIES — confirmed verbatim and in both instruments. Lei n.º 30/IX/2018 Article 3 and Decreto-Regulamentar n.º 1/2020 Article 2(1) both use the phrase 'património imobiliário edificado OU EM FASE DE CONSTRUÇÃO' — real estate built OR UNDER CONSTRUCTION. This is unusually explicit; most comparable regimes are silent and have to be inferred.
offplan.text_zh: 預售屋符合資格——已由兩份文件逐字確認。2018 年第 30/IX 號法律第 3 條與 2020 年第 1 號規則命令第 2 條第 1 項均使用「已建成『或興建中』之不動產」一語。此一寫法異常明確；多數可資比較的制度對此保持沉默，只能靠推論。

mortgage.text_en: Not addressed — but the funds-from-abroad condition is the operative constraint and it is stated three times. Article 3(a) and (b) both require the purchase be 'pago com recursos transferidos do estrangeiro', and Article 7(2)(a) makes it an access condition that the applicant 'Demonstrar ter adquirido o património imobiliário com recursos transferidos do estrangeiro, nos montantes mínimos previstos'. A purchase financed by a Cape Verdean lender therefore does not obviously satisfy the qualifying condition, whatever the mortgage's own legality. No inference beyond that is drawn.
mortgage.text_zh: 未處理——但「資金須自境外匯入」才是實際的約束，且法條三度重申。第 3 條 a、b 兩款均要求購置須「以自境外匯入之資金支付」，第 7 條第 2 項 a 款更將其列為准入條件：申請人須「證明係以自境外匯入之資金、按所定最低金額取得該不動產」。因此，由維德角本地放款人融資的購置，顯然無法當然滿足資格條件，無論該抵押貸款本身是否合法。此外不作進一步推論。

dependants.text_en: Lei n.º 30/IX/2018 Article 5(1): the residence authorisation extends to the spouse or the de facto partner judicially recognised in the country of origin, under Articles 59 and 60 of Lei n.º 66/VIII/2014 as amended, and to a minor under 14 and/or a dependant in the applicant's charge, on terms to be regulated. Decreto-Regulamentar n.º 1/2020 devotes a full chapter to family reunification, handled through the same one-stop shop.
dependants.text_zh: 2018 年第 30/IX 號法律第 5 條第 1 項：居留許可及於配偶，或在原籍國經司法承認之事實伴侶（依 2014 年第 66/VIII 號法律第 59、60 條及其修正），並及於 14 歲以下未成年人及／或由申請人扶養之受扶養人，具體條件另以命令定之。2020 年第 1 號規則命令另闢一整章規範家庭團聚，由同一單一窗口辦理。

entry_tax.text_en: THE TAX BREAK IS REAL, IS DISCRETIONARY, AND ITS OBJECT HAS BEEN ABOLISHED — all three points apply together. Lei n.º 30/IX/2018 Article 6(1): property acquired under the Act is exempt from Imposto Único sobre o Património (IUP) on the transfer and on transmission by mortis causa succession, 'e sujeito a redução em 50% (cinquenta por cento) do IUP devido nos dez anos seguintes, MEDIANTE DELIBERAÇÃO DA ASSEMBLEIA MUNICIPAL do Concelho onde se localiza o imóvel' — the 50%/ten-year reduction requires a resolution of the Municipal Assembly of the council where the property sits, so it is a municipal discretion, not an entitlement. Article 6(2): where the Green Card holder is a retiree whose pension income was not generated in Cape Verde, that income is exempt under the personal income tax code (CIRPS). CRITICALLY: the IUP was repealed with effect from 1 January 2026 and replaced by two new codes, the Imposto sobre a Propriedade de Imóveis (IPI) and the Imposto sobre Transmissões de Imóveis (ITI). A Cape Verdean parliamentary Deliberação published in the Boletim Oficial of 22 October 2025 refers to the IUP as running 'até 31 de dezembro de 2025, que em 2026 deve ser revogado'. Article 6 of the 2018 Act grants exemption from a tax that no longer exists; whether the exemption carries across to IPI and ITI was NOT established and must not be assumed. Green Card issuance fees are set by a joint ministerial Portaria (Regulation Article 8) and are not stated in either instrument. PRECISE CITATION ADDED: the successor codes to the abolished IUP are IPI (property tax) = Law 55/X/2025 of 6 June 2025, and ITI (property transfer tax) = Law 54/X/2025 of 6 June 2025, both published in official gazette Series I, Issue 46 of 6 June 2025. WHETHER THE art. 6 GREEN-CARD EXEMPTION CARRIES OVER to IPI/ITI could NOT be confirmed: an attempt to retrieve the IPI's full article text failed (only the gazette heading/summary was obtained), and a Cape Verdean tax-advisory site (tier 2) makes no mention of Green Card transitional treatment either. The finding remains 'not established, do not assume continuity' — genuinely checked and unresolved, not unchecked.
entry_tax.text_zh: 稅賦優惠確實存在、屬裁量性質、且其課稅客體已被廢除——三點需一併理解。2018 年第 30/IX 號法律第 6 條第 1 項：依本法取得之不動產，於移轉時及因死亡繼承移轉時免徵單一財產稅（IUP），「並就其後十年應納之 IUP 減徵 50%（百分之五十），惟須經不動產所在市鎮之市議會決議」——五成／十年的減徵須經物業所在市鎮的市議會決議，故屬市鎮裁量，並非當然權利。第 6 條第 2 項：綠卡持有人若為退休人士，且其退休金來源所得非於維德角產生，該所得依個人所得稅法（CIRPS）免稅。關鍵在於：IUP 已自 2026 年 1 月 1 日起廢止，由兩部新法典取代——不動產財產稅（IPI）與不動產移轉稅（ITI）。維德角國民議會 2025 年 10 月 22 日刊登於官方公報之決議提及 IUP 施行「至 2025 年 12 月 31 日止，並應於 2026 年廢止」。2018 年法律第 6 條所免徵的，是一個已不復存在的稅目；該免稅是否延續適用於 IPI 與 ITI，未能確立，不得逕予假設。綠卡核發規費由部長聯合命令（規則命令第 8 條）定之，兩份文件均未載明金額。 補上精確引註：接替已廢止 IUP 之後續法典為 IPI（不動產財產稅）＝2025 年 6 月 6 日第 55/X 號法律；ITI（不動產移轉稅）＝2025 年 6 月 6 日第 54/X 號法律，均刊於官方公報第一輯第 46 期（2025 年 6 月 6 日）。第 6 條綠卡免稅是否延續至 IPI／ITI，未能確認：嘗試讀取 IPI 全文條文未成功（僅取得公報標題／摘要），另一家維德角本地稅務顧問網站（第二級）亦完全未提及綠卡過渡待遇。結論維持『未能確立、不得假設』——確實已查而未解決，非未查。

last_change.text_en: THE INSTRUMENT CITATION IS SETTLED. The governing Act is Lei n.º 30/IX/2018 de 23 de abril, published in the Boletim Oficial da República de Cabo Verde, I Série n.º 23, 23 April 2018, at page 540. The implementing text is Decreto-Regulamentar n.º 1/2020 de 7 de janeiro, published in the Boletim Oficial, I Série n.º 2, 7 January 2020. Both were read in full from the official gazette. A competing citation, 'Law No. 31/IX/2018', reported by the law firm Miranda, is incorrect. No later amendment to either instrument was located.
last_change.text_zh: 法源引註已定案。母法為 2018 年 4 月 23 日第 30/IX 號法律，刊登於《維德角共和國官方公報》第一輯第 23 號，2018 年 4 月 23 日，第 540 頁。施行文件為 2020 年 1 月 7 日第 1 號規則命令，刊登於官方公報第一輯第 2 號，2020 年 1 月 7 日。兩者皆已自官方公報全文讀取。Miranda 律師事務所所報「2018 年第 31/IX 號法律」之引註有誤。未發現兩份文件的後續修正。

short.term_en: Permanent in status, five-yearly in paperwork; ten-yearly from the second renewal
short.term_zh: 身分為永久，證件 5 年換發，自第二次換發起為 10 年
short.outcome_en: Permanent residence; naturalisation not addressed
short.outcome_zh: 永久居留；歸化未見規定
short.own_en: Continued ownership must be proved at every renewal, so there is no sell-and-keep exit
short.own_zh: 每次換發均須證明仍持有該物件，故不存在售出後保留身分之退出路徑

programmes.notes_en: THREE CLAIMS THAT CIRCULATE ABOUT THIS PROGRAMME, ALL RESOLVED AT TIER 1 AGAINST THE OFFICIAL GAZETTE. (1) NO ZDTI / TOURISM-ZONE REQUIREMENT. Neither Lei n.º 30/IX/2018 nor Decreto-Regulamentar n.º 1/2020 mentions ZDTI, tourism zones, or any designated-area concept at all. The one and only geographic criterion in the whole scheme is whether the MUNICIPALITY's GDP per capita sits below, or at or above, the national average — and where that cannot be computed per municipality, per island. Any claim that the property must sit in a tourism development zone has no basis in the statute. (2) THE EUR 200,000 TIER DOES NOT EXIST. Article 3 of the Act contains exactly two figures, EUR 80,000 and EUR 120,000, and Article 2 of the Regulation reproduces the same two. No third tier appears anywhere in either instrument. (3) THE TAX BREAK WAS WRITTEN AGAINST THE IUP AND THE IUP IS GONE, and the position is worse than commonly reported. Article 6 exempts the property from IUP; the IUP was repealed effective 1 January 2026 and replaced by IPI and ITI. Additionally, the part of the benefit most often marketed — the 50% reduction over ten years — was never automatic even while IUP existed: it requires a resolution of the Municipal Assembly of the relevant council. So the tax argument for this programme should be treated as unsupported until someone produces the IPI/ITI transitional provision. TWO FURTHER CORRECTIONS TO THE CIRCULATING DESCRIPTION. First, 'indefinite residence' oversells it: the status is permanent but the title must be renewed every five years, then every ten from the second renewal, and each renewal requires proof of continued ownership. Second, the funds-transferred-from-abroad condition is stated three separate times across the two instruments and is a genuine gate — it is not boilerplate. One point that could NOT be verified and is therefore omitted: the tenure type. Neither instrument says 'freehold'. Also note the gazette itself contains a typographical error at Article 2(1)(b) of the Regulation, which reads 'cento e vinte mil escudos' where the parent Act correctly reads 'cento e vinte mil euros'; the escudo figure printed alongside (13,231,800$00) confirms euros is meant.
programmes.notes_zh: 三項流傳於本計畫之說法，全部依官方公報以一級來源解決。（1）不存在 ZDTI／旅遊區要求。2018 年第 30/IX 號法律與 2020 年第 1 號規則命令，皆完全未提及 ZDTI、旅遊區或任何指定區域概念。整套制度中唯一的地理判準，是該「市鎮」的人均 GDP 低於全國平均、抑或等於或高於全國平均；無法按市鎮計算時則按島計算。任何稱物業須位於旅遊開發區之說法，於法條均查無依據。（2）不存在 20 萬歐元檔。法律第 3 條恰恰只有兩個數字：80,000 歐元與 120,000 歐元；規則命令第 2 條原樣重複同樣兩個數字。兩份文件任何處都沒有第三檔。（3）稅賦優惠是針對 IUP 而寫，而 IUP 已不存在，且情況比坊間常見報導更差。第 6 條免徵的是該不動產的 IUP；IUP 已自 2026 年 1 月 1 日起廢止，由 IPI 與 ITI 取代。此外，最常被行銷的那一部分優惠——十年內減徵五成——即使在 IUP 仍存在時也從來不是自動適用：它需要相關市鎮的市議會決議。因此，在有人拿出 IPI／ITI 的過渡條款之前，本計畫的稅務論點應視為欠缺依據。另有兩項對流通版本描述的修正。其一，「無限期居留」的說法言過其實：身分雖為永久，但證照須每五年續發，自第二次續期起改為每十年，且每次續期都須提出持續持有物業的證明。其二，「資金須自境外匯入」的條件在兩份文件中三度出現，是真正的關卡，而非樣板文字。有一點未能查證因而略去：產權型態。兩份文件都沒有出現「自由保有」字樣。另附記：官方公報本身在規則命令第 2 條第 1 項 b 款有排印錯誤，寫成「一十二萬『埃斯庫多』」，而母法正確寫為「一十二萬『歐元』」；並列印出的埃斯庫多數字（13,231,800$00）足證原意為歐元。

companion_requirements.text_en: Funds must be REMITTED FROM ABROAD — the statute reiterates this three times; local financing/mortgage cannot be used. Each renewal (5-year cycle, then 10-year) requires proof of continued ownership of the property — there is no 'sell but keep the status' exit path. No minimum stay requirement was found, though a late renewal requires justifying any absence. No asset-proof, health-insurance, criminal-record, or language requirement was found (checked, not merely absent from a structured field). The issuance fee amount remains unpublished.
companion_requirements.text_zh: 資金須自境外匯入——法條三度重申此點，不得使用本地融資／房貸。每次換發（5 年一期，其後 10 年一期）皆須證明仍持有該物業——不存在『賣掉仍保留身分』的退場路徑。未查得最低居住天數要求，惟逾期換發須舉證缺席原因。未查得資產證明、健康保險、無犯罪紀錄或語言要求（已查，非僅結構化欄位缺漏）。核發規費金額仍未公布。

programmes.programme: Qualified Investor permanent residence (Residente Permanente en calidad de Inversionista Calificado) — real estate route
programmes.programme_zh: 合格投資人永久居留——不動產路徑

min_value.basis: Gaceta Oficial 30613 (16 September 2026), Executive Decree 17 of 8 September 2026, art. 4: property bought new from the developer (first sale) needs at least US$300,000; property that has been sold, occupied or let before (secondary market) needs at least US$500,000. The qualifying value is the lower of the price paid and the commercial value, less any lien on the property (art. 5). The funds must come from abroad. The decree sets no expiry date and no scheduled reversion of the US$300,000 figure. Confirmed by the Ministry of Commerce and Industries (MICI) announcement of 21 September 2026.

extra_tiers.label_en: Secondary-market property (previously sold, occupied or let) — minimum US$500,000; the US$300,000 minimum applies to first-sale property only
extra_tiers.label_zh: 二手市場物件（曾轉售、使用或出租者）門檻為 50 萬美元；30 萬美元僅適用於首次銷售物件

term.text_en: Permanent residence is granted directly. The decree sets maximum processing times: 15 business days for the MICI investment certificate once the file is admitted, then 30 business days for the Migration Service decision once the complete file is received (art. 15). The investment must be held for at least five years, with annual proof (art. 12).
term.text_zh: 直接取得永久居留。法令訂有處理時限：商工部（MICI）自受理案件起 15 個工作日內核發投資證明，移民局自收到完整案件起 30 個工作日內作出決定（第 15 條）。投資須持有至少 5 年，並每年提交證明（第 12 條）。

stay.text_en: Agreed by two independent law firms: no minimum annual day-count requirement; the only constraint is the general Panamanian permanent-residence rule against continuous absence exceeding 2 years.
stay.text_zh: 確立，雙來源一致：無最低年度居住天數要求，僅需避免連續離境超過 2 年（巴拿馬永久居留一般規則）。

leads_to.text_en: After five consecutive years of residence the investor, including dependants, may apply for Panamanian naturalisation under the Constitution (art. 14). The law firms add that naturalisation requires Spanish-language ability and a Panama history and geography test.
leads_to.text_zh: 連續居住滿 5 年後，投資人（含依親人）可依憲法申請歸化為巴拿馬公民（第 14 條）。律師事務所補充，歸化另須通過西班牙語能力與巴拿馬歷史、地理測驗。

ownership_form.text_en: Panamanian real estate held directly, or through a company or private-interest foundation of which the applicant is the beneficial owner (art. 5). Two sub-routes: first-sale property (new, unoccupied, bought from the developer) at US$300,000 or more; secondary-market property at US$500,000 or more (art. 4). Other qualifying investments under the same decree: securities through a licensed broker, US$500,000 held for five years (art. 8); a fixed-term bank deposit of US$750,000, or US$500,000 if placed only with Banco Nacional de Panamá or Caja de Ahorros, held for five years (art. 9). Real estate is one of several tracks, not the only one.
ownership_form.text_zh: 巴拿馬不動產，可由本人直接持有，或透過申請人為實質受益人的公司或私人利益基金會持有（第 5 條）。分兩類：首次銷售物件（新建、未曾使用、向建商購入）至少 30 萬美元；二手市場物件至少 50 萬美元（第 4 條）。同一法令下另有其他合格投資：透過持照券商投資證券 50 萬美元，持有 5 年（第 8 條）；定期存款 75 萬美元，若只存入巴拿馬國家銀行或儲蓄銀行則為 50 萬美元，存期 5 年（第 9 條）。不動產只是多條途徑之一。

offplan.text_en: Qualifies, with a US$300,000 minimum (art. 7). Two structures: a trust deposit with a licensed bank or trustee that pays the seller, or payment of 100% of the price to the developer. The second structure must be backed by an irrevocable, on-demand bank instrument (stand-by letter of credit, bank guarantee or performance guarantee) that covers the full amount invested, stays in force until the unit is built, subdivided and registered in the investor's name, and is renewed and filed with MICI every year. Residence resting only on a promise of sale lasts at most three years in total (art. 7). If the developer fails to complete registration, the investor has 180 business days to move the money into another qualifying investment (art. 7).
offplan.text_zh: 可以，門檻 30 萬美元（第 7 條）。有兩種架構：一是把款項存入持照銀行或信託公司的信託帳戶，用於支付賣方；二是直接向建商支付全額價款。第二種須有銀行出具的不可撤銷、見索即付的保證文件（備用信用狀、銀行保證或履約保證），保額涵蓋全部投資金額，效期至物件完成興建、分割並登記於投資人名下為止，並須每年更新、提交商工部。僅憑買賣預約維持的居留身分，累計最長 3 年（第 7 條）。若因建商違約而未能完成登記，投資人有 180 個工作日改投其他合格投資（第 7 條）。

mortgage.text_en: Financing is allowed only for the part above the minimum. The qualifying net value is the lower of the price paid and the commercial value, minus the balance of any lien on the property, and a lien may not push that net value below US$300,000 (first sale) or US$500,000 (secondary market) (art. 5). In practice the investor needs at least the minimum amount in unencumbered equity.
mortgage.text_zh: 貸款只能用在超出門檻的部分。合格淨值是成交價與合理市價兩者中較低者，扣除物件上所有擔保債權餘額；扣除後不得低於門檻（首次銷售 30 萬美元、二手 50 萬美元）（第 5 條）。實際上，投資人至少要有等同門檻金額的無負擔自有資金。

dependants.text_en: Dependants may be included in the application. Government fees are US$1,000 to the Treasury plus a US$1,000 repatriation deposit for each dependant (art. 11). A spouse married, or a child born or adopted, after approval can be added later for the same US$1,000 plus US$1,000 (art. 17).
dependants.text_zh: 家屬可併入申請。每名家屬須繳 1,000 美元申請規費，另繳 1,000 美元遣返保證金（第 11 條）。核准後才結婚的配偶、才出生或收養的子女，可日後加入，費用同為 1,000 美元加 1,000 美元（第 17 條）。

entry_tax.text_en: Government fees for the main applicant are a US$5,000 application fee paid to the Treasury plus a US$5,000 repatriation deposit paid to the Migration Service (art. 11). Taxes and costs of buying the property itself were not examined.
entry_tax.text_zh: 主申請人的政府規費為 5,000 美元申請規費（繳國庫）加 5,000 美元遣返保證金（繳移民局）（第 11 條）。購置不動產本身的稅負與費用未查證。

last_change.text_en: Executive Decree 17 of 8 September 2026, published in Gaceta Oficial 30613 on 16 September 2026 and in force from promulgation, replaces Executive Decree 722 of 2020 and its amendments (109/2022 and 193/2024) in full (art. 20). It sets the real-estate minimum at US$300,000 for first-sale property and US$500,000 for secondary-market property. The decree sets no expiry date and no automatic reversion for the US$300,000 figure. MICI announced the decree on 21 September 2026. Applications already filed are decided under the rules in force when they were filed; investments and binding contracts completed before the decree can use the earlier rules if the application is filed within six months of entry into force (art. 19).

Decree 17 of 2026 sets no expiry date; US$500,000 applies only to secondary-market property, as a separate category. Law-firm articles dated before 16 September 2026 describe the replaced rules (property free of encumbrances; US$300,000 for all real estate). Earlier material tied an October 2026 date to a sunset clause in the 2022 decree (109/2022, art. 10), which has since been replaced; two of the replaced decrees (722 of 2020 and 193 of 2024) are themselves dated 15 October.

companion_requirements.text_en: Funds must come from abroad and be the applicant's own; gifts and other free transfers from third parties do not count towards the minimum (arts. 2 and 11). The investment must be held for at least five years, with annual proof filed with MICI (art. 12). Proof of the transfer from abroad is required (bank letter, foreign bank statement or notarised letter with a bank certificate).
companion_requirements.text_zh: 資金須來自境外且為申請人自有資金；贈與等第三人無償轉入的款項不計入門檻（第 2、11 條）。投資須持有至少 5 年，並每年向商工部提交證明（第 12 條）。須提供資金自境外匯入的證明（銀行函、境外銀行對帳單，或公證函加銀行證明）。

companion_requirements.text_en: A clean-criminal-record certificate (notarised or apostilled, valid roughly 6 months) is reported by the law firms. A medical certificate is mentioned by only a single source and does not clear the two-independent-source bar — not adopted.

programmes.programme: Temporary residence as Investor (Inversionista) under Ley N.º 9996 — real estate qualifies
programmes.programme_zh: 依第 9996 號法律取得投資人（Inversionista）臨時居留——不動產符合資格

min_value.basis: Reglamento a la Ley N.º 9996, hosted by the Dirección General de Migración y Extranjería, requiring a certification by an authorised public accountant demonstrating 'la inversión por un monto no inferior a ciento cincuenta mil dólares (US$ 150.000,00)'. IMPORTANT LIMITATION ON THIS CITATION: this wording was read from the search index of the PDF on migracion.go.cr, not from a full read of the document, which returned HTTP 403 to this environment. The figure is a verbatim quotation from a tier-1 document; the surrounding conditions are not.

term.text_en: ARTICULO 4 — a two-year period, renewable, with each renewal requiring proof that the qualifying investment has been maintained continuously since the permit was granted.
term.text_zh: 確立：第 4 條——兩年一期，可展延，每次展延前須證明投資自取得居留起持續維持不間斷。

stay.text_en: ARTICULO 5's exhaustive list of application requirements contains no minimum physical-presence requirement, corroborated by two independent tier-2 sources.
stay.text_zh: 確立為條文沉默：第 5 條窮盡列舉之申請要件清單中完全無最低居住天數規定，並經兩則獨立第二級來源佐證。

leads_to.text_en: Via two independent tier-2 sources (the Reglamento itself does not address this, as it falls under the general Immigration Law rather than this specific law): after 3 years of temporary residence, the holder may apply to convert to permanent residence under the general rule.
leads_to.text_zh: 透過兩則獨立第二級來源確立（本 Reglamento 本身未觸及，此點屬《移民法》一般規則，非本法特有）：臨時居留滿 3 年可依一般規則申請轉為永久居留。

ownership_form.text_en: Real estate is one of several qualifying asset classes, alongside registrable goods, shares, securities and productive projects. This categorisation is corroborated at tier 2/3 and matches the structure of Ley 9996, but the enumerating article was not read directly.
ownership_form.text_zh: 不動產為數種合格資產類別之一，與可登記財產、股份、有價證券及生產性專案並列。此一分類在二／三級來源獲得佐證，且與第 9996 號法律的架構相符，惟列舉條文未直接讀取。

offplan.text_en: Not addressed in what was read. Deliberately omitted.
offplan.text_zh: 所讀內容未處理。刻意略去。

mortgage.text_en: Art. 7(A)(1) requires real estate to be registered in the Registro Nacional in the name of a natural person (corporate ownership is not accepted), and immigration staff must independently verify the public Registro Nacional database; the regulation states verbatim 'No seran admitidas certificaciones notariales o de contador publico autorizado para demostrar la inversion a traves de bienes inmuebles' — notarial or CPA certifications are expressly not accepted for real estate, unlike other qualifying-asset categories (shares, securities), where such certifications are accepted. Real estate is thus more title-verification-based than other asset classes. Separately, a rule on mortgage-financed purchases: art. 7(A)(2) requires the down payment itself to be no less than US$150,000 — a financed buyer faces the same net threshold as a cash buyer; financing the balance above US$150,000 does not lower the qualifying amount.
mortgage.text_zh: 第 7(A)(1) 條要求不動產須以自然人名義登記於 Registro Nacional（不接受法人名義），移民局承辦人須自行查核 Registro Nacional 公開資料庫；法條明文『不得以公證人或會計師證明用於證明透過不動產之投資』——公證人或會計師證明對不動產明文不被接受，與其他合格資產類別（股份、有價證券，這些類別可接受此類證明）不同。不動產反而比其他資產類別更接近產權查核。另外，貸款購房規則：第 7(A)(2) 條要求頭期款本身不低於 15 萬美元——貸款購房者實際自付門檻與現金購房者相同，超過 15 萬美元之餘額用貸款支應並不會降低合格門檻。

dependants.text_en: ARTICULO 6 explicitly lists spouse, minor children, an adult child declared disabled, and an unmarried, economically-dependent, student child under 25. PARENTS ARE EXPLICITLY NOT INCLUDED — this corrects a conflicting tier-2 source that had claimed dependent parents could be included; the tier-1 statutory text is followed here.
dependants.text_zh: 確立：第 6 條明文列舉配偶、未成年子女、已宣告失能之成年子女、25 歲以下未婚且經濟依賴並在學之子女。明確不含父母——此點修正一則主張可納入受扶養父母的第二級來源，本記錄以第一級法條原文為準。

entry_tax.text_en: ARTICULO 5(2)(3) — government fees of US$50 (under Immigration Law art. 255) plus US$200 (art. 89), totalling US$250; a clean-criminal-record certificate (issued by the country of origin or of lawful residence in the past three years, apostilled/legalised) is also required.
entry_tax.text_zh: 確立：第 5 條第 2、3 項——政府規費 US$50（依《移民法》第 255 條）＋US$200（第 89 條），共 US$250；須附無犯罪紀錄證明（原籍國或近三年合法居留國核發，須認證／海牙認證）。

last_change.text_en: Ley N.º 9996 (Ley para la atracción de inversionistas, rentistas y pensionados) and its Reglamento, the copy consulted being hosted by the immigration authority under a 2025/10 path. Dentons noted in March 2023 that the investor sub-category requires investments 'no menores a US$150,000'. The date on which US$150,000 replaced the earlier US$200,000 was not verified and is not published.
last_change.text_zh: 第 9996 號法律（吸引投資人、年金生活者與退休人士法）及其施行細則，所查閱之版本由移民主管機關以 2025/10 路徑託管。Dentons 於 2023 年 3 月指出投資人子類別要求投資額「不低於 150,000 美元」。150,000 美元取代先前 200,000 美元的生效日期未查證，不予刊登。

Everything else about the programme — term, stay, dependants, whether real estate specifically is enumerated in the regulation as opposed to the parent Act, and whether the investment must be maintained — was NOT established, because the PDF returned HTTP 403 to a direct fetch and time did not permit a browser-rendered read. Confidence is medium for that reason alone, not because the threshold is doubtful. This entry deliberately publishes one number and almost nothing else.
programmes.notes_zh: 150,000 美元一數本身係自移民主管機關自家託管之施行細則逐字引錄，並由 Dentons 及數家哥斯大黎加事務所獨立佐證，故該數字紮實。該計畫的其餘一切——期限、居留要求、依親、不動產是否具體列舉於施行細則（而非母法）之中、以及投資是否須持續維持——皆未能確立，因為該 PDF 對直接抓取回傳 HTTP 403，時間亦不容許以瀏覽器渲染方式讀取。信心度列為 medium 純因於此，而非門檻本身有疑。本條刻意只刊登一個數字，其餘幾乎全部從缺。

companion_requirements.text_en: If investing through a trust (fideicomiso), only the trust SETTLOR (fideicomitente) — not the beneficiary — may apply under this sub-category (ARTICULO 4, final paragraph). A time-limited tax benefit exists: under ARTICULO 22, anyone who enjoyed import/property-transfer tax exemptions within the law's first 5 years (roughly July 2021-July 2026, a window that has now expired or is about to) must hold that asset for at least 10 years — this affects only the tax benefit, not the residence status itself, and is a reason for time-sensitivity if this article is ever cited going forward.
companion_requirements.text_zh: 若透過信託投資，僅信託委託人（fideicomitente，非受益人）可申請此居留子類別（第 4 條末段）。另有一項具時效性之稅務優惠：依第 22 條，若在法律生效首 5 年內（約 2021 年 7 月至 2026 年 7 月，此適用期現已屆滿或即將屆滿）曾享有進口／產權轉讓稅優惠，該資產須持有至少 10 年——此僅影響稅務優惠本身，不影響居留身分，惟日後引用本條時應注意其時效性。
