min_value.basis: PROPERTY DOES QUALIFY; THE THRESHOLD IS SET AS A MULTIPLE OF UMA, NOT AS A HEADLINE CURRENCY AMOUNT. Direct pdftotext extraction of the official Lineamientos Generales para la Expedicion de Visas (25 July 2025 edition, DOF-hosted) confirms the current text, Tramite 5(III)(f): 'un valor que exceda de NOVENTA Y UN MIL SETECIENTOS DIEZ dias en UMA' — the current threshold is 91,710 UMA-days, corroborated independently by the SRE Spain consulate page. The '40,000 UMA' figure that circulates (from a single tier-2 law firm plus a tier-3 real-estate site) is WRONG BY MORE THAN 2X and is not used. Using the 2026 UMA daily value of MXN$117.31 (effective 1 Feb 2026, DOF), 91,710 UMA-days converts to approximately MXN$10,758,500 — order of magnitude roughly USD 600,000-650,000 at informal exchange rates (this FX conversion is NOT tier-1 and is for orientation only). No headline USD/MXN figure is shown, because informally converted amounts should not be presented as statutory; the 91,710 figure itself is tier-1-sourced and is the reference figure.

term.text_en: This route grants Residencia Temporal (temporary residence), valid for 'no mas que 4 anos' — a ceiling, not a fixed term.
term.text_zh: 確立：本路徑核發臨時居留（Residencia Temporal），效期『不超過 4 年』——為效期上限，非固定年限。

stay.text_en: The SRE official temporary-residence-visa page nowhere states a minimum day-count requirement; the '180 days to 4 years' figure that appears on the page is the VISA VALIDITY RANGE, not a mandatory annual physical-presence rule.
stay.text_zh: 確立為條文沉默：SRE 官方臨時居留簽證頁面完全未提及最低居留天數要求；頁面所載『180 天至 4 年』為簽證效期範圍，非強制年度居留天數規定。

leads_to.text_en: NOT ESTABLISHED, but confirmed to be a genuine textual gap rather than a research failure: within the Lineamientos' Tramite 7 (permanent-residence visa) provisions, real estate is not listed as a direct qualifying route to permanent residence (that route is open only to retirees/pensioners or family-reunification cases). Whether temporary residence obtained on this real-estate ground can later convert to permanent residence under the general Immigration Law (rather than under the Lineamientos specifically) was checked and not resolved within this document.
leads_to.text_zh: 未查證，惟已確認為文本本身之真實缺口而非研究疏漏：《準則》第 7 項（永久居留簽證）規定中，不動產並未列為直接申請永久居留之合格路徑（該路徑僅開放退休人士／家庭團聚案例）。依本不動產事由取得之臨時居留，是否可另循《移民法》一般規則（非本準則本身）轉為永久居留，查、未能在本文件中解決。

ownership_form.text_en: CONFIRMED SILENT via full-text search, a stronger result than 'not researched': a full-text search of the 41-page Lineamientos for 'fideicomiso' returns exactly ONE occurrence, in a completely unrelated 'institutional invitation' clause elsewhere in the document — the real-estate provision itself does not mention it at all. Whether foreign ownership of coastal/border land via a bank trust (fideicomiso) satisfies the 'titular de bienes inmuebles' (real-estate title-holder) test is a genuine regulatory silence, confirmed by exhaustive search, not an unresearched gap.
ownership_form.text_zh: 透過全文檢索確認沉默，較『未研究』更確定：逐字檢索 41 頁《準則》全文『fideicomiso』一詞，僅出現一次，且落在文件中完全無關之『機構邀請』條款脈絡下——不動產條款本身完全未提及。透過銀行信託（fideicomiso）持有沿海／邊境土地是否符合『titular de bienes inmuebles』（不動產所有權人）測試，經窮盡檢索確認為真正的規範沉默，非未研究之缺口。

mortgage.text_en: A verbatim search of item (f) (the real-estate provision) in the full DOF-hosted Lineamientos text finds no occurrence of 'libre de gravamenes' or any encumbrance-related language. A single tier-2 source (DIAM) states the property must be unencumbered, but this cannot be corroborated in the tier-1 text and may be a conflation with another jurisdiction's rule (e.g. Panama, which does explicitly require this).

The threshold is 91,710 UMA-days, read from the official Lineamientos Generales para la Expedicion de Visas (25 July 2025 edition, Tramite 5(III)(f)); the earlier reading of 40,000 UMA is retired. companion_requirements.text_en: A notarised public deed (escritura publica) proving ownership is required. Beyond that, the real-estate provision itself imposes no other requirement (no supplementary financial proof, no income test — because the real-estate threshold is already an independent, high bar roughly 8x the general financial-solvency threshold of 11,460 UMA-days/12 months or 680 UMA-days/month over 6 months, under a SEPARATE clause, item (a) — this real-estate route should not be read as a substitute for the general financial-solvency test, it is a distinct and much higher bar). Reference note: the 2026 UMA daily value is MXN$117.31 (effective 1 Feb 2026, DOF) — see `min_value` for the resulting order-of-magnitude conversion.
companion_requirements.text_zh: 須以公證人出具之地契（escritura pública）證明不動產所有權。除此之外，不動產條款本身未列出其他必要條件（無財力補充證明、無收入測試——因不動產門檻本身已是獨立且高出約 8 倍於一般財力證明門檻〔第 a 款，11,460 UMA 天／近 12 個月，或月 680 UMA 天／近 6 個月〕的高門檻，本不動產路徑不應被理解為一般財力證明測試之替代方案，而是獨立且高出甚多的門檻）。參考備註：2026 年 UMA 日值為 MXN$117.31（2026/2/1 起生效，DOF 公告）——換算量級見 min_value 欄位。

programmes.programme: Real Estate Owner Residency, one of seven Premium Residency products (Premium Residency Permit Law, Royal Decree No. M/106, and its Implementing Regulations Art. 3–4)
programmes.programme_zh: 不動產持有人居留——優質居留制度七項產品之一（《優質居留許可法》Royal Decree No. M/106 及其實施條例第 3–4 條）

min_value.basis: Category 1 — full ownership or usufruct of an existing residential property (not land), unmortgaged. Category 2 — off-plan purchase at the same threshold, plus a deposit of not less than SAR 1,000,000 or 10% of the price (whichever is higher), developer must be REGA-approved. SAR pegged to USD at 3.75 (long-standing peg, not a floating-rate conversion). One-time fee SAR 4,000 for either category.

term.text_en: No standard fixed-term/renewal cycle is documented for this specific product, distinct from the separate one-year 'Renewable Residency' product. The governing document's own 'Term' section states renewal conditions are 'Not applicable' (§7.1) — read together with §10/§11, the permit's validity appears tied continuously to maintaining the qualifying ownership: if the property is sold, it must be replaced within 90 days, and an off-plan purchase must complete (title transfer) within 5 years — failing either triggers revocation. Whether a separate periodic renewal application is additionally required beyond maintaining ownership is not stated either way.
term.text_zh: 本產品未見標準的固定期限／續期週期規定，與另一項獨立的一年期「可續期居留」產品不同。治理文件本身「期限」一節載明續期條件「不適用」（第 7.1 節）——與第 10、11 節合看，許可效力似與持續持有合格不動產綁定：出售物件須於 90 天內替換，期房須於 5 年內完成過戶，未達成任一項即撤銷許可。除持續持有外，是否另需定期申請續期程序，兩種說法皆未見明文。

stay.text_en: No minimum physical presence in the Kingdom requirement found anywhere in the governing documents (Law, Regulations, or the product's own Detailed Conditions) — internally consistent with there being no permanent-conversion pathway to build toward (contrast Special Talent/Gifted products, which require 30 months' cumulative presence specifically to convert to permanent residency).
stay.text_zh: 母法、實施條例、本產品專屬詳細條件文件，皆未見任何境內最低停留天數要求——與本產品無轉永久居留路徑一事內部一致（相對照，特殊人才／傑出人士產品要求累計 30 個月停留以轉換為永久居留）。

leads_to.text_en: Explicitly and categorically excluded from converting to permanent residency. The product's Detailed Conditions document §7.2 ('Conditions for Obtaining the Permanent Premium Residency Permit for the Real Estate Owner Residency') states verbatim 'Not applicable' — not a partial exemption, an outright absence of any permanent-conversion pathway. Structurally corroborated: Implementing Regulations Art. 4(7) gives every one of the other four discretionary products (Special Talent, Gifted, Investor, Entrepreneur) an explicit permanent-conversion clause or grants permanent status outright; Real Estate alone has none.
leads_to.text_zh: 明文且絕對地排除轉換為永久居留。本產品「詳細條件與要求」文件第 7.2 節（「取得不動產居留產品之永久優質居留許可之條件」）逐字載明「不適用」——不是部分豁免，是完全沒有轉永久居留的路徑。結構上亦互相印證：實施條例第 4 條第 7 項為其餘四項自由裁量產品（特殊人才、傑出人士、投資人、企業家）逐一列出明確的轉永久條款或直接授予永久身分，唯獨不動產產品沒有。

ownership_form.text_en: Full ownership or usufruct right over a completed residential property (land does not qualify), unmortgaged before and after acquisition, located anywhere in the Kingdom except the cities of Mecca and Medina and designated border areas (Premium Residency Permit Law Art. 2(1)). Within Mecca/Medina, a separate mechanism permits usufruct — not ownership — for up to 99 years via a notarized deed. If sold, must be replaced with another qualifying property within 90 days or the permit is revoked.
ownership_form.text_zh: 須為已完工住宅不動產之完整所有權或用益權（土地不合格），取得前後皆不得有抵押，物件須位於王國境內、麥加與麥地那兩市及指定邊境地區以外（《優質居留許可法》第 2 條第 1 項）。麥加／麥地那境內另有獨立機制，允許以公證用益權契約持有（非所有權）最長 99 年。出售物件須於 90 天內替換為另一合格物件，否則許可撤銷。

offplan.text_en: Qualifies (Category 2), at the same SAR 4,000,000 threshold. Requires: a deposit of not less than SAR 1,000,000 or 10% of the purchase price (whichever is higher); the developer must be REGA-approved; the purchase must complete (full title transfer) within 5 years, or the permit is revoked.
offplan.text_zh: 合格（Category 2），門檻與既有物業相同，皆為 SAR 4,000,000。須：訂金不低於 SAR 1,000,000 或房價 10%（取高者）；開發商須經 REGA 核准；須於 5 年內完成過戶，否則許可撤銷。

mortgage.text_en: Cash only, both categories. Existing-property route: property 'shall not be mortgaged and shall not be mortgaged thereafter.' Off-plan route: 'shall not be purchased through mortgage financing... shall not be mortgaged after transfer of ownership.' No financing is permitted at any point in either category.
mortgage.text_zh: 兩類皆限現金，不得融資。既有物業路徑：「取得前不得有抵押，取得後亦不得抵押」。期房路徑：「不得以貸款融資方式購入……過戶後亦不得抵押」。兩類在任何時點皆不得使用融資／貸款。

dependants.text_en: Covered under the Premium Residency system's standard 'Family' definition applicable to all seven products: spouse, children under 25, and non-working parents. This is a general system-wide rule, not real-estate-specific — no product-specific variation was found.
dependants.text_zh: 適用優質居留制度七項產品共用之「家庭」定義：配偶、25 歲以下子女、無業父母。此為制度層級之一般規則，非不動產產品專屬——未見任何產品別差異。

entry_tax.text_en: Not established. The general Real Estate Transaction Tax (RETT, 5% on most transfers) and its interaction with foreign Premium Residency purchasers specifically has not been checked.
entry_tax.text_zh: 未能確立。一般性不動產交易稅（RETT，多數過戶適用 5%）及其與外籍優質居留購屋者之互動，尚未查核。

last_change.text_en: A separate general foreign-ownership law — Royal Decree No. M/14 ('Real Estate Ownership Law by Non-Saudis'), published 25 July 2025, in force roughly 180 days later (≈late January 2026, i.e. currently in force) — repeals the 2000-era foreign-ownership law and lets non-Saudis own real estate in zones designated by the Council of Ministers/REGA (Mecca/Medina restricted to Muslim natural persons under special conditions). Arab News (24 June 2026) and the National Law Review report that the Council of Ministers approved the Implementing Regulations and the designated geographic zones on 23 June 2026, and REGA has published a map of the permitted areas; the gazette text and the pr.gov.sa and REGA originals were not retrieved. This is a DIFFERENT legal instrument governing whether a foreigner may own the underlying asset at all, not the Premium Residency law itself, and the live product page (checked 2026-08) still shows the SAR 4,000,000 residency threshold unchanged.
last_change.text_zh: 另有一套與本居留產品不同的一般性外籍人士不動產所有權法——Royal Decree No. M/14（《非沙國籍人士不動產所有權法》），2025 年 7 月 25 日頒布，約 180 天後生效（即約 2026 年 1 月底，現已生效），取代 2000 年舊法，允許非沙國籍人士於部長會議／REGA 指定區域持有不動產（麥加／麥地那僅限穆斯林自然人依特別條件）。阿拉伯新聞（Arab News，2026 年 6 月 24 日）與 National Law Review 報導，部長會議已於 2026 年 6 月 23 日核准施行細則與指定地理區域，REGA 並公布了可購買區域地圖；公報原文與 pr.gov.sa、REGA 原件未取得。此為規範「外國人能否持有標的資產」之獨立法律工具，非優質居留法本身；查核當下（2026-08）產品頁 SAR 4,000,000 門檻仍維持不變。

short.term_en: Tied continuously to ownership; no defined renewal cycle documented
short.term_zh: 與持有物件持續綁定；未見明確續期週期規定
short.outcome_en: Renewable only — permanent conversion explicitly "Not applicable"
short.outcome_zh: 僅可續期——永久居留條款明文「不適用」
short.own_en: Existing property (cash, unmortgaged) or off-plan (REGA-approved developer, ≥10%/SAR 1M deposit); replace within 90 days if sold, complete off-plan within 5 years
short.own_zh: 既有物業（現金，不得抵押）或期房（開發商須經 REGA 核准，訂金≥10%或 SAR 100 萬）；出售須 90 天內替換，期房須 5 年內完成過戶

programmes.notes_en: Citation note: Implementing Regulations Art. 4(8) is the general empowering clause shared by all five discretionary Premium Residency products (confirmed by cross-checking the Special Talent product's own Detailed Conditions document, which cites the identical article for itself) — it is not a real-estate-specific substantive rule; the substantive SAR 4,000,000 rule lives in the product's own Detailed Conditions document. Revocation grounds are nine (a-i). The programme is one of seven Premium Residency products (Permanent; Renewable one-year; Special Talent; Gifted; Investor at SAR 7,000,000 in 'investment activities' — a separate product; Entrepreneur; Real Estate) — real estate ownership alone, at or above SAR 4,000,000, is sufficient and complete for this specific product, with no alternative qualifying assets bundled into it.
programmes.notes_zh: 引註說明：實施條例第 4 條第 8 項是五項自由裁量優質居留產品共用之授權條款（經交叉核對「特殊人才」產品自身之詳細條件文件、引用同一條號證實），非不動產專屬之實體規則；SAR 4,000,000 之實體規定載於本產品專屬之詳細條件文件本身。撤銷事由為九項（a–i）。本制度為優質居留七項產品之一（永久／可續期一年／特殊人才／傑出人士／投資人〔SAR 7,000,000『投資活動』，為另一獨立產品〕／企業家／不動產）——不動產所有權本身達 SAR 4,000,000 以上即已足夠且完整，不搭配其他可選資產。

companion_requirements.text_en: Health insurance required (Premium Residency Permit Law Art. 6(1)(b)) — a system-wide requirement, not real-estate-specific.
companion_requirements.text_zh: 須具備健康保險（《優質居留許可法》第 6 條第 1 項 b 款）——制度層級之一般要求，非不動產產品專屬。

companion_requirements.text_en: Proof of financial solvency (recent bank statement or other documents required by the Center) — a generic requirement, not a separate income test.
companion_requirements.text_zh: 須提出財力證明（近期銀行對帳單或中心要求之其他文件）——為一般性要求，非獨立之收入門檻測試。

companion_requirements.text_en: Clean criminal record required — system-wide KYC requirement across all seven products.
companion_requirements.text_zh: 須無犯罪紀錄——七項產品共用之基本 KYC 要求。

companion_requirements.text_en: One-time application/issuance fee SAR 4,000 (Implementing Regulations Art. 6 fee table).
companion_requirements.text_zh: 一次性申請／核發規費 SAR 4,000（實施條例第 6 條規費對照表）。

companion_requirements.text_en: If the qualifying property is sold, it must be replaced with another qualifying property within 90 days, or the permit is revoked.
companion_requirements.text_zh: 若出售合格物件，須於 90 天內替換為另一合格物件，否則許可撤銷。

companion_requirements.text_en: Off-plan purchases must complete (full title transfer) within 5 years, or the permit is revoked.
companion_requirements.text_zh: 期房須於 5 年內完成過戶，否則許可撤銷。

companion_requirements.text_en: No minimum physical presence in the Kingdom is required to maintain the permit.
companion_requirements.text_zh: 維持許可不須任何最低境內停留天數。

companion_requirements.text_en: Not established: whether any additional recurring fee applies beyond the one-time SAR 4,000 issuance fee.
companion_requirements.text_zh: 未能確立：除一次性 SAR 4,000 核發規費外，是否另有經常性費用。

programmes.programme: Citizenship by investment — real estate route (Nationality Law No. 26/1975 Art. 4bis, as amended by Law No. 28/2023; implemented via Prime Ministerial Decree No. 876/2023, amending Decree No. 3099/2019)
programmes.programme_zh: 投資入籍——不動產路徑（《國籍法》1975 年第 26 號法律第 4bis 條，經 2023 年第 28 號法律修正；並依 2023 年第 876 號總理令〔修正 2019 年第 3099 號總理令〕施行）

min_value.basis: One of four interchangeable investment routes under Nationality Law Art. 4bis, as most recently restructured by PM Decree 876/2023 (2023-03-02), amending base Decree 3099/2019 (2019-12-18, which set the real-estate threshold at USD 500,000): (1) real estate purchase >= USD 300,000; (2) investment-project capital injection USD 350,000 + USD 100,000 non-refundable; (3) a USD 500,000 deposit held 3 years; (4) a USD 250,000 non-refundable deposit. Funds must be transferred from abroad through Central Bank of Egypt channels, or proven to have entered Egypt via a customs port with customs certification.

term.text_en: Not a fixed 'permit term' — this route grants citizenship directly, not a renewable/temporary residence permit. What is time-bound is a POST-GRANT retention condition: per the original 2019 decree text (Decree 3099/2019, Article One, trailing paragraph), if the qualifying property is disposed of before 5 years have passed since acquisition, retention of the citizenship requires depositing the Route-4 amount (USD 250,000) — unless the property is transferred to the state without consideration. This is a conditional retention mechanism, not an outright prohibition on selling, and it applies to both the real-estate route and the investment-project route, not real estate alone. Whether this clause was carried forward unchanged into the current 876/2023-amended text was not directly confirmed — Decree 876/2023 replaced only the routes-enumeration paragraph, and the retention clause is a separate, later paragraph structurally unaffected by that amendment, so its survival is a reasoned inference, not a re-confirmed current text.
term.text_zh: 非固定的「許可期限」——本路徑直接授予公民身分，非可續期／臨時居留許可。真正與時間掛鉤的是一項**核准後之保留條件**：依原始 2019 年第 3099 號總理令（第一條後段）原文，若合格物件於取得後未滿 5 年即處分，欲保留公民身分須另存入第（4）項金額（25 萬美元）——除非該物業係無償轉予國家。此為條件式保留機制，非絕對禁止出售，且同時適用於不動產與投資項目兩條路徑，非不動產專屬。此條款是否原封不動延續進現行 876/2023 修正後文本，尚未直接重新確認——876/2023 僅取代「路徑列舉」該段，保留條款屬結構上獨立之後段，理論上不受該次修正影響，惟此為合理推論，非重新確認之現行文本。

stay.text_en: Confirmed absent. GAFI's own official program page states no residency-period requirement is imposed on the applicant (unlike programmes requiring years of prior residence) — the applicant receives a 6-month temporary residence permit solely to execute the chosen investment, after which citizenship is granted directly by Prime Ministerial decision, typically within 3-6 months of application.
stay.text_zh: 已確認不存在。GAFI 官方頁明文不對申請人設居留期間要求（有別於須先居留數年之其他制度）——申請人僅取得 6 個月臨時居留以完成所選投資，其後由總理決定直接授予公民身分，一般於申請後約 3–6 個月內完成。

leads_to.text_en: Citizenship (naturalization), not residency — confirmed verbatim on GAFI's official English program page: 'Egyptian citizenship is granted to the investor and their minor children up to the age of 21, by decision of the Prime Minister,' mirrored identically on GAFI's Arabic page. Textually anchored in the Nationality Law itself: Art. 4bis governs the naturalization application (طلب التجنس), administered by the Naturalization Application Examination Unit affiliated with the Prime Minister's Office (GAFI merely hosts an intake office). Grant is direct, with no additional residence-period requirement layered on top.
leads_to.text_zh: 入籍（歸化），非居留——GAFI 官方英文頁逐字確認：「Egyptian citizenship is granted to the investor and their minor children up to the age of 21, by decision of the Prime Minister」，阿拉伯文版內容一致。法條文字本身亦錨定於此：《國籍法》第 4bis 條規範「歸化申請」，由隸屬總理府之「歸化申請審查小組」主管（GAFI 僅代為受理）。核准為直接授予，不另外疊加居留年限要求。

ownership_form.text_en: UNRESOLVED TENSION between decree-level and law-level text — stated here as unresolved. The most recent Prime Ministerial decree found (876/2023) still states the real-estate route requires property 'owned by the state or other public legal persons' — i.e. only property acquired FROM a state/public-sector seller, not any privately-owned real estate. But the parent statute (Nationality Law Art. 4bis, as amended by Law No. 28/2023, enacted two months after Decree 876/2023) deletes that qualifier. No decree-level text conforming 876/2023's wording to the broadened law-level definition was found. GAFI's own official page currently describes the route simply as 'purchasing real estate,' with no state-ownership qualifier, suggesting the programme operates in practice on the broadened law-level definition — but this is inference from an official summary page, not a directly confirmed current decree text.
ownership_form.text_zh: **總理令層級與法律層級文本存在未解決之張力，此處特別標示**。現行可查得之最新總理令（876/2023）字面上仍要求不動產路徑須為「國家或其他公法人所有」之物業——即僅限向公部門賣方購買，非任何私人物業。但母法（《國籍法》第 4bis 條，經 876/2023 兩個月後生效之第 28/2023 號法律修正）已刪除此限定語。未能找到任何將 876/2023 文字更新至與母法一致之後續總理令。GAFI 官方頁本身將此路徑簡述為「購買不動產」，未附加限國有之限定語，暗示實務上已依母法放寬版本運作——但這是從官方摘要頁推論，非直接確認之現行總理令文本。

offplan.text_en: Not established. No source reached addressed whether an off-plan/pre-completion real estate purchase qualifies for this route, as distinct from a completed, titled property.
offplan.text_zh: 未能確立。未見任何來源觸及期房／未完工不動產是否合格於本路徑，或是否須為已完工、已取得產權之物件。

mortgage.text_en: Not established specifically for domestic financing/mortgage arrangements. What is confirmed: the qualifying USD 300,000 must be transferred from abroad through Central Bank of Egypt channels, OR proven to have physically entered Egypt via a customs port with customs certification — this governs the SOURCE of funds, not whether local Egyptian mortgage financing may cover part of the purchase price.
mortgage.text_zh: 本地融資／貸款安排未能確立。已確認者：達標所需之 30 萬美元須透過埃及中央銀行管道自境外匯入，或經海關查驗證明實體入境——此規範資金**來源**，非物業價金是否得以埃及本地房貸支應部分金額。

dependants.text_en: Minor children up to age 21 are covered (GAFI's official page; Law No. 28/2023 also addresses minor children's nationality-inheritance/election rules). Spouse coverage was not confirmed in any source reached — this is a gap in the record, not a confirmed absence.
dependants.text_zh: 涵蓋 21 歲以下未成年子女（GAFI 官方頁；第 28/2023 號法律亦處理未成年子女國籍隨同／選擇規則）。配偶是否納入，未於任何來源中確認——屬記錄缺口，非已確認之排除。

entry_tax.text_en: Not established. Egypt's general property-transfer tax/registration fee regime, independent of this citizenship programme's own USD 10,000 application fee, was not checked.
entry_tax.text_zh: 未能確立。埃及一般性不動產過戶稅／登記費制度（與本入籍制度自身之 1 萬美元申請規費為兩件事），尚未查核。

last_change.text_en: Most recent instrument found: Law No. 28/2023 (signed by President El-Sisi, Official Gazette Issue 20 bis(د), 2023-05-21), amending the base Nationality Law itself, not merely an implementing decree — removes the 'state/public-legal-person-owned property only' restriction from the real-estate route, and re-confirms the USD 10,000 application fee at statute level. No later decree or law (2024, 2025, or 2026) touching this programme was found, despite a dedicated search of the gazette mirror's document-relations trees for both the base decree and the base law — but that index is demonstrably incomplete (it does not even list Law 28/2023 itself under the base law's amendment history), so this is an unfound negative, not a confirmed one. NOTE: a 'Decree No. 3562/2023, Gazette Issue 37(مكرر), dated 2023-09-18' cited as the instrument removing the state-ownership restriction could not be located anywhere by number, by date, or in either instrument's amendment-relations tree. The substantive change it described is real and confirmed; the actual instrument achieving it is Law No. 28/2023 (a presidential-signed statute) — different instrument type, date, and issuing authority than previously cited.
last_change.text_zh: 已查得之最新法源：**第 28/2023 號法律**（總統 El-Sisi 簽署，公報第 20 期續篇（د），2023-05-21），修正《國籍法》母法本身，非僅為施行令——刪除不動產路徑「限國家或公法人所有物業」之限制，並於法律層級重新確認 1 萬美元申請規費。窮盡搜尋公報鏡像站之修正關係樹（涵蓋原始總理令與母法兩者），未見任何 2024、2025 或 2026 年後續修法——惟該索引經證實不完整（連第 28/2023 號法律本身都未列於母法修正歷史中），故此為「未查得」而非「已確認查無」。坊間流傳之「2023 年第 3562 號總理令，公報第 37 期（مكرر），2023-09-18」，以文號、日期、及兩份法源各自之修正關係樹逐一核對，皆查無此文號，與現制不符。實際刪除限國有物業限制之法源是第 28/2023 號法律（總統簽署之法律，非總理令）——法源類型、日期、簽署機關均不同於坊間流傳版本。

programmes.notes_en: TWO POINTS ON SOURCING: (1) A commonly cited 'Decree No. 3562/2023' could not be located under that number/date in the gazette mirror's index. The instrument that actually removed the state-ownership restriction is Law No. 28/2023 (a presidential-signed amendment to the Nationality Law itself, Official Gazette Issue 20 bis, 2023-05-21), not a Prime Ministerial decree. (2) The '5-year disposal lock' is not an outright prohibition on selling — it is a conditional citizenship-retention clause: sell before 5 years and citizenship remains valid only if the USD 250,000 Route-4 amount is then deposited (or the property is given to the state for free); this clause applies to the investment-project route as well, not real estate alone. (3) 'cc.gov.eg' resolves to Egypt's Court of Cassation, not the Supreme Constitutional Court as previously described (does not affect substantive findings). route_type is property_one_of_several: real estate is one of four interchangeable investment options under the same citizenship programme. An unresolved tension exists between the most recent decree-level text (876/2023, still says state-owned property only) and the law-level text (Law 28/2023, removes that restriction) — see ownership_form; it cannot be assumed unconditionally that any privately-owned property qualifies. Spouse coverage (as opposed to minor children) was not confirmed. No Tier 2 secondary-source corroboration (law firm, Big 4, international press) has been obtained, because search for this niche topic returned nothing usable — the entry rests on Tier 1 primary-source text (three Official Gazette instruments read directly, plus GAFI's own official page in English and Arabic) without independent secondary corroboration. This absence should be disclosed if a stricter dual-source standard is later applied.
programmes.notes_zh: 查證中有兩點須特別說明：（一）坊間流傳之「2023 年第 3562 號總理令」，於公報鏡像站索引中以文號、日期皆查無此文號。實際刪除限國有物業限制之法源，是**第 28/2023 號法律**（總統簽署之《國籍法》母法修正案，公報第 20 期續篇，2023-05-21），非總理令。（二）「五年處分鎖定」並非絕對禁止出售——實為條件式公民身分保留條款：五年內出售，仍可保留公民身分，惟須另存入第（4）項之 25 萬美元（或無償轉予國家）；此條款同時適用於投資項目路徑，非不動產專屬。（三）「cc.gov.eg」實際指向埃及最高上訴法院，而非最高憲法法院（不影響實質結論）。`route_type` 為 property_one_of_several：不動產僅為同一入籍制度下四種可互換投資選項之一。最新總理令層級文本（876/2023，仍寫限國有物業）與母法層級文本（第 28/2023 號法律，已刪除該限制）之間存在未解決之張力——見 `ownership_form` 欄位；不應無條件斷言任何私人物業皆合格。配偶（相對於未成年子女）是否納入配套未經確認。因針對此冷門主題的搜尋未得到可用結果，未取得任何 Tier 2 次級來源交叉佐證——本筆係基於 Tier 1 一手文本（三份官方公報原文＋GAFI 官方頁英阿雙語版）獨立支撐，未經第二來源交叉確認。若日後套用更嚴格之雙重來源標準，應揭露此點。

programmes.programme: Real estate investor residence (RN 36/2018, as amended by RN 46/2021 and RN 49/2024)

min_value.basis: General threshold, urban real estate only (built or under construction; Art. 2 caput). May aggregate multiple properties to reach the threshold (Art. 2 §2). Co-ownership permitted but each co-owner must individually invest the full threshold (Art. 3 §1).

extra_tiers.label_en: North and Northeast regions — the minimum investment value may be reduced by up to 30% below the standard threshold (Art. 2 §1: "o valor mínimo do investimento poderá ser inferior até 30% do total"), i.e. a floor of BRL 700,000, not a separate/conflicting figure.
extra_tiers.label_zh: 北部與東北部地區——投資最低金額得低於一般門檻至多 30%（第 2 條第 1 項），即地板值 BRL 700,000，並非另一個互相矛盾的數字。

term.text_en: 4 years, fixed (Art. 3 §4 / Art. 4). If the investor misses the 14-day/2-year stay requirement or the conversion-application window, a fresh 4-year temporary term may be requested instead, provided the investment is still held (Art. 6-A).
term.text_zh: 4 年固定期限（第 3 條第 4 項／第 4 條）。若錯過「14 天／2 年」停留規定或轉換申請窗口，得於投資仍維持之前提下重新申請一次 4 年期臨時居留（第 6-A 條）。

stay.text_en: Minimum 14 days (continuous or split) per every rolling 2-year period, counted from Polícia Federal registration (Art. 6). Meeting this blocks the standard residency-abandonment clause.
stay.text_zh: 自聯邦警察局登記起算，每 2 年須累計在境內停留至少 14 天（可分次，第 6 條）。符合此規定可避免適用一般的居留放棄條款。

leads_to.text_en: After the 4-year term, the permit MAY be converted to indefinite residence (Art. 5) — NOT automatic. Requires: proof the Art. 2 investment conditions are still maintained, a copy of the migrant registration card (CRNM), and clean criminal-record certificates covering the temporary-residence period. The investment must continue to be maintained even after conversion — ceasing to hold it at any point (fixed-term or indefinite) is cause for loss of status (Art. 6-B).
leads_to.text_zh: 4 年期滿後「得」轉換為無限期居留（第 5 條）——非自動轉換。須提交：投資條件仍維持之證明、外僑登記卡（CRNM）副本、居留期間之無犯罪紀錄證明。即使轉為無限期後，投資仍須持續維持——任何時點（固定期或無限期）不再持有投資即構成喪失居留身分之事由（第 6-B 條）。

ownership_form.text_en: Urban real estate only (rural land does not qualify, Art. 2 caput). Multiple properties may be aggregated (Art. 2 §2). Co-ownership permitted, but each co-owner must individually invest the full threshold (Art. 3 §1).
ownership_form.text_zh: 限都市不動產（農村土地不合格，第 2 條）。得合併多筆物件達標（第 2 條第 2 項）。允許共有，惟每位共有人須個別達到完整門檻金額（第 3 條第 1 項）。

offplan.text_en: Qualifies. Accepted with a registered Promessa de Compra e Venda (purchase-and-sale promise), a construction permit (Alvará de Construção), and a registered Memorial de Incorporação (Art. 3 II).
offplan.text_zh: 預售╱在建物件合格。須備已登記之「購售預約」（Promessa de Compra e Venda）、建照（Alvará de Construção）、已登記之「分割設立備忘錄」（Memorial de Incorporação）（第 3 條第 2 項）。

mortgage.text_en: Financing/mortgage is allowed only on the portion of the price exceeding BRL 1,000,000 — the qualifying minimum itself must come from the investor's own external-origin funds and cannot be financed (Art. 3 §2).
mortgage.text_zh: 僅超過 BRL 1,000,000 之部分得以融資／貸款支應——達標所需之門檻金額本身須為投資人自有之境外來源資金，不得融資（第 3 條第 2 項）。

last_change.text_en: Amended twice since original 2018 text: RN 46/2021 (9 Dec 2021) and RN 49/2024 (25 Jun 2024), both confirmed as amendments (not replacements) via the Ministry's own current resolutions index; no resolution newer than RN 49/2024 touches RN 36/2018, per the ministry's own listing page (checked 2026-08-02) — this is not an exhaustive news search, and a live search-engine sweep for any 2025/2026 amending announcement has not been run.

programmes.notes_en: Dedicated real-estate resolution (property_is_route), not a sub-option of a broader investor visa. Ongoing-maintenance condition (Art. 6-B) means there is no stated safe harbor for selling after N years — losing the underlying investment at any point risks loss of status, even post-conversion to indefinite residence. Funds must be transferred via a bank authorized/registered with the Banco Central do Brasil (Art. 3 I-b, II-b) — a hard documentary requirement. Government reserves the right to conduct on-site inspection of the investment (Art. 3 §3). Providing false or omitted information triggers a cancellation process (Art. 6-C). Health insurance and application fees were not found in RN 36/2018 itself and may exist under general immigration law (Decree 9.199/2017) — not checked, do not assume either way.
programmes.notes_zh: 本決議為專屬不動產投資之獨立法源（非附屬於更廣泛投資人簽證下的其中一款）。持續維持條件（第 6-B 條）意味著法條並未明訂「持有滿 N 年後即可自由出售」的安全期——任何時點失去該投資標的均有喪失居留身分之風險，即使已轉為無限期居留亦然。資金須經巴西中央銀行核准／登記之銀行辦理跨境匯款（第 3 條第 1 項 b 款、第 2 項 b 款）——此為硬性文件要求。政府保留對投資標的進行實地查核之權利（第 3 條第 3 項）。提供不實或隱匿資訊將啟動撤銷程序（第 6-C 條）。健康保險與申請規費未見於 RN 36/2018 本文，可能規範於一般移民法規（2017 年第 9,199 號行政命令）內，未查證，不應假設有或沒有。

companion_requirements.text_zh: 持續性條件：任何時點（固定期間內或轉為無限期後）不再符合投資條件，均構成喪失居留身分之事由（第 6-B 條）。

min_value.basis: 100x Salario Básico Unificado (SBU). Ecuador is dollarised, so the SBU and this threshold are already denominated in USD, not a converted figure. The '100 SBU' rule and the requirement that the deed be registered at the cantonal Property Registry are tier 1 (gob.ec). The 2026 SBU value itself (USD 482/month, per Acuerdo Ministerial MDT-2025-195) rests on five-plus agreeing tier-2/3 sources, not on the primary decree text (attempted fetch returned a corrupted file).

term.text_en: 2 years, renewable, multiple entries permitted, no time limit on stays abroad.
term.text_zh: 2 年，可續期，多次入境，境外停留天數無上限。

stay.text_en: Not established. No explicit minimum-stay-in-Ecuador requirement was found for maintaining or renewing this temporary visa category itself — distinct from the general 21-month continuous-residence rule needed to CONVERT to permanent residence (see leads_to), which is a behavioral requirement for conversion, not a renewal requirement for the temporary status.
stay.text_zh: 未能確立。本簽證類別本身之續簽╱維持並未見任何明確的境內停留天數要求——這與「轉永久居留」所需之連續 21 個月居留規則（見 leads_to）不同，後者是轉換的行為要件，非臨時身分續簽的條件。

leads_to.text_en: General LOMH rule (applies to any temporary-residence category, not specific to this one): 21 continuous months of ACTUAL temporary residence status permits application for permanent residence. Requires genuine residence behavior, not passive investment-holding — an investor who buys property but does not actually live in Ecuador would not satisfy this and would simply keep renewing the 2-year temporary visa.
leads_to.text_zh: 《人口流動組織法》一般規則（適用於所有臨時居留類別，非本簽證專屬）：連續 21 個月之「實際」臨時居留身分，即可申請轉永久居留。須有真實居住行為，非被動持有投資即可——僅購置不動產但未實際居住於厄瓜多者，無法滿足此條件，只能持續續簽 2 年期臨時簽證。

ownership_form.text_en: Notarized deed (escritura de compraventa) registered at the cantonal Property Registry (Registro de la Propiedad) — registration is the qualifying event.
ownership_form.text_zh: 已公證之購售契據（escritura de compraventa），須於所在市（canton）之不動產登記處完成登記——登記本身即為達標事件。

programmes.notes_en: IMPORTANT: this is NOT a dedicated real-estate investor visa. The official category is a general 'Inversionista' temporary residence visa with FOUR interchangeable qualifying investment types (bank deposit ≥730 days, real estate, company equity, government investment contract), each independently sufficient at 100 SBU. Presenting this as a real-estate-specific visa would misrepresent the underlying legal structure. Application fees: USD 50 + USD 270 issuance (50% discount age 65+, full exemption for ≥30% disability) — tier 1. Requires an apostilled criminal background certificate covering country of origin plus any country resided in during the last 5 years (180-day validity window), plus separate proof of lawful income under Acuerdo Ministerial No. 70 (2024-06-28) layered on top of the investment itself — tier 1.

finding.text_en: CONFIRMED STILL ABOLISHED. The real-estate routes to the Golden Visa (ARI) were closed to new applications by Lei n.º 56/2023 ('Mais Habitação'), published in Diário da República n.º 194/2023, Série I, on 6 October 2023 and in force 7 October 2023 (art. 55.º: 'A presente lei entra em vigor no dia seguinte ao da sua publicação'). MECHANISM: Lei 56/2023 did NOT amend art. 90.º-A of Lei 23/2007 — it leaves 90.º-A textually intact and instead imposes a standalone prohibition in art. 42.º, which provides that no new applications are admitted under subalíneas i), iii) and iv) of alínea d) of n.º 1 of art. 3.º of Lei 23/2007. Existing permits may still be RENEWED under the prior regime, family reunification is preserved, permanent ARI remains available to existing holders meeting art. 80.º, and renewals convert into an 'autorização de residência para imigrantes empreendedores' under art. 89.º n.º 4 with a minimum stay of 7 days in year one and 14 days in each subsequent two-year period. NO RESTORATION: AIMA's current official ARI page lists only subalíneas ii (10 jobs), v (EUR 500,000 research), vi (EUR 250,000 cultural heritage), vii (EUR 500,000 into Portuguese collective investment undertakings, expressly 'não imobiliários'), and viii (EUR 500,000 company incorporation with jobs). Subalíneas i, iii and iv are absent, and the only occurrence of 'imobiliári*' on the page is the express exclusion in category vii.
finding.text_zh: 確認仍為廢止狀態。黃金簽證（ARI）之不動產途徑經第 56/2023 號《更多住房法》關閉，該法於 2023 年 10 月 6 日刊登於《共和國公報》第 194/2023 號第一輯，2023 年 10 月 7 日生效（第 55 條：「本法自公布之翌日起施行」）。機制：第 56/2023 號法律並未修正第 23/2007 號法律第 90-A 條——該條文義維持不變，而係於第 42 條另設獨立禁止規定，明定自本法生效日起不再受理依第 23/2007 號法律第 3 條第 1 項第 d 款第 i、iii、iv 目提出之新申請。既有許可仍得依舊制續期，家庭團聚獲保留，符合第 80 條之既有持有人仍可取得永久 ARI，且續期將轉換為第 89 條第 4 項之「創業移民居留許可」，最低居留為第一年 7 日、其後每 2 年期間各 14 日。並未恢復：AIMA 現行官方 ARI 頁面僅列第 ii 目（創造 10 個就業機會）、第 v 目（50 萬歐元研究）、第 vi 目（25 萬歐元文化資產）、第 vii 目（50 萬歐元投入葡萄牙集合投資機構，並明文限「非不動產類」）及第 viii 目（50 萬歐元設立公司並創造就業）。第 i、iii、iv 目均已不存在，該頁面唯一出現「不動產」字樣之處即為第 vii 目之明文排除。

finding.text_en: CONFIRMED ABOLISHED, and the repealing provision is now pinned. Ley Orgánica 1/2025, de 2 de enero, de medidas en materia de eficiencia del Servicio Público de Justicia, published in BOE núm. 3 on 3 JANUARY 2025 (not 6 January, as one tier-2 source states), entered into force 3 April 2025. The operative provision is DISPOSICIÓN FINAL VIGESIMOPRIMERA, sub-paragraph Uno: 'Se dejan sin contenido los artículos 63, 64, 65, 66 y 67' of Ley 14/2013. The BOE consolidated text of Ley 14/2013 now shows all five articles as '(Sin contenido)', each carrying the note 'Se deja sin contenido, con efectos de 3 de abril de 2025, por la disposición final 21.1 de la Ley Orgánica 1/2025, de 2 de enero'. The emptied articles are 63 investor residence visa, 64 form of proof of investment, 65 effects of the investor residence visa, 66 investor residence authorisation, 67 duration of the investor residence authorisation. ALL investor categories were eliminated, not only real estate — property, public debt, shares, funds, bank deposits and business projects. TRANSITIONAL PROTECTION is written into the same disposición final: applications filed before entry into force are decided under the rules in force at filing, and visas and authorisations valid at entry into force keep their validity for their stated term, with renewals processed under the rules in force when the initial authorisation was granted.
finding.text_zh: 確認廢止，且廢止條款已鎖定。2025 年 1 月 2 日第 1/2025 號組織法《司法公共服務效能措施法》於 2025 年 1 月 3 日刊登於《官方公報》第 3 號（非某第二級來源所稱之 1 月 6 日），2025 年 4 月 3 日生效。關鍵條款為第 21 附則第 1 目：「第 14/2013 號法律第 63、64、65、66、67 條刪除內容」。《官方公報》第 14/2013 號法律彙編版現將該五條均標示為「（無內容）」，並各附註記「依 2025 年 1 月 2 日第 1/2025 號組織法第 21 附則第 1 目，自 2025 年 4 月 3 日起刪除內容」。遭刪除之條文為：第 63 條投資人居留簽證、第 64 條投資證明方式、第 65 條投資人居留簽證之效力、第 66 條投資人居留授權、第 67 條投資人居留授權之期間。所有投資類別均遭取消，不限於不動產——尚包括公債、股份、基金、銀行存款及營運計畫。同一附則並明定過渡保障：生效前提出之申請依提出時之法規審定；生效時有效之簽證與授權於其所載期間內維持效力，續期則依原授權核准時之法規辦理。

negatives.short_en: Investor citizenship closed after CJEU Case C-181/23; naturalisation is now by merit only. The MPRP residence programme is a separate instrument and remains open.
negatives.short_zh: 投資入籍於歐盟法院第 C-181/23 號判決後關閉，歸化改為僅限功績類。MPRP 居留計畫屬另一法令，仍然開放。

finding.text_en: CLOSED — the EUR 700,000 property component and the EUR 600,000/EUR 750,000 contribution are not a live programme. On 29 April 2025 the CJEU (Grand Chamber) in Case C-181/23, Commission v Malta, held that the 2020 investor citizenship scheme 'amounts to the commercialisation of the grant of the nationality of a Member State and, by extension, of Union citizenship', infringing art. 20 TFEU and art. 4(3) TEU. Malta responded with Act No. XXI of 2025, the Maltese Citizenship (Amendment) Act, passed by the House on 23 July 2025 and assented on 24 JULY 2025. That Act substituted art. 10(9) of the Maltese Citizenship Act so that naturalisation is now available only 'by merit' — for 'a person who renders exceptional services or who makes an exceptional contribution, including through job creation', defined by reference to scientists, researchers, athletes, artists, cultural performers, entrepreneurs, philanthropists and technologists. The direct-investment limb is gone; the definition 'individual investor programme' was deleted from art. 2; and the Regulator's remit was re-scoped to naturalisation on the basis of merit. Applications filed under the old art. 10(9) BEFORE the Act came into force continue under the old rules. RESIDUAL GAP, stated honestly: no Legal Notice formally repealing L.N. 437 of 2020 itself was located — its enabling provision was substituted, which removes its legal basis, so the safe formulation is 'the enabling provision was replaced by Act XXI of 2025', not 'L.N. 437 of 2020 was repealed by X'.
finding.text_zh: 已關閉——70 萬歐元之不動產部分與 60 萬／75 萬歐元捐獻均非現行計畫。2025 年 4 月 29 日，歐盟法院大法庭於 C-181/23 號執委會訴馬爾他案判決，認 2020 年投資入籍制度「構成會員國國籍、進而歐盟公民身分之商品化」，違反《歐盟運作條約》第 20 條與《歐盟條約》第 4 條第 3 項。馬爾他以 2025 年第 XXI 號《馬爾他公民身分（修正）法》回應，該法於 2025 年 7 月 23 日經眾議院通過，2025 年 7 月 24 日獲同意。該法替換《馬爾他公民身分法》第 10 條第 9 項，使歸化僅限「憑功績」——即「提供卓越服務或作出卓越貢獻（含創造就業）之人」，並以科學家、研究人員、運動員、藝術家、文化表演者、企業家、慈善家與技術專才為例示。直接投資分支已刪除；第 2 條中「個人投資者計畫」之定義遭刪；監理機關職權亦重新界定為憑功績之歸化。於該法生效前依舊第 10 條第 9 項提出之申請仍依舊制辦理。誠實揭露之殘餘缺口：未查得正式廢止 2020 年第 437 號法律公告本身之法律公告——其授權條款已遭替換，法源因而消滅，故穩健之表述為「授權條款已由 2025 年第 XXI 號法律取代」，而非「2020 年第 437 號公告經 X 廢止」。

negatives.short_en: The Investor Visa list of qualifying investments is closed and exhaustive, and property appears nowhere in it.

finding.text_en: REAL ESTATE IS EXCLUDED BY DESIGN. Art. 26-bis of Legislative Decree 286/1998 (introduced by Law 232/2016) sets out a CLOSED, EXHAUSTIVE list of qualifying investments for the Investor Visa, and property appears nowhere in it: (a) at least EUR 2,000,000 in Italian government securities held at least 2 years; (b) at least EUR 500,000 in capital instruments of a company OR A VENTURE CAPITAL FUND constituted and operating in Italy, held at least 2 years, reduced to at least EUR 250,000 where the company is a registered innovative start-up; (c) a philanthropic donation of at least EUR 1,000,000 to a public-interest project in culture, education, immigration management, scientific research or restoration of cultural or landscape assets. Two precision points: the EUR 250,000 start-up figure is a SUB-CASE of letter (b), not a separate lettera — the statute has three letters, not four; and letter (b) also covers a venture capital fund, which the official portal's summary omits. The separate elective residence visa (visto per residenza elettiva) is a distinct national type-D category listed separately from 'INVESTITORI' on the official MAECI visa portal; property purchase is not a qualifying investment under it and does not itself confer residence. URL NOTE: investorvisa.esteri.it DOES NOT RESOLVE — the live portal is investorvisa.mise.gov.it, rebranded to MIMIT only in the page furniture. Also of note: the programme is suspended for Russian and Belarusian citizens by Committee Chair order of 14 July 2023, extended on 20 March 2024 to dual nationals holding a Russian or Belarusian passport.
finding.text_zh: 不動產係經制度設計而排除。第 286/1998 號立法命令第 26-bis 條（由第 232/2016 號法律引入）就投資人簽證訂有封閉且窮盡之合格投資清單，其中完全不含不動產：（a）義大利政府債券至少 200 萬歐元，持有至少 2 年；（b）在義大利設立並營運之公司或創投基金之資本工具至少 50 萬歐元，持有至少 2 年，若該公司為登記在案之創新新創企業則降為至少 25 萬歐元；（c）就文化、教育、移民管理、科學研究或文化與景觀資產修復之公益計畫捐贈至少 100 萬歐元。兩點精確說明：25 萬歐元之新創數字係第（b）款之次類型而非獨立款項，法條為三款而非四款；第（b）款並涵蓋創投基金，官方入口網站之摘要漏未提及。另一套「選擇性居留簽證」（visto per residenza elettiva）在外交部官方簽證入口網站中係與「投資人」並列之獨立 D 類國家簽證類別，購置不動產並非其合格投資，本身亦不賦予居留權。網址備註：investorvisa.esteri.it 無法解析，現行入口網站為 investorvisa.mise.gov.it，僅頁面外觀改為 MIMIT 品牌。另須註記：依 2023 年 7 月 14 日委員會主席令，該計畫對俄羅斯與白俄羅斯公民停止適用，並於 2024 年 3 月 20 日擴及持有俄羅斯或白俄羅斯護照之雙重國籍者。

negatives.short_en: The Immigrant Investor Programme closed to new applications on 15 February 2023, and property was never a qualifying investment in its own right.
negatives.short_zh: 投資移民計畫於 2023 年 2 月 15 日停止受理新申請，且不動產從未單獨構成合格投資。

finding.text_en: IIP CLOSED, AND PROPERTY WAS NEVER A QUALIFYING INVESTMENT IN ITS OWN RIGHT. Minister for Justice Simon Harris TD obtained Government approval and announced closure of the Immigrant Investor Programme to further applications from close of business on 15 FEBRUARY 2023; the announcement itself was made on 14 February 2023. Existing applications on hand continued to be processed and approved projects were unaffected; the Start-up Entrepreneur Programme continues. The four options at closure were: Enterprise Investment, minimum EUR 1 million in an Irish enterprise for at least 3 years; Investment Fund, minimum EUR 1 million in a Central Bank-approved and regulated fund for at least 3 years; Real Estate Investment Trusts, minimum EUR 2 million in an Irish REIT listed on the Irish Stock Exchange for at least 3 years; and Endowment, minimum EUR 500,000 philanthropic donation, reduced to EUR 400,000 where five or more applications were received. Applicants also needed personal wealth of at least EUR 2 million. The programme approved approximately EUR 1.252 billion of investment over its life and was introduced in 2012. The REIT option was NOT suspended or removed before closure, contrary to some circulating accounts — it was live and listed as one of the four available options at the moment of closure. What was suspended in 2016 was a different pair, the Government bond and Mixed investment options. ACCESS CAVEAT: irishimmigration.ie returns HTTP 403 to automated requests; verification used the Internet Archive capture of the official page taken on 15 February 2023, i.e. contemporaneous.
finding.text_zh: 移民投資人計畫（IIP）已關閉，且不動產從未單獨構成合格投資。司法部長 Simon Harris 取得內閣同意後宣布，該計畫自 2023 年 2 月 15 日營業時間結束起停止受理新申請；宣布本身係於 2023 年 2 月 14 日作出。已受理之申請繼續審理，已核准之計畫不受影響；新創企業家計畫則持續運作。關閉時之四種選項為：企業投資，投入愛爾蘭企業至少 100 萬歐元、持有至少 3 年；投資基金，投入央行核准並受監理之基金至少 100 萬歐元、持有至少 3 年；不動產投資信託，投入在愛爾蘭證券交易所上市之愛爾蘭 REIT 至少 200 萬歐元、持有至少 3 年；以及捐贈，公益捐贈至少 50 萬歐元，若同時收到 5 件以上申請則降為 40 萬歐元。申請人並須具備至少 200 萬歐元之個人財富。該計畫存續期間共核准約 12.52 億歐元投資，於 2012 年設立。與部分坊間流傳說法相反，REIT 選項在關閉前並未遭停止或移除——關閉當下該選項仍在運作，且列為四種可用選項之一。2016 年遭停止者為另外兩項，即政府公債選項與混合投資選項。取用保留：irishimmigration.ie 對自動請求回應 403，查證係採用網際網路檔案館於 2023 年 2 月 15 日對官方頁面所作之同期存檔。

negatives.short_en: The direct property option existed for about six months in 2024. The surviving route is EUR 250,000 of units in a real-estate fund registered by the Magyar Nemzeti Bank.
negatives.short_zh: 直接購屋選項於 2024 年僅存續約六個月。現存途徑為認購匈牙利央行登記之不動產基金受益權 25 萬歐元。

finding.text_en: NO DIRECT PROPERTY-PURCHASE OPTION AS AT 1 AUGUST 2026 — and the surviving option is more property-linked than a flat negative implies. The consolidated text of Act XC of 2023 (Btátv.) with validity stamp 'Hatály: 2026.I.1. – 2026.IX.26.' — the law literally in force today — provides at §16(3) only TWO qualifying investments: (a) acquisition of investment fund units worth at least EUR 250,000 issued by a real estate fund registered by the Magyar Nemzeti Bank, and (b) a monetary donation of at least EUR 1,000,000 to a higher-education institution maintained by a public-interest asset management foundation. TWO CORRECTIONS TO CLAIMS THAT CIRCULATE ELSEWHERE: first, the fund amount was NOT raised — it is still EUR 250,000, verified both in the text in force now and in the future time-state from 27 September 2026. Second, 'deleted before it was ever activated' is not accurate. Act XC of 2023 entered into force 1 January 2024, but §286(17) provides that the guest investor visa and residence permit subtitles 'shall be applied from 1 July 2024'. The EUR 500,000 residential property option was therefore applicable from 1 July 2024 until 29 December 2024 — a live window of roughly six months — before being removed with effect from 30 DECEMBER 2024 by Act LXXXIV of 2024 §135(2) (the CER Directive transposition act, which carried the immigration amendments as a rider). Whether any permits were in fact ISSUED on the property basis in that window is an empirical question that was not sourced; zero cannot be asserted. NUANCE: the surviving EUR 250,000 option is genuinely property-linked. §22(9) requires the applicant to directly subscribe and continuously hold for at least five years units of a real estate fund whose net asset value is at least 40% invested in RESIDENTIAL-FUNCTION REAL ESTATE LOCATED IN HUNGARY, and whose fund manager appears on the qualified market participants list under Act XXX of 2016, vetted by the Constitution Protection Office. The investor never owns real estate, so it is not a property purchase — but a negative entry saying 'no property connection whatsoever' would overstate the position. This is the closest surviving analogue to a residency-by-property route in the EU.
finding.text_zh: 截至 2026 年 8 月 1 日並無直接購屋選項，且現存選項與不動產之連結遠較單純否定為深。2023 年第 XC 號法律（Btátv.）之彙編條文，效力戳記為「2026.I.1.－2026.IX.26.」（即今日實際施行之版本），其第 16 條第 3 項僅列兩種合格投資：（a）取得由匈牙利國家銀行登記之不動產基金所發行、價值至少 25 萬歐元之投資基金受益權；（b）向公益資產管理基金會所設之高等教育機構捐贈至少 100 萬歐元。對坊間流傳說法的兩處更正：其一，基金金額並未調升，仍為 25 萬歐元，已就現行條文及 2026 年 9 月 27 日起之未來版本雙重查證。其二，「在啟用前即遭刪除」並不正確。2023 年第 XC 號法律於 2024 年 1 月 1 日生效，惟第 286 條第 17 項規定客座投資人簽證與居留許可各節「自 2024 年 7 月 1 日起適用」。故 50 萬歐元之住宅不動產選項自 2024 年 7 月 1 日起至 2024 年 12 月 29 日止確曾適用，實際運作視窗約 6 個月，其後依 2024 年第 LXXXIV 號法律第 135 條第 2 項（關鍵實體韌性指令之轉換法，移民修正條款係搭載其中），自 2024 年 12 月 30 日起刪除。該期間內是否確曾核發不動產類許可，屬未查得出處之經驗性問題，不能斷言為零。須併同說明的細節：現存之 25 萬歐元選項確與不動產相連。第 22 條第 9 項要求申請人直接認購並持續持有至少 5 年之不動產基金受益權，該基金之淨資產價值須至少 40% 投資於位在匈牙利之住宅用途不動產，且其基金經理人須列於 2016 年第 XXX 號法律之合格市場參與者名單，並經憲法保護局審查。投資人始終不擁有不動產，故非購屋；惟若於否定條目中稱「與不動產全無關聯」則屬言過其實。這是歐盟境內現存最接近購屋取得居留之類似制度。

negatives.short_en: The real-estate residence route (EUR 250,000) ended when the new Immigration Law took effect on 15 September 2026. Permits already issued and files already lodged are carried over under transitional rules.
negatives.short_zh: 不動產居留途徑（25 萬歐元）隨新《移民法》於 2026 年 9 月 15 日生效而終止。已核發的許可與已受理的申請依過渡條款處理。

finding.text_en: CLOSED to new applicants since 15 September 2026. The Saeima adopted a wholly new Immigration Law on 20 August 2026 (likumi.lv id 370622); it entered into force on 15 September 2026 and repealed the 2002 Immigration Law, including s. 23(1)(29), the real-estate investment ground (EUR 250,000 of property plus a 5% payment to the state budget). The list of temporary-residence grounds in the new law (s. 27(1)) contains no property-purchase ground. The one investment ground it keeps is a EUR 150,000 placement for five years with a state-established alternative investment fund, plus EUR 10,000 to the state budget (s. 27(1)(36)); the investor does not buy property. TRANSITION: applications for a temporary permit lodged before 15 September 2026 are decided under the 2002 law (transitional provision 4); permits already issued stay valid to the end of their registration or validity period (provision 6); holders of permits issued on the real-estate ground can apply to renew for up to five years on the same ground if the investment still qualifies, paying EUR 1,000 for each year of the previous and the new permit, less sums already paid (provision 10). Cross-checked against the LV portals explainer of 15 September 2026 (no temporary residence permit for acquiring real estate) and the likumi.lv record of the 2002 law, which now shows it as no longer in force.
finding.text_zh: 自 2026 年 9 月 15 日起不再受理新申請。拉脫維亞國會於 2026 年 8 月 20 日通過全新的《移民法》（likumi.lv 編號 370622），2026 年 9 月 15 日施行，同時廢止 2002 年《移民法》，包括不動產投資居留的依據（第 23 條第 1 項第 29 款：25 萬歐元不動產，另繳相當於價值 5% 的國庫款項）。新法臨時居留事由清單（第 27 條第 1 項）沒有購置不動產這一項。新法保留的唯一投資事由，是把 15 萬歐元放進國家設立的另類投資基金 5 年，另繳 1 萬歐元給國庫（第 27 條第 1 項第 36 款），投資人並不購買房產。過渡安排：2026 年 9 月 15 日前提出的臨時居留申請，依 2002 年法審理（過渡條款第 4 點）；已核發的許可在登記期或效期屆滿前仍然有效（第 6 點）；以不動產事由取得許可的人，若投資仍符合條件，可依同一事由申請續期，最長 5 年，費用為前一張與新一張許可每滿一年繳 1,000 歐元，扣除已繳款項（第 10 點）。查證依據：LV portals 於 2026 年 9 月 15 日的說明文章（購置不動產不再核發臨時居留許可），以及 likumi.lv 上 2002 年法的紀錄（現顯示已失效）。

negatives.short_en: The Federal Office of Justice states that owning property confers no residence permit; the Lex Koller restricts acquisition instead.
negatives.short_zh: 聯邦司法辦公室明載持有不動產不賦予居留許可；《Lex Koller》反而限制取得。

finding.text_en: NO PROPERTY ROUTE, AND THE LAW RUNS THE OTHER WAY. The Swiss Federal Office of Justice states it in one sentence: 'It should also be noted that owning a property in Switzerland does not entitle the foreign national(s) concerned to a residence permit.' The inverse is what the law actually does: acquisition of property in Switzerland by foreign nationals, by companies domiciled abroad, or by Swiss-domiciled companies under foreign control is governed by the Lex Koller, which the Federal Office of Justice renders in English as ANRA, the Federal Act on the Acquisition of Immovable Property in Switzerland by Foreign Non-Residents, CC 211.412.41, with implementing ordinance SR 211.412.411. It generally REQUIRES authorisation from the competent cantonal authority, which may be granted only on grounds set out in the Act and in any cantonal legislation; enforcement is primarily a cantonal matter, and some communes additionally restrict acquisition of holiday homes and aparthotel units. The Federal Office of Justice page expressly redirects residence-permit questions to the State Secretariat for Migration or cantonal immigration authorities — the two matters are institutionally separate. NOTE ON ABBREVIATIONS: BewG and LFAIE are the German and French short titles; the Federal Office of Justice's own English abbreviation is ANRA. NOT VERIFIED and therefore not asserted: the characterisation of the lump-sum taxation (forfait fiscal / Pauschalbesteuerung) route as a cantonal tax arrangement rather than a property-based residence route. That characterisation is consistent with everything seen but was not independently sourced.
finding.text_zh: 無購屋途徑，且法律走向恰恰相反。瑞士聯邦司法辦公室以一句話明示：「並須注意，於瑞士擁有不動產並不賦予相關外國人取得居留許可之權利。」法律實際運作方向適得其反：外國人、境外設籍公司或受外國控制之瑞士設籍公司取得瑞士不動產，受《洛克斯・科勒法》規範，聯邦司法辦公室之英文簡稱為 ANRA，即《外國非居民取得瑞士不動產聯邦法》（CC 211.412.41），並有施行命令 SR 211.412.411。該法原則上要求取得主管州機關之許可，且僅得依該法及各州法律所定事由核准；執行主要屬各州權限，部分市鎮並另行限制度假屋與公寓式旅館單位之取得。聯邦司法辦公室頁面明確將居留許可問題導向聯邦移民事務國務秘書處或各州移民機關——兩者在制度上分屬不同事務。簡稱說明：BewG 與 LFAIE 分別為德文與法文簡稱，聯邦司法辦公室採用之英文簡稱為 ANRA。未經查證故不主張：將定額課稅（forfait fiscal／Pauschalbesteuerung）途徑定性為州級稅務安排而非不動產型居留途徑一節，該定性與所見資料一致，惟未經獨立查證。

negatives.notes_en: On 15 April 2026 the Federal Council opened a public consultation (closing 15 July 2026) on further tightening Lex Koller, not loosening it — the direction reinforces this negative finding. Normal federal legislative timelines put any resulting change well past 2028.
negatives.notes_zh: 2026 年 4 月 15 日聯邦委員會已展開 Lex Koller 進一步收緊（非放寬）之公眾諮詢程序（至 2026 年 7 月 15 日止）——方向強化本否定結論。依正常聯邦立法時程，任何後續修法要到 2028 年後才可能施行。

negatives.short_en: The residence permit for business rests on four enumerated bases, none of which is real estate.
negatives.short_zh: 營業居留許可設四項列舉事由，均非不動產。

finding.text_en: PROPERTY PURCHASE CONFERS NO RESIDENCE. The residence permit for business is available on four enumerated bases, none of which is real estate: shareholder of a company, at least EUR 65,000 invested in the company's activities in Estonia; sole proprietor, at least EUR 16,000 invested in the business activity in Estonia; start-up entrepreneur, a separate track; and LARGE INVESTOR, at least EUR 1,000,000 of permanent direct investment in an Estonian company investing in the Estonian economy, or in an investment fund investing mainly in Estonian companies. All bases additionally require income of at least six times the subsistence level and health insurance under Aliens Act §120, and the shareholder and sole-proprietor routes require settling in Estonia and registering in the Population Register. Permits issue for up to 5 years and are extendable up to 10 years at a time. TWO POINTS: first, the EUR 1,000,000 large-investor route is real and current — still not a property route, being company or fund only, but it is noted here so that the entry is complete. Second, a precision point that matters: the official pages do NOT contain an express exclusion of real estate. Real estate is simply not among the enumerated bases, i.e. exclusion by OMISSION FROM A CLOSED LIST, not by express prohibition. That is the accurate description; the stronger phrasing is not supported by the source text. E-RESIDENCY IS NOT RESIDENCE, in the authority's own words: 'e-Resident's digital ID does not grant the right to reside in Estonia.' It is a digital identity for electronic identification and digital signature only, valid 5 years, granted only to foreign nationals who do NOT hold an Estonian residence permit or right of residence. NOT VERIFIED: Aliens Act §§18–19 section references circulating elsewhere — riigiteataja.ee is a JavaScript application and the statute text could not be retrieved; only §120 for the insurance requirement is confirmed. Check the section numbers before citing them.
finding.text_zh: 購置不動產不賦予居留權，惟坊間常見說法有兩處須更正。營業居留許可有四種列舉事由，均不含不動產：公司股東，投入該公司在愛沙尼亞之營業活動至少 6.5 萬歐元；獨資經營者，投入在愛沙尼亞之營業活動至少 1.6 萬歐元；新創企業家，屬獨立途徑；以及大額投資人，對投資於愛沙尼亞經濟之愛沙尼亞公司、或對主要投資於愛沙尼亞公司之投資基金，作出至少 100 萬歐元之永久性直接投資。各事由並均要求收入達最低生活費之 6 倍以上，及依《外國人法》第 120 條投保健康保險；股東與獨資經營者途徑另須在愛沙尼亞定居並辦理人口登記。許可效期最長 5 年，每次可延長至多 10 年。更正一：坊間常見說法漏列 100 萬歐元之大額投資人途徑，該途徑真實且現行有效——仍非不動產途徑（僅限公司或基金），於此一併列出，以免讀者誤以為有所遺漏。更正二（此一精確度攸關重大）：官方頁面並無明文排除不動產之規定，不動產僅係未列於列舉事由之中，亦即係「自封閉清單中省略」而排除，而非明文禁止。此為準確描述；較強之措辭並無來源條文支持。電子居民身分並非居留，主管機關原文為：「電子居民數位身分證不賦予在愛沙尼亞居住之權利。」該身分僅為電子識別與數位簽章之用，效期 5 年，且僅核發予未持有愛沙尼亞居留許可或居留權之外國人。未經查證：《外國人法》第 18 至 19 條之條號——riigiteataja.ee 為 JavaScript 應用程式，條文無法取得，僅健康保險要件之第 120 條獲確認。引用條號前應先行查核。

negatives.short_en: The wealthy-foreign-national residence ground was abolished with effect from 17 April 2024.
negatives.short_zh: 高資產外國人居留事由自 2024 年 4 月 17 日起廢止。

finding.text_en: NO PROPERTY ROUTE, AND THE COMMONLY CITED DATE IS WRONG. The wealthy-foreign-national residence ground (vermogende vreemdeling) was abolished with effect from 17 APRIL 2024, not 1 January 2024. Instrument: Besluit (Order in Council) of 9 April 2024 amending the Besluit inburgering 2021, the Besluit uitvoering Wet arbeid vreemdelingen 2022 and the Vreemdelingenbesluit 2000, published as Staatsblad 2024, 83, issued 16 April 2024; article V provides that it enters into force on the day after the date of issue of the Staatsblad in which it is placed, i.e. 17 April 2024. The Staatsblad's own table of contents labels the operative articles '[afschaffing verblijfsgrond vermogende vreemdelingen]'. Mechanically, art. I(D) strikes the term 'vermogende vreemdeling' from art. 3.29a(1) Vb 2000 and repeals art. 3.29a(2) in its entirety — the explanatory memorandum states the second limb was repealed expressly to put beyond doubt that wealthy foreign nationals cannot still qualify via the second paragraph. Art. IV preserves permits already granted. PROPERTY NEVER QUALIFIED: the scheme entered into force 1 October 2013 and allowed a permit to foreign nationals with assets of at least EUR 1,250,000, but in 2013 the policy narrowed this to foreign investors investing at least that amount in an INNOVATIVE ENTERPRISE (Vreemdelingencirculaire B11/2.2), the stated reason being that merely holding that sum 'would on reflection be too little ground for granting a right of residence in the Netherlands'. Property purchase was never a qualifying use of the funds. Two facts: FEWER THAN TEN permits were ever granted on this ground between 1 October 2013 and abolition; and the stated rationale for abolition was that such schemes 'have been under discussion within the EU for some years because of the risk of criminal activity, such as money laundering', with adaptation while preserving anti-abuse safeguards judged not feasible. Abolition was announced by the previous government by letter of 11 January 2021. IND's current listing of twenty work-related residence permits contains no wealthy-foreign-national or investor permit whatsoever. NOT VERIFIED: the Dutch-American Friendship Treaty route, which is administered as a variant of the self-employed permit and is not property-based, was not independently sourced.
finding.text_zh: 無不動產途徑，且坊間常見之日期有誤。高資產外國人居留事由（vermogende vreemdeling）自 2024 年 4 月 17 日起廢止，而非 2024 年 1 月 1 日。法律工具：2024 年 4 月 9 日之王室命令，修正《2021 年融入命令》、《2022 年外國人勞動法施行命令》及《2000 年外國人命令》，刊登為《國家公報》2024 年第 83 號，發行日 2024 年 4 月 16 日；第 V 條規定自刊載該命令之《國家公報》發行日之翌日起生效，即 2024 年 4 月 17 日。《國家公報》目次就相關條文之標示即為「〔廢止高資產外國人居留事由〕」。技術上，第 I 條第 D 款自《2000 年外國人命令》第 3.29a 條第 1 項刪除「高資產外國人」一詞，並全部廢止第 3.29a 條第 2 項——立法理由說明，廢止第二項係為明確排除高資產外國人仍得循第二項取得資格之疑義。第 IV 條保留已核發之許可。不動產從未合格：該制度於 2013 年 10 月 1 日生效，容許資產達 125 萬歐元以上之外國人取得許可，惟 2013 年之政策已將其限縮為將該金額投入創新企業之外國投資人（《外國人通函》B11/2.2），理由為單純持有該筆金額「經審酌後，作為在荷蘭取得居留權之依據仍嫌不足」。購置不動產從未屬合格之資金用途。兩項事實：自 2013 年 10 月 1 日至廢止為止，依此事由核發之許可不足 10 件；廢止理由為此類制度「因洗錢等犯罪風險，於歐盟內部已討論多年」，且經評估認為在維持防弊機制之前提下加以調整並不可行。廢止係由前任政府以 2021 年 1 月 11 日函宣布。荷蘭移民局現行所列 20 種工作類居留許可中，完全不含高資產外國人或投資人許可。未經查證：荷美友好條約途徑（以自營作業許可之變體辦理，非以不動產為基礎）未經獨立查證。

sources.publisher: Staatsblad van het Koninkrijk der Nederlanden — Stb. 2024, 83

negatives.short_en: Statuses of residence are enumerated exhaustively in the appended tables and none rests on real-estate ownership.
negatives.short_zh: 在留資格於附表中窮盡列舉，其中並無以不動產所有權為基礎者。

finding.text_en: Property purchase confers no status of residence. Residence requires a Status of Residence under the Immigration Control and Refugee Recognition Act, whose appended tables enumerate the categories exhaustively; none is based on real-estate ownership. Separately verified and worth flagging because it is often the fallback route people reach for: the Business Manager status was materially tightened with effect from 16 October 2025 — required capital rose from JPY 5 million to JPY 30 million, plus at least one full-time employee, Japanese-language capability, and a degree or three or more years' management experience.
finding.text_zh: 購置不動產不賦予任何居留資格。居留須依《出入國管理及難民認定法》取得在留資格，該法附表窮盡列舉各類資格，其中並無以不動產所有權為基礎者。另經查證且值得標示者（因常被視為替代途徑）：經營管理在留資格自 2025 年 10 月 16 日起大幅收緊——所需資本額由 500 萬日圓提高至 3,000 萬日圓，並須僱用至少 1 名全職員工、具備日語能力，且具學位或 3 年以上經營管理經驗。

ownership_form.text_en: No nationality restriction on freehold ownership of land or buildings. The only overlay is a notification regime — not a prohibition — under the Important Land Survey Act (Act No. 84 of 2021, in force 20 September 2022) for land near defence sites and critical infrastructure.
ownership_form.text_zh: 土地及建物之完全所有權不設國籍限制。唯一附加者為通報制度而非禁止規定，依《重要土地調查法》（2021 年第 84 號法律，2022 年 9 月 20 日施行），適用於防衛設施及重要基礎設施周邊土地。

sources.publisher: Immigration Services Agency, Ministry of Justice, Japan

negatives.short_en: Investment-immigration routes are limited to investment in a profit-seeking enterprise or in central government bonds.
negatives.short_zh: 投資移民途徑僅限投資營利事業或中央政府公債。

finding.text_en: Property purchase grants no residence. The National Immigration Agency's investment-immigration routes are exhaustively listed and real estate is absent from both the eligibility list and the documentary checklist. The two routes are investment of NT$15 million or more in a profit-seeking enterprise creating employment for five or more nationals for three years, or investment of NT$30 million or more in central government bonds held for three years.
finding.text_zh: 購置不動產不取得居留權。內政部移民署之投資移民途徑係窮盡列舉，不動產既不在資格清單，亦不在文件檢核表內。兩條途徑分別為：投資營利事業新臺幣 1,500 萬元以上並創造 5 人以上本國人就業機會滿 3 年，或投資中央政府公債面額新臺幣 3,000 萬元以上滿 3 年。

ownership_form.text_en: Foreign nationals require Ministry of the Interior approval, subject to the reciprocity principle in Article 18 of the Land Act — acquisition of land rights by foreign nationals is to be equal to the rights ROC nationals enjoy in the host country. NOT PUBLISHED: the sometimes-cited 'vacant land / investment-use' restriction could not be pinned to a citable provision and is omitted.
ownership_form.text_zh: 外國人須經內政部核准，並適用《土地法》第 18 條之平等互惠原則——外國人取得土地權利，以其本國給予中華民國人民同樣權利者為限。不予刊載：時而被引用之「空地／投資用途」限制無法對應可引註之條文，故從缺。

negatives.notes_en: A non-government aggregator site cites a TWD 6,000,000 corporate-investment figure, distinct from this record's TWD 15,000,000 (drawn directly from the National Immigration Agency's official page, tier 1). The TWD 6,000,000 figure carries no statutory citation and is not adopted. Neither route is property-linked in any case, which is the operative finding here.
negatives.notes_zh: 一非官方彙整站引用 TWD 6,000,000 之公司投資數字，與本記錄採用之 TWD 15,000,000（直接引自移民署官網，第一級）不同，未附法條依據，不予採信。無論如何，兩條途徑均與不動產無關，此為本筆之關鍵結論。

negatives.short_en: The Global Investor Programme requires business and investment activity; residential property is not a qualifying investment.
negatives.short_zh: 全球投資者計畫要求實質營運與投資活動，住宅不動產不屬合格投資。

finding.text_en: No residence from property. The Global Investor Programme confers permanent residence for business and investment activity — EDB describes it as according PR 'to eligible global investors who intend to drive their businesses and investment growth from Singapore' and requiring 'a substantial business track record and successful entrepreneurial background'. Residential property is not a qualifying investment. NOT PUBLISHED: the specific GIP thresholds sometimes quoted as SGD 10m business / SGD 25m fund / SGD 50m family-office AUM could not be verified — the EDB factsheet would not retrieve — so the qualitative statement stands but the three figures are omitted.
finding.text_zh: 不因購置不動產取得居留。全球投資者計畫係就商業與投資活動授予永久居留——經濟發展局稱其授予永久居留予「有意自新加坡推動其事業與投資成長之合資格全球投資人」，並要求「深厚之商業經歷與成功之創業背景」。住宅不動產非合格投資項目。不予刊載：時而被引用之新幣 1,000 萬元企業／2,500 萬元基金／5,000 萬元家族辦公室管理資產等具體門檻無法查證（經濟發展局說明文件無法取得），故保留定性陳述而略去該三項數字。

ownership_form.text_en: Foreign persons need Land Dealings Approval Unit approval under the Residential Property Act for vacant residential land and for terrace, semi-detached and bungalow houses, and for Sentosa Cove landed property; the stated criteria are at least five years' Singapore permanent residence and exceptional economic contribution to Singapore. Condominiums and strata flats are exempt. Additional Buyer's Stamp Duty for foreigners was raised from 30% to 60% with effect from 27 April 2023 — stated as a dated change because no tier-1 page confirming the rate is still 60% in 2026 could be retrieved.
ownership_form.text_zh: 外國人購買空置住宅用地、排屋、半獨立式及獨立式洋房，以及聖淘沙灣有地房產，須依《住宅財產法》取得土地交易審批組核准；所列標準為已取得新加坡永久居留至少 5 年且對新加坡有卓越經濟貢獻。公寓及分層住宅不在此限。外國人額外買方印花稅自 2023 年 4 月 27 日起由 30% 調高至 60%——以「該日之調整」陳述，因無法取得確認 2026 年仍為 60% 之一級來源頁面。

sources.publisher: Singapore Economic Development Board
Singapore Land Authority
Ministry of Finance, Singapore

negatives.short_en: Causation runs the other way: visa status determines whether a purchase is permitted at all, and FIRB approval is required in order to buy.
negatives.short_zh: 因果關係相反：簽證身分決定是否得以購置，且購置前須取得外資審議委員會核准。

finding.text_en: Buying confers no visa; the causation runs the other way. FIRB approval is required in order TO BUY, and visa status determines whether purchase is permitted at all. The ATO defines a foreign person as one who is not an Australian citizen, an Australian permanent resident, or a New Zealand citizen holding a special category visa. The ban on foreign purchases of established dwellings does NOT end on 31 March 2027, contrary to some circulating accounts. It ran from 1 April 2025 and has been extended by two years and three months to 30 JUNE 2029, announced in the 2026-27 Budget.
finding.text_zh: 購置不賦予簽證；因果關係恰好相反。取得外資審查委員會核准是購買之前提，且簽證身分決定是否得以購買。澳洲稅務局將外國人定義為非澳洲公民、非澳洲永久居民、且非持特別類別簽證之紐西蘭公民者。與部分坊間流傳說法相反，外國人購買既有住宅之禁令並非於 2027 年 3 月 31 日屆滿。該禁令自 2025 年 4 月 1 日起實施，並依 2026-27 年度預算宣布延長 2 年 3 個月至 2029 年 6 月 30 日。

ownership_form.text_en: Foreign persons require FIRB (now foreigninvestment.gov.au) approval for residential and commercial property. From 1 April 2025 to 30 June 2029 foreign persons are banned from purchasing established dwellings, with limited exceptions.
ownership_form.text_zh: 外國人購買住宅及商用不動產須取得外資審查委員會（現為 foreigninvestment.gov.au）核准。自 2025 年 4 月 1 日至 2029 年 6 月 30 日，外國人禁止購買既有住宅，僅有少數例外。

sources.publisher: Australian Taxation Office
Australian Taxation Office

negatives.short_en: Foreign ownership takes the form of a fixed-term certificate, not an immigration status.
negatives.short_zh: 外國人所有權之形式為定期權狀，並非移民身分。

finding.text_en: No visa or residence flows from a housing purchase. Foreign ownership is a fixed-term certificate, not an immigration status.
finding.text_zh: 購置房產不產生任何簽證或居留權。外國人之所有權為定期權利證書，並非移民身分。

ownership_form.text_en: Law on Housing 2023 (No. 27/2023/QH15) with Decree 95/2024/ND-CP, in force 1 August 2024. Foreign individuals may own for no more than 50 years from the date the certificate is granted, extendable once for a further 50 years, subject to caps of 30% of the apartments in any one building or block and no more than 250 landed houses per ward-equivalent area. A foreign individual married to a Vietnamese citizen obtains stable long-term ownership under Article 20(2)(c).
ownership_form.text_zh: 《2023 年住宅法》（第 27/2023/QH15 號）及第 95/2024/ND-CP 號議定書，2024 年 8 月 1 日施行。外國個人自證書核發日起最長可持有 50 年，得延長一次再 50 年，並受同一棟或同一區塊公寓 30% 上限、以及每一坊級區域有地住宅不超過 250 戶之限制。與越南公民結婚之外國個人依第 20 條第 2 項第 c 款取得穩定之長期所有權。

Viger Law (Vietnam)
