negatives.short_en: Temporary residency by real-estate investment has been suspended since 4 April 2007 and has not reopened.
negatives.short_zh: 不動產投資臨時居留自 2007 年 4 月 4 日起暫停受理，迄今未重開。

finding.text_en: The real-estate investment residency route has been closed since 4 April 2007 and has NOT reopened. IPIM states that 'New applications for temporary residency based on investment in local real estate have not been accepted since 4 April 2007, without prejudice to the renewal application of the granted residency and extension application made by interested parties of approved residency.' The Government has separately rebutted revival rumours, confirming that 'Administrative Regulation No. 7/2007, effective from 4 April 2007, is still in force and ... temporary residency applications for investment in local real estate are still suspended.' The backlog of pre-suspension applications was fully cleared by 17 July 2015. The surviving IPIM route is major-investment or major-investment-plan under Administrative Regulation No. 3/2005 — business, not property.
finding.text_zh: 以不動產投資取得居留之途徑自 2007 年 4 月 4 日起關閉，且未重新開放。貿促局表示：「自 2007 年 4 月 4 日起已不再接受以本地不動產投資為依據之臨時居留新申請，惟不影響已獲批居留者之續期申請及利害關係人之延期申請。」政府另已駁斥重啟傳聞，確認「第 7/2007 號行政法規自 2007 年 4 月 4 日生效後仍然有效……以本地不動產投資申請臨時居留仍屬暫停」。暫停前之積案已於 2015 年 7 月 17 日全數處理完畢。貿促局現存途徑為第 3/2005 號行政法規下之重大投資或重大投資計畫，屬商業性質而非不動產。

ownership_form.text_en: Legal instrument: Administrative Regulation No. 7/2007. Only renewals of already-granted residency and family-dependant extensions continue to be processed.
ownership_form.text_zh: 法律依據：第 7/2007 號行政法規。現僅繼續處理已獲批居留之續期及家團成員之延期。

sources.publisher: Macao Trade and Investment Promotion Institute (IPIM)
Macao SAR Government services portal
Macao SAR Government

negatives.short_en: The Investor Permit requires a business project approved by Investment Fiji under a Foreign Investment Registration Certificate.
negatives.short_zh: 投資人許可須具經斐濟投資局核准並取得外人投資登記證之營業專案。

finding.text_en: Property purchase confers no permit. The Investor Permit under section 9(2)(c) of the Immigration Act 2003 requires a business project approved by Investment Fiji via a Foreign Investment Registration Certificate. The minimum investment threshold is FJD 300,000, not the FJD 250,000 that sometimes circulates — Investment (Reserved and Restricted Activities) Regulations 2022, regulation 3: 'The minimum investment threshold in Fiji is FJD $300,000 except for the restricted activities outlined in the Schedule', and the investor must bring at least FJD 300,000 into Fiji within three months from the date of incorporation. Restricted activities carry higher thresholds.
finding.text_zh: 購置不動產不賦予任何許可。《2003 年入出境法》第 9(2)(c) 條之投資人許可，須有經斐濟投資局核發外國投資登記證之營業計畫。最低投資門檻為 30 萬斐濟元，並非坊間有時流傳之 25 萬——《2022 年投資（保留及限制業別）規則》第 3 條規定：「斐濟最低投資門檻為 30 萬斐濟元，附表所列限制業別除外」，且投資人須自公司設立日起 3 個月內匯入至少 30 萬斐濟元。限制業別門檻更高。

ownership_form.text_en: Land Sales (Amendment) Act 2014, new section 7A: 'any State land or freehold land for residential purposes in any area within the boundary of any town or city declared or extended under the Local Government Act (Cap. 125) shall not be sold, transferred or leased to a non-resident.' Strata and unit title and integrated tourism developments are carved out, and land outside municipal boundaries is unaffected.
ownership_form.text_zh: 《2014 年土地買賣（修正）法》新增第 7A 條：「依《地方政府法》（第 125 章）宣告或擴張之任何鎮或市界內，供住宅用途之任何國有地或永久業權土地，不得出售、移轉或出租予非居民。」分層及單元業權與整合型觀光開發案除外，市鎮界外之土地亦不受影響。

sources.publisher: Laws of Fiji — Investment (Reserved and Restricted Activities) Regulations 2022
Parliament of Fiji — Land Sales (Amendment) Act 2014
Ministry of Immigration, Fiji

negatives.short_en: Acquisition is governed by FEMA purely as an exchange-control matter and produces no immigration status.
negatives.short_zh: 取得不動產依《外匯管理法》處理，純屬外匯管制事項，不產生移民身分。

finding.text_en: No visa or residence arises from property purchase; FEMA governs acquisition purely as an exchange-control matter.
finding.text_zh: 購置不動產不產生任何簽證或居留權；《外匯管理法》純以外匯管制角度規範取得行為。

ownership_form.text_en: Foreign Exchange Management (Acquisition and Transfer of Immovable Property in India) Regulations 2018 — Notification No. FEMA 21(R)/2018-RB of 26 March 2018. Purchase rights are granted only to NRIs and OCIs (regulation 3, non-agricultural property only, funded by inward remittance or NRO/NRE accounts), to branch, liaison and project offices for property necessary for or incidental to their activity (regulation 4), and to foreign embassies and diplomats with Ministry of External Affairs clearance (regulation 5). A foreign national of non-Indian origin resident outside India falls outside all of these and needs RBI permission. Regulation 9 additionally bars nationals of Pakistan, Bangladesh, Sri Lanka, Afghanistan, China, Iran, Nepal, Bhutan, Hong Kong, Macau and North Korea from acquiring or transferring immovable property, other than a lease not exceeding five years, without prior RBI approval. Agricultural land, farmhouses and plantation property are barred to NRIs and OCIs as well.
ownership_form.text_zh: 《2018 年外匯管理（印度境內不動產之取得與移轉）規則》——2018 年 3 月 26 日第 FEMA 21(R)/2018-RB 號公告。購買權僅授予非居民印度人及海外印度公民（第 3 條，限非農業不動產，資金須為境外匯入或 NRO／NRE 帳戶）、分公司/聯絡處/專案辦事處就其業務所必需或附隨之不動產（第 4 條），以及經外交部核可之外國使領館及外交人員（第 5 條）。非印度裔且居住境外之外國人不屬上述任一情形，須經印度儲備銀行許可。第 9 條另規定，巴基斯坦、孟加拉、斯里蘭卡、阿富汗、中國、伊朗、尼泊爾、不丹、香港、澳門及北韓國民，未經印度儲備銀行事前核准，不得取得或移轉不動產（不逾 5 年之租賃除外）。農地、農舍及種植園不動產對非居民印度人及海外印度公民亦同屬禁止。

sources.publisher: Reserve Bank of India

negatives.short_en: Holding a qualifying visa is what permits the purchase; the purchase never produces a visa.
negatives.short_zh: 須先持有合格簽證方得購置；購置本身不產生任何簽證。

finding.text_en: DIRECTION CONFIRMED, and the 2026 reform does not reverse it: holding a qualifying visa is what PERMITS the purchase; the purchase never produces a visa. LINZ states that New Zealand citizens and permanent residents who meet the 'ordinarily resident' requirements can buy without restrictions, while 'Overseas people usually cannot buy a house or land in New Zealand', and that you cannot buy or build a home if you are an overseas person on a temporary, limited, interim or transit visa such as a student, work or visitor visa, or an overseas person without any visa. The 2025-26 change is now IN FORCE and its direction is the same: the Overseas Investment (National Interest Test and Other Matters) Amendment Act passed under urgency on 12 December 2025 and came into force on 6 MARCH 2026, letting holders of Active Investor Plus, Investor 1 and Investor 2 visas apply for OIO consent to buy or build ONE residential or lifestyle dwelling valued over NZD 5 million even if not ordinarily resident. That is still visa first, permission-to-buy second.
finding.text_zh: 方向已確認，2026 年之改革亦未逆轉：持有合格簽證是「得以購買」之前提；購買絕不產生簽證。土地資訊局載明，符合「通常居住」要件之紐西蘭公民及永久居民可無限制購買，而「海外人士通常不得在紐西蘭購買房屋或土地」；持學生、工作或訪客等臨時、限制、過渡或過境簽證之海外人士，以及無簽證之海外人士，不得購買或興建自用住宅。2025-26 年之修法現已生效，方向不變：《海外投資（國家利益檢驗及其他事項）修正法》於 2025 年 12 月 12 日以緊急程序通過，並於 2026 年 3 月 6 日施行，允許 Active Investor Plus、Investor 1 及 Investor 2 簽證持有人即使不符「通常居住」，亦得向海外投資辦公室申請核准購買或興建一戶價值逾 500 萬紐幣之住宅或生活型態用地住宅。此仍為先有簽證、後得購買。

ownership_form.text_en: Residential land is 'sensitive land' under the Overseas Investment Act 2005 as amended by the Overseas Investment Amendment Act 2018; the general foreign-buyer ban remains. For the new investor-visa pathway, LINZ guidance states that consent under the Overseas Investment Act is required and 'Consent will be inexpensive and generally be granted within five working days.'
ownership_form.text_zh: 住宅用地依《2005 年海外投資法》（經《2018 年海外投資修正法》修正）屬「敏感土地」；一般外國買方禁令仍然存續。就新設之投資簽證途徑，土地資訊局指引載明須依《海外投資法》取得核准，且「核准費用低廉，通常於 5 個工作日內核發」。

sources.publisher: Land Information New Zealand (LINZ)
Land Information New Zealand (LINZ) — guidance for investor visa holders
New Zealand Government

negatives.short_en: A resident visa rests on marriage, a Maldivian child or investment of USD 250,000 or more; property purchase is not a stated basis.
negatives.short_zh: 居留簽證的基礎為婚姻、馬爾地夫籍子女或 25 萬美元以上的投資；購置不動產不在所列基礎內。

finding.text_en: No residency by property purchase is published. The Maldives Immigration Resident Visa page (shown as updated 10/09/2026) lists four bases: foreign nationals legally married to Maldivians; eligible foreign investors under the Corporate Resident Visa; foreign nationals who keep eligibility after the dissolution of a marriage to a Maldivian where they have a Maldivian child; and foreign nationals whose Maldivian spouse has died. The Corporate Resident Visa may be granted to (any one of): foreign investors who have invested at least USD 1,000,000 in the Maldives within the preceding three financial years; foreign nationals who keep a fixed deposit of USD 250,000 in a Maldivian licensed bank for five years; or foreign nationals who have invested at least USD 250,000 in a project approved by the Government of Maldives. The page does not mention property purchase among the qualifying investments; whether an approved real-estate project would count is not stated.
finding.text_zh: 官方未公布以購置不動產取得居留的途徑。馬爾地夫移民局居留簽證頁面（標示更新日 10/09/2026）列出四類基礎：與馬爾地夫公民合法結婚的外國人；符合條件的外籍投資人（法人居留簽證）；與馬爾地夫公民婚姻終止後、育有馬爾地夫籍子女而仍具資格的外國人；馬爾地夫籍配偶已死亡的外國人。法人居留簽證符合下列任一項即可核發：近三個財年在馬爾地夫投資至少 100 萬美元的外籍投資人；在馬爾地夫持牌銀行持有 25 萬美元定存滿五年的外國人；在政府核准專案中至少投資 25 萬美元的外國人。該頁在合格投資項目中未提及購置不動產；政府核准的房地產專案是否算入，頁面未說明。

ownership_form.text_en: There is essentially no private freehold available to foreigners. Most land is leased from the government, though Maldivians may hold title. A 2015 constitutional amendment permitting foreign ownership of land and islands in connection with major projects — requiring investment of at least USD 1 billion with at least 70% of the land reclaimed — was REPEALED by parliament in 2019, and there are now no property or real estate laws or mechanisms allowing foreign persons to hold title to land. Foreign parties may lease for no longer than 99 years for business activity; inhabited islands are capped at 50 years, and uninhabited non-tourism islands at 21 years below USD 1m investment, rising to 50 years above USD 10m. The exact repeal month is not settled between sources (April versus August 2019) and only the year is published.
ownership_form.text_zh: 外國人實質上無私有永久業權可言。多數土地係向政府承租，惟馬爾地夫人得持有所有權。2015 年一項憲法修正案曾允許外國人就重大計畫持有土地及島嶼所有權（須投資至少 10 億美元且至少 70% 土地為填海造地），該修正案已於 2019 年經議會廢止，現行已無任何法律或機制允許外國人持有土地所有權。外國人得為營業目的承租不逾 99 年；有人島上限 50 年，無人島（非觀光用途）在投資額低於 100 萬美元時為 21 年，逾 1,000 萬美元時可達 50 年。廢止之確切月份於各來源間未有定論（2019 年 4 月或 8 月），故僅刊載年份。

sources.publisher: Maldives Immigration — Resident Visa page (shown as updated 10/09/2026)
United States Department of State — 2024 Investment Climate Statement, Maldives

negatives.short_en: Purchase requires government sanction. Residency is the prerequisite for a discount on that sanction fee, not a consequence of buying.
negatives.short_zh: 購置須取得政府核可。居留身分為核可規費折減之前提，而非購置之結果。

finding.text_en: No automatic residency from property purchase. The Seychelles Planning Authority states that 'A Non-Seychellois individual or corporate body may purchase immovable property (or rights therein) which is privately owned in Seychelles subject to sanction being obtained from the Government' — the document addresses sanction only and says nothing about residency. The causality in fact runs the opposite way: Immigration and Civil Status describes Permanent Residence holders as able to buy land and residential property with Government sanction at only 50% of the sanction fee. Residency is the prerequisite for the discount, not a consequence of the purchase.
finding.text_zh: 購置不動產不自動取得居留權。塞席爾規劃局載明：「非塞席爾籍個人或法人得購買塞席爾境內私有之不動產（或其權利），惟須取得政府之許可」——該文件僅處理許可事項，未涉及居留。實際因果關係恰好相反：移民及民事身分局說明永久居留持有人得在取得政府許可下購買土地及住宅，且僅需支付 50% 之許可費。居留是取得該折扣之前提，而非購買之結果。

ownership_form.text_en: Purchase requires Government sanction. Fees: application SCR 3,000 for a purchase; sanction processing at 1.5% of market value; residential sanction duty increased from 11% to 12% of market value. Minimum values: dwelling house SCR 10 million; bare land SCR 4,000 per square metre; condominium units SCR 30,000 per square metre.
ownership_form.text_zh: 購買須取得政府許可。費用：購買申請費 3,000 塞席爾盧比；許可處理費為市價之 1.5%；住宅許可稅由市價之 11% 調高至 12%。最低金額：住宅 1,000 萬盧比；素地每平方公尺 4,000 盧比；區分所有權單元每平方公尺 30,000 盧比。

sources.publisher: Seychelles Planning Authority

negatives.short_en: EB-5 requires a commercial enterprise and ten permanent jobs; the Gold Card launched in the interim and is not property-linked.
negatives.short_zh: EB-5 要求投資商業實體並創造 10 個長期就業機會；其後推出之 Gold Card 亦與不動產無涉。

finding.text_en: CONFIRMED: no property-linked residency route — but the wording must now account for the Gold Card, which launched in the interim and is NOT property-linked. Two routes exist, and neither is real estate. (1) EB-5: USCIS states eligibility requires the investor to 'Make the necessary investment in a commercial enterprise in the United States' and to 'Plan to create or preserve 10 permanent full-time jobs for qualified U.S. workers'. Both conditions are conjunctive and neither can be met by a passive purchase of residential real estate: buying a home is not a commercial enterprise and creates no permanent full-time jobs. Real estate features only indirectly, as the underlying asset of a job-creating commercial enterprise (typically a regional-centre development project) — an investment in an operating business, not property ownership by the applicant. (2) THE GOLD CARD: established by Executive Order 14351 of 19 September 2025. Its operative text requires 'an unrestricted gift to the Department of Commerce under 15 U.S.C. 1522', of '$1 million for an individual donating on his or her own behalf and $2 million for a corporation or similar entity donating on behalf of an individual'; the gift is then treated as evidence of eligibility under 8 U.S.C. 1153(b)(1)(A) and of exceptional business ability, i.e. it routes the applicant through the existing extraordinary-ability and exceptional-ability immigrant categories. The words 'real estate' and 'property' do not appear anywhere in the Executive Order. It is a non-refundable gift to the federal government, not an asset purchase. CONCLUSION: the United States now has a price-tagged residency route, but it buys nothing and confers no asset — there is still no US visa category granting residence in exchange for owning a home.
finding.text_zh: 已確認：不存在與房產掛鉤的居留途徑——但措辭現在必須把期間內上路的「金卡」計入，而金卡並不與房產掛鉤。目前存在兩條路徑，兩條都不是房地產。（1）EB-5：USCIS 載明資格要求投資人「在美國的商業企業中完成必要投資」，並「計畫創造或維持 10 個合格美國勞工的全職永久職位」。兩項條件並存，被動購置住宅都無法滿足：買房不是商業企業，也不創造全職永久職位。房地產僅間接出現——作為創造就業之商業企業（通常是區域中心開發案）的底層資產——那是對營運中事業的投資，而非申請人自己持有物業。（2）金卡：由 2025 年 9 月 19 日第 14351 號行政命令設立。其實體條文要求「依 15 U.S.C. 1522 向商務部作出無限制贈與」，金額為「個人以自身名義捐贈 100 萬美元，法人或類似實體代個人捐贈 200 萬美元」；該筆贈與其後被視為符合 8 U.S.C. 1153(b)(1)(A) 及卓越商業能力之資格證據，亦即將申請人導入既有的傑出人才與特殊能力移民類別。行政命令全文未出現「real estate」或「property」字樣。它是對聯邦政府的不可退還贈與，不是資產購置。結論：美國現在確有一條明碼標價的居留途徑，但它買不到任何東西、也不帶來任何資產——美國仍然沒有任何簽證類別以持有住宅換取居留權。

negatives.notes_en: The Gold Card is a signed Executive Order, read here in full at tier 1. Two things about it are not published because they were only available at tier 3: the US$15,000 processing/vetting fee, and take-up figures (reported as 338 applications, 165 fee payments and one approval as at April 2026); the negative finding does not depend on either. The EB-5 minimum investment amounts (commonly cited as US$1,050,000 standard and US$800,000 in a targeted employment area) are also not published here. The Gold Card's non-refundable gift is evidence of eligibility not only for the extraordinary-ability (EB-1A) category, but also routes through the exceptional-ability and national-interest-waiver categories under 8 U.S.C. 1153(b)(1)(A)/(b)(2) — a plural set of existing categories. Whichever category it routes through, the gift itself remains a non-refundable donation to the federal government, not a property purchase.
negatives.notes_zh: 金卡是一份已簽署之行政命令，本記錄已完整讀取全文，達第一級。兩項資訊未予刊登，因僅達第三級：1.5 萬美元審查費，以及申請件數（據報 338 件申請、165 件已繳費、1 件核准，截至 2026 年 4 月）；否定結論不依賴此二者。EB-5 最低投資金額（坊間常引一般 105 萬美元、目標就業區 80 萬美元）同樣未予刊登。金卡之不可退還贈與，除傑出人才（EB-1A）類別外，亦可路由至特殊能力與國家利益豁免類別（8 U.S.C. 1153(b)(1)(A)/(b)(2)）——為複數既有類別之集合。無論路由至哪個類別，該筆贈與本身仍是對聯邦政府之不可退還捐贈，非資產購置。

sources.publisher: U.S. Citizenship and Immigration Services (USCIS)
The White House — Executive Order 14351, 'The Gold Card', 19 September 2025

negatives.short_en: IRCC’s own complete enumeration of permanent-residence pathways contains no property-linked route.
negatives.short_zh: 加拿大移民、難民及公民部所列永久居留途徑之完整清單中，並無不動產連結途徑。

finding.text_en: CONFIRMED: no property-linked residency route. IRCC's own complete enumeration of permanent-residence pathways ('Live in Canada permanently') lists Express Entry, Caregivers, Medical doctors, Provincial Nominee Program, Rural and Francophone Community Immigration Pilots, Atlantic Immigration Program, Quebec-selected skilled workers, Quebec investors and entrepreneurs, family sponsorship, refugees, and special programs for Hong Kong residents and former youth in state care. None is property-linked; the phrase 'real estate' does not appear on the page. The same page lists Start-up Visa and Self-employed persons as Paused, and Economic Mobility Pathways Pilot, TR-to-PR pathway and Agri-Food Pilot as Closed.
finding.text_zh: 已確認：不存在與房產掛鉤的居留途徑。加拿大移民、難民及公民部（IRCC）自身完整列舉的永久居留途徑（「永久居留於加拿大」頁）包含快速通道、看護者、醫師、省提名計畫、鄉村與法語社群移民試辦、大西洋移民計畫、魁北克甄選技術移民、魁北克投資人與創業家、家庭團聚、難民，以及香港居民與曾受政府照護青年的特別計畫。無一與房產掛鉤；該頁完全沒有出現「real estate」一詞。同頁並列出創業簽證與自雇人士為「暫停」，經濟流動途徑試辦、臨時轉永久居留途徑與農業食品試辦為「關閉」。

negatives.notes_en: The federal Immigrant Investor Programme's termination is confirmed at tier 1: a Government of Canada official archived news release confirms termination was announced 11 February 2014, formalised by the 2014 Economic Action Plan Act (Bill C-31, passed 19 June 2014), with pending applications cancelled. The Quebec Investor Programme has not ended and remains listed on IRCC's current page as a live regional pathway; its current parameters are net worth of at least CAD 2,000,000, a CAD 1,000,000 five-year government-guaranteed note, a CAD 200,000 non-refundable donation to Investissement Quebec, French-language requirements, and signals of tightening intake in 2026 — but it is confirmed to be unrelated to real estate (a note plus a donation, not an asset purchase), so the negative conclusion for Canada is unaffected. Confidence: high.
negatives.notes_zh: 聯邦投資移民計畫之終止已達第一級確認：加拿大政府官方存檔新聞稿確認，終止於 2014 年 2 月 11 日宣布，並經 2014 年經濟行動計畫法（Bill C-31，2014 年 6 月 19 日通過）正式終止，未決申請一併取消。魁北克投資人計畫並未結束，現仍列於 IRCC 現行頁面為運作中之區域途徑；其現行參數為淨資產至少加幣 200 萬、加幣 100 萬五年期政府擔保票據、加幣 20 萬不可退還捐款予 Investissement Québec、法語能力要求，另有 2026 年名額緊縮訊號——惟已確認與不動產完全無關（票據＋捐款，非資產購置），故不影響加拿大之否定結論。信心度：高。

sources.publisher: Immigration, Refugees and Citizenship Canada (IRCC)
Government of Canada — official news archive, termination of the federal Immigrant Investor and Entrepreneur programmes

negatives.short_en: The Desert Visa Programme has never been launched, and five mutually inconsistent thresholds circulate for it.
negatives.short_zh: 沙漠簽證計畫從未上路，坊間就其門檻流傳五個互不一致的數字。

finding.text_en: NO PROPERTY-LINKED RESIDENCY ROUTE IS IN FORCE, and the reported debunk of the 'NAD 3.95m golden visa' is supported — though by a different and stronger argument than the one reported. The programme that agency material describes is the Desert Visa Programme, under which foreign investors would obtain a renewable five-year residence permit by purchasing real estate in approved projects. It was announced by the CEO of the Namibia Investment Promotion and Development Board and has been reported on since 2021, but as at April 2026 the specialist investment-migration outlet IMI Daily records it as 'under review in Cabinet', 'contingent on passage of a pending migration control bill', and explicitly 'not formally launched'; a second specialist source states the launch date 'has not yet been confirmed' and depends on passage of a draft law; a third describes it as 'stalled in development since 2021'. A programme that has not been launched cannot have a threshold, which is the cleanest possible answer to the NAD 3.95m question. THE SECOND, INDEPENDENT ARGUMENT IS THE STATE OF THE CIRCULATING NUMBERS THEMSELVES. Across agency and marketing material for the same claimed Namibian programme, the following figures all circulate: NAD 2,000,000 (~US$110,000), NAD 3,950,000, US$316,000, US$375,000, and 'no fixed or official investment threshold'. Five mutually inconsistent figures for one supposed programme is not a sourcing gap — it is what invention looks like. Namibia has no in-force property-linked residency route, and no figure is published.
finding.text_zh: 不存在生效中的不動產連結居留途徑，且報導中對「NAD 395 萬黃金簽證」的破除獲得支持——惟支持的論據與報導所述不同，且更為有力。仲介文宣所描述的計畫是「沙漠簽證計畫」，據稱外籍投資人可透過購買核准建案內的不動產，取得可續期的五年居留許可。該計畫由納米比亞投資促進與發展局執行長對外宣布，自 2021 年起即有報導，但截至 2026 年 4 月，投資移民專業媒體 IMI Daily 記載其仍「處於內閣審議中」、「取決於一部尚未通過的移民管制法案」，並明白指出「尚未正式上路」；另一專業來源稱其上路日期「迄今未定」，取決於一部法律草案的通過；第三方來源則描述其「自 2021 年起停滯於研議階段」。一個尚未上路的計畫不可能有門檻，這是對 NAD 395 萬問題最乾淨俐落的回答。第二項獨立論據，是流通中的數字本身的狀態。在所見之仲介與行銷資料中，同一個號稱的納米比亞計畫出現了以下數字：NAD 2,000,000（約 11 萬美元）、NAD 3,950,000、316,000 美元、375,000 美元，以及「不存在固定或官方投資門檻」。同一個所謂計畫出現五個彼此矛盾的數字，這不是來源不足，這就是杜撰的樣貌。納米比亞並無生效中的不動產連結居留途徑，本頁不列任何數字。

negatives.notes_en: Confidence is medium, not high, for one reason: no Namibian government source could be reached. The reported claim that the national investment board affirmatively states 'no minimum capital exists' was not independently verified and is not published as a quotation; what is published is the weaker but well-supported proposition that the programme is not in force. A stronger negative would require checking the NIPDB website and the Ministry of Home Affairs directly, plus tracking the migration control bill's legislative progress — the one fact that would settle this decisively.
negatives.notes_zh: 信心度列為 medium 而非 high，理由只有一個：未能取得任何納米比亞政府來源。報導所稱該國投資局明確表示「不存在最低資本額」一節，未經獨立查證，故不以引述形式刊登；此處刊登的是較弱但佐證充分的命題——該計畫尚未生效。若需要更強的否定結論，NIPDB 網站與內政部是兩個該查的地方，而移民管制法案的立法進度，是唯一能一舉定案的事實。

sources.publisher: IMI Daily, 26 April 2026 — 'Africa Residency by Investment: 8 Active Programs', recording Namibia's Desert Visa Programme as under Cabinet review and not formally launched
Visit World — 'Golden Visas in Africa', stating Namibia's Desert Visa launch depends on passage of a draft law and no launch date is confirmed
CitizenX, 26 February 2026 — describing the proposed Desert Visa Programme as stalled in development since 2021

negatives.short_en: The official immigration portal lists only general permit, pass, alien-card, permanent-residence and citizenship entry points — no property-linked scheme.
negatives.short_zh: 官方移民入口網僅列出一般通行證、許可證、外僑證、永久居留與公民權申請入口，無不動產連結制度。

finding.text_en: No property-linked residency scheme found. Kenya's official immigration portal (fns.immigration.go.ke) exhaustively lists its permit, pass, alien-card, permanent-residence and citizenship application categories; none of them ties to purchasing real estate. This was a spot-check of Kenya's official portal structure, not a full read of the underlying Kenya Citizenship and Immigration Act — a document-level statutory read of the underlying Act has not been carried out.
finding.text_zh: 未查得不動產連結居留制度。肯亞官方移民入口網（fns.immigration.go.ke）窮盡列出其通行證、許可證、外僑證、永久居留及公民權申請類別，均與購置不動產無關。此僅為官方入口網結構之查核，未完整讀取《肯亞公民與移民法》原文，未達逐條法源核對之強度。

negatives.notes_en: Confidence is medium rather than high because this was a portal-structure spot-check, not a full statutory read (contrast Ghana, Rwanda, Tanzania and Zambia below, each confirmed against primary legislation).
negatives.notes_zh: 信心度為中等而非高，因此係入口網結構之抽查，非完整法條原文核對（相對照下方迦納、盧安達、坦尚尼亞、尚比亞四筆，均已對照母法原文確認）。

sources.publisher: Kenya Department of Immigration Services — official e-services portal

negatives.short_en: Investment thresholds under the GIPC Act require cash or imported capital goods; real estate is not a qualifying asset, and the investor permit is tied to company shareholding, not personal purchase.
negatives.short_zh: 《GIPC 投資法》之資本門檻限現金或進口資本財；不動產非合格資產，投資人居留與登記公司股東身分綁定，非個人購屋。

finding.text_en: No property-linked residency scheme. The Ghana Investment Promotion Centre (GIPC) sets minimum foreign-equity thresholds payable in 'cash or capital goods relevant to the investment' — joint venture (local equity >= 10%) USD 200,000; wholly foreign-owned USD 500,000; trading enterprise USD 1,000,000 plus 20 employed Ghanaians. 'Capital goods' is defined as imported machinery and equipment throughout the GIPC Act, 2013 (Act 865); real estate, land or buildings are not mentioned as qualifying capital anywhere in the Act. Ghana Immigration Service's investment-linked residence category (Work and Residence Permit for Missionaries/NGOs/Immigrant Quota GIPC/Shareholders) is expressly tied to registered-company shareholding and a GIPC immigrant quota, not to personal real estate purchase. GIPC's own list of investable sectors includes 'Property Development' as an industry a company may invest in (i.e. building and selling property as a business), which is a different matter from an individual buying a home to obtain residency and should not be conflated with a purchase-linked route.
finding.text_zh: 未查得不動產連結居留制度。迦納投資促進中心（GIPC）設有最低外資股權門檻，須以『現金或與投資相關之資本財』繳納——合資（本地股權≥10%）20 萬美元；獨資 50 萬美元；貿易企業 100 萬美元另須雇用 20 名加納員工。《GIPC 投資法》（2013 年第 865 號法令）通篇將『資本財』定義為進口機械設備；不動產、土地或建物於該法中皆未被列為合格資本。迦納移民局之投資連結居留類別（供傳教士／非政府組織／GIPC 移民配額／股東使用之工作與居留證）明確綁定登記公司之股東身分與 GIPC 移民配額，非個人購屋。GIPC 自身之可投資產業清單雖列有『不動產開發』（即公司從事蓋房賣房之生意），惟此屬另一件事，不應與個人購屋換居留之途徑混為一談。

sources.publisher: Ghana Investment Promotion Centre (GIPC)
Ghana Investment Promotion Centre Act, 2013 (Act 865), official PDF
Ghana Immigration Service — official permit categories

negatives.short_en: Immigration's own exhaustive list of investor-permit categories is entirely sector-based (mining, agriculture, manufacturing, hospitality, ICT, logistics); a marketed 'USD 50,000 property visa' contradicts it and is not credible.
negatives.short_zh: 移民局窮盡列舉之投資人居留類別皆為產業別（礦業、農牧、製造、旅宿、資訊科技、物流），坊間流傳之『5 萬美元購屋換居留』與此矛盾，不可採信。

finding.text_en: No property-linked residency scheme. Rwanda's Directorate General of Immigration and Emigration (DGIE) lists its full set of investor-permit categories on its official site: mining (A1/A3-1), agriculture and livestock (B1/B3-1), manufacturing (F1/F3-1), hospitality (O1/O3-1), ICT (W1/W3-1), transport and logistics (X1/X3-1), other economic sectors (Z1/Z3-1) — each requiring an investment certificate and full company registration, an exhaustive sector-based list with no property category. The Rwanda Development Board's 'real estate' investment-opportunities page in fact describes large institutional development projects (e.g. the Kigali Innovation City, a USD 100m office/student-housing/residential development) aimed at developers, not individual buyers, and makes no mention of an investment certificate or residency permit. A marketing site (kwandarealestate.com) advertises a 'USD 50,000 property path to residency and citizenship' — this directly contradicts DGIE's own exhaustive permit-category list and is judged not credible; it is not treated as evidence.
finding.text_zh: 未查得不動產連結居留制度。盧安達移民局（Directorate General of Immigration and Emigration, DGIE）官網完整列出投資人居留許可類別：礦業（A1/A3-1）、農牧（B1/B3-1）、製造（F1/F3-1）、旅宿（O1/O3-1）、資訊科技（W1/W3-1）、運輸物流（X1/X3-1）、其他經濟部門（Z1/Z3-1），各類均須投資證書與完整公司登記，為窮盡式產業分類清單，無任何不動產類別。盧安達開發署（RDB）之『不動產』投資機會頁面實際描述的是大型機構開發案（如 Kigali Innovation City，1 億美元商辦／學生宿舍／住宅開發），面向開發商而非個人購屋者，且未提及投資證書或居留許可。一仲介網站（kwandarealestate.com）刊登『5 萬美元購屋換居留與公民權』之說法——此說法與 DGIE 官方窮盡列舉之許可類別清單直接矛盾，判定為不可信，不視為證據。

negatives.notes_en: A marketing claim of a USD 50,000 property-to-residency path was actively checked and rejected as contradicting the official permit-category list — recorded here as an unreliable source.
negatives.notes_zh: 『5 萬美元購屋換居留』之仲介說法已主動查證並判定與官方許可類別清單矛盾而排除——特此記錄為不可信來源。

sources.publisher: Directorate General of Immigration and Emigration (DGIE), Rwanda
Rwanda Development Board (RDB)

negatives.jurisdiction_zh: 坦尚尼亞（本土，不含桑吉巴）
negatives.short_en: The Investment Act's definition of qualifying capital includes buildings and land, but only as assets of a for-profit business enterprise — not as an individual's home.
negatives.short_zh: 《投資法》之合格資本定義雖列有建物與土地，惟前提為屬營利事業之資產，非個人自住不動產。

finding.text_en: No property-linked residency scheme, read directly from the primary statute. The Tanzania Investment Act (Chapter 38, Act No. 10 of 2022), per Government Notice No. 395B (2023-06-13): art. 2 applies to a 'business enterprise' with a minimum capital threshold of USD 500,000 for foreign/joint capital or USD 50,000 for wholly Tanzanian capital; art. 3's definition of 'capital' does include 'buildings' and 'land', but only as assets of a for-profit business enterprise operated on commercial principles — not an individual's personal residence. Art. 19's application requirements (company name, legal form, directors/shareholders, management qualifications, description of business activity, capital structure) are entirely company-registration documents, not personal home-purchase documents. Art. 30 (immigration quota): an enterprise holding a Certificate of Incentives under this Act is entitled to an immigration quota for non-citizen employees under the relevant employment law — the quota attaches to the enterprise and its staff, not to a person who has purchased a residence.
finding.text_zh: 未查得不動產連結居留制度，直接讀取一手法條原文確認。《坦尚尼亞投資法》（第 38 章，2022 年第 10 號法令），依政府公報第 395B 號（2023-06-13）：第 2 條適用對象為『business enterprise』（企業），最低資本門檻外資／合資為 50 萬美元、純坦尚尼亞資本為 5 萬美元；第 3 條『capital』（資本）之定義確實列有『buildings』（建物）與『land』（土地），惟前提為該資產屬一以營利為目的、依商業原則經營之企業，非個人自住不動產。第 19 條之申請文件要求（公司名稱、法律形式、董事股東、管理資格、商業活動說明、資本結構）全屬企業登記資訊，非個人購屋文件。第 30 條（移民配額）：凡獲本法核發激勵證書之企業，依相關聘僱非公民之法律享有移民配額——配額授予對象為企業本身及其員工，非購屋之個人。

ownership_form.text_en: Land and buildings are technically listed within the statutory definition of 'capital' (art. 3), but only as assets contributed to a commercial business enterprise — e.g. a developer building a hotel for rental income — never as an individually-owned home. Do not read this as 'real estate counts, so there is a route.'
ownership_form.text_zh: 土地與建物在法定『資本』定義（第 3 條）中技術上確有列名，惟前提為作為營利商業企業所投入之資產（例如開發商蓋旅館出租），絕非個人自住之不動產。不應誤讀為『不動產可算資本，故有途徑』。

sources.publisher: Tanzania Investment Centre (TIC) — administering authority for the Tanzania Investment Act, 2022

negatives.short_en: The government's own residence-permit page lists only three categories — dependant, general immigrant, spouse of a citizen — none investment- or property-linked.
negatives.short_zh: 政府官方居留許可頁僅列三類——受扶養親屬、一般移民、公民配偶，均與投資或不動產無關。

finding.text_en: No property-linked residency scheme. Botswana's official government residence-permit page (gov.bw) lists exactly three categories: dependant, general immigrant, and spouse of a citizen — no investor or property category, and no statutory citation for one. Multiple immigration-consultancy sources (used here only as a directional cross-check, not a standalone basis) consistently describe a separate 'Investor Permit' of roughly BWP 1,000,000 (about USD 75,000) for a new or existing business, registered with CIPA (the Companies and Intellectual Property Authority) — with no real-estate purchase option. A newly enacted Citizenship Act amendment (art. 15A, 'economic citizenship', reportedly a USD 75,000 donation to a government development fund covering housing, renewable energy, tourism and mining diversification, said to open to applications in early 2026) was also identified — this is a donation-based citizenship scheme, structurally unlike buying a specific property, and its effective date could not be confirmed at tier 1 (secondary sources disagree). It is not published here and is not a property-purchase route; if a real-estate substitute option is later added, this entry will change.
finding.text_zh: 未查得不動產連結居留制度。波札那官方政府居留許可頁（gov.bw）僅列三類：受扶養親屬、一般移民、公民配偶——無投資人或不動產類別，亦無任何法源條號可供引用此類別。多方移民顧問來源（僅供方向性交叉核對，非獨立依據）一致描述另有一項約 100 萬波札那普拉（約 7.5 萬美元）之『投資人許可證』，用於新設或既有企業，須向 CIPA（公司與智慧財產局）登記——無不動產購置選項。另查得新修訂之《公民法》（第 15A 條『經濟公民權』，據稱為 7.5 萬美元捐款至政府發展基金，涵蓋住房、再生能源、觀光、礦業多元化，據稱 2026 年初開放申請）——此為捐款制公民權，結構上與購買特定不動產不同，其生效日期未能於第一級來源確認（次級來源說法不一）。本筆不予刊登此制度，它也不是購屋途徑；因制度極新，若日後加入不動產購置替代選項，本筆將隨之調整。

negatives.notes_en: The separate, newly enacted economic-citizenship donation scheme (Citizenship Act art. 15A) is not a property route and its effective date is unconfirmed — to be tracked separately, not evidence for or against this entry.
negatives.notes_zh: 另一項新制之捐款制經濟公民權（《公民法》第 15A 條）非不動產途徑，生效日期未經確認——留供未來另闢查證，非本筆之正反證據。

sources.publisher: Government of Botswana — official residence-permit page

negatives.short_en: The Immigration and Deportation Act's Investor's Permit is capital- and business-registration-based; a 'proof of business premises' requirement was checked and confirmed to be about a place of business, not a qualifying purchase.
negatives.short_zh: 《移民與遞解出境法》之投資人許可以資本與商業登記為要件；『須有營業處所』一項經核對確認為經營場所證明，非合格購置門檻。

finding.text_en: No property-linked residency scheme, confirmed against both the official portal and the primary statute. Zambia's Department of Immigration (zambiaimmigration.gov.zm) lists 12 permit types (residence, employment, investor, spouse, study, diplomatic, visitor, cross-border, temporary employment, temporary, transit, asylum); the Investor's Permit is defined as intent to establish a business or invest in Zambia, at a threshold of USD 250,000 for a new enterprise or USD 150,000 to join an existing company, evidenced by bank statements, remittance proof and a goods/equipment valuation declaration (ZRA Form CE20). The portal does list a requirement for 'proof of property ownership or lease' — checked directly and confirmed to be evidence of business premises, not the investment threshold itself. The Immigration and Deportation Act No. 18 of 2010 (as amended 2016), read via ZambiaLII: art. 20 (residence permits) covers language proficiency, 3+ years on an existing investor permit, established settlement, children of Zambian citizens, and retirees meeting a 'prescribed minimum net worth' deposited locally — a financial-asset test, not a property purchase; art. 29 (investor permits) requires the prescribed financial or capital contribution to a 'business' and a Zambia Development Agency (ZDA) investment licence, with no real-estate category anywhere in the statutory language.
finding.text_zh: 未查得不動產連結居留制度，經官方入口網與一手法條雙重確認。尚比亞移民局（zambiaimmigration.gov.zm）列出 12 類許可（居留／聘僱／投資人／配偶／就學／外交／訪客／跨境／臨時聘僱／臨時／過境／庇護）；投資人許可定義為『意圖在尚比亞設立事業或投資』，門檻新設事業 25 萬美元／加入既有公司 15 萬美元，佐證文件為銀行對帳單、匯款證明、貨物設備價值申報表（ZRA Form CE20）。入口網雖列有『須提出不動產所有權或租賃合約證明』，惟經直接查核確認此為營業處所證明，非投資門檻本身。《移民與遞解出境法》（2010 年第 18 號法令，經 2016 年修正），經 ZambiaLII 讀取原文：第 20 條（居留許可）涵蓋通曉當地語言者、已持投資人許可滿 3 年者、既有定居者、尚比亞公民子女、以及財力符合『規定最低淨值』並存入境內帳戶之退休人士——此為財務資產測試，非不動產購置；第 29 條（投資人許可）要求投入規定財務或資本於『事業』並取得尚比亞發展署（ZDA）投資許可證，法條文字通篇無任何不動產類別。

ownership_form.text_en: The portal's 'proof of property ownership or lease' line item was checked directly and is evidence of a business premises (an office or operating site for the investment), not a residence-qualifying purchase or an investment threshold.
ownership_form.text_zh: 入口網『須提出不動產所有權或租賃合約證明』一項經直接查核，確認係營業處所證明（供投資事業使用之辦公室或營運場所），非合格購屋或投資門檻本身。

sources.publisher: Zambia Department of Immigration — official permit-types page
ZambiaLII — Immigration and Deportation Act No. 18 of 2010 (as amended), official consolidated text

excluded.jurisdiction: North Macedonia — citizenship by investment (art. 11, Law on Citizenship)
excluded.jurisdiction_zh: 北馬其頓——投資入籍（《公民法》第 11 條）
excluded.reason_en: The route exists but its FIGURES cannot be published. Art. 11 of the Law on Citizenship permits naturalisation for special scientific, ECONOMIC, cultural, sporting or other national interest, and contains NO MONETARY FIGURE at all; art. 11(2) delegates the criteria to a Government decree (uredba) whose text could not be obtained. The widely circulated EUR 200,000 investment, 10-jobs and 1,000-person-cap figures appear only in tier-2 and tier-3 material and are not published. Confirmed at tier 1: this is an investment/national-interest route, NOT a property-purchase route. The property route is published separately as a programme. This citizenship/investment route is distinct from — and does not conflict with — the property-based residence route already published in `programmes` under `north-macedonia` (art. 119 of the Law on Foreigners, EUR 40,000 threshold). A reader should not conclude from this exclusion that North Macedonia has no purchase-linked route at all.
excluded.reason_zh: 本投資／國家利益歸化途徑，與已刊登於 programmes 之 north-macedonia 不動產居留條目（《外國人法》第 119 條，4 萬歐元門檻）為不同事由，兩者不衝突。讀者不應因本筆排除而誤以為北馬其頓完全沒有購屋連結之途徑。

excluded.reason_en: EXCLUDED — no legal instrument could be located, and the threshold itself is unestablished. Searches across the Cambodian General Department of Immigration, the Ministry of Interior and the e-visa portal returned no CM2H page of any kind; the programme has no government-domain footprint at all. Every locatable source is the programme's own marketing or a promotional outlet, i.e. tier 3. The programme's own materials describe it as launched by the Khmer Home Charity Association — a NON-GOVERNMENT body — with 'exclusive approval from the Ministry of Interior', which is a claim of authorisation rather than a legal basis, and no sub-decree, prakas or other instrument is cited anywhere. Sources disagree on basic facts in a way the available material cannot resolve: launch date is given as 2022 in one source and 2023 in another, and the threshold is given as USD 50,000 in one and USD 100,000 in another. Per the publication rule, where the threshold itself is unestablished the programme moves to excluded rather than being published at reduced confidence. No CM2H figure is published here.
excluded.reason_zh: 排除——查無任何法律文件，門檻本身亦未確立。遍查柬埔寨移民總局、內政部及電子簽證入口網，均無任何 CM2H 頁面；該計畫在政府網域完全沒有足跡。所有可查得之來源均為該計畫自身之行銷素材或宣傳性媒體，即第三級來源。該計畫自身資料稱其由高棉家園慈善協會（非政府機構）推出，並「獲內政部獨家批准」，此係授權之主張而非法律依據，且各處均未引註任何次級法令、部令或其他文件。各來源就基本事實彼此矛盾，且現有材料無法解決：發起年份一說 2022、一說 2023；門檻一說 5 萬美元、一說 10 萬美元。依刊載規則，門檻本身未確立者應移入排除項，而非降級刊載。本頁不列任何 CM2H 數字。

sources.publisher: cm2h.com — the programme's own promotional site
Google Sites page promoting CM2H
The Better Cambodia — promotional outlet

excluded.reason_en: Threshold itself remains unestablished; the official homepage carries the same result as of 2026-08-02: cbi.gov.gd mentions 'an investment in an approved project (real estate) in Grenada' as one option, and prices the National Transformation Fund route at USD 150,000, but publishes NO figure at all for the real-estate route. Market chatter has moved to USD 270,000 (shared)/USD 350,000 (sole), 5-year hold, but these are tier-3 immigration-consultancy sources only. This is Grenada's own website not disclosing a figure, not a research gap.

sources.publisher: Grenada Citizenship by Investment Committee (official)

excluded.reason_zh: 門檻本身仍未確立；官方首頁截至 2026-08-02 結果一致：cbi.gov.gd 提及『在格瑞那達投資核准建案（不動產）』為選項之一，且將 National Transformation Fund 途徑之門檻刊為 15 萬美元，惟不動產途徑完全未刊登任何金額。坊間流傳已更新為共有權 27 萬美元／單獨持有 35 萬美元、持有 5 年，惟均為第三級移民顧問來源。這是格瑞那達官網自身未揭露金額，非查證缺口。

excluded.reason_en: Not researched. The reported US$100,000 Zanzibar-only route remains unverified from either direction. Two points matter: first, the Zanzibar-only scope is load-bearing, because Zanzibar is a semi-autonomous jurisdiction within Tanzania and a Zanzibar residence permit is not mainland Tanzanian residence; second, one tier-2 sweep of African programmes ('Africa Residency by Investment: 8 Active Programs', IMI Daily, April 2026) describes an African programme qualifying 'through real estate ($50,000 for a one-year permit...)', which if it refers to Zanzibar would contradict the US$100,000 figure outright. That single ambiguity is reason enough not to publish either number. STATUTORY CANDIDATES, not yet confirmed at tier 1: the Zanzibar Investment Promotion Authority (ZIPA) operates under the Zanzibar Investment Act No. 10 of 2023; foreign condominium purchase with a renewable 99-year lease is reportedly governed by the Land Tenure (Amendment) Act No. 10 of 2010; the marketed 'Golden Visa' appears to actually be mainland Tanzania's Immigration Act Class C (C-11) residence permit, threshold reportedly around USD 100,000. zipa.go.tz itself returned insufficient content to verify any of this at tier 1.

sources.publisher: Vela Zanzibar (property-consultancy site, tier 3 — cited only for the statute numbers it names, not as a standalone basis)

excluded.reason_zh: 未查證。所謂僅限桑吉巴之 10 萬美元途徑，兩個方向均未查證。有兩點需留意：其一，「僅限桑吉巴」之範圍屬關鍵前提，因桑吉巴為坦尚尼亞境內之半自治轄區，桑吉巴居留許可並非坦尚尼亞本土居留；其二，一份非洲各國制度之第二級彙整（『Africa Residency by Investment: 8 Active Programs』，IMI Daily，2026 年 4 月）描述某非洲制度可『透過不動產取得資格（5 萬美元、1 年期許可……）』，若此指涉桑吉巴，將與 10 萬美元之數字直接矛盾。單此一項歧義即足以使兩個數字均不予刊登。法源候選（尚未達第一級確認）：桑吉巴投資促進局（ZIPA）依《桑吉巴投資法》2023 年第 10 號設立；外國人購置公寓並取得可續期 99 年租約，據稱受《土地保有（修正）法》2010 年第 10 號規範；坊間行銷之『黃金簽證』實際上似為坦尚尼亞本土《移民法》C 類（C-11 分類）居留許可，門檻據稱約 10 萬美元。zipa.go.tz 回傳內容不足，未能就上述任何一點達成第一級確認。

excluded.reason_en: Route confirmed to exist, amount unconfirmed: the Cancilleria's own 'Visa M Inversionista' page (confirmed to exist via search-result excerpts; direct WebFetch to cancilleria.gov.co returned 403 repeatedly) lists completing foreign direct investment OR purchasing real estate in one's own name, and maintaining that investment for the visa's validity, as a qualifying condition. The multiple-of-SMMLV figure (commonly cited as 350x SMMLV, approx. COP 612,816,750 / USD 120,000 for 2026) rests only on consultancy-site aggregation; the official Resolucion 5477 de 2022 PDF was downloaded (14.6MB) but is a 63-page SCANNED document with no text layer and could not be OCR'd. Status: existence near tier-1-confirmed, multiplier not established.
excluded.reason_zh: 途徑確定存在，金額未確立：外交部（Cancillería）自身『Visa M Inversionista』頁面（經搜尋結果片段確認存在；多次直接 WebFetch cancilleria.gov.co 皆遭 403 拒絕）列出完成外國直接投資或以自己名義購置不動產，並於簽證有效期間維持該投資，為受理條件之一。SMMLV 倍數（坊間普遍引用 350 倍，2026 年約合 COP 612,816,750／12 萬美元）僅見於顧問網站彙整；官方 Resolución 5477 de 2022 PDF 已下載（14.6MB），惟為 63 頁純掃描圖檔、無文字層，未能 OCR 判讀。狀態為：存在性接近第一級確認，倍數本身未能確立。

excluded.reason_en: Uruguay's ORDINARY immigration-residence system (residencia legal, at gub.uy) has NO property-purchase route — its financial test is 'medios de vida' (means of living, e.g. employment, business or pension income), confirmed directly against the official page. HOWEVER, Uruguay DOES have a property-linked instrument — it just sits in a DIFFERENT legal category than the one covered here: 'residencia fiscal' (TAX residency, under Decrees 163/020 and 148/007), which sets property-value thresholds (commonly cited around USD 370,000-520,000, or UI 15,000,000/12,500,000) as one route to becoming a Uruguayan TAX resident — a status that determines where you pay tax, not whether you may lawfully live in the country. Market material frequently blurs these two into one, creating a real risk that a reader could believe buying a house in Uruguay grants a right to reside there. It does not; it can only change your tax domicile. This entry is filed as 'confirmed: exists, but in the tax-residency category, outside this page's scope' rather than a general negative.

sources.publisher: Republica Oriental del Uruguay — gub.uy official portal, Residencia Legal Permanente

excluded.reason_zh: 烏拉圭一般移民居留制度（residencia legal，gub.uy）並無不動產購置途徑——其財力測試為『生活來源』（medios de vida，如就業、營業或退休金收入），已直接對照官方頁面確認。惟烏拉圭確實另有一套與不動產掛鉤之制度——只是落在與本頁收錄範圍不同的法律類別：『稅籍居留』（residencia fiscal，依 163/020 號與 148/007 號行政命令），設有不動產價值門檻（坊間常引約 37–52 萬美元，或 UI 1,500 萬／1,250 萬）作為取得烏拉圭稅籍居民身分之途徑之一——此身分決定你在哪裡繳稅，而非你能否合法居住於該國。市場資料經常將兩者混為一談，讀者確有可能誤以為在烏拉圭買房即取得居留權。事實並非如此；買房僅能改變稅籍居住地。本筆歸檔為『確認：制度存在，惟屬稅籍居留類別，不在本頁範疇內』，非泛泛之否定結論。

excluded.reason_en: A confirmed tier-1 NEGATIVE finding, not an open question: the full text of the official gob.pe page for the investor-residence visa was read and confirms eligible investment forms are limited to 'inversion en nuevas empresas' (investment in new companies) or 'aumento de capital en empresas ya constituidas' (capital increase in an existing company) — real estate purchase is nowhere listed as a qualifying investment form. This is a genuine tier-1 confirmed negative, filed here as excluded rather than in `negatives` because property purchase is simply outside the scope of this Peruvian visa category rather than the subject of an express prohibition.

sources.publisher: Plataforma del Estado Peruano (gob.pe) — Solicitar visa de residente para inversionista

excluded.reason_zh: 已確認之第一級否定結論，非開放性問題：完整讀完官方 gob.pe 投資人居留簽證頁面全文，確認受理投資形式明確僅限於『新設公司』（inversión en nuevas empresas）或『既有公司增資』（aumento de capital en empresas ya constituidas）——不動產購置從未列為合格投資形式。此為確實達第一級之否定結論，惟仍歸檔於本 excluded 清單而非 negatives，因不動產購置單純不在此秘魯簽證類別範疇內，而非遭明文禁止。

excluded.reason_en: PARTIALLY ESTABLISHED: the official immigration page confirms the residence-category structure under Law 25.871 (art. 22 permanent, art. 23 temporary, art. 24 transit); a temporary-residence 'rentista' (passive-income) sub-category exists, but the page does not spell out the content of an 'inversionista' (investor) sub-category specifically, nor does it mention real estate anywhere as a qualifying investment form. This is NOT a confirmed negative — the page was not exhaustive across every temporary-residence sub-category — so it remains excluded as unresolved rather than promoted to `negatives`.

excluded.reason_zh: 部分確立：官方移民局頁面確認第 25.871 號移民法之居留分類結構（第 22 條永久居留、第 23 條臨時居留、第 24 條過境居留）；臨時居留下設有『被動收入者』（rentista）子類別，惟頁面未具體列出『投資人』（inversionista）子類別之內容，亦未在任何地方提及不動產為合格投資形式。此非已確認之否定結論——該頁面未窮盡每一個臨時居留子類別——故仍歸類為未解決之排除，非升格至 negatives。

excluded.reason_en: Not researched. STATUTORY CANDIDATES: Law No. 761 (Migration and Foreigners Law, 2011); National Assembly Accord No. 8902 (new rules approved 3 June 2025); Foreign Investment Law No. 1240. Market material describes a 'Residencia Permanente de Inversionista' (permanent investor residence) and a commonly-cited USD 30,000 real-estate threshold, but neither the amount nor whether real estate specifically qualifies (as opposed to 'capital investment in a legal economic activity' generically) could be confirmed against any of these three instruments.
excluded.reason_zh: 未查證。法源候選：《761 號移民與外國人法》（2011 年）；國民議會第 8902 號協議（2025 年 6 月 3 日核准之新規則）；《1240 號外人投資法》。市場資料描述有『投資人永久居留』（Residencia Permanente de Inversionista）及坊間常引之 3 萬美元不動產門檻，惟未能就此三項法源確認金額本身、亦未能確認不動產是否確為合格投資形式（相對於泛稱之『對合法經濟活動的資本投資』）。

excluded.reason_en: For the Qualified Retired Persons (QRP) programme specifically, this is an income-based test (USD 2,000/month in verifiable foreign passive income, minimum age 40) with NO property-purchase requirement or linkage. HOWEVER, only QRP was checked; whether Belize has ANY OTHER property-linked residency or investment programme was NOT exhaustively researched. The exclusion should therefore be read narrowly as 'QRP is not a property route' rather than the stronger and unproven claim that 'Belize has no property-linked route at all.'
excluded.reason_zh: 就合格退休人士計畫（QRP）本身，此為收入測試（每月 2,000 美元境外可查證被動收入，年滿 40 歲），無不動產購置要求或連結。惟僅查了 QRP 一項，貝里斯是否另有其他不動產連結之居留或投資制度，並未窮盡查證。故本筆排除應窄義解讀為『QRP 非不動產途徑』，而非未經證實之更強主張『貝里斯完全沒有任何不動產連結途徑』。

excluded.reason_en: HOLD — the form itself is tier 1, but the core question remains unresolved. The official IGM (Guatemalan immigration authority) application form and requirements PDF confirms a 'Residencia Temporal para Inversionistas' with a USD 100,000 threshold, 1-5 year temporary residence (applicant chooses at application), legal basis Migration Code (Decreto 44-2016) arts. 27, 75-77 plus Accord IGM-016-2025 (approved by Resolution AMN 005-2025). Accepted evidentiary forms include 'Certificaciones registrales' (registry certifications) among five accepted document types, matched in ordinary administrative usage to the Registro General de la Propiedad (Guatemala's property registry) — but this remains a structural inference, not a verbatim statement naming real estate the way Brazil's or Ecuador's instruments do. A direct attempt was made to close this gap directly: the Migration Code's own arts. 27, 75-77 and Accords IGM-016-2025/IGM-017-2025 could not be read (igm.gob.gt's legal-basis page and congreso.gob.gt both returned 403; Wayback Machine was unreachable at the tool layer). A second independent law firm corroborating the USD 100,000 threshold and the 1-5 year term was found, but it does not address whether registry certifications cover real estate specifically. A marketing/relocation blog claims real estate purchase qualifies, but cites a legal basis ('Art. 48', 'Acuerdo Gubernativo 83-2019') that does not match the form's own citations and is treated as unreliable, as an agency/marketing source. Net: one weak documentary lead, one terminology inference, and one non-conforming marketing claim — not enough to clear the publication bar. Should the primary legal text (Migration Code arts. 27/75-77 or Accord IGM-016-2025) become readable and confirm real estate as a qualifying document, this entry should be promoted immediately, with route_type expected to be property_one_of_several given the form lists five parallel evidentiary document types.

sources.publisher: Instituto Guatemalteco de Migracion (IGM) — official application form and requirements, Residencia Temporal para Inversionistas, form IGM 01-2026

excluded.reason_zh: HOLD——表格本身達第一級來源，但核心問題仍未解決。官方 IGM（瓜地馬拉移民局）申請表格與規定 PDF 確認『投資人臨時居留』，門檻 10 萬美元，1–5 年期臨時居留（申請時可選），法源為《移民法典》（2016 年第 44 號法令）第 27、75–77 條，另加 IGM-016-2025 號協議（經 AMN 005-2025 號決議核准）。可佐證文件五類中含『Certificaciones registrales』（登記證明），依一般行政慣例對應瓜地馬拉之 Registro General de la Propiedad（不動產登記處）——惟這仍是術語推論，非如巴西、厄瓜多之法源逐字點名不動產。已直接嘗試補上此缺口：《移民法典》第 27、75–77 條本身及 IGM-016-2025／IGM-017-2025 號協議皆未能讀取（igm.gob.gt 法源頁與 congreso.gob.gt 均回傳 403；Wayback Machine 於工具層本身即無法連線）。另尋得第二家獨立律師事務所佐證 10 萬美元門檻與 1–5 年期，惟未觸及登記證明是否涵蓋不動產此一核心問題。一份移居類部落格主張不動產購置合格，惟其引用之法源（『第 48 條』、『2019 年第 83 號政府協議』）與表格本身引用不一致，屬仲介來源，不予採信。綜合而言：一份薄弱之文件線索、一個術語推論、一個法源不符之仲介主張——三者合計仍未達刊登門檻。若日後《移民法典》第 27、75–77 條或 IGM-016-2025 號協議原文可讀取，且明文將不動產列為合格佐證文件，本筆應立即入庫，`route_type` 預期為 property_one_of_several（表格列有五類平行佐證文件）。

excluded.reason_en: CONFIRMED as a genuinely separate instrument from the published `panama` (Qualified Investor) entry, and the boundary itself is now well-corroborated rather than merely asserted: multiple tier-3 sources consistently agree the Friendly Nations visa's legal basis is Decreto Ejecutivo 197 de 2021 (7 May 2021, in force 5 August 2021), granting 2-year temporary residence convertible to permanent residence, and the widely-quoted USD 200,000 property-or-funds option is consistently cited — but all of this remains tier-3 only (immigration-consultancy sites); the official Gaceta Oficial text or a Servicio Nacional de Migracion page was not reached. These figures stay excluded pending a tier-1 read and are not merged into the `panama` entry, which covers a different instrument with different conditions.
excluded.reason_zh: 已確認為與已刊登之 panama（合格投資人）條目確實不同之獨立制度，且此一分界本身現已獲多方佐證，非僅為主張：多個第三級來源一致同意，友好國家簽證之法源為 2021 年第 197 號行政命令（2021-05-07 頒布，2021-08-05 生效），核發可轉永久居留之 2 年臨時居留，且廣為引用之 20 萬美元不動產或資金選項數字亦多方一致——惟以上皆僅達第三級（移民顧問網站）；未能取得官方公報原文或巴拿馬移民局頁面。維持排除，待第一級來源確認；此處數字不併入 panama 條目，該條目涵蓋條件不同之另一制度。

excluded.reason_en: Morocco has no statutory 'buy property, get residency' route. Property ownership functions only as a supporting proof-of-address document within the ordinary, discretionary 'Carte de Sejour' (residence card) application process — it is not an independent, threshold-based investment-migration product. One tier-3 source states directly: 'Owning a Moroccan property is not a residency permit. Morocco has no equivalent of Portugal's or Greece's golden visa.' This is an independently confirmed negative; it is filed as excluded rather than moved to `negatives`, consistent with this page's scope classification.
excluded.reason_zh: 摩洛哥並無法定『購屋換居留』制度。不動產持有僅作為一般裁量式『居留證』（Carte de Séjour）申請流程中之住址證明輔助文件——非獨立、以門檻計算之投資移民商品。一則第三級來源直接指出：『持有摩洛哥不動產不是居留許可。摩洛哥沒有相當於葡萄牙或希臘黃金簽證的制度。』此為獨立確認之否定結論；依此頁範疇規則，歸檔於排除清單，未移至 negatives。

excluded.reason_en: The Financially Independent Visa's threshold is a net worth of approximately ZAR 12,000,000, verified by a Chartered Accountant, plus a ZAR 120,000 approval fee. Global assets, including real estate, may count toward the net-worth calculation, but NO minimum real-estate purchase alone grants the permit — one source states this directly: 'It is not a property investment visa: global assets including real estate may count, but no minimum...purchase grants the permit.' The Department of Home Affairs (dha.gov.za) official page was not reached — this remains tier-3 sourced and is disclosed as such.
excluded.reason_zh: 財力獨立簽證門檻約為淨資產 1,200 萬蘭特（南非幣），由執業會計師出具驗資報告，另加 12 萬蘭特核准費。全球資產（含不動產）可計入淨值計算，惟沒有任何最低不動產購置金額本身可單獨換取簽證——一則來源直接指出：『這不是不動產投資簽證：全球資產（含不動產）可計入，惟無任何最低……購置金額可單獨換取許可。』未能取得南非內政部（dha.gov.za）官方頁面——仍僅達第三級來源，如實揭露此點。

This entry should be read as 'checked, still unresolved' rather than 'never looked at.'
excluded.reason_zh: 無法確立，非未查證。經抽查未見任何官方或可信來源描述不動產連結居留制度，惟此僅為針對性搜尋，未完整讀取奈及利亞《移民法》或奈及利亞投資促進委員會（NIPC）之制度框架，亦未直接開啟任何奈及利亞政府官方網域。本筆應理解為『已查但仍未解決』，非『從未查過』。

excluded.reason_en: UNABLE TO ESTABLISH, not merely unresearched. A spot-check found no official or credible source describing a property-linked residency scheme, but no Tunisian government domain (e.g. the investment authority FIPA or the Ministry of Interior) has been directly opened, and Tunisia's investment code has not been read in full. Treat as 'checked, still unresolved.'
excluded.reason_zh: 無法確立，非未查證。經抽查未見任何官方或可信來源描述不動產連結居留制度，惟尚未直接開啟任何突尼西亞政府網域（如投資促進機構 FIPA 或內政部），亦未完整讀取突尼西亞投資法典原文。應理解為『已查但仍未解決』。

excluded.reason_en: UNABLE TO ESTABLISH due to technical access failures, not absence of research. Several tier-3 sources point toward 'no route' — one property-focused site describes only the purchase process itself with no residency linkage, another explicitly separates foreign-ownership rules from residency requirements as unrelated matters, and a golden-visa aggregator states outright that 'Algeria offers no formal citizenship-by-investment programme.' But the primary source that would settle the question, Algeria's investment law (Loi n° 22-18 du 24 juillet 2022), could not be opened — both the UNCTAD investment-law database and the Algerian Ministry of Commerce's own domain (commerce.gov.dz) returned server errors (503/500). A separate 'investisseur' fast-track administrative document referenced on the Prime Minister's site (premier-ministre.gov.dz) could not be opened due to SSL certificate failures on both http and https. A marketing site's claim that an ANDI/AAPI investor residence card is property-linked could not be verified (the site itself returned 403) and is not treated as reliable, as an agency/marketing source.
excluded.reason_zh: 因技術性存取問題無法確立，非未查證。多個第三級來源方向上指向『無途徑』——一個不動產類網站僅描述購屋流程本身，未提及居留權益；另一來源明確將『外國人不動產所有權限制』與『居留要件』列為兩件互不相關之法律事務；一個黃金簽證聚合網站明文表示『阿爾及利亞未提供正式投資入籍計畫』。惟能一錘定音之一手法源——阿爾及利亞現行投資法（2022 年 7 月 24 日第 22-18 號法令）——迄未能開啟：UNCTAD 投資法資料庫與阿爾及利亞商業部官網（commerce.gov.dz）均回傳伺服器錯誤（503/500）。總理府官網（premier-ministre.gov.dz）另引用之『投資者護照』快速通關行政文件，因 SSL 憑證驗證失敗（http／https 皆然）未能開啟。一仲介網站聲稱 ANDI／AAPI 投資者居留卡與不動產掛鉤，因該站本身回傳 403 無法核實，屬仲介來源，不予採信。

excluded.reason_en: UNABLE TO ESTABLISH due to technical access failures, but the evidence trend is stronger toward 'no route' than Algeria's. Le Soleil, Senegal's national daily of record (not a commercial immigration site), reported on the new 2025 Investment Code and its fiscal incentives — import/local-purchase duty exemptions, a 3-year customs holiday in Dakar/Thiès and a 5-year holiday elsewhere, a 10-working-day single-window process — with no mention anywhere of a residence permit, an investor-status card, or real estate. The primary legal text (Loi n° 2025-16, Code des Investissements 2025) was located at the national legislative portal but has not been read in full, and APIX (the Senegalese investment promotion agency)'s official PDF could not be retrieved due to a DNS resolution failure on investinsenegal.sn.
